articles.title: YunLone Galaxy star projector review — a sub-$30 customizable night light
articles.author: Kim Snaith

paras.en: Coming complete with a smartphone app, the YunLone Galaxy Projector can project just about any color combination you can think of onto the ceiling. It has a built-in Bluetooth speaker, too, offering all-around relaxation and an ambience setting.
paras.zh: Coming complete with a smartphone app, the YunLone Galaxy Projector can project just about any color combination you can think of onto the ceiling.它还具有内置蓝牙扬声器，提供全方位的放松和氛围设置。

paras.en: Why you can trust Space.com Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about how we test and review products.
paras.zh: 为什么您可以信任 Space.com 我们的专家评审员花费大量时间测试和比较产品和服务，以便您可以选择最适合您的产品和服务。详细了解我们如何测试和审查产品。

paras.en: The YunLone Galaxy Projector is an inexpensive but effective way to bring the marvel of space into your living room or bedroom. Costing around $28, this star projector can display beautiful dancing auroras across your walls and ceiling, and thanks to app support, a huge range of color options are available. In fact, the color combinations you can display here are almost infinite.
paras.zh: YunLone Galaxy 投影仪是一种廉价但有效的方式，可以将空间的奇迹带入您的客厅或卧室。这款明星投影仪售价约为 28 美元，可以在墙壁和天花板上显示美丽的舞动极光，并且由于应用程序的支持，可以提供多种颜色选择。事实上，您可以在这里显示的颜色组合几乎是无限的。

paras.en: - Size: 3.54 x 3.15 x 4.72 inches (9 x 8 x 12 cm)

With built-in sounds, a Bluetooth speaker and endless customization options, this really is an all-singing, all-dancing star projector. We're amazed at just how much is loaded into this package for such a low price. It's surprisingly good quality, too, with the unit itself being sturdy and made out of hard-wearing plastic.
paras.zh: 凭借内置声音、蓝牙扬声器和无尽的定制选项，这确实是一款能歌善舞的明星投影机。我们惊讶于这个包裹以如此低的价格装入了如此多的东西。它的质量也令人惊讶，该装置本身坚固且由耐磨塑料制成。

paras.en: This isn't a scientific star projector, of course. For that, we'd recommend the Sega Toys Homestar Classic or the Hommkiety Galaxy Projector. But even though the YunLone Galaxy Projector won't give you an accurate view of the Northern Hemisphere's night sky or a close-up of the moon, it's still a projector we recommend. If you're looking to create a relaxing atmosphere, it's one of the best star projectors we've reviewed.
paras.zh: 当然，这不是科学的星空投影仪。为此，我们推荐 Sega Toys Homestar Classic 或 Hommkiety Galaxy 投影仪。尽管云龙银河投影仪无法为您提供北半球夜空或月亮特写的准确视图，但它仍然是我们推荐的投影仪。如果您想营造轻松的氛围，它是我们评测过的最好的明星投影机之一。

paras.en: - Functional rather than aesthetic design
paras.zh: - 功能性而非美学设计

paras.en: - Limited buttons on the front of the unit
paras.zh: - 设备正面的按钮有限

paras.en: The YunLone Galaxy Projector doesn't have the most attractive design: It's clearly built for functionality rather than aesthetics. If an aesthetically pleasing projector unit is what you're looking for, perhaps consider the Jiawen Galaxy Projector Light. You won't find nearly as many functions as the YunLone Galaxy Projector packs in, however.
paras.zh: YunLone Galaxy投影仪没有最吸引人的设计：它显然是为了功能而不是美观而设计的。如果您正在寻找一款美观的投影仪，不妨考虑一下嘉文银河投影灯。然而，您不会发现与 YunLone Galaxy 投影仪一样多的功能。

paras.en: That isn't to say that the YunLone Galaxy Projector is ugly, though. The design is basic, with a circular shape that houses a clear globe in the middle that acts as the projector. It sits on rubberized feet, so it doesn't easily slip or move around, and it's naturally tilted, so it points slightly diagonally rather than straight up. Given the wide reach of the projector, it helps spread the aurora lights across your entire room.
paras.zh: 但这并不是说云龙银河投影仪很丑。该设计很基本，呈圆形，中间有一个透明的地球仪，充当投影仪。它位于橡胶脚上，因此不易滑动或移动，并且它自然倾斜，因此它稍微倾斜而不是笔直向上。鉴于投影仪的覆盖范围很广，它有助于将极光照射到整个房间。

paras.en: The projector has a solid build quality: It's plastic but feels sturdy and well-made. If you're buying for a child's bedroom, you don't need to worry about little hands being too rough when using it. Those rubber feet help prevent it from being knocked off a desk or bedside table, too.
paras.zh: 该投影机具有坚固的构造质量：它是塑料的，但感觉坚固且做工精良。如果您是为孩子的卧室购买，则无需担心小手使用时太粗糙。这些橡胶脚也有助于防止它从桌子或床头柜上掉落。

paras.en: As already mentioned, the YunLone Galaxy Projector isn't a scientific star projector. If you want to recreate actual constellations and close-ups of planets on your bedroom ceiling, this is not the projector for you. But if you're looking for beautiful, mesmerizing aurora-style patterns, it's a great choice.
paras.zh: 正如已经提到的，云龙银河投影仪不是一个科学的星空投影仪。如果您想在卧室天花板上重现实际的星座和行星特写，那么这台投影机不适合您。但如果您正在寻找美丽、迷人的极光风格图案，那么它是一个不错的选择。

paras.en: Once you're connected to the app, you can control exactly what colors the projector displays. Not only can you choose from a number of preset arrangements — labeled as seasons, colors or holidays, so you can create a mood that matches the time of year or how you feel — but you can set your own entire color scheme by choosing from a color wheel. You can also set the brightness, whether the lights will have a "breathing" effect, and how fast they ripple across your ceiling.
paras.zh: 连接到应用程序后，您可以准确控制投影仪显示的颜色。您不仅可以从多种预设排列中进行选择（标记为季节、颜色或假期，这样您就可以创造出与一年中的时间或您的感受相匹配的心情），而且您可以通过从色轮中进行选择来设置您自己的整个配色方案。您还可以设置亮度、灯光是否具有“呼吸”效果以及它们在天花板上波纹的速度。

paras.en: It's a very neat touch, and it goes beyond what we'd expect to find in a star projector in this price range. If you don't want to bother with app connection, you can still set a range of colors and options from the remote control, but the options here are more limited.
paras.zh: 这是一种非常简洁的触感，超出了我们对这个价格范围内的明星投影机的期望。如果您不想打扰应用程序连接，您仍然可以通过遥控器设置一系列颜色和选项，但此处的选项更加有限。

paras.en: The YunLone Galaxy Projector comes equipped with a laser, so it can project green laser stars onto your walls and ceiling. We didn't love the look of these, though, so it's good that you can turn them off independently of the aurora lights. You can also change the laser's brightness if you'd like the stars to appear dimmer.
paras.zh: YunLone Galaxy 投影仪配备激光器，因此它可以将绿色激光星星投射到您的墙壁和天花板上。不过，我们不喜欢它们的外观，所以最好您可以独立于极光灯将它们关闭。如果您希望星星显得更暗，您还可以更改激光的亮度。

paras.en: Both the laser stars and the aurora projections have a very wide reach, covering most of the walls and ceiling of the bedroom we tested the unit in. Obviously, this will vary depending on the size of your room and how far away from the ceiling/wall you place the unit, but we were pleasantly surprised by the coverage offered by this projector.
paras.zh: 激光星光和极光投影的覆盖范围都非常广，覆盖了我们测试该设备的卧室的大部分墙壁和天花板。显然，这将根据您的房间大小以及您放置设备的天花板/墙壁的距离而有所不同，但我们对这台投影机提供的覆盖范围感到惊喜。

paras.en: - Speaker with preset sounds and Bluetooth
paras.zh: - 具有预设声音和蓝牙功能的扬声器

paras.en: The YunLone Galaxy Projector has a companion app that can be downloaded onto an Android or Apple smartphone. Once the app is set up and paired with your unit, you have full control over the colors, speed and brightness of your projections.
paras.zh: YunLone Galaxy 投影仪有一个配套应用程序，可以下载到 Android 或 Apple 智能手机上。一旦应用程序设置完毕并与您的设备配对，您就可以完全控制投影的颜色、速度和亮度。

paras.en: The pairing process isn't entirely straightforward, however, with no simple way of forcing the projector to enter pairing mode. The instructions tell you to quickly turn the unit on and off three times, but it took several attempts before we successfully put the projector into pairing mode.
paras.zh: 然而，配对过程并不完全简单，没有简单的方法强制投影仪进入配对模式。说明告诉您快速打开和关闭设备三次，但我们尝试了几次才成功将投影机置于配对模式。

paras.en: Thankfully, once that's done, it should stay paired with your smartphone permanently so you won't have to repeat the process. And the app itself is very easy to use, working seamlessly to change the colors of the projection unit.
paras.zh: 值得庆幸的是，一旦完成，它应该与您的智能手机永久保持配对，这样您就不必重复此过程。该应用程序本身非常易于使用，可以无缝地更改投影单元的颜色。

paras.en: The bundled remote control (which requires two AAA batteries, not included) is a little more complex than most, offering a range of buttons to control both the built-in speaker and the light itself. We'd highly recommend opting for the app option as it gives you much better control over the unit, but if your smartphone is unavailable, you can at least set basic color and speed with the remote.
paras.zh: 捆绑的遥控器（需要两节 AAA 电池，不包含在供货范围内）比大多数遥控器稍微复杂一些，提供了一系列按钮来控制内置扬声器和灯本身。我们强烈建议选择应用程序选项，因为它可以让您更好地控制设备，但如果您的智能手机不可用，您至少可以使用遥控器设置基本颜色和速度。

paras.en: You can connect a music player to the projector via Bluetooth to play your own audio through its built-in speaker. The quality is decent rather than outstanding: It obviously doesn't match the sound of a specialist speaker, but it's as good as we'd expect any $28 speaker to be. It lacks the bass that music requires to sound "complete" but will be ideal for listening to audiobooks and podcasts.
paras.zh: 您可以通过蓝牙将音乐播放器连接到投影仪，通过其内置扬声器播放您自己的音频。质量还算不错，而不是出色：它显然无法与专业扬声器的声音相媲美，但它与我们期望的 28 美元扬声器一样好。它缺乏音乐听起来“完整”所需的低音，但非常适合听有声读物和播客。

paras.en: In a neat touch, the YunLone Galaxy Projector also has eight built-in sound effects, including white noise, waves, lullabies and a storm, which some users may find relaxing and good to fall asleep to.
paras.zh: 云龙银河投影仪还内置了八种音效，包括白噪音、海浪、摇篮曲和暴风雨，一些用户可能会觉得这些音效很放松，很容易入睡。

paras.en: Should I buy the YunLone Galaxy Projector?
paras.zh: 我应该购买云龙银河投影仪吗？

paras.en: We have been thoroughly impressed with what the YunLone Galaxy Projector offers. Its projections are beautiful auroras that dance across your ceiling, and the ability to fully customize the color and speed is something that we really didn't expect to find at a $28 price point.
paras.zh: YunLone Galaxy 投影仪的功能给我们留下了深刻的印象。它的投影是美丽的极光，在天花板上翩翩起舞，完全定制颜色和速度的能力是我们真正没想到的 28 美元的价位。

paras.en: If you're on a budget and looking for a non-scientific projector to use to relax and unwind with, we really don't think you can find a better unit. If, however, you want something that offers more scientific projections, you'll need to look elsewhere.
paras.zh: 如果您的预算有限，并且正在寻找一台非科学投影仪来放松身心，我们真的认为您找不到更好的设备。然而，如果您想要提供更科学预测的东西，您需要寻找其他地方。

paras.en: Sega Toys' range of projectors, including the Homestar Flux and the Homestar Classic, is excellent but comes with a much bigger price tag. The Hommkiety Galaxy Projector is worth considering too, offering realistic projections but with a price tag closer to $50.
paras.zh: Sega Toys 的投影仪系列（包括 Homestar Flux 和 Homestar Classic）非常出色，但价格却要高得多。 Hommkiety Galaxy 投影仪也值得考虑，它提供逼真的投影，但价格接近 50 美元。

paras.en: The good thing about these projectors is that they come with interchangeable discs, able to display various images of space. The Hommkiety Galaxy Projector has several discs in the box, but you'll need to buy extra discs for the Sega Toys range, so that’s an extra cost to factor in.
paras.zh: 这些投影仪的好处是它们配有可互换的光盘，能够显示各种空间图像。 Hommkiety Galaxy 投影仪的包装盒中有几张光盘，但您需要为 Sega Toys 系列购买额外的光盘，因此需要考虑额外的成本。

paras.en: Kim is a Yorkshire-based freelance writer who focuses on Lego and video game-related content. She's the co-creator of GameSpew.com and ThatBrickSite.com, where you'll find most of her work. If she's not building with plastic bricks, playing a video game, or writing about doing either of those things, you should probably check she's still breathing. You can find her on Twitter at @ichangedmyname.
paras.zh: Kim 是约克郡的自由撰稿人，专注于乐高和视频游戏相关内容。她是 GameSpew.com 和 ThatBrickSite.com 的共同创建者，您可以在其中找到她的大部分作品。如果她没有用塑料积木搭建、玩电子游戏或写关于做这些事情的文章，你可能应该检查她是否还在呼吸。您可以在 Twitter 上找到她：@ichangedmyname。

paras.zh: 评论前您必须确认您的公开显示名称

articles.title: 1st-ever detection of a dying star's 'final nuclear heartbeat' challenges what we know about our sun's eventual death
articles.author: Robert Lea

paras.en: As ubiquitous as the sun is to us today, our star is not eternal; one day, albeit in billions of years, it will die. While massive stars die in supernova explosions, the sun and stars of similar mass die quieter deaths. But that doesn't mean these stars completely go out with a whimper.
paras.zh: 尽管今天太阳对我们来说无处不在，但我们的星星并不是永恒的。有一天，尽管需要数十亿年，它也会消亡。虽然大质量恒星在超新星爆炸中死亡，但太阳和类似质量的恒星的死亡却更为安静。但这并不意味着这些明星就彻底黯然离场。

paras.en: New observations collected using the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA), the world's largest radio telescope comprised of 66 antennas in northern Chile, reveal that the sun's death throes may be different from what scientists had initially believed.
paras.zh: 使用位于智利北部的阿塔卡马大型毫米/亚毫米阵列 (ALMA)（世界上最大的射电望远镜，由 66 个天线组成）收集的新观测结果表明，太阳的垂死挣扎可能与科学家最初认为的不同。

paras.en: NASA Jet Propulsion Lab (JPL) researcher Raghvendra Sahai, who led the investigation, explained the shape the ALMA observations took: "It's essentially a physical snapshot of an event that, until now, we've mostly inferred from theoretical models. We've caught, for the first time, a star's final nuclear heartbeat, frozen in gas."
paras.zh: 领导这项调查的美国宇航局喷气推进实验室 (JPL) 研究员拉格文德拉·萨海 (Raghvendra Sahai) 解释了 ALMA 观测结果：“这本质上是一个事件的物理快照，到目前为止，我们主要是从理论模型中推断出来的。我们第一次捕捉到了一颗冻结在气体中的恒星最后的核心跳。”

paras.en: Sun-like stars "die" when they run out of hydrogen in their cores. This means that the fusion of hydrogen to helium ceases in the stellar core, and because this nuclear process is a star's main energy source, the star no longer has the outward push to support itself against the inward push of its own gravity.
paras.zh: 当类太阳恒星核心中的氢耗尽时，它们就会“死亡”。这意味着氢与氦的聚变在恒星核心停止，并且由于该核过程是恒星的主要能源，恒星不再具有向外的推力来支撑自身以抵抗自身引力的向内推力。

paras.en: As the star's core collapses to create a stellar remnant called a white dwarf, the outer layers where hydrogen is still fusing to form helium swell out. This expansion leads to a relatively short-lived "red giant" phase. Eventually, these outer layers will cool and disperse, leaving the central white dwarf surrounded by a so-called "planetary nebula" shell of debris.
paras.zh: 当恒星的核心塌缩形成称为白矮星的恒星残余物时，氢仍在融合形成氦的外层就会膨胀出来。这种扩张导致了相对短暂的“红巨星”阶段。最终，这些外层将冷却并消散，使中央白矮星被所谓的“行星状星云”碎片壳包围。

paras.en: During the red giant phase, as the stellar core is surrounded by shells of hydrogen and helium, these layers are occasionally rocked by flares in nuclear activity called thermal pulses. During these episodes, stellar material is flung into space.
paras.zh: 在红巨星阶段，由于恒星核心被氢和氦壳包围，这些层偶尔会受到核活动中称为热脉冲的耀斑的摇动。在这些事件中，恒星物质被抛入太空。

paras.en: To better understand this phase in stellar evolution, the team focused ALMA on a star called IRAS 06530-0213, located around 12,000 light-years away in the constellation Monoceros. This revealed a giant ring of gas that appears to be a frozen fossil of the star's last thermonuclear flare-up. This thermonuclear fossil rings an hourglass-shaped planetary nebula in the act of forming.
paras.zh: 为了更好地了解恒星演化的这一阶段，研究小组将 ALMA 聚焦于一颗名为 IRAS 06530-0213 的恒星，该恒星位于距我们约 12,000 光年的麒麟座中。这揭示了一个巨大的气体环，它似乎是恒星最后一次热核爆发的冰冻化石。这种热核化石围绕着正在形成的沙漏状行星状星云。

paras.en: "Most of us think of stars as unchanging points of light, but this is a real-time snapshot of a star's death throes," Sahai said. "It's the brief, violent transition between a bloated red giant and a glowing planetary nebula, frozen mid-action."
paras.zh: “我们大多数人都认为恒星是不变的光点，但这是恒星垂死挣扎的实时快照，”萨海说。 “这是一个膨胀的红巨星和一个发光的行星状星云之间短暂而剧烈的转变，在行动中冻结。”

paras.en: The team was able to determine that this gas shell of IRAS 06530-0213 is around half a light-year wide and was ejected into space around 6,500 years ago. It represents the first direct evidence of the last thermal pulse before this kind of star enters the final phase of its life.
paras.zh: 研究小组确定 IRAS 06530-0213 的气体壳大约有半光年宽，大约在 6,500 年前被喷射到太空中。它代表了此类恒星进入其生命最后阶段之前最后一次热脉冲的第一个直接证据。

paras.en: The team thinks that for around 2,000 years after the pulse, the star lost mass at a lower rate. This mass loss then increased sharply over the following 1,000 years. This led to the creation of a lumpy shell of gas now seen as a tangle of material filaments around the dying star. The fact that these filaments have a spiral shape could indicate that IRAS 06530-0213 has an unseen partner orbiting it, stirring the gas.
paras.zh: 研究小组认为，在脉冲发生后大约 2000 年里，恒星的质量损失速度较低。在接下来的 1000 年里，质量损失急剧增加。这导致了块状气体壳的形成，现在被视为垂死恒星周围的物质细丝缠结。这些细丝具有螺旋形状，这一事实可能表明 IRAS 06530-0213 有一个看不见的伙伴绕其运行，搅拌着气体。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the hourglass-shaped nebula immediately around the star began to take shape around 700 years ago, meaning that the red giant phase for IRAS 06530-0213 only ended very recently, in cosmic terms at least.
paras.zh: 与此同时，紧邻恒星周围的沙漏状星云在大约 700 年前开始形成，这意味着 IRAS 06530-0213 的红巨星阶段直到最近才结束，至少从宇宙角度来看是这样。

paras.en: There are also unexpected elements to the ALMA observations of IRAS 06530-0213.
paras.zh: IRAS 06530-0213 的 ALMA 观测结果也存在意想不到的因素。

paras.en: The team discovered an unexpected abundance of heavy versions, or isotopes, of elements like carbon, oxygen and nitrogen around IRAS 06530-0213.
paras.zh: 研究小组在 IRAS 06530-0213 周围发现了意想不到的大量碳、氧和氮等元素的重版本或同位素。

paras.en: This doesn't conform to models of how stars like IRAS 06530-0213 forge elements and mix them into their surroundings, though similar signatures have been seen around odd stellar objects, with violent bursts of nuclear fusion thought to be the cause.
paras.zh: 这并不符合像 IRAS 06530-0213 这样的恒星如何锻造元素并将它们混合到周围环境的模型，尽管在奇怪的恒星物体周围也发现了类似的特征，而剧烈的核聚变爆发被认为是其原因。

paras.en: As well as seeing something unexpected, the researchers didn't detect something they expected to observe.
paras.zh: 除了看到一些意想不到的东西之外，研究人员也没有发现他们期望观察到的东西。

paras.en: Dying stars like IRAS 06530-0213 have previously been known to have companions, typically sitting with them inside compact disks of dust. These disks are indirect evidence of material being dragged from the close companion star to the dying star. This is a process scientists have used to explain jet-sculpted hourglass shapes.
paras.zh: 此前已知像 IRAS 06530-0213 这样的垂死恒星有伴星，通常与它们一起坐在尘埃光盘中。这些圆盘是物质被从近距离伴星拖到垂死恒星的间接证据。科学家们用这个过程来解释喷射雕刻的沙漏形状。

paras.en: However, ALMA failed to detect such disk around IRAS 06530. The team suggests that this could be because a disk existed, albeit briefly, during which time it powered a short burst of high-speed jets that helped sculpt the hourglass, following this the disk simply faded away.
paras.zh: 然而，ALMA 未能在 IRAS 06530 周围检测到这样的圆盘。研究小组认为，这可能是因为圆盘存在，尽管时间很短，在此期间它为短暂的高速喷流提供动力，帮助塑造了沙漏，随后圆盘就消失了。

paras.en: "Dying stars so often have hidden companions that reshape their ejected material into intricate, bipolar or multipolar forms instead of simple spheres," Sahai concluded. "IRAS 06530 shows that the story is more complicated than the tidy explanation we've been using."
paras.zh: 萨海总结道：“垂死的恒星经常有隐藏的伴星，它们将喷射出的物质重塑成复杂的、双极或多极的形式，而不是简单的球体。” “IRAS 06530 表明，这个故事比我们一直使用的简洁解释更为复杂。”

paras.en: The team's research was published on Friday (Nov. 20) in The Astrophysical Journal.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究成果于周五（11 月 20 日）发表在《天体物理学杂志》上。

paras.en: Robert Lea is a science journalist in the U.K. whose articles have been published in Physics World, New Scientist, Astronomy Magazine, All About Space, Newsweek and ZME Science. He also writes about science communication for Elsevier and the European Journal of Physics. Rob holds a bachelor of science degree in physics and astronomy from the U.K.’s Open University. Follow him on Twitter @sciencef1rst.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·李 (Robert Lea) 是一位英国科学记者，其文章发表在《物理世界》、《新科学家》、《天文学杂志》、《All About Space》、《新闻周刊》和《ZME Science》上。他还为爱思唯尔和《欧洲物理学杂志》撰写有关科学传播的文章。 Rob 拥有英国开放大学物理和天文学理学学士学位。在 Twitter 上关注他@sciencef1rst。

articles.title: SpaceNukes Opens Los Alamos Manufacture and Materials Facility to Build Its Next-Generation Space Reactor
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M., Nov. 16, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) opened its Manufacture and Materials Development Facility at 150 Central Park Square in Los Alamos on Nov. 13. The facility is dedicated to manufacture and materials development for the company’s Generation 2 reactor, including additive manufacturing of nickel-based and refractory alloys. No radioactive material is handled in the facility.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，2026 年 11 月 16 日 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) 于 11 月 13 日在洛斯阿拉莫斯中央公园广场 150 号开设了制造和材料开发设施。该设施致力于该公司第二代反应堆的制造和材料开发，包括镍基和耐火合金的增材制造。该设施内不处理任何放射性物质。

paras.en: SpaceNukes’ next-generation reactor is designed to run much hotter. A hotter reactor needs a much smaller radiator, which makes up most of the mass of a space fission power system. Raising the temperature at which heat is rejected lets the same-size radiator shed roughly six times as much heat. The limit is not the nuclear physics but the materials. Today’s power conversion hardware already sits at the edge of what nickel-based superalloys tolerate over a long mission, so going hotter means moving to refractory alloys of tungsten, molybdenum, tantalum, rhenium and niobium. These metals are difficult to form, and many of the component shapes and materials SpaceNukes needs cannot be bought from any supplier.
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 的下一代反应堆设计为运行温度更高。更热的反应堆需要更小的散热器，它构成了空间裂变动力系统的大部分质量。提高散热温度可以让相同尺寸的散热器散发出大约六倍的热量。限制不是核物理而是材料。当今的电力转换硬件已经处于镍基高温合金长期任务承受能力的边缘，因此变得更热意味着转向钨、钼、钽、铼和铌的难熔合金。这些金属很难成型，而且 SpaceNukes 所需的许多部件形状和材料无法从任何供应商处购买。

paras.en: “Our next-generation reactor is a bet on temperature,” said Andrew Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “What stands between us and that is not the nuclear physics. The physics is in good shape, and it was proven in 2018. The limit is metal. Our next reactor is a materials and manufacturing challenge before it is a reactor problem, and that is what this building is for.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps) 表示：“我们的下一代反应堆押注于温度。” “阻碍我们的不是核物理学。物理学状况良好，并在 2018 年得到了证明。限制是金属。我们的下一个反应堆在成为反应堆问题之前首先是材料和制造挑战，而这就是这座建筑的用途。”

paras.en: The facility is led by Omar Mireles, director of manufacture and materials, who heads the Generation 2 program. Mireles spent 13 years as a research engineer and principal investigator at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center, where he led the $25 million Refractory Alloy Additive Manufacturing Build Optimization project.
paras.zh: 该工厂由制造和材料总监 Omar Mireles 领导，他也是第二代项目的负责人。 Mireles 在 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心担任了 13 年的研究工程师和首席研究员，领导了价值 2500 万美元的耐火合金增材制造构建优化项目。

paras.en: “Additive manufacturing is used only for specific circumstances,” Mireles said. “You have parts that are highly complex, made from materials that are difficult to form, have a low production rate that won’t benefit from economy of scale, and have the design flexibility that can optimize designs to the manufacturing process. These lessons were learned over the last two decades in the liquid rocket engine community, and we are applying them to the needs of SpaceNukes, which have very similar conditions. We are manufacturing aerospace components at aerospace-quality standards. This building is where we learn to make them.”
paras.zh: “增材制造仅用于特定情况，”米雷莱斯说。 “零件高度复杂，由难以成型的材料制成，生产率低，无法从规模经济中受益，并且具有可以优化制造过程设计的设计灵活性。这些经验教训是液体火箭发动机界在过去二十年中吸取的经验教训，我们正在将它们应用于具有非常相似条件的 SpaceNukes 的需求。我们正在按照航空航天质量标准制造航空航天部件。这座建筑是我们学习制造它们的地方。”

paras.en: The Los Alamos facility complements SpaceNukes’ integration and test facility in Medina, Ohio, led by chief engineer Marc Gibson. SpaceNukes is now building hardware to test components for its Generation 2 reactors at the Ohio facility.
paras.zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯工厂补充了 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的集成和测试工厂，该工厂由总工程师马克·吉布森 (Marc Gibson) 领导。 SpaceNukes 目前正在俄亥俄州工厂建造硬件来测试其第二代反应堆的组件。

paras.en: The grand opening featured remarks from Phelps and Mireles, a ribbon cutting and tours of the new facility. Guests included staff from the office of Sen. Martin Heinrich, D-N.M.; Los Alamos National Laboratory and its Feynman Center for Innovation; the Los Alamos County Council; the Los Alamos County Community Development Department; the Los Alamos Commerce & Development Corp.; the Los Alamos Chamber of Commerce; Century Bank; Merrill Lynch; and space industry partners.
paras.zh: 菲尔普斯和米雷莱斯在盛大的开幕式上致辞，并剪彩并参观了新设施。嘉宾包括新墨西哥州民主党参议员马丁·海因里希 (Martin Heinrich) 办公室的工作人员；洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室及其费曼创新中心；洛斯阿拉莫斯县议会；洛斯阿拉莫斯县社区发展部；洛斯阿拉莫斯商业发展公司；洛斯阿拉莫斯商会；世纪银行；美林；以及航天工业合作伙伴。

paras.en: The facility opening follows SpaceNukes’ Oct. 21 announcement of an agreement with the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, under its Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program, to design, build and ground-test an actively controlled Kilopower reactor with Los Alamos National Laboratory. It comes as SpaceNukes works to fly a nuclear reactor by 2028.
paras.zh: 该设施开业之前，SpaceNukes 于 10 月 21 日宣布与国防高级研究计划局达成协议，根据其快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划，与洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室一起设计、建造和地面测试主动控制 Kilopower 反应堆。 SpaceNukes 正致力于在 2028 年之前飞行一座核反应堆。

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) builds nuclear reactors that power missions in space for government and commercial clients. In March 2018, the team that is now SpaceNukes ran a space reactor at full temperature and power for 28 hours, and it performed as predicted. It was the first time this had been done in the United States in 50 years. The team took it from concept to full power in three years for less than $20 million. Today, SpaceNukes has roughly 15 full-time employees, more than $50 million in contracts and agreements with the Department of War and NASA, two completed Space Force design reviews and a Los Alamos National Laboratory license for the reactor technology its founders invented there. Space Nuclear Power Corp., headquartered in Los Alamos, New Mexico, is committed to delivering safe, affordable, reliable nuclear power wherever people and machines go in space.
paras.zh: 太空核动力公司 (SpaceNukes) 建造核反应堆，为政府和商业客户的太空任务提供动力。 2018 年 3 月，SpaceNukes 团队在全温度和全功率下运行了一个空间反应堆 28 小时，其性能符合预期。这是美国 50 年来首次这样做。该团队用了不到 2000 万美元的时间，在三年内将其从概念转变为全面发挥作用。如今，SpaceNukes 拥有大约 15 名全职员工，与战争部和 NASA 签订了价值超过 5000 万美元的合同和协议，完成了两项太空部队设计审查，并为其创始人在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室发明的反应堆技术获得了许可证。太空核电公司总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，致力于为人类和机器进入太空的任何地方提供安全、负担得起、可靠的核电。

paras.en: Andrew Phelps, CEO, Space Nuclear Power Corp.
paras.zh: 安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps)，太空核电公司首席执行官

articles.title: Cosmo Bee to flight-test Honeybee Hall thruster with D-Orbit in 2027
articles.author: Cosmo Bee

paras.en: Daejeon, Republic of Korea – October 14, 2026: South Korean space electric propulsion startup Cosmo Bee plans to conduct an in-orbit flight test of its 10 mN-class Honeybee Hall thruster system in October 2027 through a service agreement with D-Orbit.
paras.zh: 韩国大田 – 2026 年 10 月 14 日：韩国太空电力推进初创公司 Cosmo Bee 计划通过与 D-Orbit 签订的服务协议，于 2027 年 10 月对其 10 mN 级 Honeybee Hall 推进器系统进行在轨飞行测试。

paras.en: Honeybee is a 10 mN-class Hall thruster system under development by Cosmo Bee for small satellites operating in LEO constellations.
paras.zh: Honeybee 是 Cosmo Bee 正在为在 LEO 星座运行的小型卫星开发的 10 mN 级霍尔推进器系统。

paras.en: “In-orbit validation is an essential step as we prepare to bring Honeybee to the commercial market,” said Dongha Park, co-founder and CEO of Cosmo Bee. “D-Orbit is an ideal partner to help us achieve that goal.”
paras.zh: Cosmo Bee 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Dongha Park 表示：“在轨验证是我们准备将 Honeybee 推向商业市场的重要一步。” “D-Orbit 是帮助我们实现这一目标的理想合作伙伴。”

paras.en: “Hosting in-orbit demonstrations is one of the core services we offer aboard ION,” said Matteo Lorenzoni, Director of the Orbital Access Business Unit at D-Orbit. “Honeybee will operate in the real space environment, with our mission operations team supporting the test throughout, so Cosmo Bee comes away with the performance data it needs to take the thruster to market.” This test will evaluate Honeybee’s key performance parameters, including thrust and specific impulse, under various operating conditions.
paras.zh: “举办在轨演示是我们在 ION 上提供的核心服务之一，”D-Orbit 轨道接入业务部总监 Matteo Lorenzoni 说道。 “Honeybee 将在真实的太空环境中运行，我们的任务运营团队全程支持测试，因此 Cosmo Bee 可以获得将推进器推向市场所需的性能数据。”该测试将评估 Honeybee 在各种操作条件下的关键性能参数，包括推力和比冲量。

paras.en: “For satellite operators choosing a propulsion system, flight heritage is often what decides the purchase”, commented Matteo Zeni, Head of Sales of D-Orbit’s Orbital Access Business Unit. “Our in-orbit demonstration service gives technology developers like Cosmo Bee a direct route to space and the data they need to move from qualification to a commercial product. We look forward to flying Honeybee next year.”
paras.zh: “对于选择推进系统的卫星运营商来说，飞行传统往往是决定购买的因素”，D-Orbit 轨道接入业务部销售主管 Matteo Zeni 评论道。 “我们的在轨演示服务为 Cosmo Bee 等技术开发人员提供了直接进入太空的途径，以及他们从资格认证转向商业产品所需的数据。我们期待明年让 Honeybee 飞行。”

paras.en: Through the partnership, Cosmo Bee plans to establish flight heritage for Honeybee while preparing for the system’s commercial introduction in 2027. The company intends to make Honeybee available to satellite operators and mission developers seeking electric propulsion systems for small spacecraft.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Cosmo Bee 计划为 Honeybee 建立飞行遗产，同时为 2027 年该系统的商业推出做准备。该公司打算将 Honeybee 提供给卫星运营商和寻求小型航天器电力推进系统的任务开发商。

paras.en: Cosmo Bee was founded in July 2023 as a spin-off from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), building on electric propulsion research conducted by Professor Wonho Choe’s team since 2003.
paras.zh: Cosmo Bee 成立于 2023 年 7 月，是韩国科学技术院 (KAIST) 的一个衍生公司，其基础是 Wonho Choe 教授团队自 2003 年以来进行的电力推进研究。

paras.en: In November 2025, the company launched its first space mission, K-HERO, a 3U CubeSat designed to demonstrate the operation of a 150 W-class Hall thruster in orbit. The spacecraft was launched aboard South Korea’s KSLV-2 launch vehicle.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月，该公司发射了其首次太空任务 K-HERO，这是一颗 3U 立方体卫星，旨在演示 150 W 级霍尔推进器在轨道上的运行。该航天器是由韩国的 KSLV-2 运载火箭发射升空的。

paras.en: In June 2026, the Korea AeroSpace Administration (KASA) designated Cosmo Bee’s 10 mN-class Hall thruster and hollow cathode technologies as “New Space Technologies.” The company also raised $5 million in a Series A funding round that month.
paras.zh: 2026 年 6 月，韩国宇宙航空管理局 (KASA) 将 Cosmo Bee 的 10 mN 级霍尔推进器和空心阴极技术指定为“新空间技术”。该公司还在当月的 A 轮融资中筹集了 500 万美元。

paras.en: “Cosmo Bee is growing alongside the rapidly expanding demand for LEO satellite constellations in South Korea,” Park said. “We hope Honeybee can support customers developing the next generation of small satellite constellations.”
paras.zh: Park 表示：“随着韩国对 LEO 卫星星座需求的快速增长，Cosmo Bee 也在不断发展。” “我们希望 Honeybee 能够支持客户开发下一代小型卫星星座。”

articles.title: Flexell Space and ALATYR Sign MoU to Explore Solar Power Solutions for Orbital Data Centers
articles.author: Flexell Space

paras.en: – Collaboration to assess next-generation ultralight solar cells for space-based computing infrastructure
paras.zh: – 合作评估用于天基计算基础设施的下一代超轻太阳能电池

paras.en: – Partnership brings together Korean space energy technology and French orbital infrastructure expertise
paras.zh: – 合作伙伴关系汇集了韩国空间能源技术和法国轨道基础设施专业知识

paras.en: Bremen, Germany – Flexell Space, a space energy company, announced that it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with ALATYR, a French company developing orbital data centers, to explore solar power solutions for space-based computing infrastructure.
paras.zh: 德国不来梅 – 空间能源公司 Flexell Space 宣布与开发轨道数据中心的法国公司 ALATYR 签署了一份谅解备忘录 (MoU)，共同探索用于天基计算基础设施的太阳能解决方案。

paras.en: The collaboration will assess the potential application of Flexell Space’s next-generation solar cell technology to orbital infrastructure designed for large-scale computing and data storage. The companies intend to exchange technical requirements relating to power demand and operating conditions and explore opportunities for future joint development and validation.
paras.zh: 此次合作将评估 Flexell Space 的下一代太阳能电池技术在专为大规模计算和数据存储而设计的轨道基础设施中的潜在应用。两家公司打算交换有关电力需求和运行条件的技术要求，并探索未来联合开发和验证的机会。

paras.en: ALATYR develops orbital data centers designed to support artificial intelligence (AI) computing and mission-critical workloads. Its CITADEL modular infrastructure architecture and BYLD robotic system are designed to enable assembly, maintenance, and upgrades in orbit. The architecture separates the service life of the supporting infrastructure from the replacement cycle of computing hardware, enabling computing modules to be renewed in orbit while retaining the infrastructure that powers, cools, and supports them.
paras.zh: ALATYR 开发轨道数据中心，旨在支持人工智能 (AI) 计算和关键任务工作负载。其 CITADEL 模块化基础设施架构和 BYLD 机器人系统旨在实现在轨组装、维护和升级。该架构将支持基础设施的使用寿命与计算硬件的更换周期分开，使计算模块能够在轨道上更新，同时保留为其供电、冷却和支持的基础设施。

paras.en: Reliable power generation is essential to making orbital data centers viable. As these facilities grow, solar power systems must address not only electrical performance but also mass, launch and deployment efficiency, manufacturing costs, and long-term reliability.
paras.zh: 可靠的发电对于轨道数据中心的可行性至关重要。随着这些设施的发展，太阳能系统不仅必须解决电气性能问题，还必须解决质量、发射和部署效率、制造成本和长期可靠性问题。

paras.en: Flexell Space is developing next-generation space solar cells based on CIGS (copper indium gallium selenide) and perovskite technologies. With a focus on lightweight, flexible designs and large-area manufacturing, the company aims to provide power solutions for satellites and larger space infrastructure. Through the collaboration, Flexell Space intends to gain a clearer understanding of orbital data center requirements and assess how its technology could support this emerging application.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 正在开发基于 CIGS（铜铟镓硒）和钙钛矿技术的下一代太空太阳能电池。该公司专注于轻量化、灵活设计和大面积制造，旨在为卫星和更大的空间基础设施提供电源解决方案。通过此次合作，Flexell Space 打算更清楚地了解轨道数据中心的要求，并评估其技术如何支持这一新兴应用。

paras.en: “This MoU marks an important milestone in strengthening cooperation between Korea and Europe, particularly France, in space energy and infrastructure,” said Kyumin Lee, Business Development Manager at Flexell Space. “By combining our next-generation solar cell technology with ALATYR’s orbital infrastructure expertise, we aim to build a lasting partnership and lay the groundwork for joint development and validation of power solutions for future orbital data centers.”
paras.zh: Flexell Space 业务开发经理 Kyumin Lee 表示：“这份谅解备忘录标志着韩国与欧洲（特别是法国）在空间能源和基础设施领域加强合作的一个重要里程碑。” “通过将我们的下一代太阳能电池技术与 ALATYR 的轨道基础设施专业知识相结合，我们的目标是建立持久的合作伙伴关系，并为未来轨道数据中心电力解决方案的联合开发和验证奠定基础。”

paras.en: He added, “By bringing together our complementary capabilities, we aim to establish a practical foundation for future development and validation.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“通过整合我们的互补能力，我们的目标是为未来的开发和验证奠定实用的基础。”

paras.en: “Our orbital infrastructure is designed to serve successive generations of computing hardware,” said Emeric Lhomme, Chief Executive Officer of ALATYR. “That makes solar cell efficiency and longevity central to our approach: our power systems must continue to deliver reliable performance as computing modules are replaced and upgraded. With Flexell Space, we will explore how next-generation lightweight solar technologies could meet the demands of that extended service life.”
paras.zh: ALATYR 首席执行官埃默里克·洛姆 (Emeric Lhomme) 表示：“我们的轨道基础设施旨在为连续几代的计算硬件提供服务。” “这使得太阳能电池的效率和寿命成为我们方法的核心：随着计算模块的更换和升级，我们的电力系统必须继续提供可靠的性能。通过 Flexell Space，我们将探索下一代轻型太阳能技术如何满足延长使用寿命的需求。”

paras.en: The companies plan to begin by exchanging information on their technologies and development priorities, followed by a phased assessment of solar cell and power system compatibility. Specific development activities and validation approaches will be discussed through subsequent technical consultations.
paras.zh: 两家公司计划首先交换有关技术和开发优先事项的信息，然后对太阳能电池和电力系统的兼容性进行分阶段评估。具体的开发活动和验证方法将通过后续技术磋商进行讨论。

paras.en: Flexell Space is a space energy company that originated as an internal venture at Hanwha Systems. The company develops next-generation space solar cells and power solutions based on CIGS and perovskite technologies, with a focus on low-cost, large-area, ultralight products. Through collaboration with global partners, Flexell Space is advancing the commercialization of solar cell technologies for satellites and a broad range of space infrastructure.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 是一家空间能源公司，最初是韩华系统公司的内部合资企业。该公司开发基于CIGS和钙钛矿技术的下一代空间太阳能电池和电源解决方案，重点是低成本、大面积、超轻产品。通过与全球合作伙伴的合作，Flexell Space 正在推进卫星太阳能电池技术和广泛的空间基础设施的商业化。

paras.en: ALATYR is a French company developing a new layer of critical digital infrastructure in space. The company designs orbital data centers that evolve with computing technology, rather than being replaced with each hardware generation. Its infrastructure is designed to remain productive over the long term and expand with demand, creating a lasting extension of the cloud in orbit to increase computing capacity and strengthen the resilience of essential digital services worldwide.
paras.zh: ALATYR 是一家法国公司，正在开发太空关键数字基础设施的新层。该公司设计的轨道数据中心随着计算技术的发展而发展，而不是随着每一代硬件的发展而更换。其基础设施旨在长期保持生产力并根据需求进行扩展，在轨道上创建云的持久扩展，以提高计算能力并增强全球基本数字服务的弹性。

articles.title: NASA’s Titan-Bound Dragonfly Rotorcraft Gets Its Eyes

paras.en: Science instruments for NASA’s Dragonfly are starting to arrive at the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) in Laurel, Maryland, where the car-sized rotorcraft is coming together for its mission to explore Saturn’s largest moon, Titan.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局“蜻蜓”号的科学仪器开始运抵位于马里兰州劳雷尔的约翰·霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室 (APL)，这架汽车大小的旋翼飞行器正聚集在一起执行探索土星最大卫星泰坦的任务。

paras.en: First to check in: DragonCam, which consists of seven cameras designed to characterize Titan’s surface at multiple scales during flight and while on the ground. By mid-November, all seven cameras developed and built by Malin Space Science Systems had been installed in their insulated housings, tested, and integrated into the rotorcraft. Each camera will look out at Titan through a window in a foam enclosure that insulates the cameras and Dragonfly’s interior from Titan’s cryogenic environment, where ambient temperatures reach minus 290 degrees Fahrenheit.
paras.zh: 首先检查的是：DragonCam，它由七个摄像头组成，旨在在飞行期间和地面上以多个尺度描绘土卫六的表面。到 11 月中旬，马林空间科学系统公司开发和制造的所有七个相机都已安装在其绝缘外壳中，经过测试并集成到旋翼飞行器中。每个摄像机都将通过泡沫外壳中的窗户观察泰坦，该泡沫外壳将摄像机和蜻蜓号内部与泰坦的低温环境隔离开来，那里的环境温度达到-290华氏度。

paras.en: A configurable LED array, built at APL and spanning the light spectrum from the infrared to the ultraviolet, provides information about the color of surface materials at the sampling site and helps scientists make inferences about their composition. During Titan’s long night, which spans nearly eight Earth days, these observations also may allow DragonCam to identify organic molecules that fluoresce under ultraviolet light. The LED illumination also allows us to see Titan as human eyes would.
paras.zh: APL 构建的可配置 LED 阵列涵盖从红外到紫外的光谱，提供有关采样点表面材料颜色的信息，并帮助科学家推断其成分。在土卫六长达近八个地球日的漫漫长夜期间，这些观测也可能使 DragonCam 能够识别在紫外线下发出荧光的有机分子。 LED 照明还使我们能够像人眼一样看到泰坦。

paras.en: “One of the most exciting things about Dragonfly is that we'll be able to see Titan from perspectives we've never had before,” said Elizabeth Turtle, Dragonfly principal investigator at APL. “With the capability to take images when Dragonfly is on the surface as well as while flying, DragonCam will give us both detailed views and sweeping panoramas of Titan's landscape, as well as insight into the processes that shaped this extraordinary world. Seeing these cameras become part of the Dragonfly lander is an exciting milestone that brings us another step closer to this unprecedented exploration.”
paras.zh: “关于蜻蜓号最令人兴奋的事情之一是，我们将能够从以前从未有过的角度来观察泰坦，”APL 蜻蜓号首席研究员伊丽莎白·海龟 (Elizabeth Turtle) 说。 “DragonCam 能够在‘蜻蜓’号在地面和飞行时拍摄图像，将为我们提供土卫六景观的详细视图和全景图，以及对塑造这个非凡世界的过程的深入了解。看到这些相机成为‘蜻蜓号’着陆器的一部分是一个令人兴奋的里程碑，它使我们离这一前所未有的探索又近了一步。”

paras.en: In addition to these science cameras, Dragonfly has two navigation cameras, also built by Malin Space Science Systems, that were installed this summer.
paras.zh: 除了这些科学相机之外，蜻蜓号还有两台导航相机，也是由马林空间科学系统公司制造，于今年夏天安装。

paras.en: “We are extremely pleased to have delivered the DragonCam cameras,” said Michael Ravine, DragonCam development manager and a Dragonfly co-investigator from Malin Space Science Systems. “Now to have them on the Dragonfly spacecraft, taking images, it’s so much easier to picture how they will work on Titan. These will be our eyes to see and explore this whole new world.”
paras.zh: “我们非常高兴能够交付 DragonCam 相机，”Malin Space Science Systems DragonCam 开发经理兼 Dragonfly 联合研究员 Michael Ravine 说道。 “现在让它们在蜻蜓号宇宙飞船上拍摄图像，就可以更容易地想象它们将如何在土卫六上工作。这些将是我们观察和探索这个全新世界的眼睛。”

paras.en: Two forward-mounted cameras — a wide-angle camera (WAC) and medium-angle camera (MAC) — are designed to capture images of the terrain in front of Dragonfly. The forward WAC offers a 90-degree field of view, while the forward MAC overlaps with the WAC, capturing part of that field of view at a higher resolution. Combined, the images from these two cameras provide a stereoscopic perspective from the front of the lander. Together with two additional side-mounted WACs, the system is able to capture panoramic views of the Titan landscape.
paras.zh: 两个前置摄像头——广角摄像头（WAC）和中角摄像头（MAC）——旨在捕捉“蜻蜓”前方地形的图像。前向 WAC 提供 90 度视场，而前向 MAC 与 WAC 重叠，以更高分辨率捕获部分视场。结合起来，这两个摄像机的图像提供了着陆器前部的立体视角。与另外两个侧面安装的 WAC 一起，该系统能够捕捉泰坦景观的全景。

paras.en: Two downward-facing WACs provide views of the surface beneath Dragonfly, helping the mission team decide if a landing spot is safe for deploying Dragonfly’s sample-collecting tool, known as DrACO, or Drill for Acquisition of Complex Organics, and its seismometer. A high-resolution microscopic imager will aim at DrACO’s drill site to pick out the details in millimeter-sized sand grains around the sampling location.
paras.zh: 两个朝下的 WAC 提供了 Dragonfly 下方表面的视图，帮助任务团队确定着陆点是否可以安全地部署 Dragonfly 的样本收集工具（称为 DrACO，即获取复杂有机物的钻机）及其地震仪。高分辨率显微成像仪将瞄准 DrACO 的钻探现场，以识别采样位置周围毫米级沙粒的细节。

paras.en: “DragonCam will give us critical context for the samples collected by DrACO,” said Carolyn Ernst, the DragonCam instrument scientist at APL. “We’ll be collecting materials at multiple sites across Titan, and the images from the cameras will help us relate the samples to Titan’s broader landscape and piece together the story of its geology.”
paras.zh: APL 的 DragonCam 仪器科学家 Carolyn Ernst 表示：“DragonCam 将为我们提供 DrACO 收集的样本的关键背景信息。” “我们将在土卫六的多个地点收集材料，相机拍摄的图像将帮助我们将样本与土卫六更广阔的景观联系起来，并拼凑出其地质故事。”

paras.en: Components of Dragonfly's other instrument packages, DraGNS (Gamma-ray and Neutron Spectrometer), DraGMet (Geophysics and Meteorology), DraMS (Mass Spectrometer) and DrACO, are set for delivery, integration and testing over the next several months. Dragonfly is scheduled to launch in July 2028 and reach Titan in late 2034.
paras.zh: Dragonfly 的其他仪器包、DraGNS（伽马射线和中子能谱仪）、DraGMet（地球物理学和气象学）、DraMS（质谱仪）和 DrACO 的组件将在未来几个月内交付、集成和测试。蜻蜓计划于 2028 年 7 月发射，并于 2034 年末抵达泰坦。

paras.en: For more on NASA’s Dragonfly mission, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 NASA 蜻蜓任务的更多信息，请访问：

paras.en: karen.c.fox@nasa.gov / molly.l.wasser@nasa.gov
paras.zh: karen.c.fox@nasa.gov / molly.l.wasser@nasa.gov

paras.en: Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory
paras.zh: 约翰霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室

articles.title: NASA’s Northrop Grumman CRS-25 Mission Overview
articles.author: Joseph Zakrzewski

paras.en: NASA’s Northrop Grumman Commercial Resupply Services 25 mission, or Northrop Grumman CRS-25, will deliver about 11,000 pounds of science and supplies to the International Space Station. The mission will be the third flight of the company’s Cygnus XL, the larger, more cargo-capable version of the company’s solar-powered spacecraft.
paras.zh: NASA 的诺斯罗普·格鲁曼商业补给服务 25 任务（即诺斯罗普·格鲁曼 CRS-25）将向国际空间站运送约 11,000 磅的科学和物资。此次任务将是该公司天鹅座 XL 号的第三次飞行，天鹅座 XL 号是该公司太阳能航天器的更大、载货能力更强的版本。

paras.en: The Cygnus XL will launch aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. Following arrival to the station, astronauts aboard the space station will use the Canadarm2 to grapple the spacecraft before ground controllers robotically install it to the Unity module’s Earth-facing port for cargo unloading.
paras.zh: Cygnus XL 将搭载 SpaceX 猎鹰 9 号火箭从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站发射升空。抵达空间站后，空间站上的宇航员将使用 Canadaarm2 抓住航天器，然后地面控制器将其自动安装到 Unity 模块面向地球的端口以进行货物卸载。

paras.en: In addition to food, supplies, and equipment for the crew, Cygnus will deliver several new experiments aimed at improving drug delivery for cancer and osteoarthritis treatment, predicting cancer spread, advancing treatments for muscle loss, improving radiation sensing, and supporting food production for future long-duration missions. This research includes:
paras.zh: 除了为机组人员提供食物、用品和设备外，天鹅座还将进行几项新实验，旨在改善癌症和骨关节炎治疗的药物输送、预测癌症扩散、推进肌肉损失的治疗、改善辐射传感以及支持未来长期任务的粮食生产。这项研究包括：

paras.en: Cardinal Muscle 2.0 uses the microgravity environment to explore potential treatments for muscle loss. Muscle atrophy and strength loss experienced by astronauts after spaceflight share many features with age-related muscle decline on Earth and occur more rapidly in microgravity without exercise. Researchers will use a muscle tissue model to test different Food and Drug Administration-approved drugs used to treat other conditions can be repurposed to prevent or reduce muscle loss.
paras.zh: Cardinal Muscle 2.0 利用微重力环境探索肌肉损失的潜在治疗方法。宇航员在太空飞行后经历的肌肉萎缩和力量损失与地球上与年龄相关的肌肉衰退有许多共同特征，并且在不运动的微重力条件下发生得更快。研究人员将使用肌肉组织模型来测试美国食品和药物管理局批准的用于治疗其他疾病的不同药物，这些药物可以重新用于预防或减少肌肉损失。

paras.en: The DNA Nano B investigation uses microgravity to manufacture tiny, DNA-inspired particles designed to deliver medicine into dense tissues, such as cartilage and solid tumors. Microgravity may enable more uniform particle assembly, helping researchers refine production methods. The results could advance targeted treatments for cancer and osteoarthritis on Earth.
paras.zh: DNA Nano B 研究利用微重力制造受 DNA 启发的微小颗粒，旨在将药物输送到软骨和实体瘤等致密组织中。微重力可以实现更均匀的颗粒组装，帮助研究人员改进生产方法。研究结果可以推进地球上癌症和骨关节炎的靶向治疗。

paras.en: The Active Radiation Environment Sensor (ARES) will test a small radiation monitoring device to support future Artemis program and lunar missions. The system is designed to integrate with spacecraft systems and provide real-time radiation monitoring inside crew living areas. The results could inform radiation monitoring strategies and crew safety measures for future exploration missions.
paras.zh: 主动辐射环境传感器（ARES）将测试小型辐射监测设备，以支持未来的阿尔忒弥斯计划和月球任务。该系统旨在与航天器系统集成，并在机组人员生活区内提供实时辐射监测。研究结果可以为未来勘探任务的辐射监测策略和船员安全措施提供参考。

paras.en: Encapsulate-1 uses miniature replicas of patients’ tumors to study how cancer cells move, invade surrounding tissues, and potentially spread. Researchers aim to develop a space-based diagnostic tool that could predict cancer progression months or even years in advance, improving early detection and treatment decisions for patients on Earth.
paras.zh: Encapsulate-1 使用患者肿瘤的微型复制品来研究癌细胞如何移动、侵入周围组织以及潜在的扩散。研究人员的目标是开发一种基于太空的诊断工具，可以提前数月甚至数年预测癌症进展，从而改善地球上患者的早期检测和治疗决策。

paras.en: Ohalo III is a new plant growth facility designed to help food crop production on future long-duration missions. The mostly automated system uses innovative water recovery and air exchange technologies to grow a variety of crops. This research could help lead to better food production methods to keep crew healthy and fed on future exploration missions, including those to Mars.
paras.zh: Ohalo III 是一个新的植物生长设施，旨在帮助未来长期任务中的粮食作物生产。大多数自动化系统使用创新的水回收和空气交换技术来种植各种农作物。这项研究可能有助于找到更好的食物生产方法，以保持船员的健康并为未来的探索任务（包括火星探索任务）提供食物。

paras.en: JOining demonstrations IN-Space (JOINS) will mature technologies that allow robotic systems to join materials directly in space. In-space joining could enable large structures to be assembled and integrated after launch rather than being constrained by the size and volume of a launch vehicle. These capabilities may be needed to build and repair large infrastructure, such as structures that will to support future exploration under Moon Base.
paras.zh: 空间连接演示 (JOINS) 将使机器人系统能够直接在太空中连接材料的技术成熟。太空连接可以使大型结构在发射后组装和集成，而不受运载火箭尺寸和体积的限制。建造和修复大型基础设施可能需要这些能力，例如支持月球基地下未来勘探的结构。

paras.en: Testing technologies in space helps validate their performance in unique environmental conditions, matures their readiness for operational use, reduces technical risk, and builds confidence for future mission applications.
paras.zh: 太空测试技术有助于验证其在独特环境条件下的性能，成熟其操作使用的准备情况，降低技术风险，并为未来的任务应用建立信心。

paras.en: Additional supplies being flown to the space station include:
paras.zh: 飞往空间站的其他物资包括：

paras.en: - Crew quarter blankets and covers to replace old units on station.
paras.zh: - 乘员宿舍的毯子和被子替换空间站上的旧设备。

paras.en: - Hatch seal covers to be installed on U.S. segment hatch seals.
paras.zh: - 舱口密封盖将安装在美国舱口密封件上。

paras.en: - A modified toilet pretreat hose needed to operate the universal pretreat concentrate tank in the Universal Waste Management System toilet.
paras.zh: - 需要改进的厕所预处理软管来操作通用废物管理系统厕所中的通用预处理浓缩液罐。

paras.en: - Alpha Magnetic Spectrometer specific spacewalk tools to be used during upcoming spacewalks.
paras.zh: - 在即将进行的太空行走中使用阿尔法磁谱仪特定的太空行走工具。

paras.en: - Anomaly Gas Analyzer batteries required to power various sensors on space station.
paras.zh: - 为空间站上的各种传感器供电所需的异常气体分析仪电池。

articles.title: Georgia’s Pecan Belt

paras.en: From the star of its namesake pie to a supporting player in countless side dishes, the pecan has earned a place on Thanksgiving tables across the United States. But before it becomes candied, chopped, or baked, it hangs from the branches of Carya illinoinensis—a species of hickory in the walnut family native to North America. Many U.S.-grown pecans come from orchards in Georgia, the state that has historically led the nation in production.
paras.zh: 从同名馅饼中的明星到无数配菜中的配角，山核桃在美国各地的感恩节餐桌上赢得了一席之地。但在它被蜜饯、切碎或烘烤之前，它会悬挂在伊利诺伊山核桃（Carya illinoinensis）的树枝上，山核桃是一种原产于北美的核桃科山核桃。许多美国种植的山核桃来自佐治亚州的果园，该州历来产量领先全国。

paras.en: One hotspot of pecan cultivation is in the southwest part of the state, around Albany, in Dougherty County. The OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 8 captured this image of the area and neighboring counties on October 23, 2026. That date falls within the pecan harvest season, which typically runs from October into December. In addition to pecans, other crops such as peanuts, cotton, and corn are also grown in the area.
paras.zh: 山核桃种植的热点地区之一位于该州西南部的多尔蒂县奥尔巴尼周围。 Landsat 8 上的 OLI（运营陆地成像仪）于 2026 年 10 月 23 日拍摄到了该地区及邻近县的这张图像。该日期恰逢山核桃收获季节，通常从 10 月到 12 月。除了山核桃外，该地区还种植花生、棉花和玉米等其他农作物。

paras.en: Landsat observations like these contribute to the Cropland Data Layer, an annual map of crop types across the contiguous United States produced by the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s National Agricultural Statistics Service. The 2025 map shows pecan groves clustered along the Flint River within the Coastal Plain. Pecan trees need abundant water, and they generally do well in the area’s well-drained sandy soils that sit above the Floridan aquifer system that growers can tap for irrigation.
paras.zh: 此类陆地卫星观测数据有助于农田数据层，这是由美国农业部国家农业统计局制作的美国本土农作物类型年度地图。 2025 年地图显示了沿海平原内弗林特河沿岸聚集的山核桃树林。山核桃树需要充足的水，它们通常在该地区排水良好的沙质土壤中生长良好，这些沙质土壤位于佛罗里达州含水层系统之上，种植者可以利用该系统进行灌溉。

paras.en: In the late 1800s, Georgia had less than 100 acres (40 hectares) of pecan orchards. Then, in the early 1900s, southwest Georgia’s Dougherty and Mitchell counties underwent a pecan boom when thousands of acres were planted and sold to investors. By the end of the 1950s, Georgia led the nation in pecan production, producing over 17 million pounds, according to 1959 agricultural census numbers.
paras.zh: 1800 年代末，佐治亚州只有不到 100 英亩（40 公顷）的山核桃果园。然后，在 1900 年代初期，佐治亚州西南部的多尔蒂县和米切尔县经历了山核桃繁荣，种植了数千英亩山核桃并出售给投资者。根据 1959 年农业普查数据，到 20 世纪 50 年代末，佐治亚州的山核桃产量领先于全国，产量超过 1700 万磅。

paras.en: In recent decades, pecan production has grown in other states, such as New Mexico and Texas. Georgia faced challenges after Hurricane Michael damaged orchards in October 2018, and Hurricane Helene dealt another blow when it swept inland in September 2024. Even so, USDA numbers show that the state’s production has topped 100 million pounds in each of the past three years (2023-2025).
paras.zh: 近几十年来，新墨西哥州和德克萨斯州等其他州的山核桃产量有所增长。 2018 年 10 月飓风“迈克尔”破坏了果园，而 2024 年 9 月飓风海伦席卷内陆时，乔治亚州面临着挑战。即便如此，美国农业部的数据显示，该州的产量在过去三年（2023-2025 年）每年都超过 1 亿磅。

paras.en: In 2026, a wet summer in parts of the state helped scab take hold. The fungal disease causes brown spots on pecan twigs, leaves, and nut shucks. Meanwhile, some growers still recovering from Hurricane Helene reported the return of a solid crop.
paras.zh: 2026 年，该州部分地区经历了潮湿的夏季，导致痂病蔓延。这种真菌病会导致山核桃树枝、叶子和坚果壳上出现褐色斑点。与此同时，一些仍在从海伦飓风中恢复的种植者报告称，农作物已恢复丰收。

articles.title: Villeneuve: Verstappen showed 'race craft' edge over Mercedes pair in Vegas

paras.en: Max Verstappen showed 'race craft' edge over George Russell and Kimi Antonelli during Las Vegas GP, says Jacques Villeneuve
paras.zh: 雅克·维伦纽夫表示，马克斯·维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯大奖赛期间展示了对乔治·拉塞尔和基米·安东内利的“赛车技巧”优势

paras.en: Max Verstappen withstood pressure from Mercedes' George Russell and Kimi Antonelli on his way to winning a thrilling Las Vegas GP for Red Bull; watch the Qatar Grand Prix live on Sky Sports this weekend, with qualifying at 6pm on Saturday and the race at 4pm on Sunday
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘顶住了梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔和基米·安东内利的压力，为红牛赢得了激动人心的拉斯维加斯大奖赛；本周末，请观看天空体育直播的卡塔尔大奖赛，周六下午 6 点排位赛，周日下午 4 点正赛

paras.en: Former Formula 1 world champion Jacques Villeneuve says Max Verstappen's Las Vegas Grand Prix victory showed that Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and George Russell will not be able to beat the Red Bull driver in next year's championship unless they have a superior car.
paras.zh: 前一级方程式世界冠军雅克·维伦纽夫表示，马克斯·维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯大奖赛的胜利表明，梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔将无法在明年的锦标赛中击败红牛车手，除非他们拥有一辆更高级的赛车。

paras.en: Verstappen retained the lead from pole position at the start but was challenged by Russell and then later Antonelli for almost the entire 50-lap race amid near constant changes of position throughout the field, but the Red Bull driver expertly saw off their best efforts before both made late errors to drop down the order.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘一开始就保持了杆位领先，但在几乎整个 50 圈比赛中都受到了拉塞尔和安东内利的挑战，在整个比赛中位置几乎不断变化，但红牛车手熟练地完成了他们最好的努力，然后两人都在后期犯了错误，导致排名下降。

paras.en: Antonelli has already been crowned 2026 world champion after Mercedes' dominance early in the season helped him build a significant advantage, but Verstappen is putting together an ominous finish to the year, with the four-time world champion having won four of the last six races and claimed nine successive podiums.
paras.zh: 安东内利已经加冕了 2026 年世界冠军，因为梅赛德斯在赛季初的统治地位帮助他建立了显着的优势，但维斯塔潘今年的收官之路并不顺利，这位四届世界冠军赢得了过去六场比赛中的四场，并连续九次登上领奖台。

paras.en: - F1 2026 Calendar | F1 2026 Standings | F1 Gossip Column
paras.zh: - F1 2026 日历 | F1 2026 积分榜 | F1八卦专栏

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Sky Sports F1 pundit and 1997 F1 world champion Villeneuve said after the race: "It was exciting. People will say there was a battery involved [in all the passes], but it doesn't matter.
paras.zh: 天空体育 F1 评论员、1997 年 F1 世界冠军维伦纽夫在赛后表示：“这很令人兴奋。人们会说[所有的过关]都涉及到电池，但这并不重要。

paras.en: "We saw some race craft. Max was above and the two Mercedes drivers were lacking in that respect.
paras.zh: “我们看到了一些赛车手。马克斯在上面，而两位梅赛德斯车手在这方面有所欠缺。

paras.en: "And what it is telling us is that unless next year Mercedes have a car that's superior, they can't win because there's something missing."
paras.zh: “它告诉我们的是，除非明年梅赛德斯拥有一辆更优秀的赛车，否则他们就无法获胜，因为缺少了一些东西。”

paras.en: A combination of factors, most notably the extreme power of the slipstream effect, meant there were more than 350 overtakes during a breathless race at the Las Vegas Strip Circuit.
paras.zh: 多种因素结合在一起，尤其是滑流效应的极端威力，意味着在拉斯维加斯大道赛道上一场令人窒息的比赛中出现了超过 350 次超车。

paras.en: The lead changed hands 34 times, but every time Verstappen was overtaken, which on almost every occasion was by a Mercedes, the four-time world champion retook his position within a few corners.
paras.zh: 领先优势已易手 34 次，但每次维斯塔潘被超越（几乎每次都是被梅赛德斯超越）时，这位四届世界冠军都会在几个弯道内重新夺回自己的位置。

paras.en: Russell locked up and hit a barrier as he tried to pass Antonelli for second in the closing stages, before the Italian suffered a loss of power at the start of the final lap after incorrectly lifting off the throttle as he was preparing to mount a final challenge to Verstappen.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔在最后阶段试图超越安东内利获得第二名时锁死并撞上障碍物，随后意大利人在最后一圈开始时因错误地松开油门而失去动力，当时他正准备向维斯塔潘发起最后的挑战。

paras.en: Villeneuve was also impressed by the drives of seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton and last year's title winner Lando Norris, who took advantage of the Mercedes errors to finish second ahead of his McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri.
paras.zh: 七届世界冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿和去年冠军得主兰多·诺里斯的驾驶也给维伦纽夫留下了深刻的印象，后者利用梅赛德斯的失误，领先于迈凯轮队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里获得第二名。

paras.en: Hamilton could have also ended up on the podium had it not been for him spinning in a contentious collision with his Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc.
paras.zh: 如果不是汉密尔顿与他的法拉利队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔发生了一场有争议的碰撞，他也可能最终登上领奖台。

paras.en: "You could see that Lewis had good race craft as well as Lando," Villeneuve added.
paras.zh: “你可以看到刘易斯和兰多一样拥有良好的比赛技巧，”维伦纽夫补充道。

paras.en: "It was really fun to see. We saw today a race where you don't need pit stops, you don't need tyres that degrade.
paras.zh: “这真的很有趣。今天我们看到了一场比赛，你不需要进站，你不需要退化的轮胎。

paras.en: "We had a race where drivers could push like qualifying laps all the time and that allowed them to race. It was great fun."
paras.zh: “我们举办了一场比赛，车手们可以一直像排位赛一样推进，这让他们能够参加比赛。这非常有趣。”

articles.title: Rodgers benched by Steelers for game with Broncos

paras.en: Aaron Rodgers benched by Pittsburgh Steelers for game with Denver Broncos as Mason Rudolph starts at quarterback
paras.zh: 亚伦·罗杰斯在匹兹堡钢人队与丹佛野马队的比赛中被放在替补席上，梅森·鲁道夫首发四分卫

paras.en: Aaron Rodgers has struggled in the Pittsburgh Steelers' back-to-back defeats to the Cincinnati Bengals and the Philadelphia Eagles; quarterback, who turns 43 next week, has been sacked 31 times this season; Mason Rudolph has started only 19 games in seven seasons
paras.zh: 亚伦·罗杰斯在匹兹堡钢人队连续输给辛辛那提猛虎队和费城老鹰队的比赛中表现不佳。下周将满 43 岁的四分卫本赛季已被解雇 31 次；梅森·鲁道夫在七个赛季中只首发了 19 场比赛

paras.en: Aaron Rodgers has been benched by the Pittsburgh Steelers for Friday's game against the Denver Broncos with Mason Rudolph to start in the four-time NFL MVP's place.
paras.zh: 周五，匹兹堡钢人队对阵丹佛野马队的比赛中，亚伦·罗杰斯 (Aaron Rodgers) 被放在替补席上，而梅森·鲁道夫 (Mason Rudolph) 将代替这位四届 NFL MVP 首发。

paras.en: Rodgers, who turns 43 next week, has struggled during the Steelers' back-to-back defeats to the Cincinnati Bengals and the Philadelphia Eagles.
paras.zh: 下周将年满 43 岁的罗杰斯在钢人队连续输给辛辛那提猛虎队和费城老鹰队的比赛中表现不佳。

paras.en: Pittsburgh confirmed in a statement that the veteran quarterback will be "inactive", despite head coach Mike McCarthy saying on Monday that he remained the starter.
paras.zh: 匹兹堡在一份声明中证实，这位经验丰富的四分卫将“不活跃”，尽管主教练迈克·麦卡锡周一表示他仍然是首发球员。

paras.en: - Jay-Z picks himself to headline Super Bowl half-time show
paras.zh: - Jay-Z 选择自己担任超级碗中场秀的主角

paras.zh: - NOW 最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: Rodgers is amid his 22nd and final NFL season, having reunited with McCarthy after the two previously won the Super Bowl together at the Green Bay Packers in 2010.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯正处于他在 NFL 的第 22 个赛季，也是最后一个赛季，他与麦卡锡重聚，此前两人曾于 2010 年在绿湾包装工队一起赢得了超级碗冠军。

paras.en: He was key in McCarthy being hired to take over from Mike Tomlin.
paras.zh: 他是麦卡锡被聘请接替迈克·汤姆林的关键人物。

paras.en: Rudolph has started only 19 games in seven seasons with the Steelers and the Tennessee Titans, so this is a big call from Pittsburgh, even considering Rodger's flagging numbers.
paras.zh: 鲁道夫在钢人队和田纳西泰坦队的七个赛季中只首发了 19 场比赛，所以即使考虑到罗杰萎靡不振的数据，这也是来自匹兹堡的一个重大决定。

paras.en: Rodgers has completed under 61 per cent of pass attempts this season, marking one of his worst campaigns since he became a full-time starter with Green Bay in 2008.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯本赛季的传球成功率低于61%，这是他自2008年成为绿湾队全职首发以来最糟糕的赛季之一。

paras.en: The quarterback has been sacked 31 times, surpassing last year's total of 21 already, and leads the league with 257 yards lost in those sacks.
paras.zh: 这位四分卫已被擒杀 31 次，超过了去年的 21 次擒杀总数，并以 257 码的擒杀数领先全联盟。

paras.en: Earlier this week, McCarthy said of Rodgers when discussing Pittsburgh's successive defeats: "When you talk about the quarterback position, I think there's things offensively we need to do better and that always benefits and leads into quarterback play.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，麦卡锡在讨论匹兹堡队的连续失利时谈到罗杰斯：“当你谈论四分卫位置时，我认为在进攻方面我们需要做得更好，这总是有利于并引导四分卫的比赛。

paras.en: "I just need him to just keep ploughing away. We got a lot of work to do."
paras.zh: “我只需要他继续努力。我们还有很多工作要做。”

articles.title: Sky announces Game Changing coalition for women and girls in sport

paras.en: Sky announces Game Changing coalition to drive lasting change in UK for women and girls through sport
paras.zh: 天空电视台宣布成立游戏改变联盟，通过体育为英国妇女和女孩推动持久变革

paras.en: Sky has announced the Game Changing coalition for women and girls in sport; the group, convened by Sky, aims to improve participation of girls in comparison to their male counterparts; girls still spend 1.4 fewer hours playing sport than boys per week
paras.zh: 天空电视台宣布成立妇女和女童体育运动改变联盟；该组织由天空电视台召集，旨在提高女孩相对于男性同行的参与度；女孩每周参加运动的时间仍比男孩少 1.4 小时

paras.en: Sky is pleased to announce the formation of the Game Changing coalition, a new UK initiative to drive lasting change for women and girls through increased participation in sport.
paras.zh: 天空电视台很高兴地宣布成立“改变游戏规则”联盟，这是英国的一项新举措，旨在通过增加对体育的参与来推动妇女和女孩的持久变革。

paras.en: Despite growing visibility and investment in women's sport, Sky's Game Changing report shows that girls still spend 1.4 fewer hours per week playing sport than boys - equivalent to every girl being sidelined for 52 football matches per year compared to their male counterparts.
paras.zh: 尽管女子运动的知名度和投资不断增加，但天空电视台的《游戏规则改变》报告显示，女孩每周花在运动上的时间仍然比男孩少 1.4 个小时，相当于每个女孩与男性相比每年缺席 52 场足球比赛。

paras.en: While landmark sporting moments have captured the nation's imagination, this surge in interest has not translated into enough girls regularly engaging in sport.
paras.zh: 虽然具有里程碑意义的体育时刻激发了全国人民的想象力，但这种兴趣的激增并没有转化为足够多的女孩定期参与体育运动。

paras.en: Convened by Sky, the coalition held its inaugural meeting earlier this week, uniting members to combine their expertise, influence and resources to break down barriers and create opportunities with a collective impact no single organisation could achieve alone.
paras.zh: 在天空电视台的召集下，该联盟于本周早些时候举行了首次会议，团结成员，结合他们的专业知识、影响力和资源，打破障碍，创造机会，产生任何单一组织无法单独实现的集体影响力。

paras.en: Together, coalition members bring half a millennium of experience across sport, business and media; reach over 750 million people through their platforms and communities; and invest or direct millions towards sport, physical activity or grassroots programmes each year.
paras.zh: 联盟成员共同带来了体育、商业和媒体领域五千年的经验；通过他们的平台和社区覆盖超过 7.5 亿人；每年投资或指导数百万美元用于体育、体育活动或基层项目。

paras.en: By examining previous efforts and research, the core challenges, and where gaps in understanding remain, the coalition will co-create clear, accountable goals to drive meaningful change. Using constituency-level research, which sets out the sports participation gap at a local level, the coalition will also identify communities where targeted interventions can have the greatest impact.
paras.zh: 通过审查之前的努力和研究、核心挑战以及仍然存在的理解差距，联盟将共同制定明确、负责任的目标，以推动有意义的变革。利用选区一级的研究，确定地方一级的体育参与差距，该联盟还将确定有针对性的干预措施可以产生最大影响的社区。

paras.en: The coalition will focus on three interconnected pillars - Play, Watch and Attend - recognising that participation, visibility and live sporting experiences need to work together to create lifelong engagement with sport.
paras.zh: 该联盟将重点关注三个相互关联的支柱——比赛、观看和参加——认识到参与、可见性和现场体育体验需要共同努力，以创造对体育的终生参与。

paras.en: With the UK set to host the 2031 Netball World Cup and 2035 FIFA Women's World Cup, the coalition also has an opportunity to help build a lasting legacy for the tournament, ensuring more girls are inspired and supported to take part in sport, with former athletes on the coalition bringing first-hand experience to that work.
paras.zh: 随着英国即将主办 2031 年无板篮球世界杯和 2035 年国际足联女子世界杯，该联盟还有机会帮助为赛事建立持久的遗产，确保激励和支持更多女孩参与体育运动，联盟中的前运动员将为这项工作带来第一手经验。

paras.en: "Despite many excellent initiatives, progress in women's sport remains stubbornly static," Tracey Crouch, Chair of the Game Changing Coalition, said.
paras.zh: “尽管有许多出色的举措，但女子体育运动的进展仍然顽固地停滞不前，”改变游戏规则联盟主席特雷西·​​克劳奇表示。

paras.en: "What makes this coalition different is the unique mix of voices lending their influence, expertise and resources to the cause that can help drive meaningful change.
paras.zh: “这个联盟的不同之处在于独特的声音组合，将他们的影响力、专业知识和资源贡献给有助于推动有意义的变革的事业。

paras.en: "By harnessing that collective power with commercial backing, we can break down barriers at scale and ensure every girl, regardless of her background or where she lives, has the opportunity to get active and stay active."
paras.zh: “通过在商业支持下利用集体力量，我们可以大规模打破障碍，确保每个女孩，无论其背景或居住在哪里，都有机会活跃起来并保持活跃。”

paras.en: "Too many girls are experiencing barriers to playing sport, and the result is 280 million missing hours of sport a year compared to boys." CEO of Sky Sports Jonathan Licht echoed.
paras.zh: “太多女孩在参加体育运动时遇到障碍，结果导致与男孩相比，每年少了 2.8 亿个小时的运动时间。”天空体育首席执行官乔纳森·利希特对此表示赞同。

paras.en: "Closing that gap isn't just about getting more girls active, it's about giving them the opportunity to build confidence, make connections and develop skills that will benefit them throughout their lives.
paras.zh: “缩小这一差距不仅仅在于让更多女孩积极参与运动，还在于让她们有机会建立信心、建立联系并发展使她们终生受益的技能。

paras.en: "That is why we are using Sky's unique position in the UK to bring together sporting and commercial organisations with the influence to drive lasting change."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我们利用天空电视台在英国的独特地位，将具有影响力的体育和商业组织聚集在一起，推动持久变革。”

paras.en: Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy added: "For too long, girls were shut out of sport in this country. Now the Lionesses and the Red Roses have shown what is possible, participation rates soaring.
paras.zh: 文化大臣丽莎·南迪补充道：“长期以来，这个国家的女孩被排除在体育运动之外。现在，母狮队和红玫瑰队已经展示了一切的可能性，参与率飙升。

paras.en: "We now want every girl to see a place for herself in that story, and have made clear this week our vision to get a million more girls involved in sport by the time the UK hosts the Women's World Cup in 2035.
paras.zh: “我们现在希望每个女孩都能在这个故事中看到自己的一席之地，并在本周明确了我们的愿景，即到 2035 年英国主办女足世界杯时，让更多的 100 万女孩参与体育运动。

paras.en: "We need everyone with a vested interest in women's and girls' sport to play their part. The Game Changing Coalition brings together the voices, the influence and the resources to work with our Women's Sport Taskforce, back up our record investment in grassroots facilities and turn our aspiration into a reality."
paras.zh: “我们需要对妇女和女童运动感兴趣的每个人都发挥自己的作用。改变游戏规则联盟汇聚了声音、影响力和资源，与我们的女子体育工作组合作，支持我们对基层设施的创纪录投资，并将我们的愿望变成现实。”

paras.en: Sky is also proud to be supporting the newly launched The Equal Sport Project, underlining our commitment and pledge to challenge inequality in sport and help create a more level playing field for women and girls.
paras.zh: 天空电视台还很自豪能够支持新推出的平等体育项目，这突显了我们挑战体育不平等并帮助为妇女和女孩创造更加公平的竞争环境的承诺和承诺。

paras.en: To measure impact and improve outcomes, Sky will revisit its constituency-level research at the end of 2028 to track progress, particularly in communities with the lowest participation rates and where coalition interventions have been targeted.
paras.zh: 为了衡量影响并改善结果，Sky 将在 2028 年底重新审视其选区层面的研究，以跟踪进展情况，特别是在参与率最低和联合干预的目标社区。

articles.title: Nearly 6 decades after teen was killed while leaving job, Canada authorities know who did it
articles.author: Tim Stelloh

paras.en: Authorities in Canada have identified a man accused of killing a Canadian teen nearly six decades ago, police said Monday.
paras.zh: 加拿大警方周一表示，加拿大当局已确认一名男子被控在近六十年前杀害一名加拿大青少年。

paras.en: Michael Joseph Moore, who died in 2018, was responsible for the 1968 death of Jacqueline “Jacky” Dunleavy, 16, according to the London Police Service in Ontario.
paras.zh: 据安大略省伦敦警察局称，2018 年去世的迈克尔·约瑟夫·摩尔 (Michael Joseph Moore) 对 1968 年 16 岁的杰奎琳·“杰基”·邓利维 (Jacqueline “Jacky” Dunleavy) 的死亡负有责任。

paras.en: Moore, who worked as a firefighter for nearly three decades, was identified through genetic genealogy, officials said at a news conference Monday. The forensic technique combines modern DNA analysis with traditional genealogical research.
paras.zh: 官员们在周一的新闻发布会上表示，摩尔是一名消防员，工作了近三十年，他的身份是通过基因谱系确定的。法医技术将现代 DNA 分析与传统家谱研究相结合。

paras.en: If Moore was alive today, the agency said in a statement, he would have been arrested and charged in connection with the teen’s death.
paras.zh: 该机构在一份声明中表示，如果摩尔今天还活着，他就会因与这名青少年的死亡有关而被捕并受到指控。

paras.en: “Publicly identifying Moore provides an accurate historical record and answers that Jackie’s family and the community have sought for decades,” the agency said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示：“公开确认摩尔的身份提供了准确的历史记录，以及杰基的家人和社区几十年来一直在寻求的答案。”

paras.en: In a statement read at the news conference, Dunleavy’s family thanked law enforcement and said they hope the techniques used to solve her death can be used with other cold cases.
paras.zh: 在新闻发布会上宣读的一份声明中，邓利维的家人感谢执法部门，并表示他们希望用于解决她死亡的技术可以用于其他悬案。

paras.en: Authorities did not identify a possible motive, and a possible connection between Moore and Dunleavy remained unclear.
paras.zh: 当局没有确定可能的动机，摩尔和邓利维之间可能存在的联系仍不清楚。

paras.en: The high school sophomore was last seen on the evening of Jan. 9, 1968, leaving her job at a variety store in London, roughly 120 miles northeast of Detroit. Dunleavy was found dead at a school 90 minutes later, the police service said.
paras.zh: 这位高中二年级学生最后一次出现是在 1968 年 1 月 9 日晚上，她离开了位于底特律东北约 120 英里的伦敦一家杂货店的工作。警方称，90 分钟后，邓利维被发现死在一所学校。

paras.en: She had a head injury, according to the authorities, and her cause of death was determined to be strangulation.
paras.zh: 据当局称，她头部受伤，死因确定为勒死。

paras.en: - A dead homeless man was known as ‘Box Mike’ — until a global search revealed his true identity
paras.zh: - 一名死去的无家可归者被称为“盒子迈克”——直到全球搜索揭示了他的真实身份

paras.en: - Chicago police find killer in 65-year-old cold case murder of little girl — one of their own
paras.zh: - 芝加哥警方在 65 岁小女孩谋杀悬案中找到凶手——其中一名是他们自己

paras.en: - Arrest made in cold case of Iowa real estate agent killed during an open house
paras.zh: - 爱荷华州房地产经纪人在开放日期间被杀的悬案被捕

paras.en: - After 40 years and 3 overturned convictions, arrest made in murder case thanks to smoothie straw
paras.zh: - 40年后，3次推翻定罪，因冰沙吸管谋杀案被捕

paras.en: - Slaying suspect in San Diego charged with 3 more murders, including 2 cold cases
paras.zh: - 圣地亚哥凶杀案嫌疑人被控另外 3 起谋杀案，其中包括 2 起悬案

paras.en: Despite what the agency described as an extensive investigation, the case remained unsolved, and efforts in the decades that followed did not reveal her killer.
paras.zh: 尽管该机构称进行了广泛的调查，但该案仍未侦破，随后几十年的努力也没有揭露凶手。

paras.en: “The investigators who worked on Jackie’s homicide in 1968 did everything they could with the investigative and forensic tools available to them at the time,” Det. Sgt. Micah Bourdeau of the London Police Service said in a statement. “The evidence they carefully collected and preserved ultimately allowed investigators decades later to continue that work.”
paras.zh: “1968 年杰基凶杀案的调查人员利用当时可用的调查和法医工具竭尽全力，”侦探说。中士。伦敦警察局的米卡·布尔多（Micah Bourdeau）在一份声明中说道。 “他们精心收集和保存的证据最终使调查人员能够在几十年后继续开展这项工作。”

paras.en: Recently, a Texas-based DNA lab conducted specialized testing using that evidence and investigators were able to develop a family tree that helped identify Moore, the police service said.
paras.zh: 警方表示，最近，德克萨斯州的一家 DNA 实验室利用这些证据进行了专门测试，调查人员能够开发出有助于识别摩尔身份的家谱。

paras.en: After conducting additional interviews, gathering new evidence and obtaining comparison DNA samples, Moore was identified as the man responsible for the teen’s killing, the agency said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，在进行更多采访、收集新证据并获取 DNA 样本对比后，摩尔被确定为杀害这名青少年的凶手。

paras.en: Moore, who was 25 at the time, had moved to Canada from Ireland in 1967, authorities said. He worked as a firefighter for 28 years but did not have that job until after Dunleavy’s death, Det. Mike Budzyn of the London Police Service told reporters.
paras.zh: 当局称，摩尔当时 25 岁，于 1967 年从爱尔兰移居加拿大。他作为一名消防员工作了 28 年，但直到邓利维去世后才得到这份工作。伦敦警察局的迈克·布津 (Mike Budzyn) 告诉记者。

paras.en: At the time he retired, Moore was a captain.
paras.zh: 摩尔退役时是一名队长。

paras.en: His family was shocked by the revelation, Budzyn said, and “expressed their hope that these findings will provide long-awaited answers for Jackie’s family.”
paras.zh: 布津说，他的家人对这一消息感到震惊，并“表示希望这些发现能为杰基的家人提供期待已久的答案。”

articles.title: Cape York residents swelter through heatwaves and nightly water outages
articles.author: Conor Byrne and Rosanne Maloney

paras.en: Lengthy water outages during ongoing heatwaves are causing discomfort for residents on Cape York Peninsula.
paras.zh: 持续热浪期间的长时间停水给约克角半岛的居民带来了不适。

paras.en: "Abnormal" water use and power outages have been blamed for low reservoir levels.
paras.zh: “异常”用水和停电被认为是水库水位低的原因。

paras.en: The $10 million joint federal-state Northern Peninsula Area Water Supply Project is underway, and further unfunded measures have been identified.
paras.zh: 耗资 1000 万美元的联邦与州联合北部半岛地区供水项目正在进行中，并已确定了进一步的无资助措施。

paras.en: Remote communities at the tip of Cape York are having their water turned off overnight as reservoirs run critically low during a prolonged heatwave.
paras.zh: 由于长期热浪期间水库水位严重不足，约克角一角的偏远社区一夜之间停水。

paras.en: Mains water has been cut, often with only a few hours' notice, across the five communities of Queensland's Northern Peninsula Area (NPA) since early September.
paras.zh: 自 9 月初以来，昆士兰州北部半岛地区 (NPA) 的五个社区的自来水已被切断，通常只在几个小时内发出通知。

paras.en: The Bureau of Meteorology has issued heatwave warnings for the peninsula district for several weeks, the most recent forecasting temperatures in the low 40s and overnight minimums in the mid-20s until Friday.
paras.zh: 气象局已连续数周发布半岛地区热浪警报，最新预测气温将在 40 多度左右，夜间最低气温将在 20 多度左右，直至周五。

paras.en: Residents in the coastal NPA town of Seisia, near the northernmost point of the Cape, say the rolling restrictions are having a significant impact on their lives.
paras.zh: 靠近开普敦最北端的 NPA 沿海城镇 Seisia 的居民表示，滚动限制对他们的生活产生了重大影响。

paras.en: Kawia Akinsola, 45, said the outages, from 9pm to 6am on allocated days, were disrupting activities including cooking, cleaning and taking medication.
paras.zh: 45 岁的卡维亚·阿金索拉 (Kawia Akinsola) 表示，停电时间为指定日期晚上 9 点至凌晨 6 点，中断了烹饪、清洁和服药等活动。

paras.en: The Northern Peninsula Area Regional Council (NPARC) uses its Facebook page to provide updates, but Ms Akinsola said not everyone in the communities was receiving the messages.
paras.zh: 北部半岛地区委员会 (NPARC) 使用其 Facebook 页面提供最新信息，但阿金索拉女士表示，并非社区中的每个人都收到了这些信息。

paras.en: "Some of us, especially older people or people with disabilities, are not on social media, so they don't get told until the last minute most of the time," she said.
paras.zh: “我们中的一些人，尤其是老年人或残疾人，不使用社交媒体，所以大多数时候他们直到最后一刻才被告知，”她说。

paras.en: "Our elders and people with disabilities don't know the water's turned off and go to the toilet and we have to wait for the next day to flush it or clean it."
paras.zh: “我们的老人和残疾人不知道停水了，去厕所，我们必须等到第二天才能冲水或清理。”

paras.en: She said many households were also overcrowded, and stored water could run out quickly.
paras.zh: 她说，许多家庭也人满为患，储存的水可能很快就会耗尽。

paras.en: According to the 2021 Census, the Peninsula region is home to about 2,800 people living in 1,090 dwellings, with residents in New Mapoon, Injinoo, Umagico, Bamaga and Seisia impacted.
paras.zh: 根据 2021 年人口普查，半岛地区约有 2,800 人居住在 1,090 套住宅中，其中 New Mapoon、Injinoo、Umagico、Bamaga 和 Seisia 的居民受到影响。

paras.en: Veolia, the council's water contractor, warned in early November that storage levels at the region's reservoirs were at critically low levels after power outages disrupted pumping from the Jardine River.
paras.zh: 该委员会的水务承包商威立雅公司在11月初警告说，由于停电导致渣甸河的抽水中断，该地区水库的蓄水量处于极低水平。

paras.en: The council has since installed an emergency backup generator to allow reservoirs to recharge, but it has been switching off water supplies to alternating communities overnight.
paras.zh: 此后，市政厅安装了一台应急备用发电机，以便水库蓄水，但它一直在夜间轮流切断各社区的供水。

paras.en: Premier David Crisafulli described the restrictions as "completely unacceptable" and said his government had invested in water pumps and pipes in New Mapoon and Bamaga.
paras.zh: 州长戴维·克里萨富利 (David Crisafulli) 称这些限制“完全不可接受”，并表示政府已在新马蓬和巴马加投资建设水泵和管道。

paras.en: The $10 million joint federal-state Northern Peninsula Area Water Supply Project includes upgrades to the Bamaga Water Treatment Plant, increasing capacity to a proposed nine megalitres a day, replacing asbestos-cement water pipes and connecting a new water main in New Mapoon.
paras.zh: 耗资 1000 万美元的联邦与州联合北部半岛地区供水项目包括升级巴马加水处理厂、将容量增加至拟议的每天 9 兆升、更换石棉水泥水管以及连接新马普恩的新总水管。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Federal Water Minister Murray Watt said the investment would support long-term improvements to water supply infrastructure in the region.
paras.zh: 联邦水务部长默里·瓦特的发言人表示，这项投资将支持该地区供水基础设施的长期改善。

paras.en: But Cook MP David Kempton said it remained unclear whether the planned works would resolve the council's ongoing supply issues.
paras.zh: 但库克议员戴维·肯普顿表示，目前尚不清楚计划中的工程是否能解决该委员会持续存在的供应问题。

paras.en: "That's the plan, but we don't know what the state of some of those other asbestos pipes are, but as things fail, of course, we'll fix them," he said.
paras.zh: “这就是计划，但我们不知道其他一些石棉管道的状况如何，但如果出现问题，我们当然会修复它们，”他说。

paras.en: The ABC has contacted Veolia and NPARC for comment.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚广播公司已联系威立雅和NPARC征求意见。

paras.en: In March, the council's Local Resilience Action Plan identified securing a second pipeline from the Jardine River as a critical infrastructure priority. The project remains unfunded.
paras.zh: 三月份，该委员会的地方抗灾行动计划将确保渣甸河第二条管道的安全作为基础设施的关键优先事项。该项目仍然没有资金支持。

paras.en: The council has also said it is considering a second raw water pond, estimated to cost $4 million, to increase storage capacity.
paras.zh: 该委员会还表示正在考虑建造第二个原水池，以增加储存能力，预计耗资 400 万美元。

articles.title: Frustrated Bowen says geopolitical tensions hurt COP consensus
articles.author: Paul Johnson

paras.en: Minister for Climate Change and Energy Chris Bowen has laid bare his frustrations over the outcome of COP31.
paras.zh: 气候变化和能源部长克里斯·鲍文 (Chris Bowen) 表达了他对 COP31 结果的不满。

paras.en: The climate negotiations in Türkiye broke down and ended without a deal after several countries and the 27-nation European Union said they could not accept a final proposal that did not mention fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 在多个国家和 27 个欧盟国家表示无法接受未提及化石燃料的最终提案后，土耳其气候谈判破裂并无果而终。

paras.en: The deal was rejected on Sunday afternoon at the summit at which Australia and Türkiye shared leadership.
paras.zh: 该协议于周日下午在澳大利亚和土耳其共同领导的峰会上被否决。

paras.en: In the aftermath Mr Bowen has been under attack from political rivals and Opposition Leader Angus Taylor called for Mr Bowen to resign.
paras.zh: 此后，鲍文先生受到政治对手的攻击，反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒呼吁鲍文先生辞职。

paras.en: Mr Bowen, speaking in his first interview since the conference, told 7.30 that the outcome of COP31 left him frustrated after Australia had spruiked plans for its own targets, including electrification.
paras.zh: Bowen 先生在会议后首次接受采访时表示，在澳大利亚大力宣传自己的目标（包括电气化）计划后，COP31 的结果让他感到沮丧。

paras.en: "The COP negotiations were going quite well, then got caught up in the use of the words 'fossil fuels'," Mr Bowen told 7.30.
paras.zh: “缔约方大会谈判进展顺利，但后来陷入了‘化石燃料’一词的使用，”鲍文先生告诉 7.30。

paras.en: "Frustration [was the feeling] at that point ... and a strong degree of disappointment that we were so close, had done so much work, and an issue then arose.
paras.zh: “当时的感觉是沮丧……以及一种强烈的失望，因为我们已经如此接近，做了如此多的工作，然后出现了一个问题。

paras.en: "Countries dug into positions and it was very, very hard to move because of the consensus model at COP."
paras.zh: “各国都坚持立场，但由于缔约方会议的共识模式，很难采取行动。”

paras.en: That consensus model means that all nations attending the climate summit have to agree on the resolution.
paras.zh: 这种共识模式意味着参加气候峰会的所有国家都必须就该决议达成一致。

paras.en: At COP28 that included a final deal with "historic" references to "transition away from fossil fuels", a pledge to triple renewable energy and a commitment to stop adding carbon dioxide to the atmosphere by mid-century.
paras.zh: 在 COP28 上，其中包括一项“历史性”提及“摆脱化石燃料”的最终协议，承诺将可再生能源增加三倍，并承诺到本世纪中叶停止向大气中排放二氧化碳。

paras.en: At COP31 that language was dropped as Mr Bowen blamed the consensus system and existing geopolitical tensions for stopping a final proposal that mentioned fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 在 COP31 上，由于鲍文先生指责共识体系和现有的地缘政治紧张局势阻止了提到化石燃料的最终提案，因此该语言被放弃。

paras.en: "In our first draft decision, we did have language about transition away from fossil fuels, and a number of countries indicated we then consult with every country," Mr Bowen said.
paras.zh: 鲍文先生说：“在我们的第一份决定草案中，我们确实有关于摆脱化石燃料的措辞，许多国家表示我们随后会与每个国家进行磋商。”

paras.en: He also said Australia wanted that language in the final agreement but existing tensions soon kicked in.
paras.zh: 他还表示，澳大利亚希望最终协议中包含这样的措辞，但现有的紧张局势很快就开始显现。

paras.en: "There were some countries, EU and others who said, 'these words must be in' and Saudi Arabia said 'these words must be out'," Mr Bowen added.
paras.zh: “有些国家、欧盟和其他国家说，‘这些话必须放进去’，而沙特阿拉伯则说‘这些话必须被取消’，”鲍文先生补充道。

paras.en: "And both parties were saying, 'we will veto it if they're in or veto it if they're out'.
paras.zh: “双方都说，‘如果他们加入，我们将否决它，如果他们退出，我们将否决它’。

paras.en: "That's not unusual at a COP [but] the difference this year was that countries were a lot harder to budge from their position.
paras.zh: “这在缔约方会议上并不罕见，但今年的不同之处在于，各国更难改变自己的立场。

paras.en: "I felt a lot of geopolitical tension in the room on other issues infecting the conversation and making it so much harder to negotiate.
paras.zh: “我感到房间里的地缘政治紧张气氛影响了对话的其他问题，使谈判变得更加困难。

paras.en: "The views were more dug in and dislike between parties much stronger this year than I've seen previously. "
paras.zh: “今年各党派之间的观点更加深入，不喜欢的程度比我以前看到的要强烈得多。”

paras.en: This COP was held amid tensions in the Middle East and Russia's ongoing war in Ukraine.
