articles.title: Oklahoma examination identifies unfair claims settlement violations by State Farm
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: A market examination report filed last week by the Oklahoma Insurance Department (OID) shows State Farm violated the state’s Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act dozens of times and failed to timely produce records examiners requested.
paras.zh: 俄克拉荷马州保险部 (OID) 上周提交的一份市场审查报告显示，State Farm 数十次违反了该州的《不公平索赔解决实践法》，并且未能及时提供审查员要求的记录。

paras.en: State Farm agreed to a settlement of more than $45 million after receiving the results of the OID’s examination into the company’s handling of homeowners’ claims for wind and hail damage to roofs. Within 30 days of receiving the order, State Farm must develop a Corrective Action Plan that includes the detailed steps it will take to come into full compliance with the Oklahoma Insurance Code.
paras.zh: State Farm 在收到 OID 对该公司处理房主因风和冰雹屋顶损坏索赔的处理情况进行调查的结果后，同意达成超过 4500 万美元的和解协议。 State Farm 必须在收到订单后 30 天内制定纠正行动计划，其中包括为完全遵守俄克拉荷马州保险法而将采取的详细步骤。

paras.en: The market examination period was Jan. 1, 2019 through Dec. 21, 2024, and included subsequent events through Sept. 30, 2026, when the report was filed. State Farm rebutted the report on Oct. 21.
paras.zh: 市场审查期为2019年1月1日至2024年12月21日，包括截至2026年9月30日提交报告的后续事件。 State Farm于10月21日反驳了该报道。

paras.en: According to the report, 58 claimants out of a sample of 181 permitted engineers to inspect their roofs for potential storm damage. The report notes that examiners only reviewed the claim files of those who permitted the inspections.
paras.zh: 报告称，在 181 名索赔人样本中，有 58 名索赔人允许工程师检查他们的屋顶是否有潜在的风暴损坏。报告指出，审查员只审查了那些允许检查的人的索赔档案。

paras.en: In 27 instances, the engineers determined that storm-related roof damage was sufficient to warrant repair or replacement.
paras.zh: 在 27 个实例中，工程师确定风暴造成的屋顶损坏足以需要维修或更换。

paras.en: “The examiners requested the engineering firm calculate estimates of roof repair or replacement costs based upon prevailing costs at the time of the company’s claims determination,” the report states. “The examiners reviewed the estimates of cost to repair the roofs provided by the engineering firm and determined that in twenty-two (22) of the twenty-seven (27) instances the engineering firm’s estimates of repair or replacement exceeded the insured’s policy deductible, contrary to State Farm’s determinations on those claims.”
paras.zh: 报告指出：“审查人员要求工程公司根据公司索赔确定时的现行成本来计算屋顶维修或更换成本的估算。” “审查人员审查了工程公司提供的屋顶维修成本估算，并确定在二十七 (27) 起案例中，有二十二 (22) 起工程公司估算的维修或更换费用超过了被保险人的保单免赔额，这与 State Farm 对这些索赔的决定相反。”

paras.en: According to the market examination report, State Farm:
paras.zh: 根据市场检验报告，State Farm：

paras.en: - Violated the Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act, specifically 36 O.S. § | 250.7(A), in three instances, or 1.66% of 181 files in the sample. The report states that in each instance, State Farm “failed to notify the claimant in writing that the claim was being denied or failed to retain a copy of such denial in writing in the CWOP [closed without payment] claim file.”
paras.zh: - 违反了《不公平索赔解决实践法》，特别是 36 O.S. § | 250.7(A)，在三个实例中，占样本中 181 个文件的 1.66%。报告指出，在每种情况下，State Farm“均未能以书​​面形式通知索赔人索赔被拒绝，或未能在 CWOP [未付款结案]索赔文件中保留书面拒绝的副本。”

paras.en: - Failed to comply with the Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act, specifically 36 O.S. § 1250.5(4), in at least 22 instances from Nov. 1, 2023 through Dec. 31, 2024 “by failing to make a good-faith effort to promptly, fairly, and equitably settle roofing claims for which liability had become reasonably clear.” Twenty-two errors out of 181 files provide a sample proportion of 12.15% errors.
paras.zh: - 未能遵守《不公平索赔解决实践法》，特别是 36 O.S. § 1250.5(4)，从2023年11月1日到2024年12月31日，至少有22个案例“未能做出善意的努力，及时、公平和公正地解决责任已经相当明确的屋顶索赔。” 181 个文件中有 22 个错误提供了 12.15% 错误的样本比例。

paras.en: - Failed to comply with 36 O.S. § 309.3, which requires timely production of records responsive to reasonable written requests of the examiners.
paras.zh: - 未能遵守 36 O.S. § 309.3，要求根据审查员的合理书面要求及时提供记录。

paras.en: The report states that examiners relied on records provided by State Farm to conduct the market examination, as well as claimant storm damage inspection reports provided by the independent third-party engineer, and public court documents from litigation involving State Farm in Oklahoma.
paras.zh: 报告指出，审查人员依赖 State Farm 提供的记录进行市场审查，以及独立第三方工程师提供的索赔人风暴损害检查报告，以及涉及俄克拉荷马州 State Farm 诉讼的公开法庭文件。

paras.en: During the examination period, A.M. Best Co. gave State Farm its highest rating of A++ (superior), according to the report. The report shows that State Farm homeowners policies in force grew by nearly 2.1 million nationally and nearly 48,000 in Oklahoma between Dec. 31, 2019 and Dec. 31, 2025. And its homeowners written premium nearly doubled in Oklahoma and nationally during the same period.
paras.zh: 考试期间，A.M.据报道，Best Co. 给予 State Farm 最高评级 A++（高级）。报告显示，2019 年 12 月 31 日至 2025 年 12 月 31 日期间，State Farm 的房主保单在全国范围内增加了近 210 万份，在俄克拉荷马州增加了近 48,000 份。同期，其房主在俄克拉荷马州和全国范围内的承保保费几乎翻了一番。

paras.en: The report includes, as an attachment, State Farm documents and email correspondence related to an Oklahoma home insurance claim lawsuit that were unsealed in August. At the time, the plaintiffs’ attorneys said the documents and emails prove the insurer is profiting by denying claims.
paras.zh: 该报告的附件包括与 8 月份启封的俄克拉荷马州家庭保险索赔诉讼相关的 State Farm 文件和电子邮件通信。当时，原告律师表示，这些文件和电子邮件证明保险公司通过拒绝索赔而获利。

paras.en: The report notes that the unsealed internal documents span from April 2020 through January 2024, and fulfill some of what examiners requested under the market examination but weren’t “timely produced” by State Farm.
paras.zh: 该报告指出，未密封的内部文件时间跨度为 2020 年 4 月至 2024 年 1 月，满足了审查人员在市场审查中要求的部分内容，但 State Farm 并未“及时制作”。

paras.en: Oklahoma Watch reported Monday that Mulready’s successor, Bob Sullivan, newly elected earlier this month, isn’t happy with how the state will be able to deal with State Farm moving forward under the terms of the settlement.
paras.zh: 《俄克拉荷马观察报》周一报道称，本月早些时候新当选的马尔雷迪的继任者鲍勃·沙利文对该州将如何根据和解条款处理国营农场的事宜并不满意。

paras.en: “Sullivan, in a phone interview Friday afternoon, said the settlement appeared to be good news for policyholders who have had their State Farm roof claims denied and haven’t filed their own lawsuits against the company,” the article states. “Still, he said the settlement agreement takes some regulatory flexibility off the table when it comes to dealing with State Farm.”
paras.zh: 文章称，“沙利文在周五下午的电话采访中表示，对于那些州立农场屋顶索赔被拒绝且尚未对该公司提起诉讼的投保人来说，和解似乎是个好消息。” “不过，他表示，在与 State Farm 打交道时，和解协议取消了一些监管灵活性。”

paras.en: Sullivan told Oklahoma Watch: “There’s a 12-month period where we’re not going to be opening market conduct examinations against State Farm as a result of this settlement agreement. I’m not in love with it.”
paras.zh: 沙利文告诉《俄克拉荷马观察》：“由于这项和解协议，我们将在 12 个月的时间内不会对 State Farm 进行市场行为检查。我不喜欢这样。”

paras.en: The article also states that, in a written statement, State Farm “disagreed with the conclusions in the market conduct exam.”
paras.zh: 文章还指出，State Farm 在一份书面声明中“不同意市场行为检查的结论”。

paras.en: “The company said it recorded $178.5 million in net underwriting losses in Oklahoma from 2021 to 2025,” the article states.
paras.zh: 文章称：“该公司表示，2021 年至 2025 年，其在俄克拉荷马州的净承保损失为 1.785 亿美元。”

paras.en: “‘Over the past five years, State Farm has responded to more than 100,000 claims in Oklahoma,'” the statement said, according to Oklahoma Watch. “‘A limited review of individual claims should not be mistaken for a complete picture of our overall claims-handling practices.'”
paras.zh: 据《俄克拉荷马观察报》报道，声明称，“过去五年，State Farm 已对俄克拉荷马州超过 10 万起索赔请求做出了回应”。 “‘对个人索赔的有限审查不应被误认为是对我们整体索赔处理实践的全面了解。’”

paras.en: The article adds that State Farm said, “the financial commitments in the settlement were part of a negotiated resolution, not a punitive fine imposed after State Farm accepted the report’s conclusions.”
paras.zh: 文章补充说，State Farm 表示，“和解中的财务承诺是谈判解决方案的一部分，而不是 State Farm 接受报告结论后施加的惩罚性罚款。”

paras.en: On Monday, a Cleveland County, Oklahoma judge sanctioned State Farm executives to answer questions on the stand in a pending lawsuit by two of its policyholders over a roof claim for hail damage, according to a report from Oklahoma’s News 4. The sanction comes after nearly a year of State Farm failing to produce documents for executive depositions, according to the news report.
paras.zh: 据《俄克拉荷马州新闻 4》报道，周一，俄克拉荷马州克利夫兰县的一名法官制裁 State Farm 高管，让他们在两名保单持有人就屋顶冰雹损坏索赔提起的未决诉讼中回答出庭提问。据新闻报道，该制裁是在 State Farm 近一年未能提供高管证词文件之后做出的。

paras.en: One of the plaintiffs’ attorneys said he hasn’t seen State Farm sanctioned since 2006. News 4 reports the insurer will take the stand in January.
paras.zh: 一位原告律师表示，自 2006 年以来，他从未见过 State Farm 受到制裁。News 4 报道称，该保险公司将于 1 月份出庭作证。

paras.en: This year’s CRASH Network Insurer Report Card survey is open, which asks collision repairers to grade each company from A+ to F based on how well insurers’ claims practices ensure quality repairs and customer service.
paras.zh: 今年的 CRASH Network 保险公司报告卡调查已开放，要求碰撞维修商根据保险公司的理赔实践确保维修质量和客户服务的情况，对每家公司进行从 A+ 到 F 的评级。

paras.en: In October, John Yoswick filled Repairer Driven News in on how the three-minute survey garners important information for the collision repair industry and consumers.
paras.zh: 10 月，约翰·约斯威克 (John Yoswick) 在《维修驱动新闻》(Repairer Driven News) 中介绍了这项三分钟的调查如何为碰撞维修行业和消费者获取重要信息。

paras.en: “The key reason that we believe shops should participate is the Insurer Report Card can then help educate consumers,” said Yoswick, CRASH Network’s editor. “We get 1,000 shops participating, and the result is a free report that anyone can download, including consumers, showing grades for 90-plus insurers.”
paras.zh: CRASH Network 编辑 Yoswick 表示：“我们认为商店应该参与的关键原因是保险公司报告卡可以帮助教育消费者。” “我们有 1,000 家商店参与，结果是一份任何人都可以免费下载的报告，包括消费者，其中显示了 90 多家保险公司的评级。”

paras.en: He added that the survey isn’t just on the top 10 national insurers; it includes smaller, regional carriers, depending on where carriers do business. Depending on location, repairers oftentimes grade 20 or 30 carriers in their respective state.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这项调查不仅针对全国排名前 10 的保险公司，还针对全国排名前 10 的保险公司。它包括较小的区域性运营商，具体取决于运营商开展业务的地点。根据地点的不同，维修人员通常会在各自的州对 20 或 30 个运营商进行评级。

paras.en: To request a link to the Insurer Report Card survey, visit crashnetwork.com/irc/signup.php.
paras.zh: 要请求保险公司报告卡调查的链接，请访问 crashnetwork.com/irc/signup.php。

articles.title: What Goes Into Developing an OE Tire?
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: OE tire development requires manufacturers to engineer tires that match the performance requirements of new vehicles. This process involves balancing safety, rolling resistance, noise and sustainability. These priorities can vary depending on the vehicle, market and emerging technologies such as electric vehicles.
paras.zh: OE 轮胎开发要求制造商设计符合新车性能要求的轮胎。这个过程涉及平衡安全性、滚动阻力、噪音和可持续性。这些优先事项可能会根据车辆、市场和电动汽车等新兴技术的不同而有所不同。

paras.en: Many tire manufacturers now begin the development process with virtual testing.
paras.zh: 许多轮胎制造商现在通过虚拟测试开始开发过程。

paras.en: Some manufacturers, like Continental, use simulators and virtual testing to evaluate handling, noise and rolling resistance before producing physical prototypes.
paras.zh: 大陆集团等一些制造商在生产物理原型之前使用模拟器和虚拟测试来评估操控性、噪音和滚动阻力。

paras.en: Following virtual evaluations, tires undergo laboratory testing and real-world driving assessments. These tests help manufacturers determine whether simulated performance results translate to actual road conditions. The development process helps tire manufacturers produce OE tires that meet vehicle-specific requirements and support the performance characteristics intended by the automaker.
paras.zh: 经过虚拟评估后，轮胎将接受实验室测试和真实驾驶评估。这些测试帮助制造商确定模拟性能结果是否可以转化为实际路况。该开发流程可帮助轮胎制造商生产满足车辆特定要求并支持汽车制造商预期性能特征的原配轮胎。

articles.title: Separating AGM Battery Facts From The Myths
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Have you noticed more batteries are moving into the trunks and under the seats of some vehicles? Chances are, if the battery is not under the hood, it is an absorbent glass mat (AGM) or gel cell battery. AGM eliminates acid spilling in an accident because it is sealed. They can be installed at odd angles.
paras.zh: 您是否注意到越来越多的电池被移入某些车辆的后备箱和座椅下方？如果电池不在引擎盖下，则很可能是吸收性玻璃垫 (AGM) 或凝胶电池。由于 AGM 是密封的，因此可以避免事故中的酸溢出。它们可以以奇怪的角度安装。

paras.en: These batteries pack a lot of power for their size and weight, which allows manufacturers to shave off a few pounds from the vehicle. That’s a big reason why they are being found more and more on late-model vehicles. Also, these batteries have a greater reserve capacity to support stop/start systems and key-off functions.
paras.zh: 这些电池的尺寸和重量可提供大量电力，这使得制造商可以减轻车辆的重量。这就是为什么它们越来越多地出现在新型车辆上的一个重要原因。此外，这些电池具有更大的储备容量来支持停止/启动系统和熄火功能。

paras.en: Here are the four AGM battery myths that you may have heard.
paras.zh: 以下是您可能听说过的四个 AGM 电池误区。

paras.en: You can use your regular battery charger on AGM or gel cell batteries.
paras.zh: 您可以对 AGM 或凝胶电池使用常规电池充电器。

paras.en: These batteries like to be charged slow and low due to differences in internal resistance.
paras.zh: 由于内阻差异，这些电池喜欢缓慢且低速充电。

paras.en: Many AGM battery chargers have microprocessors that collect information from the battery and adjust the current and voltage accordingly. Some have different settings for charging flooded or AGM batteries. Overcharging can kill these batteries. Also, alternators are not chargers. Don’t rely on an alternator to do the work of a charger. If a battery is discharged to the point that it cannot start the vehicle, use a charger as soon as possible to make sure the battery gets fully charged.
paras.zh: 许多 AGM 电池充电器都具有微处理器，可以从电池收集信息并相应地调整电流和电压。有些电池有不同的充电设置。过度充电会损坏这些电池。此外，交流发电机不是充电器。不要依赖交流发电机来完成充电器的工作。如果电池放电到无法启动车辆的程度，请尽快使用充电器以确保电池充满电。

paras.en: Can AGMs and gel cells be tested the same way as conventional batteries?
paras.zh: AGM 和凝胶电池可以像传统电池一样进行测试吗？

paras.en: These types of batteries have lower internal resistance than flooded batteries. Older capacitance battery testers/analyzers may not be able to accurately read these batteries. Most new battery analyzers have a special mode for AGM/gel cell batteries. Old-school load testers might not provide conclusive results.
paras.zh: 这些类型的电池比富液电池具有更低的内阻。较旧的电容电池测试仪/分析仪可能无法准确读取这些电池。大多数新型电池分析仪都有针对 AGM/凝胶电池的特殊模式。老式负载测试仪可能无法提供结论性的结果。

paras.en: Using a multimeter to measure the state of charge is not the same as with a conventional flooded battery. After the surface charge is removed, the voltage of an AGM with 100% state of charge might be 13.0-volts. A flooded battery might have only 12.6-volts.
paras.zh: 使用万用表测量充电状态与传统的富液式电池不同。去除表面电荷后，100% 充电状态的 AGM 电压可能为 13.0 伏。充满水的电池可能只有 12.6 伏。

paras.en: AGM or gel cell battery replacement is the same as flooded battery replacement.
paras.zh: AGM 或凝胶电池的更换与水淹电池的更换相同。

paras.en: While the installation of the battery may be the same for the two battery styles, some vehicles require an extra step to tell the vehicle that the battery has been replaced.
paras.zh: 虽然两种电池类型的电池安装可能相同，但某些车辆需要额外的步骤来告诉车辆电池已更换。

paras.en: Newer GM vehicles have a Battery Sensor Module on the negative battery cable. Ford has the Battery Monitoring System (BMS). Other manufacturers have similar systems. These systems require recalibration with a scan tool if the battery is replaced. If the system is not recalibrated, the alternator might overcharge the new battery and cause the battery to fail soon after replacement.
paras.zh: 较新的通用汽车车辆的负极电池电缆上有一个电池传感器模块。福特拥有电池监控系统（BMS）。其他制造商也有类似的系统。如果更换电池，这些系统需要使用扫描工具重新校准。如果系统未重新校准，交流发电机可能会对新电池过度充电，并导致电池在更换后很快出现故障。

paras.en: Some vehicles can perform a self-learn for the battery by measuring the internal resistance
paras.zh: 有些车辆可以通过测量内阻来对电池进行自学习

paras.en: of the battery. But often a scan tool can force the procedure so you know there will be no issues with
paras.zh: 电池的。但扫描工具通常可以强制执行该过程，因此您知道不会有任何问题

paras.en: You can’t upgrade a customer to an AGM battery if the vehicle originally came with a flooded battery.
paras.zh: 如果车辆最初配备的是富液电池，则您无法将客户升级到 AGM 电池。

paras.en: You can install an AGM battery into a flooded battery application. An AGM battery will give the vehicle more cold cranking power and greater resistance to heat and vibration. However, you never want to downgrade a vehicle that came with an AGM battery to a flooded battery.
paras.zh: 您可以将 AGM 电池安装到富液式电池应用中。 AGM 电池将为车辆提供更强的冷启动功率以及更强的耐热性和抗振性。然而，您永远不想将配备 AGM 电池的车辆降级为富液电池。

articles.title: YANG Launches 2027 Mentorship Program
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Young Auto Care Network Group (YANG), a community of the Auto Care Association, recently launched its 2027 YANG Mentorship Program. Now in its fifth year, the program averages 125 mentees and 24 volunteer mentors annually. Anyone under age 40 who joins the YANG community can participate for free.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的青年汽车护理网络集团 (YANG) 最近启动了 2027 年 YANG 指导计划。该项目现已进入第五个年头，平均每年有 125 名学员和 24 名志愿者导师。任何 40 岁以下加入 YANG 社区的人都可以免费参与。

paras.en: “One of the most valuable aspects of my involvement with YANG has been the relationships I’ve built with individuals who genuinely challenge me to grow, both personally and professionally,” said Brandon Crenshaw, chair, YANG. “The Mentorship Program creates an opportunity to go beyond networking, by building meaningful connections, challenging your own perspectives, and developing the confidence and perspective to lead in new ways. It’s an experience I encourage every young professional in our industry to embrace.”
paras.zh: YANG 主席布兰登·克伦肖 (Brandon Crenshaw) 表示：“我参与 YANG 的最有价值的方面之一是我与那些真正挑战我成长的人建立了关系，无论是个人还是职业。” “导师计划通过建立有意义的联系、挑战自己的观点以及培养以新方式领导的信心和视角，创造了一个超越网络的机会。我鼓励我们行业的每一位年轻专业人士接受这种经历。”

paras.en: Each YANG mentee will rank industry-specific topics by preference to form mentorship circles. Examples of topics include:
paras.zh: 每个 YANG 学员都会根据偏好对特定行业主题进行排序，形成导师圈。主题示例包括：

paras.en: - Navigating change, building influence and earning your seat at the table
paras.zh: - 驾驭变革、建立影响力并赢得席位

paras.en: - Standing out and the importance of networking
paras.zh: - 脱颖而出和网络的重要性

paras.en: Each mentorship circle consists of approximately five mentees and one mentor focused on a unique topic.
paras.zh: 每个导师圈由大约五名学员和一名专注于某个独特主题的导师组成。

paras.en: Organizers will assign groups after registration closes Nov. 30. Participants will then join the YANG Mentorship Program kickoff meeting in January 2027. Each mentorship circle will meet once per quarter throughout 2027. The program runs from January through December 2027.
paras.zh: 组织者将在 11 月 30 日报名截止后分配小组。参与者随后将参加 2027 年 1 月举行的 YANG 导师计划启动会议。每个导师圈将在 2027 年每季度举行一次会议。该计划从 2027 年 1 月持续到 2027 年 12 月。

paras.en: The YANG Mentorship Program aims to help mentees experience all three YANG pillars: networking, professional development and giving back. Through this small-group mentorship program, mentees will benefit from the experience of automotive aftermarket veterans.
paras.zh: YANG 导师计划旨在帮助受训者体验 YANG 的所有三个支柱：网络、专业发展和回馈。通过这个小组辅导计划，学员将受益于汽车售后市场资深人士的经验。

paras.en: The program targets young automotive aftermarket professionals who want to advance their careers. It provides opportunities for members to focus on individual professional goals while developing the skills to become future leaders.
paras.zh: 该计划针对希望提升职业生涯的年轻汽车售后专业人士。它为会员提供了专注于个人职业目标的机会，同时培养成为未来领导者的技能。

articles.title: How Regenerative Braking Changes Repair and Inspection
articles.author: Joe Keene

paras.en: Regenerative braking allows electric vehicles to recover energy during deceleration. Instead of converting all vehicle momentum into heat at the brake rotors, the electric motor acts as a generator. This slows the vehicle while returning some energy to the battery.
paras.zh: 再生制动允许电动汽车在减速过程中回收能量。电动机不是将所有车辆动量转化为制动转子的热量，而是充当发电机。这会减慢车辆的速度，同时将一些能量返回给电池。

paras.en: The process can significantly reduce the use of conventional friction brakes. However, reduced brake usage can also create maintenance challenges involving corrosion and component operation.
paras.zh: 该过程可以显着减少传统摩擦制动器的使用。然而，减少制动器的使用也会带来涉及腐蚀和部件操作的维护挑战。

paras.en: On conventional internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles, brake pads regularly contact the rotors during braking. This friction helps remove light surface corrosion from the rotor faces.
paras.zh: 在传统的内燃机 (ICE) 车辆上，刹车片在制动过程中会定期接触转子。这种摩擦有助于消除转子表面的轻微表面腐蚀。

paras.en: EVs with aggressive regenerative braking may use their friction brakes less frequently. Exposure to moisture, road salt and humidity can then allow corrosion to develop on the rotor surfaces.
paras.zh: 具有积极再生制动功能的电动汽车可能会减少使用摩擦制动器的频率。暴露在湿气、道路盐分和湿气中会导致转子表面发生腐蚀。

paras.en: EV Regenerative Braking and Rotor Corrosion
paras.zh: 电动汽车再生制动和转子腐蚀

paras.en: Light surface rust is not necessarily a problem because normal brake applications can remove it. However, corrosion can progress when friction brakes are not used regularly.
paras.zh: 轻微的表面锈迹不一定是问题，因为正常的制动应用可以将其去除。然而，如果不定期使用摩擦制动器，腐蚀就会加剧。

paras.en: Over time, heavier rust, pitting and scaling can develop on the rotors. Once the rotor surfaces deteriorate significantly, normal brake applications may not restore their condition.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，转子上会出现更严重的锈迹、点蚀和氧化皮。一旦转子表面明显恶化，正常的制动应用可能无法恢复其状态。

paras.en: Reduced friction brake usage can also extend brake pad life. However, brake components can develop problems unrelated to friction material wear.
paras.zh: 减少摩擦制动器的使用也可以延长刹车片的使用寿命。然而，制动部件可能会出现与摩擦材料磨损无关的问题。

paras.en: Corrosion may form around brake pad hardware, caliper brackets, slide pins and other components. Pads can become restricted in their brackets, while caliper components may develop problems from limited movement.
paras.zh: 刹车片硬件、卡钳支架、滑销和其他部件周围可能会出现腐蚀。刹车片可能会受到支架的限制，而卡钳部件可能会因运动受限而出现问题。

paras.en: As a result, brake components may require replacement because of corrosion or restricted movement rather than normal wear.
paras.zh: 因此，制动部件可能因腐蚀或运动受限而不是正常磨损而需要更换。

paras.en: How Regenerative and Friction Braking Work Together
paras.zh: 再生制动和摩擦制动如何协同工作

paras.en: Electric vehicles still require conventional hydraulic friction brakes to maintain stopping performance.
paras.zh: 电动汽车仍然需要传统的液压摩擦制动器来保持制动性能。

paras.en: Regenerative braking may become reduced or unavailable under certain operating conditions. These include a fully charged battery, very cold battery temperatures, vehicle stability control intervention or certain system faults.
paras.zh: 在某些操作条件下，再生制动可能会减弱或不可用。这些包括充满电的电池、极低的电池温度、车辆稳定性控制干预或某些系统故障。

paras.en: EV braking systems blend regenerative braking with conventional hydraulic friction braking to provide the stopping performance drivers expect.
paras.zh: 电动汽车制动系统将再生制动与传统的液压摩擦制动相结合，以提供驾驶员期望的制动性能。

paras.en: This makes conventional brake system condition an important consideration, even when regenerative braking reduces normal friction brake usage.
paras.zh: 这使得传统制动系统状况成为一个重要的考虑因素，即使再生制动减少了正常的摩擦制动使用。

paras.en: EV Brake Inspection and Maintenance Considerations
paras.zh: 电动汽车制动器检查和维护注意事项

paras.en: Technicians should account for reduced friction brake usage when inspecting electric vehicle braking systems.
paras.zh: 技术人员在检查电动汽车制动系统时应考虑减少摩擦制动器的使用。

paras.en: Measuring brake pad thickness alone may not provide a complete picture of component condition.
paras.zh: 仅测量刹车片厚度可能无法提供部件状况的完整信息。

paras.en: EV regenerative braking improves efficiency by recovering energy and can substantially extend brake pad life. However, reduced friction brake usage can also increase the potential for corrosion and restricted component movement.
paras.zh: 电动汽车再生制动通过回收能量来提高效率，并可以大大延长刹车片的使用寿命。然而，减少摩擦制动器的使用也会增加腐蚀和限制部件运动的可能性。

paras.en: Brake condition assessments should account for both friction material wear and the effects of limited brake usage.
paras.zh: 制动状况评估应考虑摩擦材料磨损和限制制动使用的影响。

articles.title: The Group Begins 2026 Toys for Tots Drive
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: For the 15th consecutive year, members of the Automotive Parts Services Group (a.k.a. The Group) are supporting the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots campaign by collecting toy and monetary donations for children in need in their communities.
paras.zh: 汽车零部件服务集团（又名“集团”）的成员连续第 15 年支持美国海军陆战队为儿童储备玩具活动，为社区中有需要的儿童收集玩具和金钱捐款。

paras.en: “Over the years, our Toys for Tots partnership has continued to grow as we collect toys and raise funds to bring holiday cheer to children in need across the country,” said John Marcum, director of marketing at Federated Auto Parts. “The Group’s members have played an important role in growing the campaign through their commitment to promoting the program and encouraging community support. What began as a holiday effort has grown into a year-round initiative. We extend our sincere thanks to the Federated Alliance, The Pronto Network and our supplier partners for their ongoing generosity and commitment to this cause.”
paras.zh: Federated Auto Parts 营销总监约翰·马库姆 (John Marcum) 表示：“多年来，我们与 Toys for Tots 的合作不断发展，我们收集玩具并筹集资金，为全国有需要的儿童带来节日欢乐。” “集团成员致力于推广该计划并鼓励社区支持，在推动这项活动方面发挥了重要作用。最初的假日活动已发展成为一项全年活动。我们衷心感谢联邦联盟、Pronto Network 和我们的供应商合作伙伴对这一事业的持续慷慨和承诺。”

paras.en: Since partnering with the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots Program, The Group, its members and vendor partners have helped raise over $4 million for Toys for Tots.
paras.zh: 自从与美国海军陆战队后备儿童玩具计划合作以来，该集团、其成员和供应商合作伙伴已帮助为儿童玩具筹集了超过 400 万美元的资金。

paras.en: In addition to toy donations at participating locations, financial contributions can be made online by visiting The Group’s Toys for Tots website and clicking on “Make a Donation.” Donors can use a credit card securely or print out a form and mail it with a check made payable to Toys for Tots.
paras.zh: 除了在参与地点捐赠玩具外，还可以通过访问该集团的 Toys for Tots 网站并点击“捐赠”来在线捐款。捐赠者可以安全地使用信用卡，也可以打印表格并附上抬头为 Toys for Tots 的支票邮寄。

paras.en: “All donations made online or at participating member locations are distributed in the area where the toys and money are collected, helping make the holidays brighter for deserving children in their own communities,” said Marcum.
paras.zh: 马库姆说：“所有在线或在参与会员地点进行的捐款都会分发到收集玩具和金钱的区域，帮助他们自己社区的孩子们度过一个更加美好的假期。”

paras.en: Last year, the campaign delivered 24 million toys to nearly 11 million children and since 1947, the Marine Toys for Tots Foundation has distributed more than 732 million toys to more than 325 million children.
paras.zh: 去年，该活动向近 1100 万儿童分发了 2400 万件玩具，自 1947 年以来，海洋儿童玩具基金会已向超过 3.25 亿儿童分发了超过 7.32 亿件玩具。

articles.title: National Signing Day Welcomes Young Technicians Into the Industry with Fanfare
articles.author: NAPA

paras.en: National Signing Day: held in the spring, it features young soon-to-be professionals signing letters of intent affirming their path of choice and receiving a scholarship in turn.
paras.zh: 全国签约日：在春季举行，年轻的未来专业人士签署意向书，确认他们选择的道路，并依次获得奖学金。

paras.en: College football? No, better: the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 大学橄榄球？不，更好的是：汽车售后市场。

paras.en: That’s right: NAPA and Skills USA held their own National Signing Day on May 6, marking the day as a nationwide celebration recognizing students choosing careers in the automotive, diesel and motorsports industries.
paras.zh: 没错：NAPA 和 Skills USA 于 5 月 6 日举办了自己的全国签名日，将这一天作为全国性的庆祝活动，表彰在汽车、柴油机和赛车运动行业选择职业的学生。

paras.en: As with football, the automotive technical industry needs plenty of young people coming into the profession, and like a college that recruits a player to play for them, we need to make them feel at home in the industry.
paras.zh: 与足球一样，汽车技术行业需要大量年轻人进入这个行业，就像大学招募球员为他们效力一样，我们需要让他们在这个行业有宾至如归的感觉。

paras.en: On May 6, NAPA and Skills USA welcomed six students from Georgia to Truist Park, home of the Atlanta Braves, to sign letters of intent and officially commit to careers as automotive technicians.
paras.zh: 5 月 6 日，NAPA 和 Skills USA 迎来了六名来自佐治亚州的学生来到亚特兰大勇士队的主场 Truist Park，签署意向书并正式致力于汽车技术员的职业生涯。

paras.en: Each student received a Carlyle toolbox kit packed with the necessary tools to get their careers going. They knew that was going to happen, but what they didn’t know was that Cassie Bell, chief people officer at NAPA, was going to surprise them with $2,500 scholarships to support their post-secondary education in the industry.
paras.zh: 每个学生都收到了凯雷工具箱，其中包含推动他们职业发展所需的工具。他们知道这将会发生，但他们不知道的是 NAPA 首席人力官 Cassie Bell 将为他们提供 2,500 美元的奖学金，以支持他们在该行业的高等教育。

paras.en: “This is one of my favorite nights of the year,” said Bell. “National Signing Day is a moment the whole country pauses to recognize students stepping into their futures, and we wanted to make sure the students choosing the skilled trades felt that same energy and excitement. We talk a lot about investing in our people, and tonight that means making sure these students know how thrilled the industry is to welcome them.”
paras.zh: “这是我一年中最喜欢的夜晚之一，”贝尔说。 “全国签约日是整个国家停下来认可学生踏入未来的时刻，我们希望确保选择技术行业的学生感受到同样的活力和兴奋。我们谈论了很多关于投资于我们的员工，今晚这意味着确保这些学生知道整个行业是多么高兴地欢迎他们。”

articles.title: Autel Expands Nissan Diagnostic and ADAS Access
articles.author: Brake and Front End Staff

paras.en: Autel U.S. has released diagnostic and ADAS software updates for Nissan vehicles using the Consult 4 platform. The updates expand bidirectional control and ADAS calibration access across supported North American vehicles.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 已使用 Consult 4 平台为日产汽车发布了诊断和 ADAS 软件更新。这些更新扩展了受支持的北美车辆的双向控制和 ADAS 校准访问。

paras.en: The Nissan diagnostic software is available on supported MaxiSYS Ultra and Ultra S2 tablets. ADAS calibration capability is available on these tablets with ADAS calibration software installed.
paras.zh: Nissan 诊断软件可在受支持的 MaxiSYS Ultra 和 Ultra S2 平板电脑上使用。这些安装了 ADAS 校准软件的平板电脑上提供 ADAS 校准功能。

paras.en: Available functions depend on the vehicle and system. They include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, Active Tests and ADAS calibration procedures.
paras.zh: 可用功能取决于车辆和系统。其中包括 ECU 信息、代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和 ADAS 校准程序。

paras.en: Supported Autel tablets access protected vehicle functions through AutoAuth. The independent service works with manufacturers and aftermarket tool providers to verify shops, technicians and tools for secure vehicle access.
paras.zh: 支持的 Autel 平板电脑通过 AutoAuth 访问受保护的车辆功能。该独立服务与制造商和售后工具提供商合作，验证商店、技术人员和工具以确保车辆安全访问。

paras.en: Authenticated Access for Newer Nissan Platforms
paras.zh: 对较新 Nissan 平台进行身份验证的访问

paras.en: Nissan began incorporating security-gateway protections into select North American vehicles with the 2020 model year. These protections restrict designated bidirectional functions unless the technician, shop and diagnostic tool receive proper authentication.
paras.zh: 日产开始将安全网关保护纳入 2020 年款的精选北美车辆中。这些保护措施限制指定的双向功能，除非技术人员、车间和诊断工具得到适当的认证。

paras.en: Autel has offered AutoAuth-based Nissan security-gateway access for several years. The access applies to vehicles supported by Nissan’s Consult-III plus diagnostic platform.
paras.zh: Autel 多年来一直提供基于 AutoAuth 的 Nissan 安全网关访问。该访问权限适用于日产 Consult-III plus 诊断平台支持的车辆。

paras.en: Nissan introduced its newer web-based Consult 4 diagnostic software for the 2023 Nissan Ariya. The automaker now uses the software on a growing number of newer vehicle platforms.
paras.zh: Nissan 为 2023 款 Nissan Ariya 推出了更新的基于网络的 Consult 4 诊断软件。该汽车制造商现在在越来越多的新型车辆平台上使用该软件。

paras.en: Supporting protected functions required Autel to develop and validate a compatible authorization process. The process works with the vehicles’ newer electronic architectures.
paras.zh: 支持受保护的功能需要 Autel 开发并验证兼容的授权流程。该过程适用于车辆更新的电子架构。

paras.en: Autel’s new capability expands diagnostic and ADAS calibration access across supported Nissan vehicles using Consult 4.
paras.zh: Autel 的新功能使用 Consult 4 扩展了支持的 Nissan 车辆的诊断和 ADAS 校准访问。

paras.en: Available functions depend on the vehicle and system. They include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, Active Tests and ADAS calibration procedures.
paras.zh: 可用功能取决于车辆和系统。其中包括 ECU 信息、代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和 ADAS 校准程序。

paras.en: North American Nissan vehicles using Consult 4 include:
paras.zh: 使用 Consult 4 的北美 Nissan 车辆包括：

paras.en: - 2025 and newer Nissan Kicks, Murano, Pathfinder and Armada
paras.zh: - 2025 年及更新款 Nissan Kicks、Murano、Pathfinder 和 Armada

paras.en: Autel issued the expanded capabilities through the Nissan_V7.40 diagnostic software and Nissan_ADAS V5.20 software released on Sept. 9.
paras.zh: Autel通过9月9日发布的Nissan_V7.40诊断软件和Nissan_ADAS V5.20软件发布了扩展功能。

paras.en: Access requires an active Autel software subscription and an active AutoAuth account for Nissan access. ADAS calibration also requires applicable Autel software, equipment, targets and accessories.
paras.zh: 访问需要有效的 Autel 软件订阅和有效的 AutoAuth 帐户才能进行 Nissan 访问。 ADAS 校准还需要适用的 Autel 软件、设备、目标和配件。

paras.en: Supported Consult 4 vehicle coverage does not require a separate AutoAuth service tier. Eligible users can obtain the software releases through the standard update process on their Autel tablet.
paras.zh: 支持的 Consult 4 车辆覆盖范围不需要单独的 AutoAuth 服务层。符合条件的用户可以通过 Autel 平板电脑上的标准更新流程获取软件版本。

articles.title: MAHLE Receives EcoVadis Gold Medal for Sustainability
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: MAHLE has received the EcoVadis Gold Medal for its sustainability performance for the second time. With 88 out of a possible 100 points, the MAHLE Group improved its score by 6 points compared with the previous year. This places the technology group among the top 1 percent of automotive suppliers.
paras.zh: 马勒因其可持续发展表现第二次荣获 EcoVadis 金奖。马勒集团的得分为 88 分（满分 100 分），较上年提高了 6 分。这使得该技术集团跻身汽车供应商前 1% 之列。

paras.en: MAHLE achieved improvements across all four assessed areas: Labor & Human Rights, Environment, Sustainable Procurement, and Ethics. The result reflects the implementation of the sustainability goals as part of the MAHLE 2030+ Group strategy, the company said. EcoVadis is one of the world’s leading independent providers of corporate sustainability ratings.
paras.zh: 马勒在所有四个评估领域都取得了进步：劳工与人权、环境、可持续采购和道德。该公司表示，这一结果反映了作为马勒2030+集团战略一部分的可持续发展目标的实施。 EcoVadis 是全球领先的企业可持续发展评级独立提供商之一。

paras.en: Executive Commentary on Sustainability and Competitiveness
paras.zh: 关于可持续性和竞争力的执行评论

paras.en: “For MAHLE, sustainability is not only a social responsibility but also an important factor in long-term competitiveness. The EcoVadis result shows our customers, business partners, and employees that we systematically integrate environmental, social, and ethical requirements into our processes,” said Georg Dietz, member of the MAHLE Group Management Board and responsible, among other areas, for sustainability, environmental management and occupational safety.
paras.zh: “对于马勒来说，可持续发展不仅是一种社会责任，也是长期竞争力的重要因素。EcoVadis 的结果向我们的客户、业务合作伙伴和员工表明，我们系统地将环境、社会和道德要求融入到我们的流程中。”马勒集团管理委员会成员、负责可持续发展、环境管理和职业安全等领域的 Georg Dietz 说道。

paras.en: “The further improvement is the result of the joint efforts of numerous teams around the world. They have continued to develop our processes across the areas assessed by EcoVadis and, in doing so, made a significant contribution to this achievement,” said Kathrin Apel, director corporate sustainability and occupational health, safety and environmental management at MAHLE.
paras.zh: 马勒企业可持续发展及职业健康、安全和环境管理总监凯瑟琳·阿佩尔 (Kathrin Apel) 表示：“进一步的改进是全球众多团队共同努力的结果。他们在 EcoVadis 评估的领域中持续开发我们的流程，并为此做出了重大贡献。”

paras.en: MAHLE said it has further expanded its sustainability activities in recent years and has continuously improved its EcoVadis rating. Key factors contributing to the current result include advances in supply chain management and the successful participation in the audit program of the Responsible Supply Chain Initiative (RSCI). Collaboration with suppliers of critical raw materials has been further strengthened.
paras.zh: 马勒表示，近年来进一步扩大了可持续发展活动，并不断提高了EcoVadis评级。促成当前结果的关键因素包括供应链管理的进步以及成功参与责任供应链倡议 (RSCI) 的审核计划。与关键原材料供应商的合作进一步加强。

paras.en: EcoVadis independently assesses the environmental, social, and ethical performance of more than 175,000 companies of all sizes across 250 industry categories and more than 180 countries.
paras.zh: EcoVadis 独立评估 180 多个国家/地区 250 个行业类别的 175,000 多家各种规模的公司的环境、社会和道德绩效。

articles.title: Air Suspension Market to Hit $9.11B by 2033
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The air suspension market is projected to reach $9.11 billion by 2033, up from $6.53 billion in 2026, at a CAGR of 4.9%, according to MarketsandMarkets.
paras.zh: 根据 MarketsandMarkets 的数据，空气悬架市场预计将从 2026 年的 65.3 亿美元增至 2033 年的 91.1 亿美元，复合年增长率为 4.9%。

paras.en: Air suspension is poised for growth in heavy-duty trucks and buses, driven by OEM demand for improved ride isolation, axle-load management, and chassis stability. Electronically controlled air suspension (ECAS) delivers consistent ride height across varying payloads—enhancing cargo protection in long-haul transport and enabling kneeling functions and passenger comfort in buses.
paras.zh: 在原始设备制造商对改善行驶隔离、轴荷管理和底盘稳定性的需求的推动下，空气悬架有望在重型卡车和公共汽车中增长。电子控制空气悬架 (ECAS) 在不同的有效载荷下提供一致的行驶高度，增强长途运输中的货物保护，并在公交车中实现跪姿功能和乘客舒适度。

paras.en: For suppliers, the primary strategic opportunity lies in capturing higher system value by expanding from basic air springs into integrated ECAS controllers, height sensors, valves, and compressors, according to the MarketsandMarkets report. In electric vehicles, where heavy battery packs alter axle-load dynamics, modular air suspensions (such as ZF’s AIRTRAC or Karsan’s e-ATA platform) help stabilize chassis performance; however, air systems do not automatically increase payload capacity, making lightweight design and e-axle packaging critical to securing OEM design wins.
paras.zh: 根据 MarketsandMarkets 的报告，对于供应商来说，主要的战略机遇在于通过从基本空气弹簧扩展到集成 ECAS 控制器、高度传感器、阀门和压缩机来获取更高的系统价值。在电动汽车中，重型电池组会改变轴荷动态，模块化空气悬架（例如 ZF 的 AITRAC 或 Karsan 的 e-ATA 平台）有助于稳定底盘性能；然而，空气系统不会自动增加有效负载能力，因此轻量化设计和电子车桥包装对于确保 OEM 设计获胜至关重要。

paras.en: Despite these drivers, adoption will vary by segment due to higher upfront costs, added maintenance complexity, and potential air leakage or component wear compared with mechanical suspensions. Fleet conversion depends on proving clear lifecycle returns—such as reduced tire wear, better cargo protection, and improved uptime—to justify the cost beyond premium and high-utilization applications.
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些驱动因素，但与机械悬架相比，由于前期成本较高、维护复杂性增加以及潜在的漏气或部件磨损，各细分市场的采用情况也会有所不同。车队转换取决于证明明确的生命周期回报（例如减少轮胎磨损、更好的货物保护和更长的正常运行时间），以证明超出优质和高利用率应用的成本是合理的。

paras.en: ECAS Expected to Hold Largest Technology Share in 2026
paras.zh: ECAS 预计将在 2026 年占据最大的技术份额

paras.en: Electronically controlled air suspension is expected to hold the largest share because it converts air suspension from a passive load-support mechanism into an intelligent chassis-control system. Height sensors, pressure feedback, electronic control units, and solenoid valves enable precise ride-height regulation irrespective of payload, improving axle-load management, vehicle stability, and suspension response.
paras.zh: 电子控制空气悬架预计将占据最大份额，因为它将空气悬架从被动负载支撑机制转变为智能底盘控制系统。高度传感器、压力反馈、电子控制单元和电磁阀可实现精确的行驶高度调节，无论有效负载如何，从而改善轴荷管理、车辆稳定性和悬架响应。

paras.en: Advanced ECAS also enables automatic lift-axle control, traction optimization, and programmable chassis-height adjustment for loading docks—functions that can reduce tire wear, improve operational efficiency, and support fleet productivity. A key trend is system integration and software-enabled functionality; for instance, ZF’s fifth-generation OptiRide ECAS consolidates pressure sensing and valve actuation into a Smart Pneumatic Actuator, reducing component count, wiring, piping, and OEM integration effort.
paras.zh: 先进的 ECAS 还支持自动提升桥控制、牵引力优化以及装卸码头的可编程底盘高度调整，这些功能可以减少轮胎磨损、提高运营效率并支持车队生产力。一个主要趋势是系统集成和软件支持的功能；例如，ZF 的第五代 OptiRide ECAS 将压力传感和阀门驱动整合到智能气动执行器中，减少了组件数量、接线、管道和 OEM 集成工作。

paras.en: As commercial vehicles adopt more electronic controls and electrified architectures, ECAS will increasingly be integrated with braking, stability, and vehicle-level control systems. Future applications are likely to expand in urban low-floor and electric buses, where kneeling improves passenger accessibility, as well as heavy-duty trucks and trailers requiring dynamic load management and efficient axle utilization. Asia-Pacific offers a growth opportunity as bus electrification and ultra-low-entry platforms gain traction, while Europe remains a key market for sophisticated commercial-vehicle chassis technologies.
paras.zh: 随着商用车采用更多的电子控制和电气化架构，ECAS将越来越多地与制动、稳定性和车辆级控制系统集成。未来的应用可能会扩大到城市低地板和电动公交车，其中跪式改善了乘客的可达性，以及需要动态负载管理和高效车轴利用率的重型卡车和拖车。随着客车电气化和超低进入平台的发展，亚太地区提供了增长机会，而欧洲仍然是复杂商用车底盘技术的关键市场。

paras.en: North America Positioned as Second-Largest Market
paras.zh: 北美定位为第二大市场

paras.en: North America is expected to remain the second-largest market for air suspension, supported by its high penetration in heavy-duty trucks and trailers, established commercial-vehicle supply chains, and demand for premium pickups and SUVs. The region’s long-haul freight model places a premium on reducing cargo-damaging vibration, maintaining ride height under variable loads, and improving tire and suspension-component durability.
paras.zh: 由于重型卡车和拖车的高渗透率、成熟的商用车供应链以及对优质皮卡和 SUV 的需求，预计北美仍将是第二大空气悬架市场。该地区的长途货运模式非常重视减少损坏货物的振动、在可变负载下保持行驶高度以及提高轮胎和悬架部件的耐用性。

paras.en: Air suspension is particularly relevant for Class 8 trucks and trailers, where air springs can be integrated with electronically controlled leveling and lift-axle systems to support loading operations and axle-load management. The large installed base also generates recurring replacement demand for air springs, compressors, valves, and height-control components, extending the opportunity beyond new-vehicle production.
paras.zh: 空气悬架特别适用于 8 级卡车和拖车，其中空气弹簧可以与电子控制调平和提升轴系统集成，以支持装载操作和轴荷管理。庞大的安装基础还产生了对空气弹簧、压缩机、阀门和高度控制组件的经常性更换需求，从而将机会扩展到新车生产之外。

articles.title: Hunter Engineering Introduces Core X Tire Changers
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Hunter Engineering’s new Core X series of tire changers builds on the company’s decades of equipment design and manufacturing experience. The series focuses on power, torque, speed, simplicity and reliability. The Core X accommodates most tire and wheel assemblies currently in service.
paras.zh: Hunter Engineering 的新型 Core X 系列轮胎拆装机建立在该公司数十年的设备设计和制造经验之上。该系列注重功率、扭矩、速度、简单性和可靠性。 Core X 可容纳目前使用的大多数轮胎和车轮组件。

paras.en: Hunter Engineering Adds Brushless Motor Technology
paras.zh: Hunter Engineering 增加无刷电机技术

paras.en: The new series includes tabletop and center-clamp versions on a swing-arm platform. Both models use new brushless DC motor technology to deliver more than 800 pound-feet of torque with fully variable rotation speeds.
paras.zh: 新系列包括摆臂平台上的桌面版本和中心夹版本。两种型号均采用新型无刷直流电机技术，以完全可变的转速提供超过 800 磅英尺的扭矩。

paras.en: “We’re modernizing time-tested machines with brushless motor technology and center clamping to redefine what a ‘baseline’ tire changer can be,” said Hunter product manager Jim Hudson. “The motor drive is coupled directly to the gearbox, providing extra power with variable speed for controlling it.”
paras.zh: Hunter 产品经理 Jim Hudson 表示：“我们正在利用无刷电机技术和中心夹紧技术对经过时间考验的机器进行现代化改造，以重新定义‘基准’轮胎拆装机。” “电机驱动器直接连接到变速箱，提供额外的动力和变速控制。”

paras.en: Hunter Engineering offers the Core X in 110-volt and 220-volt versions, with compact dimensions suitable for shops. Both models accommodate OE and aftermarket fitments from 10 to 24 inches in diameter and up to 13 inches wide, including 19.5-inch assemblies.
paras.zh: Hunter Engineering 提供 110 伏和 220 伏版本的 Core X，尺寸紧凑，适合商店使用。两种型号均可容纳直径为 10 至 24 英寸、宽度达 13 英寸的原厂设备和售后配件，包括 19.5 英寸组件。

paras.en: Shops can add an optional bead press to handle more challenging assemblies. The center-clamp version offers additional safety and wheel protection while retaining the familiar swing-arm and side-shovel configuration.
paras.zh: 商店可以添加可选的压珠机来处理更具挑战性的装配。中心夹具版本提供额外的安全性和车轮保护，同时保留熟悉的摇臂和侧铲配置。

paras.en: “We looked at what matters most to tire techs, and it came down to power, speed and reliability. The new Core X series leverages the new drive technology to deliver all three,” Hudson said.
paras.zh: “我们研究了对轮胎技术最重要的因素，最终归结为动力、速度和可靠性。新的 Core X 系列利用新的驱动技术来实现这三项，”Hudson 说。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens New Store in Bradenton
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Bradenton, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 10010 State Road 64 alongside local officials and representatives from Manatee Technical College who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在布雷登顿开设了最新的商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司在 64 号国道 10010 号庆祝这家商店开业，当地官员和海牛技术学院的代表也在现场接受了对该学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training, and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学校的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “Opening our seventh store in Bradenton is an exciting milestone that allows us to better serve customers across the community,” said Mark Ortiz, regional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “Whether helping drivers maintain their vehicles or supporting professional shops and technicians, our team is focused on providing the service and products customers depend on. We’re also proud to support Manatee Technical College as they prepare future technicians for careers in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Mark Ortiz 表示：“在布雷登顿开设第七家商店是一个令人兴奋的里程碑，它使我们能够更好地为整个社区的客户提供服务。” “无论是帮助驾驶员维护车辆，还是为专业商店和技术人员提供支持，我们的团队都专注于提供客户所依赖的服务和产品。我们也很自豪能够支持海牛技术学院，因为他们为未来的技术人员在汽车行业的职业生涯做好准备。”

paras.en: Customers can access a variety of free services at Advance, including battery testing, battery and wiper blade installation with purchase, and check engine light scanning through ReliaScan, which enables a team member to quickly scan the vehicle and identify what may be causing the issue, with no appointment needed.
paras.zh: 客户可以在 Advance 获得各种免费服务，包括电池测试、购买时安装电池和雨刷片，以及通过 ReliaScan 检查发动机灯扫描，这使团队成员能够快速扫描车辆并确定可能导致问题的原因，而无需预约。

articles.title: MANN+HUMMEL’s Hasmeet Kaur and Cedric Dackam on Anticipating What’s Next
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Hasmeet Kaur, president, Transportation Division, MANN+HUMMEL, and Cedric Dackam, president & GM, Automotive Aftermarket, MANN+HUMMEL.
paras.zh: 本期《DriveTime》由曼胡默尔运输部门总裁 Hasmeet Kaur 和曼胡默尔汽车售后市场总裁兼总经理 Cedric Dackam 担任嘉宾。

paras.en: As the automotive industry undergoes significant transformation, MANN+HUMMEL is leveraging its presence in both the original equipment and aftermarket sectors to deliver solutions throughout a vehicle’s lifecycle. Kaur explained how the company’s integrated business model enables it to anticipate customer needs, beginning with vehicle design and continuing through aftermarket service and repair. Rather than treating OE and aftermarket operations as separate businesses, Kaur emphasized how the two segments complement each other, allowing MANN+HUMMEL to address evolving customer requirements while positioning both for long-term growth.
paras.zh: 随着汽车行业经历重大转型，曼胡默尔正在利用其在原始设备和售后市场领域的影响力，在车辆的整个生命周期中提供解决方案。考尔解释了该公司的综合业务模式如何使其能够预测客户需求，从车辆设计开始，一直到售后服务和维修。考尔没有将原配设备和售后市场业务视为独立的业务，而是强调这两个部门如何相互补充，使曼胡默尔能够满足不断变化的客户需求，同时为两者的长期增长做好准备。

paras.en: Dackam highlighted the growing complexity facing aftermarket suppliers and customers. An aging vehicle fleet, electrification, advanced vehicle technologies and increasing parts proliferation are reshaping the industry’s challenges and opportunities. He said customers increasingly expect more than quality products, placing greater importance on predictive analytics, accurate coverage and access to vehicle data. He also emphasized how MANN+HUMMEL’s OE engineering expertise helps the company prepare aftermarket solutions for emerging technologies, including filtration applications in battery safety, thermal management and battery venting. Its established WIX, Purolator and MANN-FILTER brands further support the company’s ability to serve different market segments and distribution channels.
paras.zh: 达卡姆强调了售后市场供应商和客户面临的日益复杂的情况。车队老化、电气化、先进的车辆技术和零部件的激增正在重塑该行业的挑战和机遇。他表示，客户对优质产品的期望越来越高，他们更加重视预测分析、准确的覆盖范围和车辆数据的访问。他还强调了曼胡默尔的原厂工程专业知识如何帮助公司为新兴技术准备售后解决方案，包括电池安全、热管理和电池通风方面的过滤应用。其成熟的 WIX、Purolator 和 MANN-FILTER 品牌进一步支持了公司服务不同细分市场和分销渠道的能力。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Kaur emphasized MANN+HUMMEL’s commitment to innovation, sustainability and its core mission of separating the useful from the harmful. She pointed to investments in filtration media development and vertical integration that enable the company to accelerate innovation and tailor solutions to customer needs. Kaur also discussed her leadership philosophy, emphasizing trust, empowerment and creating an environment where teams can perform at their best. Dackam reinforced the importance of anticipating industry change and translating emerging technologies into aftermarket opportunities, noting that the company’s engineering capabilities, established brands and customer relationships provide a foundation for navigating the industry’s evolving landscape.
paras.zh: 展望未来，考尔强调了曼胡默尔对创新、可持续发展的承诺以及将有用与有害分开的核心使命。她指出，在过滤介质开发和垂直整合方面的投资使公司能够加速创新并根据客户需求定制解决方案。考尔还讨论了她的领导理念，强调信任、授权以及创造一个让团队能够发挥最佳水平的环境。达卡姆强调了预测行业变化并将新兴技术转化为售后市场机会的重要性，并指出公司的工程能力、知名品牌和客户关系为驾驭行业不断发展的格局奠定了基础。

paras.en: To hear more of Kaur’s and Dackam’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.

articles.title: The AAM Group Celebrates 20 Years of Total Truck Centers
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The AAM Group is celebrating the 20th anniversary of Total Truck Centers, its flagship marketing program for independent truck accessory retailers and installers. Looking back on the past two decades, The AAM Group said the need for greater support in the truck accessories aftermarket led to the creation of Total Truck Centers. Distributing large, difficult-to-ship products presented unique challenges. In 2005, four distributors—Weller’s Auto Supply, North Central Truck, Nelson Truck and Titan Equipment—joined The AAM Group. Their participation laid the foundation for a dedicated truck accessories program.
paras.zh: AAM 集团正在庆祝 Total Truck Centers 成立 20 周年，这是其针对独立卡车配件零售商和安装商的旗舰营销计划。回顾过去二十年，AAM 集团表示，卡车配件售后市场需要更大的支持，因此创建了全卡车中心。配送大型、难以运输的产品带来了独特的挑战。 2005 年，四家经销商（Weller’s Auto Supply、North Central Truck、Nelson Truck 和 Titan Equipment）加入了 AAM 集团。他们的参与为专门的卡车配件计划奠定了基础。

paras.en: Total Truck Centers officially launched in 2006 with a clear purpose: helping independent truck accessory retailers compete and grow.
paras.zh: Total Truck Centers 于 2006 年正式推出，其目标明确：帮助独立卡车配件零售商竞争和发展。

paras.en: As the truck accessories aftermarket has evolved, so have the challenges facing independent retailers. Jobbers often lack the time, staff and resources to manage their own marketing. Recognizing these challenges, The AAM Group developed four core tools to help level the playing field.
paras.zh: 随着卡车配件售后市场的发展，独立零售商面临的挑战也随之而来。兼职者往往缺乏时间、人员和资源来管理自己的营销。认识到这些挑战，AAM Group 开发了四个核心工具来帮助创造公平的竞争环境。

paras.en: Aftermarket Websites® helps retailers establish an online presence and connect with customers searching for products. ReadyPosts provides free social media content and automation to help shops stay visible without adding to their workload.
paras.zh: Aftermarket Websites® 帮助零售商建立在线形象并与搜索产品的客户建立联系。 ReadyPosts 提供免费的社交媒体内容和自动化，帮助商店保持可见性，而不增加他们的工作量。

paras.en: N-Store TV brings supplier product education into showrooms, streaming more than 3 million minutes of content each month. Meanwhile, PRO Rebates has returned thousands of dollars to participating jobbers.
paras.zh: N-Store TV 将供应商产品教育带入展厅，每月播放超过 300 万分钟的内容。与此同时，PRO Rebates 已向参与活动的工作人员返还了数千美元。

paras.en: “We started Total Truck Centers because we recognized a need to better support independent truck accessory retailers,” said Tim Oddom, president of The AAM Group. “Twenty years later, the tools have changed, but our purpose hasn’t. Everything we do comes back to helping our jobbers sell more products and grow their businesses.”
paras.zh: “我们创办 Total Truck Centers 是因为我们认识到需要更好地支持独立卡车配件零售商，”AAM 集团总裁 Tim Oddom 说道。 “二十年后，工具发生了变化，但我们的目的没有改变。我们所做的一切都是为了帮助我们的批发商销售更多产品并发展他们的业务。”

paras.en: As Total Truck Centers enters its next chapter, The AAM Group said it continues listening to its members and jobbers. The organization aims to understand their challenges and develop resources that meet their changing needs.
paras.zh: 随着 Total Truck Centers 进入新篇章，AAM 集团表示将继续倾听其会员和经销商的意见。该组织旨在了解他们的挑战并开发资源来满足他们不断变化的需求。

paras.en: “The past 20 years have been about listening to our members and jobbers and responding to their needs,” said Andy Stacy, marketing director. “That same commitment will guide us for the next 20 years. As the industry changes, we’ll continue finding ways to help independent retailers succeed.”
paras.zh: “过去 20 年我们一直在倾听我们的会员和从业者的意见并满足他们的需求，”营销总监安迪·史黛西 (Andy Stacy) 说道。 “同样的承诺将指导我们未来 20 年。随着行业的变化，我们将继续寻找帮助独立零售商取得成功的方法。”

articles.title: 'Like walking the plank': For 3,000 years, Indigenous people herded bison off a unique cliff in Texas, study reveals
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists have uncovered an extremely rare example of a "bison jump" in the Texas Panhandle, where a natural geological formation allowed Indigenous people to hunt North America's largest living land mammal for 3,000 years. The discovery confirms that the prehistoric hunting technique — which involved channeling a herd of bison into a stampede off a cliff, akin to "walking the plank" — was not limited to the northern Plains like experts previously thought.
paras.zh: 考古学家在德克萨斯州狭长地带发现了极其罕见的“野牛跳跃”例子，那里的自然地质构造使原住民能够在 3000 年来猎杀北美最大的陆地哺乳动物。这一发现证实了史前狩猎技术——包括引导一群野牛从悬崖上逃跑，类似于“走木板”——并不像专家之前认为的那样仅限于北部平原。

paras.en: "Bison jumping is an iconic, uniquely North American hunting technique that yielded some of the most productive food-getting events in the history of human hunting," researchers wrote in a study published online Nov. 9 in the journal American Antiquity.
paras.zh: 研究人员在 11 月 9 日《美国古代》杂志在线发表的一项研究中写道：“野牛跳跃是一种标志性的、北美独有的狩猎技术，它产生了人类狩猎史上一些最富有成效的食物获取事件。”

paras.en: Although jump sites are well known throughout the northern Plains, only one such site had ever been found in the southern Plains. But a second bison jump called Nighthawk has now been identified in Caprock Canyons State Park in the Texas Panhandle, and researchers found that Indigenous people used the Nighthawk bison jump for millennia.
paras.zh: 尽管跳跃地点在整个北部平原都广为人知，但在南部平原却只发现过一处这样的地点。但现在在德克萨斯州狭长地带的卡普罗克峡谷州立公园发现了第二种称为“夜鹰”的野牛跳跃，研究人员发现原住民使用“夜鹰”野牛跳跃已有数千年。

paras.en: "Returning to the same place over and over again over 3,000 years shows that people had a significant connection to the Nighthawk hunting facility," study first author Gus Costa, an archaeologist at Rice University in Houston, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 研究第一作者、休斯敦莱斯大学的考古学家古斯·科斯塔在一份声明中说：“3000多年来一次又一次回到同一个地方表明，人们与夜鹰狩猎设施有着重要的联系。”

paras.en: Nighthawk was found when bison remains began eroding from a bone bed (a place where bones naturally accumulate) underneath a roughly 65-foot-tall (20 meters) cliff spur. Archaeologists investigated and found chipped stone tools near the bones, as well as a few arrowheads. Several of the bison bones had cut marks from stone tools consistent with prehistoric butchery practices. These discoveries added up to a possible bison jump.
paras.zh: 夜鹰是在野牛遗骸开始从大约 65 英尺（20 米）高的悬崖尖刺下方的骨床（骨头自然堆积的地方）侵蚀时发现的。考古学家调查并在骨头附近发现了有缺口的石器，以及一些箭头。几块野牛骨头上有石器切割的痕迹，与史前屠宰的做法一致。这些发现加起来可能是野牛跳跃。

paras.en: "The only way bison can arrive at the site is by falling from above, as the site surface is sandwiched between two cliffs," the researchers wrote. Indigenous hunters likely used the cliff's natural spur shape to herd the bison to their deaths. "Instead of a stampede toward a surprise fall, Nighthawk could have operated more like 'walking the plank,'" according to the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“野牛到达该地点的唯一方法是从上方坠落，因为该地点的表面夹在两个悬崖之间。”土著猎人很可能利用悬崖的天然山刺形状来驱赶野牛直至死亡。研究人员表示：“夜鹰的行为方式可以更像是‘走木板’，而不是突然摔倒。”

paras.en: Even more surprising than the discovery of a bison jump site in the southern Plains was the length of time the jump was used.
paras.zh: 比在南部平原发现野牛跳跃点更令人惊讶的是跳跃使用的时间长度。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: A series of radiocarbon dates revealed that there were at least seven mass bison kills at Nighthawk over a span of three millennia, between roughly 1550 B.C. and A.D. 1550. One of these events, which the researcher named Kill 3, was responsible for most of the bison bones. That enormously successful hunt most likely took place around A.D. 300 to 400 and would have required an immense labor force and precise coordination.
paras.zh: 一系列放射性碳测年结果显示，从大约公元前 1550 年到公元前 1550 年之间，在三千年的时间里，夜鹰至少发生了七起大规模的野牛猎杀事件。公元 1550 年。其中一个事件被研究人员命名为“Kill 3”，大部分野牛骨头都是由它造成的。那次极其成功的狩猎很可能发生在公元 300 年至 400 年左右，需要大量的劳动力和精确的协调。

paras.en: "Bison jumping is a complicated community effort," Costa said. "Large scale bison harvests (like jumps) are exciting because they require a large group of people working together to be successful."
paras.zh: “野牛跳跃是一项复杂的社区工作，”科斯塔说。 “大规模野牛收获（如跳跃）是令人兴奋的，因为它们需要一大群人共同努力才能取得成功。”

paras.en: - The ancestors of today's Indigenous people arrived in the Americas during the coldest part of the last ice age, study suggests
paras.zh: - 研究表明，当今原住民的祖先是在上一个冰河时代最寒冷的时期抵达美洲的

paras.en: - Ancient Indigenous people in New Mexico lived through extreme climate change 23,000 years ago, study suggests
paras.zh: - 研究表明，新墨西哥州的古代原住民在 23,000 年前就经历了极端的气候变化

paras.en: - DNA study of nearly 200 Indigenous genomes reveals unknown Asian 'ghost' population contributed to American ancestry
paras.zh: - 对近 200 个土著基因组的 DNA 研究揭示了未知的亚洲“幽灵”群体对美国血统的贡献

paras.en: It is not entirely clear what the Indigenous hunters were doing with the bison killed in the hunt. In the northern Plains, archaeologists have long assumed that bison jumps were generally performed in the fall and used to provision the community for winter. Bison in the North were used to make pemmican, a shelf-stable mix of dried meat and rendered fat.
paras.zh: It is not entirely clear what the Indigenous hunters were doing with the bison killed in the hunt.在北部平原，考古学家长期以来一直认为野牛跳跃通常在秋季进行，并用于为社区提供过冬的食物。 Bison in the North were used to make pemmican, a shelf-stable mix of dried meat and rendered fat.

paras.en: But although pemmican was an extremely useful foodstuff and trade good in the North, it was likely too warm in Texas for bison fat to last more than a few weeks, the researchers wrote. This may mean that the southern Plains bison hunts were more useful for displaying power and building alliances.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道，尽管肉干饼在北方是一种非常有用的食品和贸易品，但德克萨斯州的气温可能太高，野牛脂肪无法维持几周以上。这可能意味着南部平原的野牛狩猎对于展示权力和建立联盟更有用。

paras.en: All of the kill events at Nighthawk were at least a century apart, with an average of 500 years between each bison jump. That points to an infrequent use of the jump but also a clear memory of its utility.
paras.zh: 夜鹰的所有猎杀事件都至少相隔一个世纪，每次野牛跳跃之间平均相隔 500 年。这表明人们很少使用跳跃，但也清楚地记得它的用途。

paras.en: "The simplest explanation for long-lived jump facilities is that these techniques were passed down over long time spans rather than revived again and again," the researchers wrote.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“对长寿跳跃设施的最简单解释是，这些技术是在很长一段时间内传承下来的，而不是一次又一次地复兴。”

paras.en: Costa, A. G., Houk, B. A., Lyle, A. S., Bement, L., Lintz, C., Lawrence, K. L., Frederick, C. D., & Culleton, B. J. (2026). The Nighthawk bison jump: New evidence for recurrent Late Holocene bison jumping in the Southern Plains. American Antiquity, 1–28. https://doi.org/10.1017/aaq.2026.10229
paras.zh: Costa, A. G.、Houk, B. A.、Lyle, A. S.、Bement, L.、Lintz, C.、Lawrence, K. L.、Frederick, C. D. 和 Culleton, B. J. (2026)。夜鹰野牛跳跃：全新世晚期野牛在南部平原反复跳跃的新证据。美国古代，1-28。 https://doi.org/10.1017/aaq.2026.10229

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.

articles.title: Hoxne 'Empress' pepper pot: A 1,600-year-old silver and gold pepper shaker that a UK farmer unearthed while looking for his hammer
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Where it is from: Hoxne, Suffolk, England
paras.zh: 产地：英格兰萨福克郡霍克斯尼

paras.en: In 1992, a farmer in the village of Hoxne in southeastern England was searching for a lost hammer with a metal detector when he stumbled upon a massive hoard of more than 15,000 ancient Roman coins, jewelry and tableware. Among the artifacts in the Hoxne hoard was a silver spice container in the shape of an imperial lady.
paras.zh: 1992 年，英格兰东南部霍克斯尼村的一位农民在用金属探测器寻找一把丢失的锤子时，偶然发现了一大堆藏有 15,000 多枚古罗马硬币、珠宝和餐具的藏品。霍克斯尼宝藏中的文物中有一个皇家贵妇形状的银色香料容器。

paras.en: The artifact, named the Empress, is one of four pepper pots ("piperatoria" in Latin) discovered in the Hoxne hoard, according to the British Museum. The silver container stands about 4 inches (10 centimeters) tall and is decorated with gold around the woman's eyes, mouth, hair and accessories, including a scroll in her left hand. The woman's elaborate hairstyle helps date the creation of the pepper pot to the fourth century, but experts think the hoard may have been buried in the early fifth century, when Roman rule in Britain was ending.
paras.zh: 据大英博物馆称，这件名为“皇后”的文物是在霍克斯尼宝库中发现的四个胡椒罐（拉丁语“胡椒罐”）之一。这个银色容器高约 4 英寸（10 厘米），女人的眼睛、嘴巴、头发和配饰周围都装饰有金色，其中包括她左手拿着的卷轴。这位女士精致的发型有助于将胡椒罐的制作时间追溯到四世纪，但专家认为这些宝藏可能是在五世纪初被埋藏的，当时罗马对英国的统治即将结束。

paras.en: At the bottom of the pot, which rests on a four-legged base, there is a disc that can be set at three positions: wide open, closed and partly open. The pot would have been filled in the open position with cracked pepper and then used in the partly open position for sprinkling the spice over food.
paras.zh: 锅的底部有一个四足底座，有一个圆盘，可以设置在三个位置：全开、关闭和部分打开。锅在打开的位置装满碎胡椒，然后在部分打开的位置用于将香料撒在食物上。

paras.en: The ancient Romans were huge fans of pepper, Neil MacGregor, former director of the British Museum, wrote in "A History of the World in 100 Objects" (Penguin Books, 2010). Pepper didn't grow in the Roman Empire, so merchants procured it from India. This made it an expensive spice, and filling up the pepper pot would have been costly.
paras.zh: 大英博物馆前馆长尼尔·麦格雷戈在《100件物品中的世界历史》（企鹅出版社，2010年）中写道，古罗马人是胡椒的忠实粉丝。罗马帝国不种植胡椒，因此商人从印度采购。这使得它成为一种昂贵的香料，装满胡椒罐的成本也很高。

paras.en: A wealthy Romano-British family likely used the pepper pot as elaborate tableware, MacGregor wrote. It is unclear whom the Empress was meant to depict, but researchers don't think it features a member of the Roman imperial family. However, the fact that she holds a scroll could indicate that she was both wealthy and well educated.
paras.zh: 麦格雷戈写道，一个富裕的罗马英国家庭可能将胡椒罐用作精致的餐具。目前还不清楚皇后的形象是谁，但研究人员认为它不是罗马皇室的成员。然而，她持有卷轴这一事实可能表明她既富有又受过良好的教育。

paras.en: The ancient family who lived near Hoxne seems to have left its wealth behind during the breakdown of Roman rule in Britain, since the pepper pot was found in a chest that contained dozens of pieces of silverware, 29 pieces of gold jewelry, and more than 15,000 coins.
paras.zh: 居住在霍克斯尼附近的古老家族似乎在罗马统治英国崩溃期间留下了自己的财富，因为在一个装有数十件银器、29 件黄金首饰和 15,000 多枚硬币的箱子中发现了胡椒罐。

paras.en: "This was the mobile wealth of a rich Roman family — precisely the type of person who is in danger when the state fails," MacGregor wrote.
paras.zh: 麦格雷戈写道：“这是一个富裕的罗马家庭的流动财富——正是这种人在国家失败时处于危险之中。”

articles.title: Growing lava dome oozes ‘like toothpaste’ from superactive snow-covered volcano in Russia
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: Where is it? Shiveluch volcano, Kamchatka Peninsula, Russia [56.66230841, 161.3449064]
paras.zh: 它在哪里？俄罗斯堪察加半岛什韦卢奇火山 [56.66230841, 161.3449064]

paras.en: What's in the photo? Snow melting around a growing lava dome at the volcano's summit
paras.zh: 照片里有什么？ Snow melting around a growing lava dome at the volcano's summit

paras.en: Which satellite took the photo? Landsat 9
paras.zh: 哪颗卫星拍到了这张照片？陆地卫星 9

paras.en: This striking satellite snap shows a heavy blanket of snow surrounding a growing lava dome at the summit of one of Russia's most active and unstable volcanoes.
paras.zh: 这张引人注目的卫星照片显示，俄罗斯最活跃和不稳定的火山之一的山顶上不断生长的熔岩穹顶周围覆盖着一层厚厚的积雪。

paras.en: The snow-covered peak, called Shiveluch (also spelled Shivelyuch or Sheveluch), is a 10,771-foot-tall (3,283 meters) stratovolcano. The name Shiveluch loosely translates to "smoking mountain" in the language of the region's Indigenous Itelmen people. It is the northernmost active peak in the Kamchatka Peninsula, a highly volcanic region in eastern Russia that's famous for its unusually powerful and dramatically beautiful eruptions.
paras.zh: 这座白雪覆盖的山峰被称为 Shiveluch（也拼写为 Shivyuch 或 Sheveluch），是一座高 10,771 英尺（3,283 米）的成层火山。 Shiveluch 这个名字在该地区土著伊泰尔曼人的语言中大致翻译为“冒烟的山”。它是堪察加半岛最北端的活跃山峰，堪察加半岛是俄罗斯东部的一个火山活动频繁的地区，以其异常强大和美丽的火山喷发而闻名。

paras.en: Shiveluch stands out even among its extremely active volcanic neighbors and is one of the planet's most active volcanoes, according to NASA's Earth Observatory. It has experienced at least 15 eruptions in the past 100 years, the most recent of which has been going on since 1999, according to the Smithsonian Institution's Global Volcanism Program.
paras.zh: 根据美国宇航局地球观测站的数据，什韦卢奇火山即使在其极其活跃的火山邻居中也脱颖而出，是地球上最活跃的火山之一。根据史密森学会的全球火山计划，在过去 100 年里，它至少经历了 15 次喷发，其中最近一次是自 1999 年以来发生的。

paras.en: On average, the volcano spews around 530 million cubic feet (15 million cubic meters) of lava every year — enough to fill 6,000 Olympic-size swimming pools, according to a 2007 study. As a result, its appearance constantly changes when viewed from above.
paras.zh: 根据 2007 年的一项研究，这座火山平均每年喷出约 5.3 亿立方英尺（1500 万立方米）的熔岩，足以填满 6,000 个奥林匹克规模的游泳池。因此，从上方观察时，它的外观不断变化。

paras.en: "On a near-daily basis, satellites detect new signs of activity within [Shiveluch's] horseshoe-shaped caldera, including thermal anomalies, hot avalanches and debris flows," Earth Observatory representatives wrote. The volcano is also constantly spitting out "ash deposits that darken the surrounding landscape," they added.
paras.zh: 地球观测站代表写道：“卫星几乎每天都会检测到[Shiveluch]马蹄形破火山口内的新活动迹象，包括热异常、热雪崩和泥石流。”他们补充说，这座火山还不断喷出“火山灰沉积物，使周围的景观变暗”。

paras.en: In this image, you might be able to see a particularly dark circle at the top of the volcano's caldera. This is a lava dome — a steep-sided landform that emerges when lava piles up on top of a volcanic vent — that has been growing rapidly in recent months, according to the Earth Observatory.
paras.zh: 在这张图片中，您可能会在火山口的顶部看到一个特别黑的圆圈。据地球观测站称，这是一个熔岩穹丘——当熔岩堆积在火山口顶部时就会出现的陡峭地貌——近几个月来，它一直在迅速增长。

paras.en: The lava within this swelling blob is "extruded slowly and piles up into lobed, sloped, or spine-like shapes akin to those that form when toothpaste is squeezed from a tube," Earth Observatory representatives wrote.
paras.zh: 地球观测站的代表写道，这个膨胀的团块中的熔岩“缓慢地被挤出，堆积成叶状、倾斜的或脊柱状的形状，类似于从管子中挤出牙膏时形成的形状”。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Eventually, lava domes grow so large that they give way under their own weight, often causing the caldera's walls to collapse. However, it doesn't take long for the volcano to rebuild itself after these events. (It is currently unclear if the photographed lava dome subsequently collapsed after the photo was taken.)
paras.zh: 最终，熔岩穹丘变得如此之大，以至于在自身重量的作用下塌陷，常常导致火山口的墙壁倒塌。然而，这些事件发生后，火山很快就会自我重建。 （目前尚不清楚所拍摄的熔岩穹顶是否在照片拍摄后随后塌陷。）

paras.en: "Shivelyuch is an incredible volcano that has collapsed over and over again, on several scales, ranging from enormous flank collapses to more modest dome-collapse events," Janine Krippner, a volcanologist based in New Zealand, told the Earth Observatory. "It goes through cycles of collapse but then builds itself up again and again through constant volcanic activity."
paras.zh: 新西兰火山学家珍妮·克里普纳 (Janine Krippner) 告诉地球观测站：“希夫利奇火山是一座令人难以置信的火山，它一次又一次地崩塌，规模有多种，从巨大的侧翼崩塌到更温和的圆顶崩塌事件。” “它经历了崩溃的循环，但随后通过持续的火山活动一次又一次地自我建立。”

paras.en: In a zoomed-out version of the satellite image (see above), black streaks are visible at various points along the volcano's flanks, including a thick dark line emanating from the summit caldera. These are lava flows from recent months or years that have retained enough heat that any snow that lands on them soon melts away, according to Live Science's sister site Space.com.
paras.zh: 在卫星图像的缩小版本中（见上图），沿着火山侧面的各个点都可以看到黑色条纹，包括从山顶火山口发出的一条粗黑线。据Live Science 的姊妹网站Space.com 称，这些是近几个月或几年的熔岩流，它们保留了足够的热量，落在上面的雪很快就会融化。

paras.en: Krippner noted that when she previously visited Shiveluch for fieldwork, she could still feel heat coming from lava flows that were over 5 years old.
paras.zh: 克里普纳指出，当她之前前往希韦卢奇进行实地考察时，她仍然能感受到来自超过 5 年熔岩流的热量。

paras.en: Further afield, you can also see larger black streaks that look as if they have been painted onto the satellite image with rough brushstrokes. These are patches of pyroclastic ash left over from a 2023 eruption that burned down large parts of a nearby forest, according to the Earth Observatory.
paras.zh: 在更远的地方，您还可以看到更大的黑色条纹，看起来就像是用粗糙的笔触画在卫星图像上一样。据地球观测站称，这些是 2023 年火山喷发留下的火山碎屑灰，当时火山喷发烧毁了附近的大部分森林。

paras.en: A 2022 astronaut photo shows a thick blanket of snow covering Yellowstone Lake, transforming the frozen body of water into a featureless white void. But below the ice lie some of Earth's hottest hydrothermal vents.
paras.zh: 2022 年宇航员拍摄的一张照片显示，黄石湖上覆盖着厚厚的积雪，将冰冻的水体变成了毫无特色的白色虚空。但冰层下面有一些地球上最热的热液喷口。

paras.en: A 2025 satellite image shows a series of ghostly ice swirls sculpted on the surface of Lake Michigan by strong winds during an extreme cold snap that covered Chicago in a blanket of snow.
paras.zh: 一张 2025 年的卫星图像显示，在一次极端寒流期间，密歇根湖表面被强风雕刻出一系列幽灵般的冰漩涡，芝加哥被白雪覆盖。

paras.en: A 2017 astronaut photo shows an unusual checkered pattern surrounding a river, just south of the Canadian border. The unique sight is the result of a forest management initiative dating to the 1800s.
paras.zh: 2017 年宇航员拍摄的一张照片显示，加拿大边境以南的一条河流周围有不寻常的方格图案。这一独特的景观是 1800 年代森林管理举措的成果。

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家报道”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。
