articles.title: These Endangered Snakes Are Some of the Most Beautiful in North America. Here's How Conservationists Are Trying to Save Them

paras.en: Covered in vibrant blue, red and black stripes, the San Francisco garter snake is considered one of the most beautiful snakes in North America. But the nonvenomous species’ good looks have also made it a target for illegal collectors, and other threats—including habitat loss and invasive species—have further reduced its population. Fewer than 2,000 individuals are estimated to remain in two Northern California counties, and the species has been on the federal endangered species list since it was created in 1967.
paras.zh: 旧金山袜带蛇全身覆盖着鲜艳的蓝色、红色和黑色条纹，被认为是北美最美丽的蛇之一。但这种无毒物种的美丽外观也使其成为非法采集者的目标，而其他威胁（包括栖息地丧失和入侵物种）进一步减少了其数量。据估计，北加州两个县的数量不到 2,000 只，自 1967 年创建以来，该物种一直被列入联邦濒危物种名单。

paras.en: Now, conservationists are hoping to give the population a boost by releasing 62 captive-raised young snakes into the wild. It’s the first time they’ve attempted such an effort, according to a November 10 announcement from the San Francisco Zoo & Gardens.
paras.zh: 现在，自然资源保护主义者希望通过将 62 条圈养的幼蛇释放到野外来增加蛇的数量。根据旧金山动物园和花园 11 月 10 日的公告，这是他们第一次尝试这样的努力。

paras.en: “This is an extraordinary accomplishment for everyone who has worked for generations to protect this remarkable species,” says Karine Tokatlian, a biologist with the Midpeninsula Regional Open Space District (Midpen), one of the organizations collaborating on the project, in the statement. “This first release is an important step toward building healthy, resilient populations that can sustain themselves over the long term.”
paras.zh: “这对于世世代代保护这一非凡物种的每个人来说都是一项非凡的成就，”中半岛地区开放空间区（Midpen）的生物学家卡琳·托卡特利安（Karine Tokatlian）在声明中说道，该地区是该项目的合作组织之一。 “首次发布是朝着建立能够长期维持自身健康、有弹性的人口迈出的重要一步。”

paras.en: Planning for the project has been underway for at least a decade, reports the Washington Post’s Kyle Melnick. But on-the-ground efforts kicked off last year, when biologists carefully captured ten pregnant females in a Midpen preserve and brought them to the San Francisco Zoo. There, the females gave birth to slender babies, which spent about a year growing and feeding on earthworms.
paras.zh: 据《华盛顿邮报》的凯尔·梅尔尼克报道，该项目的规划已经进行了至少十年。但实地工作从去年开始，当时生物学家在 Midpen 保护区小心地捕获了 10 只怀孕雌性，并将它们带到旧金山动物园。在那里，雌性产下细长的婴儿，这些婴儿花了大约一年的时间生长并以蚯蚓为食。

paras.en: The mothers, meanwhile, were returned to the wild. “We tried to release them at the exact points we caught them,” Elliot Schoenig, a biologist with the U.S. Geological Survey’s Western Ecological Research Center, another project partner, told the San Francisco Chronicle’s Kurtis Alexander last year. “For the most part, they just cruised back in. Some skirted the edges of the pond, which is their typical foraging behavior. Hopefully, they’ll encounter a frog and settle back in.”
paras.zh: 与此同时，母亲们又被放回野外。 “我们试图在捕获它们的确切地点释放它们，”另一个项目合作伙伴、美国地质调查局西部生态研究中心的生物学家埃利奥特·肖尼格去年告诉《旧金山纪事报》的科蒂斯·亚历山大。 “大多数情况下，它们只是游回来。有些沿着池塘边缘，这是它们典型的觅食行为。希望它们能遇到青蛙并重新安顿下来。”

paras.en: Once the youngsters were about a foot long, experts conducted genetic testing and used the results to determine where best to release them. Roughly a third of the juveniles were returned to the area where their mothers lived, while the others were released in areas of San Mateo County that needed a population boost and greater genetic diversity. Conservationists are not revealing the specific locations over concerns that illegal collectors will seek them out.
paras.zh: 当幼崽长到大约一英尺长时，专家们进行了基因测试，并利用结果来确定将它们释放的最佳地点。大约三分之一的青少年被送回其母亲居住的地区，而其他青少年则被释放到需要增加人口和提高遗传多样性的圣马特奥县地区。由于担心非法收藏者会寻找它们，自然资源保护主义者没有透露具体地点。

paras.en: “Even for a whole bunch of biologists who are typically not the most emotional people in their work, [the releases were] impactful,” Ariel Starr, a wildlife ecologist with Midpen, tells the Washington Post.
paras.zh: Midpen 的野生动物生态学家阿里尔·斯塔尔 (Ariel Starr) 告诉《华盛顿邮报》，“即使对于一群在工作中通常不是最情绪化的生物学家来说，这些释放也是有影响力的。”

paras.en: Scientists call this process head-starting, meaning they raise young animals in captivity when they’re considered the most vulnerable to threats like predation and competition for prey. Once they’re deemed large enough to tackle some of these challenges, the creatures are released into the wild. This technique is intended to boost the juveniles’ chances of survival, hopefully allowing them to reach sexual maturity and reproduce.
paras.zh: 科学家们称这一过程为“领先”，这意味着当幼小动物被认为最容易受到捕食和猎物竞争等威胁时，他们就会圈养它们。一旦它们被认为足够大以应对其中一些挑战，这些生物就会被释放到野外。这项技术的目的是提高幼体的生存机会，希望它们能够达到性成熟并繁殖。

paras.en: Zooming out, conservationists hope to one day get the species off the federal endangered list, which would mean establishing at least ten self-sustaining breeding populations with at least 200 snakes each. To do that, they’re also improving the snakes’ habitat, monitoring wild populations, educating the public and supporting populations of the threatened California red-legged frog, one of the snakes’ primary prey species.
paras.zh: 自然资源保护主义者希望有一天能够将这一物种从联邦濒危物种名单中删除，这意味着要建立至少 10 个能够自我维持的繁殖种群，每个种群至少有 200 条蛇。为此，他们还改善蛇的栖息地，监测野生种群，教育公众并支持受威胁的加州红腿蛙（蛇的主要猎物物种之一）的种群。

paras.en: “By protecting and restoring the landscapes that the San Francisco garter snake depends on, we’re also investing in the long-term health and resilience of the region’s environment,” Tokatlian tells KQED’s Sarah Mohamad.
paras.zh: “通过保护和恢复旧金山袜带蛇赖以生存的景观，我们也在投资于该地区环境的长期健康和恢复力，”托卡特利安告诉 KQED 的 Sarah Mohamad。

paras.en: In the meantime, biologists have already captured a new round of pregnant females, which have birthed more than 130 babies at the zoo. If all goes as planned, they’ll be released into the wild next year.
paras.zh: 与此同时，生物学家已经捕获了新一轮怀孕的雌性，它们已在动物园产下 130 多个婴儿。如果一切按计划进行，它们将于明年被释放到野外。

paras.en: The recent conservation efforts have given conservationists reason for optimism. But challenges remain.
paras.zh: 最近的保护工作让保护主义者有理由感到乐观。但挑战依然存在。

paras.en: “If we don’t have more snakes out there, they could disappear in our lifetime,” Rochelle Stiles, director of field conservation at the San Francisco Zoo & Gardens, told the San Francisco Chronicle.
paras.zh: 旧金山动物园和花园的野外保护主任罗谢尔·斯蒂尔斯（Rochelle Stiles）告诉《旧金山纪事报》：“如果我们没有更多的蛇，它们可能会在我们有生之年消失。”

articles.title: Could an Erectile Dysfunction Pill Slow Alzheimer's Disease? Clinical Trial Results Show Promise for Certain Patients

paras.en: A Viagra-like pill might slow cognitive decline in people with early Alzheimer’s disease, according to study results presented November 16 at the Clinical Trials on Alzheimer’s Disease conference.
paras.zh: 根据 11 月 16 日在阿尔茨海默病临床试验会议上公布的研究结果，类似伟哥的药物可能会减缓早期阿尔茨海默病患者的认知能力下降。

paras.en: The experimental treatment—a tablet called AR1001 developed by the South Korean company AriBio—is already sold in the drugmaker’s country as a medication for erectile dysfunction. Now, a year-long international study that enrolled more than 1,500 people with Alzheimer’s disease found it delayed the progression of cognitive decline in patients who weren’t taking other dementia treatments. However, the effect vanished when researchers examined the entire group taking the investigational drug.
paras.zh: 这种实验性治疗药物是由韩国 AriBio 公司开发的一种名为 AR1001 的药片，它已经作为治疗勃起功能障碍的药物在该制药商的国家销售。现在，一项为期一年的国际研究招募了 1,500 多名阿尔茨海默病患者，发现它可以延缓未接受其他痴呆症治疗的患者认知能力下降的进程。然而，当研究人员检查服用研究药物的整个组时，这种效果消失了。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the findings “represent an important milestone in the development of new treatments for Alzheimer’s disease,” says Fred Kim, managing director of AriBio’s operations in the United States, to Lucia Auerbach at Inc.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这些发现“代表了阿尔茨海默病新疗法开发的一个重要里程碑”，AriBio 美国业务董事总经理 Fred Kim 向 Inc. 的 Lucia Auerbach 表示。

paras.en: Alzheimer’s disease is the most common form of dementia, which affects about 57 million people worldwide. No cure currently exists for the neurodegenerative disease, although there are treatments that can help delay its progression and manage symptoms.
paras.zh: 阿尔茨海默病是最常见的痴呆症，影响全球约 5700 万人。尽管有一些治疗方法可以帮助延缓其进展并控制症状，但目前尚无治愈这种神经退行性疾病的方法。

paras.en: In the new clinical trial, called Polaris-AD, researchers enrolled patients with mild Alzheimer’s across 13 countries. They were randomized into groups that either took a daily dose of 30 milligrams of AR1001—less than a third of what people typically take for erectile dysfunction—or a placebo, Elie Dolgin reports for the Washington Post. The researchers examined the participants’ dementia progression with an assessment that scores cognitive and functional measures, including memory, problem-solving and ability to care for themselves, based on interviews with the patients and their caregivers.
paras.zh: 在名为 Polaris-AD 的新临床试验中，研究人员招募了来自 13 个国家的轻度阿尔茨海默病患者。据《华盛顿邮报》报道，Elie Dolgin 报道称，他们被随机分为两组，一组每天服用 30 毫克 AR1001（不到勃起功能障碍患者通常服用剂量的三分之一），另一组服用安慰剂。研究人员根据对患者及其护理人员的采访，对参与者的痴呆症进展情况进行了评估，对认知和功能指标进行评分，包括记忆力、解决问题的能力和照顾自己的能力。

paras.en: Analyses revealed that at the year mark, the drug had slowed cognitive decline in the 604 participants not taking other dementia drugs by 31 percent compared with the placebo group. But when expanded to everyone in the experimental arm—including those taking donepezil or memantine for dementia—AR1001 failed to delay disease progression.
paras.zh: 分析显示，截至 2019 年，与安慰剂组相比，该药物使未服用其他痴呆药物的 604 名参与者的认知能力下降速度减缓了 31%。但当扩展到实验组中的所有人（包括那些服用多奈哌齐或美金刚治疗痴呆症的人）时，AR1001 未能延缓疾病进展。

paras.en: The most common adverse effects were diarrhea, falls and dizziness, according to Judy George at MedPage Today. These events led to around 5 percent of participants in the AR1001 group and 2 percent of participants in the placebo group dropping out of the trial.
paras.zh: 据 MedPage Today 的 Judy George 称，最常见的不良反应是腹泻、跌倒和头晕。这些事件导致 AR1001 组约 5% 的参与者和安慰剂组 2% 的参与者退出试验。

paras.en: The well-known erectile dysfunction medication was originally developed in the 1980s for the heart condition angina, chest pain that happens when less blood flows into the heart. However, later testing showed it wasn’t effective as an angina treatment.
paras.zh: 这种著名的勃起功能障碍药物最初是在 20 世纪 80 年代开发的，用于治疗心脏病心绞痛，即流入心脏的血液减少时发生的胸痛。然而，后来的测试表明它作为心绞痛治疗方法并不有效。

paras.en: Experts not involved in the study have welcomed the findings, though they are cautious. “It’s early days to say much definitively,” says Atticus Hainsworth, a neuroscientist at City St. George’s, University of London, who wasn’t involved in the trial but is evaluating AR1001 for another brain condition, to the Washington Post. Still, data from the subset where the drug appears to have helped “looks pretty good to me.”
paras.zh: 未参与该研究的专家对这一发现表示欢迎，但他们仍持谨慎态度。伦敦大学圣乔治市的神经科学家 Atticus Hainsworth 向《华盛顿邮报》表示：“现在下定论还为时过早。”Atticus Hainsworth 没有参与该试验，但正在评估 AR1001 对另一种大脑疾病的疗效。尽管如此，来自该药物似乎有帮助的子集的数据“对我来说看起来相当不错”。

paras.en: So, how could a Viagra-like medication have a beneficial effect on cognitive decline? Researchers aren’t entirely sure, but it’s likely because erectile dysfunction drugs block an enzyme that breaks down a chemical messenger called cGMP, writes Rahul Sidhu, a neuroscientist at the University of Sheffield in England, for the Conversation.
paras.zh: 那么，类似伟哥的药物如何对认知能力下降产生有益影响呢？英国谢菲尔德大学神经科学家拉胡尔·西杜 (Rahul Sidhu) 在《对话》杂志上写道，研究人员并不完全确定，但这可能是因为勃起功能障碍药物会阻断一种酶，这种酶会分解一种名为 cGMP 的化学信使。

paras.en: This allows the messenger to accumulate, allowing blood vessels to relax. That helps with blood flow, which is how the medications alleviate erectile dysfunction. That same signal also works in the brain, where it helps nerve cells send information to one another. Scientists suspect that by boosting the amount of cGMP, those neurons can survive longer and continue to communicate.
paras.zh: 这使得信使积聚，让血管放松。这有助于血液流动，这就是药物缓解勃起功能障碍的方法。同样的信号也适用于大脑，帮助神经细胞相互发送信息。科学家怀疑，通过增加 cGMP 的量，这些神经元可以存活更长时间并继续交流。

paras.en: The trial leaves the door open for further research. For instance, it’s unclear why AR1001 worked better for participants not already taking dementia medications. “We all have that question right now,” says Sharon Sha, a neurologist at Stanford University who led the trial, to the Washington Post.
paras.zh: 该试验为进一步研究敞开了大门。例如，目前还不清楚为什么 AR1001 对于尚未服用痴呆症药物的参与者效果更好。 “我们现在都有这个问题，”领导这项试验的斯坦福大学神经学家 Sharon Sha 向《华盛顿邮报》表示。

paras.en: Still, the results don’t mean people should start taking currently available erectile dysfunction medications for dementia.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，结果并不意味着人们应该开始服用目前可用的治疗痴呆症的勃起功能障碍药物。

paras.en: “AR1001 is from the same family of medicines as Viagra,” says Richard Oakley, associate director of research and innovation at the Alzheimer’s Society, a nonprofit in the United Kingdom, in a statement. “But it is being developed specifically for Alzheimer’s disease.”
paras.zh: “AR1001 与伟哥属于同一药物家族，”英国非营利组织阿尔茨海默氏症协会研究与创新副主任理查德·奥克利 (Richard Oakley) 在一份声明中表示。 “但它是专门针对阿尔茨海默病而开发的。”

articles.title: Inside Bolivia's Newly Restored 'Sistine Chapel of the Andes,' Centuries-Old Murals Tell Biblical Stories With Andean Imagery

paras.en: One of Bolivia’s oldest churches, built more than 400 years ago by indigenous craftspeople on the high-elevation Andean plateau, is celebrating the completion of a major, months-long renovation that will see it reopen in time for the Christmas season.
paras.zh: 玻利维亚最古老的教堂之一由土著工匠在 400 多年前在安第斯高原高海拔地区建造，目前正在庆祝为期数月的重大整修工程的完成，该工程将在圣诞节期间重新开放。

paras.en: The Santiago de Curahuara de Carangas church, which stands at nearly 13,000 feet above sea level on the Altiplano plateau, is better known by its nickname, the “Sistine Chapel of the Andes.” Elaborate murals span the walls and ceilings inside the stone and adobe building, evidence of artistic achievement and unique cross-cultural history. Scenes portraying both biblical stories and indigenous symbols are the outcome of rare collaborations between Spanish colonizers and native communities in the late 16th and early 17th centuries.
paras.zh: 圣地亚哥德库拉瓦拉德卡兰加斯教堂矗立在阿尔蒂普拉诺高原上，海拔近 13,000 英尺，它的昵称是“安第斯山脉的西斯廷教堂”。这座石头和土坯建筑内的墙壁和天花板上遍布精美的壁画，这是艺术成就和独特的跨文化历史的证据。描绘圣经故事和土著符号的场景是 16 世纪末和 17 世纪初西班牙殖民者与土著社区之间罕见合作的成果。

paras.en: Did you know? Restoring the Sistine Chapel
paras.zh: 你可知道？修复西斯廷教堂

paras.en: This spring, the Vatican restored the Sistine Chapel for the first time in 30 years, including cleansing the sweat of tourists from Michelangelo’s murals and researching the multi-headed brushes that the painter used.
paras.zh: 今年春天，梵蒂冈三十年来首次修复了西斯廷教堂，包括清除米开朗基罗壁画上游客留下的汗水，并研究画家使用的多头画笔。

paras.en: “It is a jewel of mestizo Baroque art,” Reverend Jacek Dziadosz, a Polish priest known locally as Father Jacinto, tells Carlos Valdez of the Associated Press (AP). “I still use these paintings to teach catechism to children and young people from rural communities, even in the age of TikTok.”
paras.zh: “这是混血巴洛克艺术的瑰宝，”当地被称为哈辛托神父的波兰牧师雅采克·齐亚多斯 (Jacek Dziadosz) 牧师告诉美联社 (美联社) 的卡洛斯·瓦尔迪兹。 “即使在 TikTok 时代，我仍然用这些画来向农村社区的儿童和年轻人教授教义问答。”

paras.en: The church was constructed between 1587 and 1608, while the murals, painted with natural dyes and used for centuries by missionaries to convert locals to Christianity, weren’t finished until 1777, EWTN News’ Julieta Villar reported in April, when the restoration was announced. This decades-long creative process spanned many eras of painting, and the scenes inside reflect this range, exemplifying styles such as Mannerism and 18th-century Baroque.
paras.zh: 教堂建于 1587 年至 1608 年间，而壁画是用天然染料绘制的，几个世纪以来一直被传教士用来让当地人皈依基督教，据 EWTN 新闻的朱丽叶塔·维拉尔 (Julieta Villar) 在 4 月宣布修复时报道，这些壁画直到 1777 年才完成。这个长达数十年的创作过程跨越了绘画的多个时代，里面的场景也反映了这个范围，体现了矫饰主义和18世纪巴洛克等风格。

paras.en: Depictions of famed biblical scenes including the Great Flood, Nativity and Last Judgment are imbued with details that are significant to Andean culture and spirituality. A resurrected Christ is framed on either side by the moon, sun and a rainbow. Wrath, one of the seven deadly sins, is exemplified by a sword-wielding Spanish soldier. A guinea pig, not bread, is passed around during the Last Supper. The Three Wise Men ride on llamas instead of camels. And a black cat stands at the feet of Judas, while a white dog, representing good fortune, rests at Jesus’s side.
paras.zh: 对著名圣经场景的描绘，包括大洪水、耶稣诞生和最后的审判，充满了对安第斯文化和灵性具有重要意义的细节。复活的基督被月亮、太阳和彩虹包围在两侧。愤怒是七大罪之一，挥舞着剑的西班牙士兵就是一个例子。最后的晚餐期间传递的是豚鼠，而不是面包。三智者骑的是美洲驼而不是骆驼。一只黑猫站在犹大脚下，一只代表好运的白狗则停在耶稣身边。

paras.en: “The murals were painted to warn people about sin and the importance of repentance,” Josefina Matas, an architect and conservator who is leading the renovation, tells the AP. “There is something from outside, but there is also something that is ours.”
paras.zh: “这些壁画的目的是警告人们有关罪恶和悔改的重要性，”负责翻修的建筑师兼管理员约瑟芬娜·马塔斯告诉美联社。 “有些东西是从外面来的，但也有一些东西是我们自己的。”

paras.en: The church’s patron saint, the apostle James (known in Spanish as Santiago), is represented inside in similar stylizations as Illapa, the Incan god of thunder.
paras.zh: 教堂的守护神使徒詹姆斯（西班牙语为圣地亚哥）的形象与印加雷神伊拉帕类似。

paras.en: “It’s very striking when you enter the church, because there isn’t any empty space,” Matas tells the Art Newspaper’s Graciela Ibáñez. “Everything is painted. Most of the churches in the region have murals. Here, they have been well preserved.”
paras.zh: “当你进入教堂时，你会感到非常引人注目，因为没有任何空旷的空间，”麦塔斯告诉《艺术报》的格雷西拉·伊瓦涅斯。 “一切都被画了。该地区的大多数教堂都有壁画。在这里，它们保存得很好。”

paras.en: The $66,000 renovation project was funded by the U.S. Department of State’s Ambassadors Fund for Cultural Preservation, which has funded more than 30 projects in Bolivia since 2001.
paras.zh: 这项耗资 66,000 美元的翻修项目由美国国务院文化保护大使基金资助，该基金自 2001 年以来已资助玻利维亚的 30 多个项目。

paras.en: The most crucial part of the renovation is the repair and waterproofing of its aging thatched roof, which covers roughly 8,600 square feet and protects the murals inside from harsh highland weather. Roughly a dozen Indigenous Aymara workers are leading this effort, implementing a local technique that layers straw on top of hollow cane mats that will prevent leaks. The church’s buttress is also being restored, and its exterior walls, which have weakened over time, are being secured.
paras.zh: 翻修工程最关键的部分是对其老化的茅草屋顶进行修复和防水，该屋顶面积约 8,600 平方英尺，可保护内部壁画免受恶劣的高原天气的影响。大约有十几名艾马拉原住民工人正在领导这项工作，他们采用了一种当地技术，将稻草铺在空心藤垫上，以防止泄漏。教堂的支柱也在修复中，随着时间的推移而削弱的外墙也正在得到加固。

paras.en: Declared a national monument in 1960, the church will celebrate its reopening with a special mass on December 15.
paras.zh: 该教堂于 1960 年被宣布为国家纪念碑，将于 12 月 15 日举行特别弥撒庆祝其重新开放。

paras.en: “We view culture as a catalyst for our national pride, of our essence, but also for the social cohesion and peace we so urgently need to truly understand where we come from and where we wish to go,” Andrés Aramayo, Bolivia’s deputy minister for sustainable tourism, said during an April press conference announcing the restoration, per EWTN News.
paras.zh: 据 EWTN 新闻报道，玻利维亚负责可持续旅游业的副部长安德烈斯·阿拉马约 (Andrés Aramayo) 在 4 月份宣布恢复重建的新闻发布会上表示：“我们认为文化是我们民族自豪感、我们本质的催化剂，也是我们迫切需要的社会凝聚力与和平的催化剂，以真正了解我们来自哪里以及我们想去哪里。”

articles.title: B&H Photo Promo Codes and Deals This November 2026
articles.author: Gear Team

paras.en: B&H Photo is one of our favorite places to shop for camera gear. If you’re ever in New York, head to the store to see the giant overhead conveyor belt system that brings your purchase from the upper floors to the registers downstairs (yes, seriously, here’s a video). Fortunately, B&H Photo’s website is here for the rest of us, with some good deals on photo gear we love.
paras.zh: B&H Photo 是我们最喜欢购买相机装备的地方之一。如果您在纽约，请前往商店看看巨大的高架传送带系统，该系统将您购买的商品从楼上的收银台传送到楼下的收银台（是的，说真的，这是一个视频）。幸运的是，B&H Photo 的网站为我们其他人提供了服务，其中有一些我们喜爱的摄影装备的超值优惠。

paras.en: If you’re looking for a great gift for the photographer in your life, or want to upgrade your holiday photos this year, be sure to shop B&H Photo Black Friday Deals for hundreds of dollars in savings. During the sale, you’ll see discounts on photography equipment, cameras, computers, video, lighting, audio, drones, camcorders, TVs, A/V, and more. B&H Photo also makes it easy to shop, with categories like deals under $150, $250, $500, and $1,000.
paras.zh: 如果您正在为生活中的摄影师寻找一份很棒的礼物，或者想要升级您今年的假日照片，请务必购买 B&H Photo 黑色星期五优惠，可节省数百美元。促销期间，您会看到摄影设备、相机、电脑、视频、灯光、音频、无人机、摄像机、电视、A/V 等商品的折扣。 B&H Photo 还让购物变得更加容易，类别包括 150 美元、250 美元、500 美元和 1,000 美元以下的优惠。

paras.en: B&H Photo has plenty of great deals, including Nikon's brand-new Z6III full-frame mirrorless camera for $2,196.95 ($300 off). The Z6III (8/10, WIRED Recommends) is a major update to the Z6 line and a great all-around camera for Nikon fans. There are also great deals, such as the Nikon Zf (8/10, WIRED Recommends) full-frame mirrorless camera for $200 off, or the Nikon Z8 for $600 off.
paras.zh: B&H Photo 有很多超值优惠，包括尼康全新 Z6III 全画幅无反光镜相机，现价 2,196.95 美元（立减 300 美元）。 Z6III（8/10，《连线》推荐）是 Z6 系列的重大更新，是尼康粉丝的一款出色的全能相机。还有超值优惠，例如尼康 Zf（8/10，《连线》推荐）全画幅无反光镜相机可优惠 200 美元，尼康 Z8 可优惠 600 美元。

paras.en: Not in the market for the latest Nikon cameras? There are plenty of other deals, including our favorite action camera, the GoPro Hero 13, for $70 off (7/10, WIRED Recommends), and Sony’s a7R V full-frame mirrorless camera for $400 off.
paras.zh: 不在市场上购买最新的尼康相机？还有很多其他优惠，包括我们最喜欢的运动相机 GoPro Hero 13，折扣 70 美元（7/10，连线推荐），以及索尼的 a7R V 全画幅无反光镜相机，折扣 400 美元。

paras.en: Why a B&H Gift Card Makes the Ultimate Tech Gift
paras.zh: 为什么 B&H 礼品卡是终极科技礼物

paras.en: Not sure what to get the tech or photography lover in your life this holiday season? A B&H gift card is a gift that people on your list will actually want. B&H has tech for everyone on your list, with hundreds of models of cameras, computers, projectors, and more.
paras.zh: 不知道在这个假期给你生活中的科技或摄影爱好者送什么礼物？ B&H 礼品卡是您名单上的人真正想要的礼物。 B&H 为您列表中的每个人提供技术，包括数百种型号的相机、计算机、投影仪等。

paras.en: One of the many perks of B&H Photo is its generous free shipping policy. Most orders at B&H over $49 qualify for free expedited shipping to the Lower 48 states. The savings keep coming, as most items under $49 also qualify for free standard shipping in the contiguous US. If for some reason your order doesn't qualify for free shipping, you can review alternative shipping options at checkout—full shipping policy details are available here.
paras.zh: B&H Photo 的众多优势之一就是慷慨的免费送货政策。 B&H 上超过 49 美元的大多数订单均可免费加急运送至美国本土 48 个州。节省的费用不断增加，因为大多数 49 美元以下的商品也有资格享受美国本土的免费标准送货服务。如果由于某种原因您的订单不符合免费送货的条件，您可以在结帐时查看替代送货选项 - 此处提供了完整的送货政策详细信息。

paras.en: Best Times to Find B&H Promo Codes and Discounts
paras.zh: 查找 B&H 促销代码和折扣的最佳时机

paras.en: Like most retailers, B&H Photo offers some of its best deals of the year during Black Friday and Cyber Monday, but that doesn’t mean there aren’t other ways to save outside this sale period. There’s still time to take advantage of extended holiday sales, with up to $300 in 24-hour camera discounts and featured price drops across all accessories. While there may not be any B&H promo codes available at the moment, there are plenty of other ways to save at B&H.
paras.zh: 与大多数零售商一样，B&H Photo 在黑色星期五和网络星期一期间提供一些年度最佳优惠，但这并不意味着在此销售期间之外没有其他方法可以节省费用。您还有时间享受延长假期促销，24 小时相机折扣高达 300 美元，所有配件均降价。虽然目前可能没有任何 B&H 促销代码可用，但 B&H 还有很多其他方式可以节省费用。

paras.en: Score Deals on Used and Refurbished Gear
paras.zh: 二手和翻新装备优惠

paras.en: B&H Photo also sells used and refurbished gear. Deals and conditions vary, but if you’re looking to save some money, that’s a solid way to go. You can have peace of mind buying secondhand at B&H because they only sell used equipment that has been tested and proven to be in good working order. Each gadget is evaluated by expert evaluators to ensure its functionality. Plus, there's a 30-day return policy and a 90-day parts and labor warranty. And if you’d rather sell and trade in your used (but functioning) tech, B&H Photo has a hassle-free trade-in program offering competitive prices.
paras.zh: B&H Photo 还销售二手和翻新装备。优惠和条件各不相同，但如果您想省钱，这是一个不错的选择。您可以放心在 B&H 购买二手设备，因为他们只销售经过测试并证明工作状态良好的二手设备。每个小工具都经过专家评估员的评估，以确保其功能。此外，还有 30 天退货政策和 90 天零件和人工保修。如果您想出售和交易您用过的（但功能正常的）技术，B&H Photo 有一个无忧的以旧换新计划，提供有竞争力的价格。

paras.en: The B&H Photo Deal Zone is one of the best ways to save on your camera and tech purchases. With new, rotating deals updated daily, it’s the place to find the best limited-time prices on B&H Photo gear. Whether you’re in the market for a discounted Lenovo tablet or a Logitech wireless mouse, B&H Photo offers the best deals online in one place, making shopping for discounted tech easier than ever.
paras.zh: B&H 照片交易区是节省相机和技术购买费用的最佳方式之一。每天都会更新轮换的新优惠，您可以在这里找到 B&H 摄影装备的最佳限时价格。无论您是在市场上购买打折的联想平板电脑还是罗技无线鼠标，B&H Photo 都能在一个地方提供最优惠的在线价格，让购买打折科技产品变得比以往更加容易。

paras.en: Use the B&H Payboo Credit Card to Save More
paras.zh: 使用 B&H Payboo 信用卡可节省更多

paras.en: If you shop at B&H Photo, you might consider getting a B&H Payboo credit card for enhanced benefits. With this card, you’ll save on taxes and get instant payback on qualifying purchases shipped to New York, up to 8.875% off. If you’re not based in New York, you can still get 6- and 12-month special financing on a minimum purchase of $199 for 6 months or $599 for 12 months with a B&H Payboo credit card, including no interest if paid in full within 6 or 12 months. (Interest will be charged to your Account from the purchase date if the promotional plan balance is not paid in full within the promotional period.)
paras.zh: 如果您在 B&H Photo 购物，您可以考虑购买 B&H Payboo 信用卡以获得更多优惠。使用此卡，您可以节省税款，并在运送到纽约的合格购买商品时立即获得回报，最高可享受 8.875% 的折扣。如果您不在纽约，使用 B&H Payboo 信用卡购买至少 199 美元（6 个月）或 599 美元（12 个月）仍可以获得 6 个月和 12 个月的特别融资，如果在 6 或 12 个月内全额支付，则无需支付利息。 （如果在促销期内未全额支付促销计划余额，将从购买之日起向您的帐户收取利息。）

articles.title: Wish List 2026: 27 Gifts for the Visionaries, Explorers, and Early Adopters in Your Life
articles.author: Michael Calore, Julian Chokkattu

paras.en: For the design freak in your life who obsesses over the most precisely considered objects, this is the ultimate desktop curio. The Brooklyn firm Craighill makes all sorts of fun everyday items—key rings, scissors, pens—with close attention paid to fit and finish. Place a thumb against the dimples of this telescoping ruler and extend the sliding mechanism with the most deliciously smooth push. The anodized aluminum body gives it a pleasant heft. It takes measurements, caliper-style, up to 8 inches or 20 centimeters, depending on your numerical affiliation.
paras.zh: 对于您生活中痴迷于最精确考虑的对象的设计狂来说，这是终极桌面古董。布鲁克林公司 Craighill 生产各种有趣的日常用品——钥匙圈、剪刀、钢笔——并密切关注装配和表面处理。将拇指放在伸缩尺的凹坑上，然后以最顺畅的推力延伸滑动机构。阳极氧化铝机身赋予其令人愉悦的重量。它采用卡尺式测量，最大可达 8 英寸或 20 厘米，具体取决于您的数字隶属关系。

paras.en: The direct-to-consumer ebike brand Aventon made its name on sturdy and reliable city commuter bikes. After branching out to cargo bikes and trail models, the company is going hard into mountain climbing. The full-suspension Current ADV is powered by a 750-watt motor between the cranks that delivers smooth pedal assistance over hill and dale, plus a boost mode for rocketing up the steep stuff. The battery is good for hours of riding; it can go over 100 miles on a charge in Eco mode, so your loved one can go even farther.
paras.zh: 直接面向消费者的电动自行车品牌 Aventon 因坚固可靠的城市通勤自行车而闻名。在涉足货运自行车和林道车型之后，该公司正大力进军登山领域。全悬架 Current ADV 由位于曲柄之间的 750 瓦电机提供动力，可在翻山越岭时提供平稳的踏板辅助，并提供助推模式，可让您快速爬上陡峭的山坡。电池可以支持数小时的骑行；在 Eco 模式下，一次充电可行驶 100 英里以上，让您的亲人可以走得更远。

paras.en: What’s a surefire gift for the person who is otherwise impossible to shop for? A good pair of sunglasses. The Minnesota company Article One has all of its glasses made in Japan to exacting standards. We especially like the Accord frames, with clean lines that give the specs an understated style that’s fashionable in nearly every situation. The lenses are made of TR-18 Tritan, a co-polyester material making waves in the eyewear industry that offers great visual clarity while being more durable than common tinted polycarbonate lenses.
paras.zh: 对于那些无法通过其他方式购买的人来说，什么是绝对可靠的礼物呢？一副好的太阳镜。明尼苏达州公司 Article One 的所有眼镜均在日本制造，符合严格的标准。我们特别喜欢 Accord 车架，其简洁的线条赋予镜框一种低调的风格，几乎在任何情况下都很时尚。该镜片由 TR-18 Tritan 制成，这是一种在眼镜行业引起轰动的共聚酯材料，可提供出色的视觉清晰度，同时比普通有色聚碳酸酯镜片更耐用。

paras.en: Mostly known for his shiny and expensive pendants and lighting fixtures, Tom Dixon also designs fun—and affordable—items for around the house like this foot-tall cast-iron hand. Its powder-coated finish offers a little grip, making it the perfect perch for a phone, a notebook, or a wristwatch. A perfect gift for the person in your life with the funky taste who is otherwise impossible to shop for.
paras.zh: 汤姆·迪克森 (Tom Dixon) 以其闪亮而昂贵的吊坠和照明灯具而闻名，他还为房子周围设计有趣且价格实惠的物品，例如这只一英尺高的铸铁手。其粉末涂层表面具有一定的抓握力，使其成为手机、笔记本电脑或手表的完美支架。这是送给您生命中品味时髦的人的完美礼物，否则您无法通过其他方式购买。

paras.en: Handmade from slip-cast terra cotta in Eugene, Oregon, this donut-shaped lamp puts out 600 lumens of soft, warm light. A 6-watt LED sits inside the frosted globe, and you can dim it via a rotary switch on the power cord. It’s a functional and tiny (5.5 x 4.5-inch) beacon to beautify your loved one’s love nest.
paras.zh: 这款甜甜圈形状的灯采用俄勒冈州尤金的滑铸赤土手工制成，可发出 600 流明的柔和温暖的光线。磨砂球体内部装有一个 6 瓦 LED，您可以通过电源线上的旋转开关将其调暗。它是一款实用且小巧（5.5 x 4.5 英寸）的灯塔，可美化您所爱之人的爱巢。

paras.en: The mobile technology company Nothing has been focusing on its audio prowess lately, and its new Headphone (1) Pro are evidence, catering to audio professionals in the studio chasing the best sound quality. With a triple-driver architecture in each ear and studio-quality tuning, these cans are a surprise hit with what WIRED reviewer Harry Rabinowitz called “outstanding” sound quality.
paras.zh: 移动技术公司 Nothing 最近一直专注于其音频实力，其新款 Headphone (1) Pro 就是明证，迎合了录音室中追求最佳音质的音频专业人士的需求。每只耳朵均采用三驱动器架构，并具有录音室品质的调音，这些耳机凭借《连线》评论员 Harry Rabinowitz 所说的“出色”音质而出人意料。

paras.en: Once a niche category, Art TVs are now all the rage. These displays work like regular old boob tubes, but when you turn them off, their bezel-framed matte screens double as digital picture frames for fine art you can download. Samsung was early to the Art TV market, and its latest Frame Pro is its most gorgeous plug-and-play gallery yet. Art lovers will appreciate the bevy of options to show on the TV, with top-name painters and photographers available in Samsung’s store, as well as collections from The Met and MoMA. Sizes range from 55 to 85 inches, and wireless connections make setup a breeze.
paras.zh: 艺术电视曾经是一个小众类别，现在却风靡一时。这些显示器的工作原理就像普通的旧布布管一样，但当你关闭它们时，它们的边框磨砂屏幕兼作数字相框，供你下载美术作品。三星很早就进入了艺术电视市场，其最新的 Frame Pro 是迄今为止最华丽的即插即用画廊。艺术爱好者一定会喜欢电视上展示的众多选择，三星商店里有顶级画家和摄影师的作品，还有大都会艺术博物馆和现代艺术博物馆的藏品。尺寸范围为 55 至 85 英寸，无线连接使设置变得轻而易举。

paras.en: Your photo-taking friend already has a few cameras. They have the big one with the fancy lenses, and the smaller one with the even fancier lenses. They shoot tons of pictures with their phone, too, of course. But the camera they really want is the Ricoh GR IV. Fans of this pocketable, high-end digital point-and-shoot are like a cult, the type of people who find each other at parties and whisper in the corner about this camera and how much it’s totally changed their game. We could list the specs and tell you what it can do, but you can read our review for all of that. The most important thing to know is that if you want to splurge on something nice for your friend who’s obsessively taking photos all the time, this is the perfect camera for them. Be their hero. (Note: Our review is of the previous model. This newer version has a highlight-diffusion filter that improves the camera’s performance in extreme light and dark conditions, making it even more desirable.)
paras.zh: 你的拍照朋友已经有几台相机了。他们有带有精美镜头的大镜头，还有带有更精美镜头的小镜头。当然，他们也用手机拍摄了大量照片。但他们真正想要的相机是理光 GR IV。这款袖珍高端数码傻瓜相机的粉丝就像一个邪教，他们在聚会上互相碰面，在角落里窃窃私语这款相机，以及它对他们的游戏方式的彻底改变。我们可以列出规格并告诉您它的功能，但您可以阅读我们的评论来了解所有这些。最重要的是，如果您想为一直痴迷于拍照的朋友买一些好东西，那么这对他们来说是完美的相机。成为他们的英雄。 （注：我们的评测是针对之前的型号。这个新版本具有高光扩散滤镜，可以提高相机在极端光照和黑暗条件下的性能，使其更加理想。）

paras.en: There’s no shortage of beautiful, functional bags in our midst, but this zipper tote is one of our favorites. Nomadix makes blankets, towels, and bags from recycled materials, and the DayTripper's nylon shell and polyester interior are made from 100 percent recycled fabric. The ripstop face adds toughness as well as some visual flair. Inside are a padded laptop sleeve, two bottle sleeves, and a zipper pocket. The 26-liter capacity lets it do double duty as a commuter and a weekender.
paras.zh: 我们身边不乏漂亮、实用的包包，但这款拉链手提包是我们的最爱之一。 Nomadix 采用回收材料制作毯子、毛巾和袋子，DayTripper 的尼龙外壳和聚酯内饰则由 100% 回收面料制成。防撕裂表面增加了韧性以及一些视觉风格。里面有一个带衬垫的笔记本电脑套、两个瓶套和一个拉链口袋。 26 升的容量使其能够承担通勤和周末的双重任务。

paras.en: For the trail runner in your life who gets up at dawn to put in serious miles in the wilderness, only the best shoes will do. These kicks from Norda are tough, light, and responsive. The uppers and laces are made from ecofriendly Dyneema, a highly durable all-weather fabric made from by-products of the wood and pulp industries. The soles are made by Vibram, a pioneer in those thin-but-springy soles that let the runner really feel the earth beneath their feet.
paras.zh: 对于您生命中黎明起床、在荒野中进行长距离跑步的越野跑者来说，只有最好的鞋子才可以。 Norda 的这些踢鞋坚韧、轻便且反应灵敏。鞋面和鞋带由环保迪尼玛 (Dyneema) 制成，这是一种高度耐用的全天候面料，由木材和纸浆工业的副产品制成。鞋底由 Vibram 制造，Vibram 是薄而有弹性鞋底的先驱，让跑步者真正感受到脚下的土地。

paras.en: For a long time, wetsuits were made with neoprene, a petroleum-based product with an eco footprint that didn’t really square with surfing’s ocean-loving, conservation-minded vibe. Patagonia was early to the market with neoprene-free suits, and now the company has completely overhauled its wetsuit designs. The new Regulator collection—made from natural rubber and recycled nylon—has thicker insulation and padding where it’s needed most. The rest of the suit stays flexible and comfy to wear for long stretches. A big U-shaped zipper runs around the shoulders, making it easier for surfers to get it on and off in the parking lot. Comes in various thicknesses, and in men’s and women’s cuts.
paras.zh: 长期以来，潜水衣都是用氯丁橡胶制成的，氯丁橡胶是一种以石油为基础的产品，具有生态足迹，与冲浪运动热爱海洋、保护环境的氛围并不相符。巴塔哥尼亚很早就向市场推出了不含氯丁橡胶的潜水服，现在该公司已经彻底改造了其潜水服设计。全新 Regulator 系列由天然橡胶和再生尼龙制成，在最需要的地方具有更厚的绝缘层和衬垫。套装的其余部分在长时间穿着时保持灵活和舒适。肩部设有大 U 形拉链，方便冲浪者在停车场穿脱。有各种厚度，以及男士和女士剪裁。

paras.en: Kindles have always been plasticky pieces of tech. However, now that Amazon’s hardware is under the eye of ex-Microsoft Surface hardware guru Panos Panay, the brand has been zhuzhing its devices. The basic Kindle now comes in an all-aluminum design. (You can still buy the plastic version for a little less cash.) It still lacks the warm light and auto-adjusting light of premium models, but you get double the storage, plus no ads. It's heavy in a good way, like a book, and the size is still just right for reading. It's a great upgrade for the book lover in your life—unless they've already converted to a non-Amazon e-reader.
paras.zh: Kindle 一直是塑料科技产品。然而，现在亚马逊的硬件受到了前微软Surface硬件大师Panos Panay的关注，该品牌一直在对其设备进行着注。基本款 Kindle 现在采用全铝设计。 （你仍然可以花更少的钱购买塑料版本。）它仍然缺乏高级型号的暖光和自动调节光，但你可以获得双倍的存储空间，而且没有广告。它很重，就像一本书，而且大小仍然适合阅读。对于您生活中的图书爱好者来说，这是一次伟大的升级 - 除非他们已经转换为非亚马逊电子阅读器。

paras.en: Musicians and audio nerds alike flip out over Teenage Engineering’s fun and inventive approach to creative noisemaking. This little multipurpose box is the latest must-have for TE fans. It’s technically a speaker—powered by a 12-hour battery, with connections for whatever you can think to pair or plug in—but it doubles as an amplifier for musical performance. Plug in a guitar, bass, keyboard, or microphone and enjoy 35 watts of volume from the dual speakers (a 4-inch woofer and a 1-inch tweeter). Dial up onboard effects like distortion, echo, and reverb. When rock time is over, your musical loved one can attach the optional antenna ($29) and use it as an FM radio, or plug in the optional mic ($29) for some karaoke.
paras.zh: 音乐家和音频迷都对 Teenage Engineering 有趣且富有创意的创造性噪音制造方法感到兴奋。这款小型多功能盒是 TE 粉丝的最新必备品。从技术上讲，它是一个扬声器，由 12 小时的电池供电，具有任何您能想到的配对或插入的连接器，但它也可以作为音乐表演的放大器。插入吉他、贝斯、键盘或麦克风，即可享受双扬声器（4 英寸低音扬声器和 1 英寸高音扬声器）带来的 35 瓦音量。调节失真、回声和混响等板载效果。当摇滚时间结束时，您的音乐爱好者可以连接可选天线（29 美元）并将其用作 FM 收音机，或者插入可选麦克风（29 美元）来唱卡拉 OK。

paras.en: If you're always stealing your loved one's battery pack and leaving them with little charge left for their own devices, buy Nimble's SharePower for them (or yourself). This power bank splits into two, so you can always share power (get it) with someone else. Each half is 5,000 mAh, enough to recharge a smartphone. They combine magnetically for 10,000 mAh that can recharge your gadget twice. Nimble is also known for its sustainability chops, manufacturing the battery with 100 percent recycled plastic and shipping it in plastic-free packaging.
paras.zh: 如果您总是偷走亲人的电池组，并让他们自己的设备电量所剩无几，请为他们（或您自己）购买 Nimble 的 SharePower。该移动电源一分为二，因此您可以随时与其他人共享电源（获取）。每一半为 5,000 mAh，足以为智能手机充电。它们通过磁性结合在一起，容量为 10,000 mAh，可为您的设备充电两次。 Nimble 还以其可持续发展而闻名，其电池采用 100% 再生塑料制造，并采用无塑料包装运输。

paras.en: Aren't magnets amazing? Wandrd's new Magnetic Camera Straps prove that yet again. These straps have a magnetic attachment system that makes removing the camera a breeze. The magnets guide the strap into the anchor point, while a locking mechanism ensures the camera can’t fall off. If your loved one already has a camera strap they love, like a fancy leather strap, Wandrd sells cheap DIY kits so they can add the ingenious magnetic system to their own strap.
paras.zh: 磁铁是不是很神奇？ Wandrd 的新款磁性相机带再次证明了这一点。这些肩带具有磁性连接系统，使拆卸相机变得轻而易举。磁铁将带子引导至锚点，而锁定机构则确保相机不会掉落。如果您所爱的人已经拥有一条他们喜欢的相机背带，例如精美的皮革背带，Wandrd 出售廉价的 DIY 套件，这样他们就可以将巧妙的磁性系统添加到自己的背带上。

paras.en: This 15-inch clock, dreamed up by Polish designer Marta Krupińska for Ikea’s latest PS collection, is designed to resemble a marine periscope. Whether placing this curvy clock on the bedside table will result in nautical dreams, we can’t say. However, we can tell you that it won’t disturb your loved one’s sleep; the quartz movement is entirely silent, with no ticktock sounds. Buy it in their favorite color, as long as it’s red.
paras.zh: 这款 15 英寸时钟是波兰设计师 Marta Krupińska 为宜家最新 PS 系列设计的，其设计类似于海洋潜望镜。把这个弯曲的时钟放在床头柜上是否会带来航海梦，我们还不能说。然而，我们可以告诉您，它不会打扰您所爱之人的睡眠；石英机芯完全静音，没有滴答声。买他们最喜欢的颜色，只要是红色的。

paras.en: The San Francisco producer Veso makes zippy aperitifs as well as vermouths with unconventional flavorings like fig leaf, miso, olive, and anchovy. This bottling, a limited 2026 release, is vermouth flavored with tomatoes. Early Girls and Purple Cherokees take a seven-month bath in grape spirits, then the liquid is pressed and mixed into a pinot blanc with kombu, beets, and carrots. The result is a pinkish vermouth with a salty, vegetal, and umami character that’s wholly unique. Get this for the adventurous drinker in your life, and settle in to enjoy some tomato gibsons, tomato-mezcal negronis, and tomato-wine spritzers.
paras.zh: 旧金山生产商 Veso 生产清爽的开胃酒以及带有无花果叶、味噌、橄榄和凤尾鱼等非传统调味料的苦艾酒。这款瓶装产品于 2026 年限量发行，采用番茄味苦艾酒。早期女孩和紫切诺基人在葡萄烈酒中浸泡七个月，然后将液体压榨并与昆布、甜菜和胡萝卜混合成白皮诺。其结果是一种粉红色的苦艾酒，具有咸味、植物性和鲜味，这是完全独特的。为您生活中喜欢冒险的饮酒者购买这款产品，然后坐下来享用一些番茄吉布森酒、番茄梅斯卡尔内格罗尼酒和番茄酒雪碧。

paras.en: The season’s hottest toy is a programmable, robotic duck. That’s not a joke: The Microduck is a funky little automaton made by the robotics team at the AI company Hugging Face. The 10-inch-tall bipedal bot has a camera and a lidar system to interact with its surroundings, plus two inertia sensors that help it right itself when it inevitably tips over. The little guy can even pick things up with its beak. Owners train their physical ducks using a virtual duck simulator on their computers. Since the Microducks are on backorder—new purchases will ship in the new year—your loved one can prepare for their robot’s arrival by using AI models to train up the duck and imagining all the things it can do.
paras.zh: 本季最热门的玩具是可编程的机器鸭子。这不是玩笑：Microduck 是人工智能公司 Hugging Face 的机器人团队制造的一款时髦的小机器人。这款 10 英寸高的双足机器人配有摄像头和激光雷达系统，可与周围环境进行交互，此外还有两个惯性传感器，可在其不可避免地翻倒时帮助其自行恢复原状。小家伙甚至可以用喙捡起东西。主人使用计算机上的虚拟鸭子模拟器来训练他们的实体鸭子。由于 Microducks 处于缺货状态（新购买的产品将在新的一年发货），您所爱的人可以使用人工智能模型训练小鸭子并想象它能做的所有事情，为机器人的到来做好准备。

paras.en: This plug-and-play turntable makes a great starter record player for the vinyl-curious audiophile or a solid upgrade for the obsessive record collector. A built-in preamp lets the Spira connect directly to an existing stereo without additional equipment. It comes outfitted with a very nice Audio-Technica cartridge so they can spin their most precious platters on day one. It even has Bluetooth to connect to a speaker or wireless headphones. Aside from those conveniences, the Spira comes from Cambridge Audio, a British hi-fi brand known for high-quality, sweet-sounding components that keep performing for decades.
paras.zh: 这款即插即用转盘对于对黑胶唱片感兴趣的发烧友来说是一款出色的入门电唱机，对于痴迷的唱片收藏家来说是一个可靠的升级。内置前置放大器可让 Spira 直接连接到现有立体声音响，无需额外设备。它配备了一个非常漂亮的铁三角唱头，这样他们就可以在第一天旋转他们最珍贵的盘片。它甚至还具有蓝牙功能，可连接扬声器或无线耳机。除了这些便利之外，Spira 来自 Cambridge Audio，这是一个英国高保真品牌，以高品质、声音甜美的组件而闻名，这些组件可以持续数十年的性能。

paras.en: The horological aficionado on your list probably has a G-Shock—the iconic resin Casio was countless collectors’ first watch—but we’d doubt they have one of these. The new release ditches the digital readout for analog hands, handsomely encased in a shock-resistant, waterproof 44.5-millimeter case. A couple of complications round out the face: a sleepable second-hand dial and a date wheel in the eye at 3 o’clock. It comes in a variety of colors and materials, but this statement-worthy bright yellow version is our favorite.
paras.zh: 您名单上的钟表爱好者可能拥有一块 G-Shock——标志性的树脂卡西欧手表是无数收藏家的第一块手表——但我们怀疑他们是否拥有其中一款。新版本放弃了模拟指针的数字读数，精美地封装在抗震防水的 44.5 毫米表壳中。一些复杂功能使表面更加圆润：可休眠的秒针表盘和位于 3 点钟位置的日期轮。它有多种颜色和材质可供选择，但这款值得一提的亮黄色版本是我们的最爱。

paras.en: Some folks are born with an eye for design, and some need solid training—preferably during the first couple years of life. Michelle Rial’s book presents familiar picture-book-for-kids fare (numbers, vocabulary, colors, feelings) as charts, diagrams, graphs, and infographics. While it does actually serve as a fine developmental learning tool for tots, we all know who the real audience for this book is. Get it for the person in your life at the center of the Venn diagram between “creative professional” and “new parent.”
paras.zh: 有些人天生就有设计眼光，有些人需要扎实的训练——最好是在生命的最初几年。米歇尔·里亚尔的书以图表、图表、图形和信息图的形式呈现了熟悉的儿童图画书（数字、词汇、颜色、感受）。虽然它实际上确实是幼儿的良好发展学习工具，但我们都知道这本书的真正读者是谁。为你生活中位于“创意专业人士”和“新手父母”之间的维恩图中心的人购买它。

paras.en: TIRED: Retro arcade games. WIRED: Retro arcade games made of Lego bricks that you assemble yourself. Yes, this 15.5-inch play set actually works, giving you a wholly analog representation of the 1981 classic, Donkey Kong. It’s made up of 1,367 pieces, and includes working controls, three characters, and a mechanism to keep launching barrels into the scaffolding on a loop. Move the joystick and make Mario (aka Jumpman) leap over the barrels, climb to the top, and save the kidnapped Pauline.
paras.zh: 累了：复古街机游戏。连线：由您自己组装的乐高积木制成的复古街机游戏。是的，这款 15.5 英寸的游戏套装确实有效，为您提供 1981 年经典游戏《大金刚》的完全模拟再现。它由 1,367 个部件组成，包括工作控制器、三个角色以及一个将桶循环发射到脚手架中的机制。移动操纵杆，让马里奥（又名跳跃人）跳过木桶，爬到顶部，拯救被绑架的宝琳。

paras.en: If your loved one can’t start their day without a cup of pour-over coffee, this is the only brewing machine they’ll want. It automates the method of slowly pouring hot water over freshly ground beans. It even replicating the spiral pour pattern (hence the name) essential to pour-over brewing, as a swirl of the spout helps evenly distribute water to the grounds in the filter. The machine includes a bean grinder and a water tank, so one button push is all that’s needed for a cup or two of brightly flavored coffee.
paras.zh: 如果您所爱的人没有一杯手冲咖啡就无法开始新的一天，这是他们唯一想要的冲泡机。它自动执行将热水缓慢倒在新鲜磨碎的豆子上的方法。它甚至复制了倒冲式冲泡所必需的螺旋倾倒模式（因此得名），因为喷嘴的漩涡有助于将水均匀地分配到过滤器中的咖啡粉中。该机器包括一个磨豆机和一个水箱，因此只需按一下按钮即可制作一两杯味道鲜美的咖啡。

paras.en: The stepped shape of this stainless steel jigger is based on an antique measuring tool from the 1930s. The simple yet effective design makes eyeballing precise measurements exceptionally easy—especially helpful if the jigger has already gotten some use earlier in the evening. The steps are in half-ounce (15 milliliters) increments, with four indicators going up to a full 2 ounces (60 ml). Get one for the mixologist in your midst.
paras.zh: 这款不锈钢夹具的阶梯形状是基于 20 世纪 30 年代的古董测量工具。简单而有效的设计使肉眼观察精确测量变得异常容易——如果卷染机在晚上早些时候已经使用过的话，尤其有用。这些步骤以半盎司（15 毫升）为增量，四个指示器最多可达 2 盎司（60 毫升）。为你们中间的调酒师买一份。

paras.en: The Electronic Frontier Foundation is one of the premier nonprofits advocating for digital privacy and civil rights in the connected world. When they’re not busy taking on government, law enforcement, and big tech, they like to play cards. This deck, designed by EFF employees, has faces adorned with HTTP status codes. All the good ones are represented: 200 OK, 511 Network Authentication Required, 403 Forbidden, 408 Request Timeout, and of course, saucy old 404 Not Found.
paras.zh: 电子前沿基金会是倡导互联世界数字隐私和公民权利的首要非营利组织之一。当他们不忙于与政府、执法部门和大型科技公司较量时，他们喜欢玩牌。该套牌由 EFF 员工设计，其面孔上装饰有 HTTP 状态代码。所有好的都被代表了：200 OK，511 Network Authentication required，403 Forbidden，408 Request Timeout，当然还有老套的 404 Not Found。

paras.en: Here’s a fun idea for a connected device: The IDX is an analog gauge to display real-time data streams pulled from the internet. You can configure it out of the box to show the current temperature or air quality, the price of Bitcoin or $ANT, your home’s electricity use, or live download speeds. It can also be used as a focus timer. The digital face changes based on what data you’re displaying, but the big needle is completely mechanical, giving the data nerd in your home a way to monitor anything important to them without constantly pulling out their phone.
paras.zh: 对于连接设备来说，这是一个有趣的想法：IDX 是一种模拟仪表，用于显示从互联网获取的实时数据流。您可以开箱即用地对其进行配置，以显示当前温度或空气质量、比特币或 $ANT 的价格、您家的用电量或实时下载速度。它还可以用作焦点计时器。数字面孔会根据您显示的数据而变化，但大针是完全机械的，让您家中的数据迷能够监控对他们来说重要的任何事情，而无需不断地拿出手机。

paras.en: The world is awash in tools to generate music with AI, and the results are often lacking. Far more interesting is this tool your musical loved one can use to generate music with PI—plant intelligence. PlantWave is a small box with a pair of electrical sensors that attach to the leaves of any plant or mushroom. The box measures the subtle electrical signals the plant gives off and converts that into musical data. Assign that data stream to one of many digital instruments in the companion app, and listen to the plants sing. We originally tested the PlantWave several years ago, but the app has since blossomed to include more sounds and even lets creators craft their own digital instruments.
paras.zh: 世界上充斥着利用人工智能生成音乐的工具，但结果却往往不尽如人意。更有趣的是，您的音乐亲人可以使用这个工具通过 PI（植物智能）生成音乐。 PlantWave 是一个带有一对电子传感器的小盒子，可以附着在任何植物或蘑菇的叶子上。该盒子测量植物发出的微妙电信号，并将其转换为音乐数据。将该数据流分配给配套应用程序中的众多数字仪器之一，然后聆听植物的歌唱。我们最初在几年前测试了 PlantWave，但此后该应用程序不断发展，包含更多声音，甚至允许创作者制作自己的数字乐器。

articles.title: AI Solved Math’s Most Famous Problem. Now Humans Are Struggling to Understand It
articles.author: Isabella Ward

paras.en: Mathematicians are struggling to decode a 17-million-line solution to their field’s most famous problem, published by an Anthropic researcher on Friday.
paras.zh: 数学家们正竭力破解一个1700万行代码的解法，该解法是Anthropic的一名研究人员周五发布的，用于解决该领域最著名的难题。

paras.en: Levent Alpöge released a proof in the programming language Lean of the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, which he had created with Claude. While the conjecture, which describes how prime numbers are distributed, is widely assumed to be true, many mathematicians have tried and failed to definitively show this, and the problem has become something of a holy grail of number theory.
paras.zh: Levent Alpöge 用编程语言 Lean 发布了他与 Claude 共同创建的 167 年黎曼假设的证明。虽然描述素数如何分布的猜想被广泛认为是正确的，但许多数学家试图明确地证明这一点但未能明确，这个问题已成为数论的圣杯。

paras.en: Since Alpöge published his proof, more than 200 people have been collaborating to verify it. On Saturday, the nonprofit the Lean Focused Research Organization and volunteer-led organization Mathlib said on Saturday they have “full confidence” that the proof is sound. The problem is formulated correctly and the code compiles, they confirmed. Now, “we look forward to all the activity in the mathematical community that will help explain the new ideas in this proof,” they wrote.
paras.zh: 自从 Alpöge 发表他的证明以来，已有 200 多人合作验证。周六，非营利组织精益聚焦研究组织和志愿者领导的组织 Mathlib 周六表示，他们“完全有信心”证明证据是可靠的。他们确认，问题的表述正确并且代码可以编译。现在，“我们期待数学界的所有活动都将有助于解释这个证明中的新想法，”他们写道。

paras.en: Lean proofs are written to be checked by machine, while mathematical papers are written to explain the results to the community so that they can be reviewed and advanced. But Alpöge hasn’t released the paper version, which clocks in at 250,000 pages and is, in his own estimation, a “travesty of slop.” (On Monday, he added in an X post that the Lean proof “is full of garbage obviously” but that it still “compiles.” He also said that the 250,000 pages was a “joke … I find big number [sic] extremely hilarious.”) That’s left mathematicians to their own devices as they try to decipher what new findings they can obtain and build from the result.
paras.zh: 编写精益证明是为了让机器检查，而编写数学论文是为了向社区解释结果，以便对其进行审查和改进。但 Alpöge 尚未发布纸质版本，该版本有 250,000 页，据他自己估计，这是“对废话的嘲讽”。 （周一，他在一篇 X 帖子中补充道，精益证明“显然充满了垃圾”，但它仍然“可以编译”。他还说 250,000 页是一个“笑话……我发现大数字[原文如此]非常搞笑。”）这让数学家们只能依靠自己的设备，试图破译他们可以从结果中获得和构建哪些新发现。

paras.en: “Knowing there is a proof is one thing,” Abhishek Saha, a professor of mathematics at Queen Mary University of London, tells WIRED, “but when we understand the proof, that would allow us to actually go beyond what has happened, to build new branches of mathematics perhaps or formulate the next conjecture to push the horizon further.”
paras.zh: 伦敦玛丽女王大学数学教授阿布舍克·萨哈 (Abhishek Saha) 告诉《连线》杂志：“知道有证据是一回事，但当我们理解了证据时，这将使我们能够真正超越已经发生的事情，或许能够建立新的数学分支，或者制定下一个猜想，进一步推动我们的发展。”

paras.en: Saha reckons the community effort should be able to simplify the result into a human-readable form of under 10,000, if not 1,000, pages. But complicating this feat is the fact that the proof appears to draw on many advanced branches of number theory in a long and “incredibly counterintuitive” argument. “I don't think this kind of proof would ever come from a human,” says Saha, “but AIs can do something completely different and almost alien, and that breaks our intuition about how very difficult mathematical results might come about.”
paras.zh: Saha 认为社区的努力应该能够将结果简化为人类可读的形式，即使不是 1,000 页，也不会超过 10,000 页。但让这一壮举变得复杂的是，这个证明似乎在一个漫长且“极其违反直觉”的论证中借鉴了数论的许多高级分支。 “我认为这种证明永远不会来自人类，”萨哈说，“但人工智能可以做一些完全不同、几乎是外星人的事情，这打破了我们对数学结果可能如何产生的直觉。”

paras.en: He was shocked to see even his own corner of number theory utilized by the proof, and has since been trying to understand how. Saha has been using OpenAI’s Astra model to convert sections of the Lean proof into more digestible formats, such as single-page posters like those presented at conferences and shorter documents. But there’s a limit to that approach.
paras.zh: 他惊讶地发现证明甚至使用了他自己的数论角落，并且从那时起就一直试图理解其中的原理。 Saha 一直在使用 OpenAI 的 Astra 模型将精益证明的各个部分转换为更易于理解的格式，例如会议上展示的单页海报和较短的文档。但这种方法有其局限性。

paras.en: “It may well be that no single person has the expertise to understand in detail every part of the proof,” he says.
paras.zh: “很可能没有一个人拥有专业知识来详细理解证明的每个部分，”他说。

paras.en: More than 60 other individuals are using AI agents to try to translate the Lean lines into understandable ideas on Principia Math, a collaborative platform designed to facilitate the understanding of AI breakthroughs. So far, they have done this for more than 3,000 pieces of the Lean proof, though platform chief executive officer Anton Shakov expects it will take mathematicians months before they have a good conceptual understanding of the proof Alpöge produced with Claude in roughly six weeks. “I personally believe the picture we will get in the end, once the ideas of this proof have been properly understood, will be astoundingly beautiful," he tells WIRED.
paras.zh: 超过 60 名其他人正在 Principia Math 上使用 AI 代理，尝试将精益路线转化为可理解的想法，Principia Math 是一个协作平台，旨在促进对 AI 突破的理解。到目前为止，他们已经对 3,000 多条精益证明进行了此操作，尽管平台首席执行官 Anton Shakov 预计数学家们还需要几个月的时间才能对 Alpöge 与 Claude 在大约六周内制作的证明有一个良好的概念理解。他告诉《连线》杂志：“我个人相信，一旦这个证明的思想被正确理解，我们最终得到的画面将会非常美丽。”

paras.en: Independent mathematicians have already understood and written up one smaller result to have come out of Alpöge’s proof.
paras.zh: 独立数学家已经理解并写下了阿尔波格证明中的一个较小的结果。

paras.en: AI labs have previously been criticized for rushing to publish breakthrough mathematical results, claiming glory while leaving the academic community to digest the results—and clean up mistakes.
paras.zh: 人工智能实验室此前曾因急于发表突破性的数学结果而受到批评，声称自己的荣耀，却让学术界消化结果并纠正错误。

paras.en: “No human being can reasonably claim to be responsible for, or even to understand, such a document,” the Association for Human Mathematics, a group of more than 1,000 mathematicians founded in September, wrote in a statement on Friday of the 17-million-line opus. It complained that Alpöge’s announcement “builds upon over a century of human work, but fails to advance mathematical understanding in the same way.”
paras.zh: “没有人可以合理地声称对这样一份文件负责，甚至无法理解，”9 月成立的由 1000 多名数学家组成的人类数学协会在周五的一份关于这份 1700 万行作品的声明中写道。它抱怨说，Alpöge 的声明“建立在人类一个多世纪的工作基础上，但未能以同样的方式促进数学理解。”

paras.en: Alpöge, who before joining Anthropic was a researcher at Harvard University, acknowledged on Friday what an “extraordinary” situation it was to present “the world with a complete argument before having mastered a massive neighborhood around its mathematics,” and wrote that he would try his best to help digest the proof, including by writing it up properly. But having had to hold off from making the announcement ahead of Anthropic’s initial public offering on Thursday, “I just could not live if I waited even longer,” he wrote.
paras.zh: Alpöge 在加入 Anthropic 之前是哈佛大学的一名研究员，他周五承认，“在掌握了围绕数学的大量邻域之前，向世界呈现一个完整的论证”是一种多么“非同寻常”的情况，并写道，他将尽力帮助消化证明，包括正确地把它写下来。但由于不得不在周四 Anthropic 首次公开募股之前推迟宣布这一消息，“如果我再等更长时间，我就活不下去了，”他写道。

paras.en: Anthropic rival OpenAI in October proved a weaker version of the problem, called the quasi-Riemann hypothesis. Alpöge had been scooped by OpenAI in September on another Millennium Prize Problem concerning the Navier-Stokes equations, which describe fluid motion. When the company said it had solved part of the problem, Alpöge’s collaborator, New York University professor Tristan Buckmaster, claimed OpenAI had rushed ahead to beat the pair to it after becoming aware of his work. The pair also announced on Friday that they had completed the remaining unsolved parts of the Navier-Stokes problem.
paras.zh: 人类竞争对手 OpenAI 在 10 月份证明了该问题的一个较弱版本，称为拟黎曼假设。 Alpöge 在 9 月份被 OpenAI 凭借另一个涉及纳维-斯托克斯方程的千年奖问题获得，该方程描述了流体运动。当该公司表示已经解决了部分问题时，Alpöge 的合作者、纽约大学教授特里斯坦·巴克马斯特 (Tristan Buckmaster) 声称，OpenAI 在了解他的工作后，冲在了前面，击败了两人。两人还在周五宣布，他们已经完成了纳维-斯托克斯问题剩余的未解决部分。

articles.title: See the Sasha & Digweed Poster That Sold for $21,500 at Auction
articles.author: Katie Bain

paras.en: A recent auction of items related to Sasha & Digweed‘s seminal 1996 mix album Northern Exposure included one lot that fetched far more than the rest.
paras.zh: 最近，一场与 Sasha & Digweed 1996 年影响深远的混音专辑《Northern Exposure》相关物品的拍卖中，其中一件拍品的成交价远远高于其他拍品。

paras.en: Entering the auction directly from Digweed’s personal archives, a poster advertising the duo’s 1994 debut mix album Renaissance: The Mix Collection received a winning bid of $21,500. See an image of this poster below.
paras.zh: 直接从 Digweed 的个人档案中进入拍卖会的海报是二人组 1994 年首张混音专辑《Renaissance: The Mix Collection》的广告海报，最终以 21,500 美元的价格中标。请参阅下面这张海报的图片。

paras.en: “The reason is that most of these posters were stuck on billboard sites or in the tube station so they would not have been recoverable even when taken down,” Digweed tells Billboard on what made the poster so valuable. “I had kept a poster from that release and had forgot about it. When I was in my record room searching out the Northern Exposure vinyl, I remembered this poster was on the top shelf. It was in perfect condition and a real collectors piece from such a classic mix album release. In a world of scarcity this poster is very rare indeed. I can see why a massive fan would want it but was blown away by how much.”
paras.zh: “原因是大多数海报都贴在广告牌网站或地铁站上，因此即使拆除它们也无法恢复，”迪格韦德告诉 Billboard 为何海报如此有价值。 “我保留了那张专辑的一张海报，但后来忘记了。当我在唱片室里寻找《Northern Exposure》黑胶唱片时，我记得这张海报在最上面的架子上。它保存完好，是这张经典混音专辑中真正的收藏品。在一个稀缺的世界里，这张海报确实非常罕见。我可以理解为什么大量粉丝想要它，但却被它的数量所震撼。”

paras.en: Hosted by online auction platform Amplifyd, which has previously hosted auctions for items from artists including Danny Tenaglia, the Northern Exposure sale opened on Sept. 29 and closed Oct. 21. Featuring items from the producers’ personal archives, the auction included the actual records used to mix Northern Exposure, Northern Exposure 2, Northern Exposure: Expeditions and Communicate, in addition to various posters, flyers and other memorabilia.
paras.zh: Northern Exposure 拍卖会由在线拍卖平台 Amplifyd 主办，该平台此前曾举办过 Danny Tenaglia 等艺术家的拍卖会，该拍卖会于 9 月 29 日开幕，并于 10 月 21 日结束。拍卖会以制作人个人档案中的物品为特色，包括用于混合 Northern Exposure、Northern Exposure 2、Northern Exposure: Expeditions 和 Communicate 的实际记录，以及各种海报、传单和其他纪念品。

paras.en: All of the auction’s 113 lots brought winning bids, with the $21,500 poster being not only the highest-selling item of this auction, but the highest-selling item in Amplifyd history.
paras.zh: 此次拍卖的 113 件拍品全部中标，其中价值 21,500 美元的海报不仅是本次拍卖中销量最高的拍品，也是 Amplifyd 历史上销量最高的拍品。

paras.en: Sasha & Digweed have upcoming shows at The Roundhouse in London on Dec. 5 and EDC Mexico in February.
paras.zh: Sasha & Digweed 将于 12 月 5 日在伦敦 The Roundhouse 以及 2 月在 EDC 墨西哥举办演出。

articles.title: Benny Benassi and Fedde Le Grand Set Three Australian Shows for January
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Benny Benassi and Fedde Le Grand have added two Australian shows in January, expanding a run that until now consisted of a single appearance at the Australian Open.
paras.zh: 本尼·贝纳西 (Benny Benassi) 和费德·勒·格兰德 (Fedde Le Grand) 在 1 月份增加了两场澳大利亚赛，扩大了此前仅参加过一次澳大利亚公开赛的阵容。

paras.en: The producers will play a club set at the Beach Hotel in Byron Bay on Friday, Jan. 29, a day party at The Ivy in Sydney on Saturday, Jan. 30, and close at John Cain Arena in Melbourne on Sunday, Jan. 31 for AO Live, the Australian Open’s music program.
paras.zh: 制作人将于 1 月 29 日星期五在拜伦湾海滩酒店举行俱乐部演出，1 月 30 日星期六在悉尼 The Ivy 举行日间派对，并于 1 月 31 日星期日在墨尔本约翰凯恩竞技场为澳大利亚网球公开赛的音乐节目 AO Live 闭幕。

paras.en: Live Nation is promoting all three, with the Byron Bay show presented alongside Beach Hotel and the Sydney date with Fuzzy.
paras.zh: Live Nation 正在推广这三场演出，其中拜伦湾演出与海滩酒店一起演出，悉尼演出则与 Fuzzy 一起演出。

paras.en: The Melbourne set falls on the tournament’s final day, with the pair joined by Sonique, TV Rock, Zoë Badwi and Kailyn Crabbe.
paras.zh: 墨尔本赛场在比赛的最后一天举行，索尼克 (Sonique)、TV Rock、佐伊·巴德维 (Zoë Badwi) 和凯琳·克拉布 (Kailyn Crabbe) 也加入其中。

paras.en: Benassi helped define electro-house with “Satisfaction,” produced in 2002 with his cousin Alle Benassi as the Benassi Bros. The track’s distorted bassline and mechanical groove became a template for a decade of festival dance music. He has remained a fixture on the circuit since, with sets at Coachella, Tomorrowland, EDC and Ultra.
paras.zh: Benassi 于 2002 年与他的表弟 Alle Benassi 作为 Benassi Bros 一起制作了《Satisfaction》，帮助定义了电子浩室音乐。这首歌扭曲的低音线和机械律动成为十年来节日舞曲音乐的模板。此后，他一直是巡回赛的常客，曾在 Coachella、Tomorrowland、EDC 和 Ultra 等音乐节上演出。

paras.en: His influence has twice been recognized by the Recording Academy, in both directions. Benassi won best remixed recording at the 2008 Grammys for his Sfaction remix of Public Enemy‘s “Bring the Noise.” Four years later, the same award went to Skrillex for his remix of Benassi’s “Cinema” — a record widely credited with helping break dubstep in North America.
paras.zh: 他的影响力曾两次获得唱片学院的双向认可。 Benassi 凭借他对 Public Enemy 的“Bring the Noise”的 Sfaction 混音版赢得了 2008 年格莱美奖最佳混音唱片奖。四年后，斯克里莱克斯因对贝纳西的“Cinema”进行混音而获得了同样的奖项——这张唱片被广泛认为有助于打破北美的回响贝斯。

paras.en: Benassi’s U.S. chart high came with “Beautiful People,” his 2011 collaboration with Chris Brown, which topped Billboard’s Dance Club Songs chart and came close to the Hot 100’s top 40. Earlier, “Illusion” reached No. 4 on Hot Dance Club Play. He has also worked with John Legend and System of a Down’s Serj Tankian.
paras.zh: 贝纳西 (Benassi) 凭借 2011 年与克里斯·布朗 (Chris Brown) 合作的《Beautiful People》在美国排行榜上名列前茅，该歌曲登上了 Billboard 舞蹈俱乐部歌曲排行榜的榜首，并接近 Hot 100 的前 40 名。此前，《Illusion》在 Hot Dance Club Play 上排名第四。他还曾与 John Legend 和 System of a Down 的 Serj Tankian 合作过。

paras.en: Le Grand broke through with “Put Your Hands Up for Detroit,” which topped Billboard’s Global Dance Tracks chart in 2006 and spent 49 weeks on it. The Dutch producer, who arrived at a moment when house was widely seen as stagnating, followed with “Let Me Think About It,” his crossover with Ida Corr, along with “The Creeps,” “So Much Love” and “Sparks (Turn Off Your Mind).” He has played Tomorrowland, Ultra and Coachella.
paras.zh: Le Grand 凭借《Put Your Hands Up for Detroit》取得突破，在 2006 年登上公告牌全球舞曲排行榜榜首，并持续了 49 周。这位荷兰制作人在人们普遍认为 House 停滞不前的时候到来，随后推出了他与 Ida Corr 的合作歌曲《Let Me Think About It》，以及《The Creeps》、《So Much Love》和《Sparks (Turn Off Your Mind)》。他曾演奏过 Tomorrowland、Ultra 和 Coachella。

paras.en: Sonique, who joins them in Melbourne, reached No. 8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and No. 1 on Dance Club Songs in 2000 with “It Feels So Good.”
paras.zh: 2000 年，索尼克在墨尔本加入了他们的行列，凭借《It Feels So Good》在 Billboard Hot 100 中排名第 8，在舞蹈俱乐部歌曲中排名第 1。

paras.en: AO Live runs across the tournament, which takes place Jan. 10-31 at Melbourne Park. RuPaul headlines the smaller TOPCOURT stage on Jan. 29, the Open’s Pride Day, in a DJ set, with the program split between Live Nation at John Cain Arena and Untitled Group at TOPCOURT.
paras.zh: 比赛将于 1 月 10 日至 31 日在墨尔本公园举行，AO Live 全程直播。 1 月 29 日，英国公开赛的骄傲日，鲁保罗 (RuPaul) 在较小的 TOPCOURT 舞台上成为头条新闻，节目由 John Cain Arena 的 Live Nation 和 TOPCOURT 的 Untitled Group 两部分进行。

paras.en: A Live Nation presale for Byron Bay and Sydney runs from Thursday (Nov. 26) at 10 a.m. local time until Friday at 10 a.m., with general sale Friday at 11 a.m. local. Tickets for the Melbourne show are on sale now and include an Australian Open ground pass.
paras.zh: Live Nation 拜伦湾和悉尼的预售时间为当地时间周四（11 月 26 日）上午 10 点至周五上午 10 点，一般发售时间为当地时间周五上午 11 点。墨尔本演出门票现已发售，其中包含澳大利亚公开赛地面通行证。

articles.title: Billy Ray Cyrus on Miley’s Wedding: ‘I’m the Proudest Dad Alive’
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Billy Ray Cyrus has shared a series of photos from daughter Miley Cyrus’ wedding to Maxx Morando, with the “Achy Breaky Heart” singer posting publicly about the ceremony for the first time.
paras.zh: 比利·雷·赛勒斯 (Billy Ray Cyrus) 分享了女儿麦莉·赛勒斯 (Miley Cyrus) 与 Maxx Morando 婚礼的一系列照片，这位“Achy Breaky Heart”歌手首次公开发布有关婚礼的信息。

paras.en: “My little girl married the love of her life! I can’t describe how beautiful it felt to have all my family together in one room, united by love,” he wrote on Instagram. “Words can’t begin to express how proud you make me every day. I’m the proudest dad alive!”
paras.zh: 他在 Instagram 上写道：“我的小女儿嫁给了她一生的挚爱！我无法形容我所有的家人都在一个房间里，因爱而团结在一起的感觉是多么美好。” “言语无法表达您每天让我感到多么自豪。我是世上最自豪的爸爸！”

paras.en: Addressing Morando directly, he added: “I’m so honoured to welcome you to the family. The two of you kids are a match made in heaven.”
paras.zh: 他直接对莫兰多说道：“我很荣幸欢迎你加入这个家庭。你们两个孩子简直就是天作之合。”

paras.en: The post confirmed that his fiancée, Elizabeth Hurley, attended along with her son Damian Hurley, who also shared images of the lavish nuptials.
paras.zh: 该帖子证实，他的未婚妻伊丽莎白·赫尔利(Elizabeth Hurley)和她的儿子达米安·赫尔利(Damian Hurley)一起出席，后者还分享了奢华婚礼的照片。

paras.en: Miley married Morando on Saturday (Nov. 21) at the Frank Sinatra House in Palm Springs, Calif., in a poolside ceremony officiated by Wayne Coyne of the Flaming Lips, who collaborated with her on 2015’s Miley Cyrus & Her Dead Petz.
paras.zh: 麦莉于周六（11 月 21 日）在加利福尼亚州棕榈泉的 Frank Sinatra House 与 Morando 结婚，婚礼由 Flaming Lips 成员 Wayne Coyne 主持，后者曾在 2015 年的电影《Miley Cyrus & Her Dead Petz》中与麦莉合作。

paras.en: She shared her own images on Monday, her 34th birthday, including one of her mother, Tish Cyrus-Purcell, walking her down the aisle and another of her dancing with her father at the reception. “Waking up on my 34th birthday feeling so grateful,” she wrote. “Thank you for all the wishes and to everyone who made this weekend a memory we’ll cherish for a lifetime and beyond.”
paras.zh: 周一，也就是她的 34 岁生日，她分享了自己的照片，其中一张是她的母亲蒂什·赛勒斯-珀塞尔 (Tish Cyrus-Purcell) 陪着她走上红毯，另一张是她在招待会上与父亲跳舞的照片。 “在我 34 岁生日那天醒来，​​我感到非常感激，”她写道。 “感谢大家的祝福，感谢所有让这个周末成为我们一生乃至以后都会珍惜的回忆的人。”

paras.en: Father and daughter share a long musical history. Billy Ray broke through in 1992 with “Achy Breaky Heart,” which topped Billboard’s Hot Country Songs chart and reached No. 4 on the Billboard Hot 100, and returned to the top of the Hot 100 in 2019 alongside Lil Nas X on the “Old Town Road” remix, which spent a record 19 weeks at No. 1. He played Miley’s on-screen dad on Disney Channel’s Hannah Montana, and the pair dueted on 2007’s “Ready, Set, Don’t Go.”
paras.zh: 父女俩有着悠久的音乐历史。比利·雷 (Billy Ray) 于 1992 年凭借《Achy Breaky Heart》取得突破，登上了 Billboard 热门乡村歌曲榜冠军，并在 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜上排名第四，并于 2019 年与 Lil Nas X 一起凭借《Old Town Road》混音版重回 Hot 100 榜首，该歌曲连续 19 周排名第一。他在迪士尼频道的《汉娜》中扮演麦莉的银幕父亲。蒙大拿州，两人在 2007 年的歌曲《Ready, Set, Don't Go》中合唱。

paras.en: Miley has since scored two Billboard Hot 100 No. 1s of her own, with “Wrecking Ball” and “Flowers,” the latter earning her first Grammy wins, for record of the year and best pop solo performance. Her latest era has extended that chart run: “Bass Persuades” debuted at No. 35 on the Hot 100, becoming her 24th top 40 hit, while the album of the same name opened at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with 61,000 equivalent album units — her sixth chart-topper and first since Bangerz in 2013. The set followed 2025’s Something Beautiful, which debuted and peaked at No. 4.
paras.zh: 此后，麦莉凭借《Wrecking Ball》和《Flowers》两次登上公告牌百强单曲榜第一名，后者为她赢得了她的第一个格莱美奖，获得了年度唱片和最佳流行独奏表演奖。她的最新时代延续了这一趋势：《Bass Persuades》首次亮相就在 Hot 100 排行榜上排名第 35 位，成为她第 24 张进入前 40 名的热门单曲，而同名专辑在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第一，拥有 61,000 个同等专辑单位——她第六次登上排行榜冠军，也是自 2013 年 Bangerz 以来的第一次。 4号。

paras.en: The post marks a shift for a family whose tensions have played out publicly. Miley and Billy Ray were estranged for years following his 2022 divorce from Tish Cyrus, and he did not attend her Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony in May, though she referenced him in her speech. Miley confirmed last year that they were no longer estranged, saying she had learned to respect her parents as individuals, and Billy Ray publicly celebrated her engagement in December 2025.
paras.zh: 这篇帖子标志着这个紧张关系已经公开化的家庭发生了转变。麦莉和比利·雷在 2022 年与蒂什·赛勒斯离婚后疏远了多年，他也没有参加她 5 月份的好莱坞星光大道仪式，尽管她在演讲中提到了他。麦莉去年证实，他们不再疏远，并表示她已经学会尊重父母作为个人，比利·雷于 2025 年 12 月公开庆祝了她的订婚。

paras.en: Morando, 28, is the drummer for Los Angeles band Liily. He and Miley began dating in 2021 and became engaged in December 2025. It marks the singer’s second marriage; she was previously married to Liam Hemsworth from December 2018 until their separation the following August.
paras.zh: 28 岁的莫兰多是洛杉矶乐队 Liily 的鼓手。他和麦莉于 2021 年开始约会，并于 2025 年 12 月订婚。这标志着这位歌手的第二次婚姻；她曾于 2018 年 12 月与利亚姆·海姆斯沃斯 (Liam Hemsworth) 结婚，直至次年 8 月分居。

articles.title: 2026 International Emmy Winners Revealed: ‘Carême’ Wins Best Drama
articles.author: Scott Roxborough

paras.en: The International Emmy Awards, the global version of the U.S. TV honors, were handed out in New York Monday night.
paras.zh: 国际艾美奖是美国电视奖项的全球版本，周一晚上在纽约颁发。

paras.en: The top prize of best drama went to French foodie-themed period series Carême from Apple TV. The series beat out Steven Knight’s Hulu boxing drama A Thousand Blows; Prime Video’s Argentine political drama Menem; and underdog sports drama Real Kashmir Football Club from Indian pay-TV group Sony LIV.
paras.zh: 最佳剧集最高奖颁给了 Apple TV 出品的法国美食主题古装剧《Carême》。该剧击败了史蒂文·奈特 (Steven Knight) 的 Hulu 拳击剧《千击》； Prime Video 的阿根廷政治剧《梅内姆》；以及印度付费电视集团索尼 LIV 出品的失败体育剧《皇家克什米尔足球俱乐部》。

paras.en: Best drama was one of the few categories where Netflix was not represented.
paras.zh: 最佳剧集是少数几个没有 Netflix 参与的类别之一。

paras.en: Netflix went into the 54th International Emmys the clear frontrunner with nine nominations, including all four best comedy noms — for the Rowan Atkinson slapstick series Man vs. Baby; the Spanish sitcom Old Dog, New Tricks; Argentine satire División Palermo; and Vir Das: Fool Volume, the latest comedy special from the Indian stand-up star. División Palermo won the award.
paras.zh: Netflix 在第 54 届国际艾美奖颁奖典礼上以九项提名遥遥领先，其中包括全部四项最佳喜剧提名——罗温·阿特金森的闹剧剧集《男人大战婴儿》；西班牙情景喜剧《老狗新把戏》；阿根廷讽刺剧 División Palermo； 《Vir Das: Fool Volume》是这位印度单口喜剧明星的最新喜剧特辑。巴勒莫分区荣获该奖项。

paras.en: Still that prize was the only one that went to a program from the streamer.
paras.zh: 不过，该奖项是唯一颁发给流媒体节目的奖项。

paras.en: Best actor went to Bobby Schofield for BBC drama Unforgivable, beating out nominees Javier Cámara, up for his lead performance Spanish dark comedy Jakarta for Moviestar Plus+; Ricardo Darín for Netflix’s Argentine sci-fi survival thriller The Eternaut; and Ian Roberts for Prime Video’s South African road movie A Kind of Madness.
paras.zh: 鲍比·斯科菲尔德凭借 BBC 电视剧《不可饶恕》击败了提名者哈维尔·卡马拉，凭借在 Moviestar Plus+ 中主演的西班牙黑色喜剧《雅加达》获得最佳男主角奖；里卡多·达林 (Ricardo Darín) 主演的 Netflix 阿根廷科幻生存惊悚片《永恒》；和伊恩·罗伯茨 (Ian Roberts) 主演的 Prime Video 南非公路电影《疯狂》。

paras.en: Best actress, despite Netflix boasting two of this year’s nominees, went to Belgian actress Mona Mina Leon, nominated for Flemish dramedy Holy Sh!t. Leon beat out Bárbara Mori from Lucca’s World, Park Ji-Hyun from You and Everything Else and Sheridan Smith for the Brit true-crime drama I Fought the Law from ITV.
paras.zh: 尽管 Netflix 吹嘘今年有两名提名者，但最佳女主角还是由比利时女演员莫娜·米娜·莱昂 (Mona Mina Leon) 获得，她凭借佛兰芒剧情片《Holy Sh!t》获得提名。莱昂击败了《卢卡世界》中的芭芭拉·莫里、《你和一切》中的朴智贤以及英国独立电视台的真实犯罪剧《我与法律斗争》中的谢里丹·史密斯。

paras.en: In total, there were 64 nominees across 16 categories spanning 22 countries. Shrinking star Michael Urie hosted this year’s ceremony at the New York Hilton in Manhattan.
paras.zh: 总共有 64 名提名者，涉及 22 个国家、16 个类别。缩水明星迈克尔·尤里 (Michael Urie) 在曼哈顿的纽约希尔顿酒店主持了今年的颁奖典礼。

paras.en: In addition to the competitive awards, former Netflix chief content officer Bela Bajaria received the Founders Award and former Warner Bros. Discovery international president Gerhard Zeiler received the Directorate Award, presented by former WBD CEO David Zaslav.
paras.zh: 除了竞争性奖项外，前 Netflix 首席内容官 Bela Bajaria 还获得了创始人奖，前华纳兄弟探索国际总裁 Gerhard Zeiler 获得了由前 WBD 首席执行官 David Zaslav 颁发的董事会奖。
