articles.title: Mysterious new viruses reveal a missing link in evolution

paras.en: Mysterious new viruses reveal a missing link in evolution
paras.zh: 神秘的新病毒揭示了进化中缺失的一环

paras.en: Scientists have discovered previously unknown viruses that could help explain how some of lifeâs earliest biological structures evolved. The surprising findings challenge a longstanding evolutionary theory and suggest that viruses may have hidden capabilities far beyond simply infecting cells.
paras.zh: 科学家们发现了以前未知的病毒，可以帮助解释一些生命最早的生物结构是如何进化的。这些令人惊讶的发现挑战了长期存在的进化理论，并表明病毒可能具有远远超出简单感染细胞的隐藏能力。

paras.en: Researchers at the University of Miami have discovered a previously unknown group of viruses that could help explain a missing piece of evolutionary history. The finding reveals an unexpected connection between viruses and tiny protein compartments inside cells, offering new clues about how some of life's earliest biological structures may have developed.
paras.zh: 迈阿密大学的研究人员发现了一组以前未知的病毒，可以帮助解释进化历史中缺失的一段。这一发现揭示了病毒与细胞内微小蛋白质区室之间的意想不到的联系，为了解生命中一些最早的生物结构如何发育提供了新的线索。

paras.en: The research, published in Nature Communications, challenges the conventional explanation for the origins of cellular structures known as encapsulins. Scientists previously believed these compartments evolved from viruses. However, the new evidence suggests a more complicated evolutionary relationship in which viruses and encapsulins may have repeatedly evolved from one another over millions of years.
paras.zh: 这项发表在《自然通讯》上的研究挑战了对被称为封装蛋白的细胞结构起源的传统解释。科学家此前认为这些隔室是由病毒进化而来的。然而，新的证据表明存在一种更复杂的进化关系，其中病毒和封装蛋白可能在数百万年的时间里反复相互进化。

paras.en: The discovery could have important implications for biotechnology and for understanding the origins and early evolution of life. It also raises the possibility that viruses have biological functions that scientists have largely overlooked.
paras.zh: 这一发现可能对生物技术和理解生命的起源和早期进化产生重要影响。这也提出了病毒具有科学家在很大程度上忽视的生物学功能的可能性。

paras.en: Mysterious New Viruses Reveal an Evolutionary Connection
paras.zh: 神秘的新病毒揭示了进化联系

paras.en: At the center of the discovery are proteins that fold into a distinctive three-dimensional structure known as the HK97-fold. These proteins can assemble into protective shells and are found in both viruses and encapsulins.
paras.zh: 这一发现的核心是蛋白质，它们折叠成一种独特的三维结构，称为 HK97 折叠。这些蛋白质可以组装成保护壳，并且存在于病毒和封装蛋白中。

paras.en: The newly identified viruses have smaller, simpler genomes than other viruses that produce HK97-fold protein shells. They also possess characteristics associated with both viruses and encapsulins, making them possible evolutionary intermediates between the two. Studying these unusual viruses could help researchers understand how increasingly complex biological systems first appeared.
paras.zh: 新发现的病毒比其他产生 HK97 倍蛋白壳的病毒具有更小、更简单的基因组。它们还具有与病毒和封装蛋白相关的特征，使它们可能成为两者之间的进化中间体。研究这些不寻常的病毒可以帮助研究人员了解日益复杂的生物系统是如何最初出现的。

paras.en: "What makes the HK97-fold proteins so interesting is that they can form shells that enclose biochemical reactions in cellular lineages, archaea, and bacteria. But they also serve genetic purposes in viruses, storing and protecting their viral genome," said Abelardo Aguilar, the study's first author and a Ph.D. student in the Department of Biology at the University of Miami College of Arts and Sciences.
paras.zh: “HK97 折叠蛋白之所以如此有趣，是因为它们可以形成外壳，包围细胞谱系、古细菌和细菌中的生化反应。但它们也在病毒中发挥遗传作用，储存和保护病毒基因组，”该研究的第一作者、博士生 Abelardo Aguilar 说。迈阿密大学艺术与科学学院生物系的学生。

paras.en: "These proteins build compartments with two different roles, which connects directly with the study of the origin of life and its early evolution because if you think about it, life at its core is about enclosing reactions and also enclosing information that can be inherited so those reactions can happen in the future."
paras.zh: “这些蛋白质构建了具有两种不同作用的隔室，这与生命起源及其早期进化的研究直接相关，因为如果你仔细想想，生命的核心就是封闭反应以及封闭可以遗传的信息，以便这些反应可以在未来发生。”

paras.en: AI Helps Discover Hidden Viruses in Billions of DNA Sequences
paras.zh: 人工智能帮助发现数十亿 DNA 序列中隐藏的病毒

paras.en: To uncover these previously unknown viruses, Aguilar worked with Antoni Luque Santolaria, the study's senior author and an associate professor in the Department of Biology. Luque also holds secondary appointments in the Department of Physics within the College of Arts and Sciences and the Department of Chemical, Environmental and Materials Engineering in the College of Engineering. The project brought together collaborators from multiple institutions.
paras.zh: 为了发现这些以前未知的病毒，阿吉拉尔与该研究的资深作者、生物系副教授安东尼·卢克·桑托拉里亚 (Antoni Luque Santolaria) 合作。卢克还在文理学院物理系和工程学院化学、环境和材料工程系担任二级职务。该项目汇集了来自多个机构的合作者。

paras.en: Rather than relying on laboratory experiments to grow viruses, the team searched enormous genetic databases containing billions of DNA sequences. They combined bioinformatics, models of protein behavior, and artificial intelligence tools, including protein language models and AlphaFold, to investigate the structures encoded by these sequences.
paras.zh: 该团队并没有依靠实验室实验来培养病毒，而是搜索了包含数十亿 DNA 序列的巨大遗传数据库。他们结合了生物信息学、蛋白质行为模型和人工智能工具（包括蛋白质语言模型和 AlphaFold）来研究这些序列编码的结构。

paras.en: The databases included IMG/M, a resource associated with the U.S. Department of Energy's Joint Genome Institute and the University of California, Berkeley. Its genetic information comes from environmental samples collected around the world, including soil, seawater, wastewater, the human gut, and numerous other locations.
paras.zh: 这些数据库包括 IMG/M，这是与美国能源部联合基因组研究所和加州大学伯克利分校相关的资源。它的遗传信息来自世界各地收集的环境样本，包括土壤、海水、废水、人类肠道和许多其他地方。

paras.en: This approach allows scientists to investigate viruses that have never been successfully grown in a laboratory, greatly expanding the number of organisms and evolutionary relationships they can study.
paras.zh: 这种方法使科学家能够研究从未在实验室成功培养的病毒，极大地扩展了他们可以研究的生物体数量和进化关系。

paras.en: "The majority of viruses cannot be grown in the lab. But now through sequencing, we have access to information on viruses for which we don't know the host, that we can't culture in the lab, but that are everywhere," Luque explained. "That means there are multiple questions in relation to evolution and how viruses have adapted to the world that it's now possible to explore bioinformatically."
paras.zh: “大多数病毒无法在实验室中培养。但现在通过测序，我们可以获得有关我们不知道宿主、无法在实验室培养但无处不在的病毒的信息，”卢克解释道。 “这意味着与进化以及病毒如何适应现在可以通过生物信息学探索的世界有关的多个问题。”

paras.en: Viral Protein Shells May Have Unexpected Functions
paras.zh: 病毒蛋白壳可能具有意想不到的功能

paras.en: Beyond identifying the new viruses, the researchers proposed a possible molecular explanation for how viruses and encapsulins could have evolved from one another.
paras.zh: 除了识别新病毒之外，研究人员还提出了一种可能的分子解释，解释病毒和封装蛋白如何相互进化。

paras.en: Their model centers on procapsids, immature viral protein shells (capsids) that may provide a pathway between the two types of structures. These shells could potentially support both genetic functions, such as containing viral DNA, and metabolic functions involving chemical reactions.
paras.zh: 他们的模型以原衣壳为中心，即未成熟的病毒蛋白壳（衣壳），可能在两种类型的结构之间提供通路。这些外壳可能支持遗传功能（例如包含病毒 DNA）和涉及化学反应的代谢功能。

paras.en: This raises an intriguing possibility. Viral capsids are generally recognized for packaging and protecting genetic material, but certain forms might also help create environments where biochemical reactions can occur.
paras.zh: 这提出了一个有趣的可能性。病毒衣壳通常被认为可以包装和保护遗传物质，但某些形式也可能有助于创造可以发生生化反应的环境。

paras.en: "One implication of this research is the possibility that viral capsids could also facilitate biochemical reactions, which would open up the potential roles that capsids have in environments as a whole," Aguilar explained.
paras.zh: 阿吉拉尔解释说：“这项研究的一个意义是，病毒衣壳也可能促进生化反应，这将揭示衣壳在整个环境中的潜在作用。”

paras.en: Although further research is needed to establish these potential functions, the findings suggest that scientists may need to look beyond the infectious stages of viruses to fully understand their roles in nature.
paras.zh: 尽管需要进一步研究来确定这些潜在功能，但研究结果表明，科学家可能需要超越病毒的感染阶段，才能充分了解它们在自然界中的作用。

paras.en: "When we're looking at viruses, we tend to look only at the particles that are infective, and this study points out that we might need to start putting more emphasis on the non-infective versions of the virus and what other functions those viral-like particles may have that we have overlooked in the past."
paras.zh: “当我们研究病毒时，我们往往只关注具有感染性的颗粒，这项研究指出，我们可能需要开始更加重视病毒的非感染性版本，以及这些病毒样颗粒可能具有我们过去忽视的其他功能。”

paras.en: New AI Tools Open the Door to More Viral Discoveries
paras.zh: 新的人工智能工具为更多病毒式发现打开了大门

paras.en: The research also demonstrates how artificial intelligence and computational biology are transforming the study of viruses. By combining powerful analytical tools with knowledge of protein structure and physical behavior, scientists can now investigate evolutionary questions that were previously difficult to explore.
paras.zh: 该研究还展示了人工智能和计算生物学如何改变病毒研究。通过将强大的分析工具与蛋白质结构和物理行为知识相结合，科学家现在可以研究以前难以探索的进化问题。

paras.en: Supported by the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation and the U.S. National Science Foundation, the project provides a framework for studying other poorly understood viruses and their biological capabilities.
paras.zh: 该项目得到戈登和贝蒂摩尔基金会以及美国国家科学基金会的支持，为研究其他知之甚少的病毒及其生物学能力提供了一个框架。

paras.en: The researchers believe these methods could also be useful beyond evolutionary biology, including efforts to understand newly emerging viruses and pathogens.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这些方法也可能在进化生物学之外发挥作用，包括努力了解新出现的病毒和病原体。

paras.en: "If you have the right question and you pair it with the right tools and physical insights, it gives researchers an opportunity to look at viruses in a way that we didn't have an opportunity to do before," Luque said. "There are evolution questions, but there are also questions about emerging pathogens or emerging viruses. The set of tools that we use can be moved forward in different contexts."
paras.zh: 卢克说：“如果你有正确的问题，并将其与正确的工具和物理见解相结合，那么研究人员就有机会以一种我们以前没有机会做的方式来观察病毒。” “存在进化问题，但也存在有关新出现的病原体或新出现的病毒的问题。我们使用的这套工具可以在不同的情况下向前推进。”

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Miami. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由迈阿密大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Abelardo Aguilar, Ingrid Miranda Perez, Omer Nadel, Stephen Nayfach, Luis Ruiz Pestana, Anca M. Segall, Forest L. Rohwer, Simon Roux, Simon White, Antoni Luque. Small viruses reveal bidirectional evolution between HK97-fold viruses and encapsulins via procapsids. Nature Communications, 2026; 17 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-78136-1
paras.zh: - 阿韦拉多·阿吉拉尔、英格丽德·米兰达·佩雷斯、奥马尔·纳德尔、斯蒂芬·奈法赫、路易斯·鲁伊斯·佩斯塔纳、安卡·M·西格尔、福里斯特·L·罗维尔、西蒙·鲁、西蒙·怀特、安东尼·卢克。小病毒通过原衣壳揭示了 HK97 倍病毒和封装蛋白之间的双向进化。自然通讯，2026； 17 (1) DOI：10.1038/s41467-026-78136-1

articles.title: Weird 'potato chips' and 'ghostly rocks' on Mars spotted by NASA rovers Curiosity and Perseverance
articles.author: Samantha Mathewson

paras.en: NASA's Curiosity and Perseverance rovers have spotted a bizarre assortment of Martian oddities, from potato chip-like rocks and ghostly white formations to mysterious patterns etched into the Red Planet's surface.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的好奇号和毅力号火星车发现了火星上各种各样的奇异现象，从薯片状的岩石和幽灵般的白色结构，到蚀刻在这颗红色星球表面的神秘图案。

paras.en: While their appearances may be unusual, these formations offer scientists something far more valuable than a collection of curious snapshots: clues to the geological processes that shaped Mars over billions of years.
paras.zh: 虽然它们的外观可能很不寻常，但这些构造为科学家提供了比一组好奇快照更有价值的东西：数十亿年来塑造火星的地质过程的线索。

paras.en: In particular, the rocks and mineral deposits could help researchers piece together the planet's watery past and identify environments that may once have been capable of supporting microbial life.
paras.zh: 特别是，岩石和矿藏可以帮助研究人员拼凑出地球上水的过去，并确定曾经能够支持微生物生命的环境。

paras.en: NASA's Curiosity rover recently wrapped up a drilling campaign at a location nicknamed "Nazca," where scientists have been examining unusual disk-shaped crystal formations embedded in the surrounding bedrock. Some of the features are so thin and flat that the mission team likened them to potato chips, according to a statement from the space agency.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的好奇号火星车最近在一个绰号为“纳斯卡”的地点完成了一次钻探活动，科学家们一直在那里检查嵌入周围基岩中的不寻常的盘状晶体结构。根据航天局的一份声明，其中一些特征非常薄且平坦，任务团队将它们比作薯片。

paras.en: Curiosity used its Mars Hand Lens Imager (MAHLI), mounted on the end of its robotic arm, to capture detailed close-up images of the formations on Nov. 7 — the rover's 5,067th Martian day, or Sol 5067. The rover also used its ChemCam instrument to study the rocks' chemical composition, while samples from the Nazca drill site were delivered to its onboard Sample Analysis at Mars (SAM) instrument for further analysis.
paras.zh: 好奇号使用安装在其机械臂末端的火星手持镜头成像仪 (MAHLI) 捕获了 11 月 7 日（好奇号的第 5,067 个火星日，即 Sol 5067）地层的详细特写图像。好奇号还使用其 ChemCam 仪器来研究岩石的化学成分，而来自纳斯卡钻探现场的样本则被传送到其机载火星样本分析 (SAM) 仪器进行进一步分析。

paras.en: Meanwhile, NASA's Perseverance rover has been investigating a collection of unusually bright rocks in an area called "Idubi," located in the “Lac de Charmes” region outside Jezero Crater. The rover captured images of the formations on Oct. 29, 2026 (Sol 2023), revealing pale, ghostly-looking rocks that stand out dramatically against the darker, dust-covered Martian landscape.
paras.zh: 与此同时，美国宇航局的毅力号火星车一直在调查位于杰泽罗陨石坑外“魅力湖”地区的“伊杜比”地区的一组异常明亮的岩石。火星车于 2026 年 10 月 29 日（Sol 2023）拍摄到了这些地层的图像，显​​示出苍白、幽灵般的岩石，这些岩石在较暗、布满灰尘的火星景观中显得格外突出。

paras.en: Data from Perseverance's SuperCam instrument revealed that the rocks are rich in hydrated silica rather than being typical igneous rocks. That discovery has scientists particularly interested. On Earth, hydrated silica can form in environments involving hydrothermal activity or groundwater. These deposits are also capable of preserving microscopic fossils, making them valuable targets in the search for evidence of ancient life, according to another statement from NASA.
paras.zh: 来自 Perseverance 的 SuperCam 仪器的数据显示，这些岩石富含水合二氧化硅，而不是典型的火成岩。这一发现引起了科学家们的特别兴趣。在地球上，水合二氧化硅可以在涉及热液活动或地下水的环境中形成。根据美国宇航局的另一份声明，这些沉积物还能够保存微观化石，使其成为寻找古代生命证据的宝贵目标。

paras.en: Perseverance is now conducting a closer investigation of the formations, using its instruments to gather detailed chemical and mineralogical data that could help scientists determine how the rocks formed and whether they preserve potential signs of past microbial activity.
paras.zh: 毅力号现在正在对这些地层进行更仔细的调查，利用其仪器收集详细的化学和矿物学数据，这些数据可以帮助科学家确定岩石是如何形成的，以及它们是否保留了过去微生物活动的潜在迹象。

paras.en: Back at Mount Sharp, Curiosity has also spotted another geological curiosity: the return of distinctive polygon-shaped patterns across the Martian bedrock.
paras.zh: 回到夏普山，好奇号还发现了另一个地质奇观：火星基岩上重新出现了独特的多边形图案。

paras.en: The rover's latest images, captured on Nov. 13, 2026 (Sol 5073), show small, regularly shaped polygons outlined by raised ridges, resembling patterns the rover encountered earlier in its climb up the layered mountain, whose rocky slopes preserve a record of Mars' changing climate and ancient watery environments. Scientists say these formations could have developed through several processes, including mineral shrinkage as water evaporated, temperature changes or the expansion and compaction of buried sediments, according to a statement from NASA.
paras.zh: 火星车的最新图像于 2026 年 11 月 13 日（太阳 5073）拍摄，显示了由凸起山脊勾勒出的规则形状的小多边形，类似于火星车早些时候攀登层状山脉时遇到的图案，其岩石斜坡保留了火星不断变化的气候和古代水环境的记录。根据美国宇航局的一份声明，科学家们表示，这些地层可能是通过几个过程形成的，包括水蒸发时矿物的收缩、温度变化或埋藏沉积物的膨胀和压实。

paras.en: By studying the composition of the rocks and the material cementing the raised ridges around the polygons, researchers hope to determine which processes shaped the terrain.
paras.zh: 通过研究岩石的成分和粘合多边形周围凸起山脊的材料，研究人员希望确定是哪些过程塑造了地形。

paras.en: Together, these discoveries highlight how much Mars' seemingly barren landscape can reveal about its past. As Curiosity continues climbing Mount Sharp and Perseverance investigates ancient terrain beyond Jezero Crater, both rovers are helping piece together the planet's unique features and complex geological history.
paras.zh: 这些发现共同凸显了火星看似贫瘠的景观可以揭示其过去的多少。随着好奇号继续攀登夏普山，毅力号探索杰泽罗陨石坑以外的古代地形，两辆漫游车都在帮助拼凑出这颗行星的独特特征和复杂的地质历史。

paras.en: Samantha Mathewson joined Space.com as an intern in the summer of 2016. She received a B.A. in Journalism and Environmental Science at the University of New Haven, in Connecticut. Previously, her work has been published in Nature World News. When not writing or reading about science, Samantha enjoys traveling to new places and taking photos! You can follow her on Twitter @Sam_Ashley13.
paras.zh: Samantha Mathewson 于 2016 年夏天作为实习生加入 Space.com。她获得了学士学位。康涅狄格州纽黑文大学新闻与环境科学专业。此前，她的研究成果曾发表在《自然·世界新闻》上。当不撰写或阅读有关科学的内容时，萨曼莎喜欢去新的地方旅行并拍照！您可以在 Twitter 上关注她@Sam_Ashley13。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 23, 2015: Blue Origin sticks 1st-ever rocket landing from space with its suborbital New Shepard rocket
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 23, 2015, a Blue Origin rocket made a historic landing. Before this time, all rockets were single-use only — even SpaceX's rockets. Blue Origin changed the concept forever.
paras.zh: 2015 年 11 月 23 日，蓝色起源火箭实现了历史性的着陆。在此之前，所有火箭都是一次性的——甚至包括 SpaceX 的火箭。蓝色起源永远改变了这个概念。

paras.en: After launching the New Shepard capsule safely into space, the rocket started heading back to Earth. It flew towards a landing pad, reignited its engine to slow down and touched down softly on the ground. This was the first successful vertical landing from space in history.
paras.zh: 将新谢泼德太空舱安全发射到太空后，火箭开始返回地球。它飞向着陆场，重新点燃发动机减速，然后轻轻降落在地面上。这是历史上首次成功的太空垂直着陆。

paras.en: The Blue Origin milestone meant that rockets could be reused for multiple missions, which saves money and reduces waste.
paras.zh: 蓝色起源的里程碑意味着火箭可以重复用于多项任务，从而节省资金并减少浪费。

paras.en: Today, SpaceX may be the most well-known for landing its Falcon 9 rocket boosters from orbit. The company's triple-core Falcon Heavy boosters can also land vertically and its massive Starship megarocket can even return to the launch site to be caught by giant metal arms.
paras.zh: 如今，SpaceX 可能因将猎鹰 9 号火箭助推器从轨道着陆而闻名。该公司的三核猎鹰重型助推器也可以垂直着陆，其巨大的星舰巨型火箭甚至可以返回发射场并被巨大的金属臂抓住。

paras.en: But in the end, Blue Origin did it first.
paras.zh: 但最终，蓝色起源率先做到了。

paras.en: Blue Origin's New Shepard booster landing kicked off an era of vertical launch and vertical landings for rockets that continues to this day. It may have even outlasted the New Shepard rocket.
paras.zh: 蓝色起源的新谢泼德助推器着陆开启了火箭垂直发射和垂直着陆的时代，这一时代一直延续至今。它甚至可能比新谢泼德火箭更耐用。

paras.en: Since that first landing, Blue Origin has launched 17 suborbital astronaut flights with New Shepard, and 21 more uncrewed flights for a total of 38 missions between April 2015 and 2026. The company reused its New Shepard boosters repeatedly (though it did lose one during an uncrewed launch after a technical issue.) But in January 2026, the company announced a pause in New Shepard flights for two years so that it could focus on moon lander projects.
paras.zh: 自首次着陆以来，蓝色起源公司已使用新谢泼德号发射了 17 次亚轨道宇航员飞行，并在 2015 年 4 月至 2026 年期间总共执行了 38 次任务，另外还进行了 21 次无人驾驶飞行。该公司多次重复使用了新谢泼德号助推器（尽管在一次技术问题后的无人发射中确实丢失了一个。）但在 2026 年 1 月，该公司宣布暂停新谢泼德号飞行两年，以便能够专注于月球着陆器项目。

paras.en: But Blue Origin did not abandon rocket landings. Indeed, the company's success with New Shepard led it to build vertical landing into its larger orbital rocket, New Glenn, which made its first successful landing 2025 — nearly 10 years after that first touchdown.
paras.zh: 但蓝色起源并没有放弃火箭着陆。事实上，该公司在 New Shepard 项目上的成功促使其在其更大的轨道火箭 New Glenn 中建立了垂直着陆功能，该火箭于 2025 年首次成功着陆——距首次着陆近 10 年。

paras.en: Blue Origin has since reflown a New Glenn booster, and is developing a new rocket engine called Northstar for even better performance.
paras.zh: 此后，蓝色起源重新改装了新格伦助推器，并正在开发一种名为“北极星”的新型火箭发动机，以实现更好的性能。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: The ten best time travel movies to buy and own on Blu-ray and 4K UHD Blu-ray this Black Friday
articles.author: Chris McMullen

paras.en: Love time travel movies? You're not alone and, as a sci-fi staple, cinema has no shortage of timey-wimey greats. It's Black Friday week and many of these titles are now deeply discounted. So, I picked out the ten time travel movies you need to own, from classic blockbusters like Back to the Future, through to modern gems such as Needle in a Timestack, where the only obstacle to time travel is your bank balance.
paras.zh: 喜欢时空旅行电影吗？你并不孤单，作为科幻题材的电影，电影中不乏及时雨的伟人。今天是黑色星期五周，许多此类图书现在都大幅打折。因此，我挑选了您需要拥有的十部时间旅行电影，从《回到未来》等经典大片，到《时间堆栈中的针》等现代瑰宝，其中时间旅行的唯一障碍是您的银行余额。

paras.en: We do mean own, too. All too often, we've sat down to rewatch a film to find it's vanished from our streaming service. At best, it's rematerialized on a different streaming service; at worst, it's been exterminated as some media conglomerate's tax write-off. Even 'buying' a movie, you're just getting a license that can be revoked at any time.
paras.zh: 我们也指自己的。我们常常坐下来重新观看一部电影，却发现它从我们的流媒体服务中消失了。最好的情况是，它会在不同的流媒体服务上重新实现；最坏的情况是，它会因为某些媒体集团的税收冲销而被消灭。即使“购买”一部电影，您也只是获得了可以随时撤销的许可证。

paras.en: The solution? By buying these time travel movies on Blu-ray or 4K UHD Blu-ray, they'll still be sitting on your shelf ready to watch and rewatch for years, even decades, from now.
paras.zh: 解决方案是什么？通过购买这些蓝光或 4K 超高清蓝光时光旅行电影，它们仍然可以放在您的书架上，可供反复观看数年甚至数十年。

articles.title: Moog Marks 25 Years Since ESPA Design Milestone: Innovating Space Rideshare
articles.author: Moog Inc.

paras.en: East Aurora, N.Y. — Moog Inc. (NYSE: MOG.A and MOG.B) marks 25 years since the Evolved Secondary Payload Adapter (ESPA) ring completed its Critical Design Review in 2001. The pioneering technology helped advance space rideshare by enabling multiple payloads to share a launch and broadening access to orbit for commercial, government, and defense missions.
paras.zh: 纽约州东奥罗拉 — 穆格公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：MOG.A 和 MOG.B）庆祝演进型辅助有效载荷适配器 (ESPA) 环于 2001 年完成关键设计审查以来 25 周年。这项开创性技术通过支持多个有效载荷共享发射并拓宽商业、政府和国防任务的轨道通道，帮助推进了太空共享出行。

paras.en: Development of ESPA began in 1999 through a collaborative government-industry initiative, culminating in the successful completion of its Critical Design Review on January 18, 2001. The ESPA ring enabled launch vehicles to carry multiple secondary payloads by efficiently using previously unused volume beneath primary satellites. This approach lowered costs and increased mission flexibility, supporting commercial satellite constellations, technology demonstrations, and critical defense operations.
paras.zh: ESPA 的开发始于 1999 年，通过政府与行业的合作倡议，最终于 2001 年 1 月 18 日成功完成了关键设计审查。ESPA 环使运载火箭能够通过有效利用主卫星下方以前未使用的空间来携带多个辅助有效载荷。这种方法降低了成本并提高了任务灵活性，支持商业卫星星座、技术演示和关键防御行动。

paras.en: “ESPA helped redefine access to space by enabling additional payloads to share a launch with primary missions. Its impact continues across commercial, government, and military space—and its story reflects the value of enduring collaboration between Air Force Research Lab (AFRL) and industry partners such as Moog,” said Dr. Darren Raspa, chief historian, AFRL Space and Directed Energy Systems.
paras.zh: AFRL 空间和定向能源系统首席历史学家达伦·拉斯帕 (Darren Raspa) 博士表示：“ESPA 通过启用额外的有效载荷与主要任务共享发射，帮助重新定义了太空访问。它的影响持续遍及商业、政府和军事太空，它的故事反映了空军研究实验室 (AFRL) 与穆格等行业合作伙伴之间持久合作的价值。”

paras.en: Over the past 25 years, the ESPA family has evolved into a versatile, modular platform supporting varied payload sizes and interface configurations. ESPA-derived designs have also served as the structural foundation for spacecraft buses. Today, the platform continues to support mission planning for NASA, the U.S. government, and commercial space ventures worldwide.
paras.zh: 在过去的 25 年里，ESPA 系列已发展成为一个多功能的模块化平台，支持各种有效负载大小和接口配置。 ESPA 衍生设计也成为航天器总线的结构基础。如今，该平台继续支持 NASA、美国政府和全球商业航天企业的任务规划。

paras.en: Moog continues to offer a family of ESPA configurations, including Standard ESPA, ESPA Heavy, and ESPA Grande, designed to accommodate evolving payload and mission requirements. The platform’s modular architecture and adaptable interfaces support rideshare missions, payload integration, and spacecraft applications across the growing space market.
paras.zh: 穆格继续提供一系列 ESPA 配置，包括标准 ESPA、ESPA Heavy 和 ESPA Grande，旨在适应不断变化的有效载荷和任务要求。该平台的模块化架构和适应性强的接口支持不断增长的太空市场中的乘车共享任务、有效载荷集成和航天器应用。

paras.en: “The ESPA ring began as a technical solution to a practical challenge: maximizing every launch opportunity,” said Timothy Pargett, general manager, Moog Payload Adapters and Isolation business. “Today, it stands as a cornerstone of how missions, large and small, gain cost-effective, reliable access to orbit through rideshare. Its enduring legacy reflects visionary innovation and trusted partnerships across the aerospace community.”
paras.zh: “ESPA 环最初是作为应对实际挑战的技术解决方案：最大化每个发射机会，”穆格有效负载适配器和隔离业务总经理 Timothy Pargett 说道。 “如今，它已成为大大小小的任务如何通过拼车获得具有成本效益且可靠的轨道访问的基石。它的持久遗产反映了整个航空航天界的富有远见的创新和值得信赖的合作伙伴关系。”

paras.en: In conjunction with the anniversary, a Moog flight-qualified ESPA ring will be on display at the National Museum of Nuclear Science & History in Albuquerque, N.M., from November 7, 2026, through January 10, 2027.
paras.zh: 为庆祝周年纪念日，一枚符合穆格飞行资格的 ESPA 环将于 2026 年 11 月 7 日至 2027 年 1 月 10 日在新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的国家核科学与历史博物馆展出。

paras.en: Museum visitors will have the opportunity to see firsthand the hardware that helped advance rideshare and enable diverse space missions.
paras.zh: 博物馆参观者将有机会亲眼目睹有助于推进乘车共享和实现多样化太空任务的硬件。

paras.en: As ESPA enters its next chapter, Moog continues to advance spacecraft payload integration and develop adaptable solutions that expand flexible, cost-effective access to orbit for future space exploration and defense missions.
paras.zh: 随着 ESPA 进入新篇章，穆格将继续推进航天器有效载荷集成，并开发适应性强的解决方案，为未来的太空探索和防御任务扩展灵活、经济高效的轨道接入方式。

paras.en: Moog is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and systems integrator of high-performance precision motion and fluid controls and control systems. Moog’s high-performance systems control military and commercial aircraft, satellites, and space vehicles, launch vehicles, defense systems, missiles, automated industrial machinery, marine, and medical equipment. Additional information about the Company can be found at www.moog.com or www.moog.com/space.
paras.zh: 穆格是全球高性能精密运动和流体控制及控制系统的设计者、制造商和系统集成商。穆格的高性能系统控制军用和商用飞机、卫星和航天器、运载火箭、防御系统、导弹、自动化工业机械、船舶和医疗设备。有关公司的更多信息，请访问 www.moog.com 或 www.moog.com/space。

articles.title: What role does industry play in Europe’s space sovereignty push?
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Jason Rainbow interviews Atle Woello, the CEO and senior vice president of the space systems and surveillance business unit at Kongsberg NanoAvionics. They discuss the role space plays for defense systems that are increasingly interconnected across domains, as well as the role that the European industrial base can play in the continent’s recent political and fundraising push to bolster sovereignty, independence and resilience in space.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Jason Rainbow 采访了 Kongsberg NanoAvionics 空间系统和监视业务部门的首席执行官兼高级副总裁 Atle Woello。他们讨论了太空对于跨领域互联日益紧密的防御系统的作用，以及欧洲工业基础在欧洲大陆最近为加强太空主权、独立和复原力而进行的政治和筹款活动中可以发挥的作用。

paras.en: This episode is sponsored by Xiphos Systems.
paras.zh: 本集由 Xiphos Systems 赞助。

paras.en: Xiphos Systems develops compact, high-performance embedded computing solutions for spacecraft and aerospace applications. Founded in 1996 and based in Montreal, the company specializes in commercial off-the-shelf processing platforms designed for space, combining processors, programmable logic, storage, networking, and RF capabilities in low size, weight, power, and cost designs. Its portfolio includes processor boards, onboard computers, RF payload systems, and AI-capable computing platforms for satellites, launch vehicles, lunar missions, and robotics. With more than two decades of experience and over 1,000 processor cards delivered, Xiphos supports customers from system integration through deployment, helping bring reliable computing closer to the mission.
paras.zh: Xiphos Systems 为航天器和航空航天应用开发紧凑、高性能的嵌入式计算解决方案。该公司成立于 1996 年，总部位于蒙特利尔，专注于为太空设计的商用现成处理平台，将处理器、可编程逻辑、存储、网络和射频功能与低尺寸、重量、功耗和成本设计相结合。其产品组合包括处理器板、机载计算机、射频有效载荷系统以及用于卫星、运载火箭、月球任务和机器人的人工智能计算平台。 Xiphos 拥有二十多年的经验和交付的 1,000 多个处理器卡，为客户提供从系统集成到部署的支持，帮助实现可靠的计算更接近使命。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
paras.zh: 每周四在 SpaceNews.com 以及我们的 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple 频道上观看新剧集。

articles.title: Commercial Space Federation Welcomes CesiumAstro as a New Associate Member
articles.author: Commercial Space Federation

paras.en: November 13, 2026— Washington, D.C.—The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome CesiumAstro as its newest Associate Member. A global leader in advanced connectivity solutions for the space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. CesiumAstro’s addition further strengthens CSF’s diverse membership and the Federation’s work to advance a competitive, innovative, and sustainable U.S. commercial space economy.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日——华盛顿特区——商业航天联合会 (CSF) 很高兴欢迎 CesiumAstro 成为其最新准会员。 CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。 CesiumAstro 的加入进一步加强了 CSF 的多元化成员资格以及联合会推动竞争性、创新性和可持续的美国商业太空经济的工作。

paras.en: CesiumAstro is a lobal leader in advanced connectivity solutions for space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. Its full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads and advanced computing systems. CesiumAstro maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards. Headquartered near Austin, Texas, the company operates additional facilities in Colorado, California, Washington, D.C., Florida, the United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Taiwan, and Japan.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，CesiumAstro 提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。其全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。 CesiumAstro 保持与内部设计、制造和测试能力的完全垂直整合，并通过了 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证。该公司总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀附近，在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、华盛顿特区、佛罗里达州、英国、德国、新加坡、台湾和日本设有其他工厂。

paras.en: CesiumAstro recently announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation. The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 最近宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元，并推出了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划中的 737 颗卫星、支持人工智能的星座。新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has expanded its capabilities through three strategic acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr, strengthening the company’s capabilities across semiconductor technology, mission software, and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项战略收购扩大了其能力：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr，增强了公司在半导体技术、任务软件和人工智能方面的能力。

paras.en: CesiumAstro’s full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads, and advanced compute systems. The company maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 的全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。该公司与通过 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证的内部设计、制造和测试能力保持完整的垂直整合。

paras.en: “A thriving commercial economy in low Earth orbit needs reliable communications and a clear path from development to operations. CesiumAstro is joining CSF’s Commercial LEO Council to bring our communications expertise to that effort. We look forward to advancing policies that encourage investment, expand government use of commercial services, and support companies building the next generation of space infrastructure.”
paras.zh: “近地轨道上蓬勃发展的商业经济需要可靠的通信以及从开发到运营的清晰路径。CesiumAstro 正在加入 CSF 的商业 LEO 委员会，将我们的通信专业知识用于这一努力。我们期待推进鼓励投资、扩大政府对商业服务的使用以及支持企业建设下一代空间基础设施的政策。”

paras.en: – Josh Ingersoll, Director of Spectrum and Regulatory Affairs at CesiumAstro
paras.zh: – Josh Ingersoll，CesiumAstro 频谱和监管事务总监

paras.en: Founded in 2006, the Commercial Space Federation (CSF) and its members are laying the foundation for democratizing access to outer space for scientists, students, civilians, and businesses. All while working towards the goal of expanding the U.S. Commercial Space Economy. Through the promotion of technological innovation, CSF and its diverse membership are guiding the bolstering of U.S. leadership in aerospace and inspiring America’s next generation of engineers and explorers. CSF also serves as the commercial space industry’s primary advocate with the U.S. Congress and the Administration, helping inform the development and implementation of policy priorities. By engaging with congressional players, CSF is able to provide recommendations on commercial space issues that will impact the commercial space industry in the short and long term.
paras.zh: 商业太空联盟 (CSF) 及其成员成立于 2006 年，正在为科学家、学生、平民和企业进入外太空的民主化奠定基础。同时努力实现扩大美国商业太空经济的目标。通过促进技术创新，CSF 及其多元化成员正在指导巩固美国在航空航天领域的领导地位，并激励美国下一代工程师和探险家。 CSF 还担任美国国会和政府商业航天业的主要倡导者，帮助为政策优先事项的制定和实施提供信息。通过与国会参与者合作，CSF 能够就商业航天问题提供建议，这些问题将在短期和长期影响商业航天行业。

articles.title: NASA’s Webb Shows How Supernova Dust Chronicles Star Evolution

paras.en: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope has painted a vibrant tapestry of the legendary supernova remnant Cassiopeia A (Cas A). Remnants like these are the clouds of gas and dust that remain following the explosion of a massive star and will eventually seed a new generation of stars and planets.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜为传奇超新星遗迹仙后座 A (Cas A) 绘制了一幅充满活力的挂毯。像这样的残余物是大质量恒星爆炸后留下的气体和尘埃云，最终将孕育新一代的恒星和行星。

paras.en: This high-resolution, mid-infrared observation from Webb reveals new details that are helping astronomers chronicle the structure and evolution of Cas A’s original star. The Webb data supports a scenario in which the interior of the star underwent a dramatic change, possibly just hours before its demise. These results published Monday in The Astrophysical Journal Letters.
paras.zh: 韦伯的这一高分辨率中红外观测揭示了新的细节，有助于天文学家记录 Cas A 原始恒星的结构和演化。韦伯数据支持这样一种情况：恒星的内部发生了巨大的变化，可能就在它消亡前的几个小时。这些结果周一发表在《天体物理学杂志快报》上。

paras.en: Image: Dust In Cassiopeia A (MIRI Image)
paras.zh: 图片：仙后座 A 中的尘埃（MIRI 图片）

paras.en: Stars begin their lives as large clouds of mostly hydrogen gas and cosmic dust called molecular clouds. Eventually, gravity causes these molecular clouds to collapse, the material heats up, and protostars — infant stars — form. Under the constant pressure of gravity, hydrogen within a protostar begins to fuse into helium, which marks the point where protostars evolve into full-fledged stars like our Sun.
paras.zh: 恒星的生命始于大片云，主要由氢气和宇宙尘埃组成，称为分子云。最终，重力导致这些分子云塌陷，物质升温，并形成原恒星（婴儿恒星）。在恒定的重力压力下，原恒星内的氢开始融合成氦，这标志着原恒星演变成像太阳一样成熟的恒星。

paras.en: As hydrogen in the core runs out, the core contracts and heats until helium begins to fuse into heavier elements. This process repeats as stars like Cas A’s original star evolve, with increasingly heavier elements fusing in the core (eventually stopping at iron) and lighter elements fusing in surrounding layers. This leads to multiple shells of elements that provide a record of a star’s evolutionary history. When a star goes supernova, these elements are scattered into the surrounding space, where some of them condense to form dust grains, which can clump together. By studying and mapping the composition of these individual, solar-system-sized dust clumps in Cas A, Webb found evidence of a shell merger, a process in which the layers inside a star mix before the explosion.
paras.zh: 当核心中的氢耗尽时，核心会收缩并加热，直到氦开始融合成更重的元素。随着像 Cas A 的原始恒星这样的恒星演化，这个过程不断重复，越来越重的元素在核心融合（最终停在铁），而较轻的元素在周围层融合。这导致了多个元素壳的形成，这些元素提供了恒星演化历史的记录。当一颗恒星变成超新星时，这些元素会分散到周围的空间中，其中一些元素会凝结成尘埃颗粒，这些尘埃颗粒会聚集在一起。通过研究和绘制 Cas A 中这些单独的、太阳系大小的尘埃团的成分，韦伯发现了壳层合并的证据，这是恒星内部各层在爆炸前混合的过程。

paras.en: “Material within these shells churns and circulates, which can cause the shells to merge shortly before the supernova explosion,” said Tea Temim, lead author of the study and research scientist from Columbia University in New York. “So, for example, the oxygen- and carbon-burning shells in a star merge together and change the structure of the star significantly. And that would then change the chemical abundances that you would see after a supernova explosion in the ejecta of a supernova remnant.”
paras.zh: 该研究的主要作者、纽约哥伦比亚大学的研究科学家 Tea Temim 表示：“这些壳内的物质会搅拌和循环，这可能会导致这些壳在超新星爆炸前不久合并。” “因此，举例来说，恒星中的氧燃烧层和碳燃烧层合并在一起，显着改变了恒星的结构。这将改变超新星爆炸后超新星遗迹喷射物中的化学丰度。”

paras.en: Image: Dust In Cassiopeia A, North Up (MIRI)
paras.zh: 图片：仙后座 A 中的尘埃，北上 (MIRI)

paras.en: For the researchers to know where to look with Webb, they also leveraged data from NASA’s retired Spitzer Space Telescope. Although it couldn’t resolve the minute details of the region during its observation, Spitzer identified three specific regions to observe with Webb’s keen eye.
paras.zh: 为了让研究人员知道如何利用韦伯进行观察，他们还利用了美国宇航局退役的斯皮策太空望远镜的数据。尽管斯皮策在观测过程中无法解析该区域的微小细节，但它还是通过韦伯敏锐的眼睛确定了三个需要观察的特定区域。

paras.en: Two of the targets were inside Cas A’s reverse-shocked region, where an inward-moving shock wave collides with debris thrown outward by the supernova. Webb observed that the ejecta in one of the two contained mostly silica dust, while the other was dominated by carbon dust. The third target was the “Green Monster,” a structure first discovered by Webb, which was found to be rich in complex magnesium silicates. Unlike the other two regions, the Green Monster originated from material the star shed before it exploded, rather than from the supernova’s ejecta.
paras.zh: 其中两个目标位于 Cas A 的反向激波区域内，向内移动的激波与超新星向外抛出的碎片发生碰撞。韦伯观察到，其中一个的喷射物主要含有硅尘，而另一个则主要含有碳尘。第三个目标是“绿色怪物”，这是韦伯首先发现的结构，被发现富含复杂的硅酸镁。与其他两个区域不同，绿色怪物起源于恒星​​爆炸前脱落的物质，而不是超新星的喷射物。

paras.en: Image: Dust in Cassiopeia A (Spitzer and Webb)
paras.zh: 图片：仙后座 A 中的尘埃（斯皮策和韦伯）

paras.en: Building on the X-ray observations of NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory and the JAXA-led XRISM, Webb mapped the dust composition of Cas A across the entire remnant, providing crucial insight into the shell merger phenomenon. Together, these observations indicate that the merger was underway very shortly before the supernova explosion.
paras.zh: 基于 NASA 钱德拉 X 射线天文台和 JAXA 领导的 XRISM 的 X 射线观测，韦伯绘制了整个残骸中 Cas A 的尘埃成分图，为壳层合并现象提供了重要的见解。总之，这些观察表明合并是在超新星爆炸前不久进行的。

paras.en: “With Webb, the vast improvement in being able to resolve at the individual clump level helps us do more sophisticated dust chemistry,” said Dan Milisavljevic, associate professor and co-author of the study from Purdue University in West Lafayette, Indiana. “As a result, we can tie the explosion back to the makeup of the progenitor star hundreds of years afterward. It’s telling us about what was happening, we think, in the hours leading up to core collapse. Understanding this process is essential to explaining which elements the supernova explosion will release into the galaxy and how those elements enrich future generations of stars and planets.”
paras.zh: 印第安纳州西拉斐特市普渡大学的副教授兼该研究的合著者 Dan Milisavljevic 表示：“有了韦伯，在单个团簇水平上解析能力的巨大进步有助于我们进行更复杂的尘埃化学研究。” “因此，我们可以将爆炸与数百年后的祖星的构成联系起来。我们认为，它告诉我们在核心塌陷前的几个小时内发生了什么。了解这个过程对于解释超新星爆炸将释放哪些元素到银河系以及这些元素如何丰富未来几代恒星和行星至关重要。”

paras.en: The dust map from Webb also reveals that the merger signatures are present throughout much of the supernova remnant. These efforts provide a new method for other astronomers who want to infer characteristics about an originating star’s structure by using the dust of a supernova remnant.
paras.zh: 韦伯的尘埃图还显示，合并特征存在于超新星遗迹的大部分区域。这些努力为其他想要利用超新星遗迹的尘埃推断起源恒星结构特征的天文学家提供了一种新方法。

paras.en: The James Webb Space Telescope is the largest and most powerful observatory ever sent to space, serving thousands of astronomers worldwide. Webb is solving mysteries in our solar system, looking beyond to distant worlds around other stars, and probing the mysterious structures and origins of our universe and our place in it. Webb is an international program led by NASA with its partners, ESA (European Space Agency) and CSA (Canadian Space Agency).
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜是有史以来发送到太空的最大、最强大的天文台，为全球数千名天文学家提供服务。韦伯正在解开太阳系中的谜团，展望其他恒星周围的遥远世界，并探索宇宙的神秘结构和起源以及我们在其中的位置。韦伯是由 NASA 及其合作伙伴 ESA（欧洲航天局）和 CSA（加拿大航天局）领导的一项国际计划。

paras.en: The following sections contain links to download this article's images and videos in all available resolutions followed by related information links, media contacts, and if available, research paper and Spanish translation links.
paras.zh: 以下部分包含以所有可用分辨率下载本文图像和视频的链接，后面是相关信息链接、媒体联系人以及研究论文和西班牙语翻译链接（如果有）。

articles.title: Eruption Extends Iwo Jima’s Beach

paras.en: A volcanic eruption in the shallows near Iwo Jima has extended the Japanese island’s famed black sand beaches, at least temporarily.
paras.zh: 硫磺岛附近浅滩的火山喷发至少暂时扩大了日本岛屿著名的黑沙滩。

paras.en: Signs of unrest began in late October 2026. On October 27, seismic sensors recorded a sharp uptick in activity, and Japan’s Meteorological Agency reported that the first photographs of the eruption were captured. Soon after, sensors on several satellites began to capture an array of observations.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月下旬开始出现骚乱迹象。10 月 27 日，地震传感器记录到火山活动急剧增加，日本气象厅报告称，拍摄到了第一批火山喷发照片。不久之后，几颗卫星上的传感器开始捕获一系列观测结果。

paras.en: The OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 9 captured the left image on October 26, when the coast was still quiet. On November 11, Landsat 9 got its first clear view of the land the submarine volcano has built (right). A shortwave-infrared signature, a sign of the eruption’s heat, is shown in orange. A faint gray volcanic plume drifts southeast of the vent, and a streak of floating pumice stretches across the water in the same direction.
paras.zh: Landsat 9 上的 OLI（操作陆地成像仪）于 10 月 26 日拍摄到了左侧图像，当时海岸还很安静。 11 月 11 日，Landsat 9 首次清晰地看到了海底火山所形成的陆地（右）。短波红外特征（喷发热量的标志）以橙色显示。淡淡的灰色火山羽流向喷口东南方向飘去，一条漂浮的浮石向同一方向延伸穿过水面。

paras.en: A false-color backscatter radar image from the NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) satellite offered an even earlier look at the eruption. On October 28, despite heavy cloud cover, the radar detected a large disturbance in the water in the same area that erupted in December 2023. When the clouds cleared in early November, the MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) and VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite) sensors on NASA and NOAA satellites also captured signs of the ongoing eruption’s volcanic plumes and infrared signature.
paras.zh: 来自 NISAR（NASA-ISRO 合成孔径雷达）卫星的假彩色反向散射雷达图像提供了更早的火山喷发情况。 10 月 28 日，尽管云层厚重，雷达还是检测到 2023 年 12 月喷发的同一地区的海水出现了大规模扰动。当 11 月初云层散去时，NASA 和 NOAA 卫星上的 MODIS（中分辨率成像光谱仪）和 VIIRS（可见红外成像辐射仪套件）传感器也捕获了正在进行的火山喷发的火山羽流和红外特征的迹象。

paras.en: Japan’s Coast Guard released a report on November 16 confirming the formation of new land connected to the pre-existing beach. The eruption appears to have added roughly 50 hectares (125 acres) of new beach, about the area of 90 American football fields. That would enlarge the island by about 1.7 percent. The new land adjoins the southeast beach where American troops landed on February 19, 1945, beginning one of the bloodiest battles in the history of the U.S. Marines.
paras.zh: 日本海上保安厅11月16日发布报告，确认已形成与现有海滩相连的新陆地。这次火山喷发似乎增加了大约 50 公顷（125 英亩）的新海​​滩，大约相当于 90 个美式足球场的面积。这将使岛屿面积扩大约 1.7%。这片新土地毗邻东南海滩，美国军队于 1945 年 2 月 19 日在此登陆，开始了美国海军陆战队历史上最血腥的战斗之一。

paras.en: The location of the eruption is no surprise to scientists. In addition to the 2023 eruption off the southeast coast, Iwo Jima had an eruption off its west coast in August 2025, said Daniel Slayback, a scientist at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center.
paras.zh: 火山喷发的地点对科学家来说并不奇怪。美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的科学家丹尼尔·斯莱贝克 (Daniel Slayback) 表示，除了 2023 年在东南海岸发生的火山喷发外，硫磺岛还在 2025 年 8 月在其西海岸发生了火山喷发。

paras.en: How long the new land will persist remains an open question. New land created by the 2023 eruption succumbed to wave action after just a few weeks, Slayback said. New land on volcanic islands has persisted more than a decade only a handful of times in recent times, including at Capelinhos, Surtsey, McDonald Island, and Home Reef, he added. “I imagine we’ll see this new land wash away within a few months,” he said. “But we’ll have to wait and see.”
paras.zh: 新土地能持续多久仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。 Slayback 表示，2023 年火山喷发形成的新土地在几周后就屈服于波浪作用。他补充说，火山岛上的新陆地持续了十多年，最近只有几次出现，包括卡佩利纽斯岛、瑟特西岛、麦克唐纳岛和Home Reef。 “我想我们会在几个月内看到这片新土地被冲走，”他说。 “但我们必须拭目以待。”

paras.en: Among the scientists watching closely is James Garvin, the chief scientist at Goddard and a geologist with a long-standing interest in how underwater volcanic eruptions create new islands and other landforms.
paras.zh: 密切关注的科学家之一是詹姆斯·加文（James Garvin），他是戈达德的首席科学家，也是一位地质学家，长期以来对水下火山喷发如何形成新的岛屿和其他地貌感兴趣。

paras.en: Typically, tephra-dominated eruptions like this form new land that is quickly “attacked” by ocean waves and other hydrologic forces, Garvin explained. An exception is when the eruption also injects certain types of lava that “cement” the ash into stronger material. “If we do see injection of basaltic-andesitic lava within the new materials, then it’s possible the new land could follow a pattern different from what we monitored in 2023,” he said.
paras.zh: 加文解释说，通常情况下，像这样以火山灰为主的喷发会形成新的陆地，并很快受到海浪和其他水文力量的“攻击”。一个例外是，喷发还注入某些类型的熔岩，将火山灰“粘合”成更坚固的材料。他说：“如果我们确实看到新材料中注入了玄武岩-安山岩熔岩，那么新土地可能会遵循与我们 2023 年监测到的不同的模式。”

paras.en: NISAR will be especially valuable for tracking the site, Garvin said, because it makes frequent, high-resolution interferometric observations through clouds and can show whether the new land erodes, subsides, or grows. The satellite has already recorded major changes at the eruption site between October 28 and November 11.
paras.zh: 加文说，NISAR 对于跟踪该地点特别有价值，因为它可以通过云层进行频繁的高分辨率干涉观测，并可以显示新土地是否受到侵蚀、下沉或增长。该卫星已经记录了10月28日至11月11日期间火山喷发地点的重大变化。

paras.en: NASA scientists will also analyze sub-meter-resolution imagery from commercial satellites through NASA’s Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition Program. These images can reveal subtle deformation features like rilles, fractures, and cracks that offer clues about the stability of the new land.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局科学家还将通过美国宇航局商业卫星数据采集计划分析来自商业卫星的亚米分辨率图像。这些图像可以揭示细微的变形特征，如细沟、裂缝和裂缝，为新土地的稳定性提供线索。

paras.en: Both Slayback and Garvin have studied new volcanic land before. They were part of a team that monitored new land in the Kingdom of Tonga after an eruption in the Southwest Pacific but before most of it was obliterated during the highly explosive Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha‘apai caldera collapse and eruption in January 2022.
paras.zh: Slayback 和 Garvin 之前都研究过新的火山地。他们所在的团队在西南太平洋喷发后监测汤加王国的新土地，但在 2022 年 1 月高爆炸性的洪加汤加-洪加哈派火山口崩塌和喷发期间，大部分土地被摧毁之前。

articles.title: Guterres laments COP31 outcome, urges climate justice from Barbados

paras.en: Guterres laments COP31 outcome, urges climate justice from Barbados
paras.zh: 古特雷斯对第三十一届缔约方会议的结果表示遗憾，敦促巴巴多斯实现气候正义

paras.en: Secretary-General António Guterres on Sunday expressed deep disappointment over the collapse of COP31 climate negotiations, using a visit to Barbados to call for stronger action on fossil fuels, climate finance and support for vulnerable nations.
paras.zh: 秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯周日对 COP31 气候谈判的失败表示深感失望，并利用对巴巴多斯的访问呼吁在化石燃料、气候融资和对脆弱国家的支持方面采取更强有力的行动。

paras.en: Speaking alongside Prime Minister Mia Mottley in Bridgetown ahead of a UN-backed summit on artificial intelligence (AI) safety, the UN chief said governments had failed to match the urgency of the climate crisis after the conference in Antalya, Türkiye, ended without an overarching agreement.
paras.zh: 在联合国支持的人工智能安全峰会之前，这位联合国秘书长在布里奇敦与总理米娅·莫特利一起发表讲话，她表示，土耳其安塔利亚会议结束后，各国政府未能应对气候危机的紧迫性，但没有达成总体协议。

paras.en: “At a moment when the climate crisis is accelerating, governments failed to rise to the level of ambition this crisis demands,” he said.
paras.zh: “在气候危机加剧之际，各国政府未能达到这场危机所要求的雄心水平，”他说。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres noted that Barbados and other small island developing States are among those paying the highest price for global warming despite contributing little to the problem.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生指出，巴巴多斯和其他小岛屿发展中国家是为全球变暖付出最高代价的国家之一，尽管其对这一问题的影响微乎其微。

paras.en: “Countries like Barbados are on the frontlines of the climate crisis,” he said, pointing to stronger storms, rising seas and mounting economic costs.
paras.zh: “像巴巴多斯这样的国家正处于气候危机的前线，”他说，并指出更强的风暴、海平面上升和不断上升的经济成本。

paras.en: Fossil fuels remain at the heart of the crisis
paras.zh: 化石燃料仍然是危机的核心

paras.en: The Secretary-General warned that the world is on course to exceed the internationally agreed 1.5°C warming limit and reiterated his call for an accelerated transition away from coal, oil and gas.
paras.zh: 秘书长警告说，世界将超过国际商定的 1.5°C 升温极限，并重申他呼吁加快摆脱煤炭、石油和天然气的过渡。

paras.en: “The continued addiction to coal, oil and gas is fueling climate chaos,” he said. “We can’t put out the fire while pouring fuel on it.”
paras.zh: “对煤炭、石油和天然气的持续依赖正在加剧气候混乱，”他说。 “我们无法一边往火上浇油一边将火扑灭。”

paras.en: He argued that renewable energy offers countries a pathway to greater energy security, lower costs and more resilient economies, while urging major emitters to lead efforts to cut emissions and developed nations to honour climate finance commitments.
paras.zh: 他认为，可再生能源为各国提供了一条提高能源安全、降低成本和增强经济弹性的途径，同时敦促主要排放国带头努力减排，并敦促发达国家履行气候融资承诺。

paras.en: “Countries that did least to cause this crisis cannot be left to face its worst consequences alone,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“不能让那些对引发这场危机影响最小的国家独自面对最严重的后果。”

paras.en: Turning to his host country, Mr. Guterres praised Barbados for helping shape international debates on issues ranging from climate action to global financial reform.
paras.zh: 谈到东道国，古特雷斯先生赞扬巴巴多斯帮助塑造了从气候行动到全球金融改革等问题的国际辩论。

paras.en: “On issue after issue, Barbados is punching above its weight,” he said, describing the country as “a champion of multilateralism and a source of solutions.”
paras.zh: 他说：“在一个又一个的问题上，巴巴多斯的表现超出了自己的承受范围。”他将该国描述为“多边主义的捍卫者和解决方案的来源”。

paras.en: He singled out Prime Minister Mottley’s advocacy for a fairer international financial system, including through the Bridgetown Initiative, which calls for reforms to make financing more accessible and affordable for developing countries.
paras.zh: 他特别提到莫特利总理倡导建立更公平的国际金融体系，包括通过布里奇敦倡议，该倡议呼吁进行改革，使发展中国家更容易获得和负担得起融资。

paras.en: The Secretary-General also welcomed a new five-year UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework for the Caribbean and the signing of a new long-term lease for UN House in Barbados.
paras.zh: 秘书长还对新的五年期联合国加勒比可持续发展合作框架以及巴巴多斯联合国之家签署新的长期租约表示欢迎。

paras.en: “The United Nations is here for the long haul,” he said.
paras.zh: “联合国将长期存在，”他说。

paras.en: Haiti needs security and a political path
paras.zh: 海地需要安全和政治道路

paras.en: Addressing the crisis in Haiti, Mr. Guterres said the international community must strengthen support for the country as it confronts escalating violence and weakened state institutions.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯在谈到海地危机时表示，国际社会必须加强对该国的支持，因为该国正面临暴力升级和国家机构削弱的问题。

paras.en: He called for the full deployment of international security assistance and continued backing for Haitian security institutions, while stressing that security measures alone will not be enough.
paras.zh: 他呼吁全面部署国际安全援助并继续支持海地安全机构，同时强调仅采取安全措施是不够的。

paras.en: “Haiti needs a Haitian-owned political process that restores democratic institutions through elections, rebuilds the authority of the state, and offers young people hope beyond the grip of the gangs,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“海地需要一个海地人主导的政治进程，通过选举恢复民主制度，重建国家权威，并为年轻人提供摆脱帮派控制的希望。”

paras.en: The Secretary-General is in Barbados to attend Monday’s Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety, co-hosted by the UN and the Government of Barbados.
paras.zh: 秘书长正在巴巴多斯出席周一由联合国和巴巴多斯政府共同主办的布里奇敦人工智能安全特别峰会。

paras.en: The gathering will bring together government leaders, technology companies, scientists, civil society representatives and international organizations to discuss how the benefits of AI can be shared more widely while addressing growing risks associated with the rapidly evolving technology.
paras.zh: 这次聚会将汇集政府领导人、科技公司、科学家、民间社会代表和国际组织，讨论如何更广泛地分享人工智能的好处，同时应对与快速发展的技术相关的日益增长的风险。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres said Barbados is once again helping to drive an important global conversation, this time on ensuring that AI serves people everywhere.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生表示，巴巴多斯再次帮助推动重要的全球对话，这次是为了确保人工智能为世界各地的人们服务。

paras.en: “The world needs that leadership and moral voice now more than ever,” he said.
paras.zh: “世界现在比以往任何时候都更需要这种领导力和道德声音，”他说。

paras.en: Find out more about COP31 on our new podcast, Talk & Action, and our special coverage of the conference.
paras.zh: 通过我们的新播客“Talk & Action”以及我们对会议的特别报道，了解有关 COP31 的更多信息。

articles.title: Libya: UN mission urges probe into Benghazi port attacks

paras.en: Libya: UN mission urges probe into Benghazi port attacks
paras.zh: 利比亚：联合国代表团敦促调查班加西港口袭击事件

paras.en: A Russian warship docked at the port was hit in suspected sea drone strikes causing it to explode and sink, while a commercial vessel was struck in a separate attack, according to reports, which note that Ukraine has claimed responsibility.
paras.zh: 据报道，一艘停靠在该港口的俄罗斯军舰疑似遭到海上无人机袭击，导致其爆炸并沉没，而一艘商船则在另一次袭击中被击中，乌克兰已声称对此负责。

paras.en: UNSMIL issued a statement expressing serious concern, stressing that Libya’s sovereignty, territorial integrity and the security of its citizens and assets must be fully respected.
paras.zh: 联利支助团发表声明表示严重关切，强调利比亚的主权、领土完整及其公民和资产的安全必须得到充分尊重。

paras.en: The North African country has been in political crisis since the fall of the Muammar Gaddafi regime in 2011; it remains divided between the internationally-recognised Government of National Unity in the capital, Tripoli, and a rival administration based in Benghazi that is backed by the House of Representatives and military general Khalifa Haftar’s Libyan National Army.
paras.zh: 自2011年穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲政权垮台以来，这个北非国家一直处于政治危机之中。首都的黎波里的国际承认的民族团结政府和总部位于班加西的敌对政府之间仍然存在分歧，后者得到众议院和军事将军哈利法·哈夫塔尔领导的利比亚国民军的支持。

paras.en: The UN mission warned against escalatory actions or rhetoric that could fuel tensions within Libya or draw the country into wider regional or international confrontations.
paras.zh: 联合国代表团警告不要采取升级行动或言论，否则可能会加剧利比亚境内的紧张局势，或使该国陷入更广泛的地区或国际对抗。

paras.en: “Libya cannot afford, and must not become, a battleground for foreign conflicts,” it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“利比亚承受不起、也决不能成为外国冲突的战场。”

paras.en: “These incidents also underscore the urgent need to expedite efforts to reunify Libya’s national institutions and strengthen their ability to safeguard the country’s national sovereignty and security.”
paras.zh: “这些事件还凸显了迫切需要加快统一利比亚国家机构并加强其维护国家主权和安全的能力。”

paras.en: UNSMIL called for an immediate, independent and transparent investigation into the attacks to establish the facts and hold those responsible to account, noting that the UN stands ready to assist the Libyan authorities in the investigation.
paras.zh: 联利支助团呼吁立即对袭击事件进行独立和透明的调查，以查明事实并追究责任人的责任，并指出联合国随时准备协助利比亚当局进行调查。

paras.en: “The mission urges all parties to exercise maximum restraint and refrain from putting unverified information in the public domain or politicizing the incident while the investigation is underway,” it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“调查团敦促各方保持最大限度的克制，不要在调查过程中将未经证实的信息公之于众，也不要将事件政治化。”

paras.en: In the meantime, UNSMIL said that it will continue to closely monitor developments. It called on all sides to act responsibly to preserve Libya’s stability and build on efforts towards a durable settlement of the crisis in the country.
paras.zh: 与此同时，联利支助团表示将继续密切关注事态发展。它呼吁各方采取负责任的行动，维护利比亚的稳定，并为持久解决该国危机作出努力。

articles.title: Heavy fighting in Ituri traps DR Congo Ebola responders: WHO

paras.en: Heavy fighting in Ituri traps DR Congo Ebola responders: WHO
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织：伊图里的激烈战斗使刚果民主共和国埃博拉应对人员陷入困境

paras.en: Heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has disrupted the vital work of Ebola responders and forced emergency teams to take cover for more than 24 hours.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 伊图里省一家医院附近的激烈战斗扰乱了埃博拉应对人员的重要工作，迫使应急小组躲藏超过 24 小时。

paras.en: In a post on X on Sunday, World Health Organization (WHO) Director-General, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, said that agency staff and Ebola responders had been forced to shelter “for their lives” in a maternity ward of the hospital.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织 (WHO) 总干事谭德塞在周日的 X 帖子中表示，该机构工作人员和埃博拉应对人员被迫在医院的产科病房“避难”。

paras.en: The WHO chief added that the agency was working with partners to evacuate trapped staff safely, before calling for their “immediate safe passage and for the hospital facilities, staff and patients to be protected”.
paras.zh: 世卫组织负责人补充说，该机构正在与合作伙伴合作，安全疏散被困人员，然后呼吁他们“立即安全通行，并保护医院设施、工作人员和患者”。

paras.en: Since 1 January, WHO has verified more than 87 attacks on healthcare in DRC.
paras.zh: 自 1 月 1 日以来，世卫组织已核实刚果民主共和国发生超过 87 起医疗保健袭击事件。

paras.en: The development follows a warning earlier this month by the UN’s Senior Ebola Response Coordinator, Julien Harneis, that more people have been killed by the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) fighters than by the Ebola vitus in recent days. “The violence in tens of villages all across the south of Ituri and North Kivu (provinces) goes unnoticed”, Mr. Harneis insisted. “People are scared; people are furious at the lack of action on this.”
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，联合国高级埃博拉应对协调员朱利安·哈尼斯 (Julien Harneis) 发出警告，称最近几天被民主同盟军 (ADF) 战士杀害的人数比被埃博拉病毒杀害的人数还要多。哈内斯先生坚称，“伊图里南部和北基伍（省）数十个村庄发生的暴力事件并未引起人们的注意”。 “人们感到害怕；人们对对此缺乏行动感到愤怒。”

paras.en: Repeated ADF attacks and human rights abuses against civilians have been happening for more than two decades in eastern DRC. “Following up contact tracing in areas where ADF is operating is a very hazardous idea,” Mr. Harneis told journalists in Geneva on 13 November.
paras.zh: 二十多年来，刚果民主共和国东部不断发生民主同盟军袭击和侵犯平民人权的事件。 “在 ADF 开展活动的地区进行接触者追踪是一个非常危险的想法，”哈内斯先生 11 月 13 日在日内瓦告诉记者。

paras.en: Ituri province remains the epicentre of the outbreak of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus and accounts for more than two-thirds of confirmed cases.
paras.zh: 伊图里省仍然是本迪布焦病毒引起的埃博拉疫情的震中，占确诊病例的三分之二以上。

paras.en: A total of eight provinces have been impacted and the latest incident near the hospital in Ituri happened in an area close to where the Ebola outbreak was first detected.
paras.zh: 共有八个省受到影响，伊图里医院附近的最新事件发生在靠近首次发现埃博拉疫情的地区。

paras.en: WHO has warned repeatedly that rising insecurity in eastern DRC is one of the main obstacles to containing the virus, with attacks on civilians and health workers hampering response efforts.
paras.zh: 世卫组织一再警告说，刚果民主共和国东部日益严重的不安全局势是遏制该病毒的主要障碍之一，对平民和卫生工作者的袭击阻碍了应对工作。

paras.en: More than six months after it was first declared, the Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC continues to spread. A high proportion of deaths continue to occur in communities and outside dedicated treatment centres, especially among young children, highlighting challenges in early case detection and access to care.
paras.zh: 自首次宣布以来的六个多月后，刚果民主共和国东部的埃博拉疫情仍在继续蔓延。很大比例的死亡继续发生在社区和专门治疗中心之外，特别是幼儿，凸显了早期病例发现和获得护理方面的挑战。

paras.en: According to figures released on 20 November, the outbreak has resulted in 11,762 confirmed cases, including 5,775 deaths, across 68 health zones in eight provinces.
paras.zh: 根据11月20日发布的数据，疫情已导致八个省份68个卫生区确诊病例11,762例，其中死亡5,775例。

paras.en: Ituri remains the hardest-hit province, with a cumulative total of more than 8,000 confirmed cases and 3,791 deaths, representing a case fatality rate of 47 per cent. The province accounts for more than two-thirds of all confirmed cases and nearly 60 per cent of newly reported infections.
paras.zh: 伊图里仍然是疫情最严重的省份，累计确诊病例超过8000例，死亡3791例，病死率为47%。该省占所有确诊病例的三分之二以上，占新报告感染病例的近60%。

paras.en: Of the 39 new confirmed cases reported in the latest epidemiological update, 23 were recorded in Ituri.
paras.zh: 在最新流行病学报告中报告的 39 例新增确诊病例中，伊图里有 23 例。

articles.title: Wolves are clicking, Stoke are dreaming - but could QPR be dark horses?

paras.en: Wolves hit their stride, Stoke continue to dream but can they last the course and are QPR dark horses of Championship?
paras.zh: 狼队大步向前，斯托克城继续梦想，但他们能否坚持到底，成为 QPR 冠军黑马？

paras.en: Wolves are improving defensively, Stoke look strong and QPR look resolute; Andy Hinchcliffe picks out the key stories in The Championship catch-up; a Sky Sports column focusing on the second tier.
paras.zh: 狼队的防守正在进步，斯托克城看起来很强大，女王公园巡游者看起来很坚决；安迪·欣奇克利夫 (Andy Hinchcliffe) 挑选了锦标赛追赶赛中的关键故事；天空体育专栏专注于第二梯队。

paras.en: Welcome to The Championship Catch-up, a new Sky Sports column in which Andy Hinchcliffe rounds up some of the key stories from the second tier. This week:
paras.zh: 欢迎来到《冠军追赶》，这是天空体育的一个新专栏，安迪·欣奇克利夫在其中总结了第二梯队的一些关键故事。本星期：

paras.en: - Wolves are coming together under Peixoto
paras.zh: - 狼队在佩索托的带领下齐聚一堂

paras.en: - Stoke look like they can last the course
paras.zh: - 斯托克城看起来他们可以坚持到底

paras.en: - QPR's defensive improvements prove key
paras.zh: - QPR 的防守改进是关键

paras.en: Wolves have added solidity at the back to attacking prowess
paras.zh: 狼队加强了后防线的实力，增强了进攻能力

paras.en: With the players Wolves have got and the way they play, they were always going to score goals. They've averaged around 1.7 goals per game across those periods, so they're still good for a goal under Cesar Peixoto.
paras.zh: 凭借狼队现有的球员和他们的比赛方式，他们总是能进球。在此期间，他们场均进球约 1.7 个，因此在塞萨尔·佩肖托 (Cesar Peixoto) 的带领下，他们仍然有能力进球。

paras.en: But in the last seven games they've conceded only five, compared to the 14 goals they shipped in their first nine. They're not playing defensively, they're just defending well. They're keeping the ball and keeping teams away from their penalty area.
paras.zh: 但在过去 7 场比赛中，他们只丢了 5 个球，而前 9 场比赛则丢了 14 个球。他们不是在防守，他们只是防守得很好。他们控球并让球队远离他们的禁区。

paras.en: At the start of the season they were too open. They were great to watch and scoring goals, but conceding too many. They needed to find a balance. They didn't have to become ultra-defensive, but they did need some defensive strength.
paras.zh: 赛季初他们太开放了。他们的表现很棒，进球也很多，但失球太多。他们需要找到平衡点。他们不必变得超级防守，但他们确实需要一些防守实力。

paras.en: - Transfer Centre LIVE! | Latest EFL news and rumours
paras.zh: - 换乘中心上线！ |最新的 EFL 新闻和谣言

paras.en: - Championship table | Championship fixtures & results
paras.zh: - 冠军表|锦标赛赛程及结果

paras.en: They've got plenty of attacking threats. Raul Jimenez is still missing, but Adam Armstrong is doing really well and is a proven goalscorer at this level. They've got width, dynamism and options, while Andre plays a really important role sitting deep in midfield.
paras.zh: 他们有很多进攻威胁。劳尔·希门尼斯仍然缺阵，但亚当·阿姆斯特朗表现非常好，并且是这个级别的公认射手。他们拥有宽度、活力和选择，而安德烈在中场深处扮演着非常重要的角色。

paras.en: All I was looking for was more balanced performances. They didn't need to let the goals dry up just to keep clean sheets. They've managed to find that balance and do both. They're dominating games, keeping teams out and still scoring goals.
paras.zh: 我所寻找的只是更平衡的表演。他们不需要为了保持不失球而让进球枯竭。他们成功地找到了这种平衡并做到了两者兼而有之。他们统治着比赛，将球队拒之门外，并且仍然进球。

paras.en: Even when they change the right-back, centre-half or left-back, they can maintain that defensive strength. They're clearly moving in the right direction and are now a much more balanced, complete team.
paras.zh: 即使他们更换了右后卫、中后卫或左后卫，他们也能保持这样的防守强度。他们显然正在朝着正确的方向前进，现在是一支更加平衡、更加完整的团队。

paras.en: Kieran Trippier's experience has been invaluable. He cares about the club getting promoted back to the Premier League. Individually, he wants to do well, but he also wants the team to succeed.
paras.zh: 基兰·特里皮尔的经验非常宝贵。他关心俱乐部能否重返英超。就个人而言，他希望表现出色，但他也希望团队取得成功。

paras.en: He's perhaps not the player he was five years ago, but he can still have a huge effect. He'll have to get used to the fact that he might not play every game, but Wolves have the depth to manage that.
paras.zh: 他也许不再是五年前的球员了，但他仍然可以产生巨大的影响。他必须适应这样一个事实：他可能不会参加每场比赛，但狼队有足够的深度来应对这一点。

paras.en: With Trippier, it's not just about his ability but also his leadership and experience. He can reinforce the standards they should be setting and what they're looking to achieve this season.
paras.zh: 对于特里皮尔来说，这不仅取决于他的能力，还取决于他的领导力和经验。他可以强化他们应该设定的标准以及他们本赛季希望实现的目标。

paras.en: Can Stoke City last the course under Mark Robins?
paras.zh: 斯托克城能否在马克·罗宾斯的带领下坚持到底？

paras.en: Stoke City have won 10 of 16 games, more than any other Championship team. Would you have expected them to have won more games than Wolves, West Ham, Middlesbrough or Southampton after 16 matches? Probably not.
paras.zh: 斯托克城在 16 场比赛中赢了 10 场，比任何其他英冠球队都多。 16 场比赛之后，你是否预计他们会比狼队、西汉姆联、米德尔斯堡或南安普顿赢得更多比赛？可能不会。

paras.en: They're still overachieving in terms of the data, but Mark Robins spoke during the international break about the need to improve their performances. The league position doesn't really tell you how good you are. You have to monitor performances and look at how to develop and improve.
paras.zh: 他们在数据上仍然表现出色，但马克·罗宾斯在国际比赛日期间谈到了提高表现的必要性。联赛排名并不能真正告诉你你有多优秀。你必须监控表现并研究如何发展和改进。

paras.en: There's still work to do at both ends of the pitch, but they're getting goals from different players. George Hirst came in for big money and had been struggling for goals and not starting games. He won them the game against Birmingham, which is a lift for him and the team.
paras.zh: 攻防两端仍有工作要做，但他们的进球来自不同的球员。乔治·赫斯特 (George Hirst) 身价不菲，但一直在为进球而苦苦挣扎，但没有首发。他赢得了对阵伯明翰的比赛，这对他和球队来说都是一个提升。

paras.en: Against Birmingham, they were down to 10 men for a long time and showed the resilience to hold on to a 1-0 lead. When you look at everything, the foundations are there for them to get better.
paras.zh: 对阵伯明翰队，他们在长期10人的情况下，表现出了韧性，保持了1-0的领先优势。当你审视一切时，就会发现他们变得更好的基础就在那里。

paras.en: How many experienced, very good coaches have gone to Stoke and not been able to make it work? We all hoped Mark Robins would succeed because of the work he did at Coventry, but there was always the question of whether he would become another coach who fell foul of a club where nobody seemed able to get things going.
paras.zh: 有多少经验丰富、非常优秀的教练去了斯托克城却没能发挥作用？我们都希望马克·罗宾斯能够因为他在考文垂所做的工作而取得成功，但始终存在这样的问题：他是否会成为另一位与俱乐部发生冲突的教练，因为俱乐部似乎没有人能够让事情进展顺利。

paras.en: I just think it's wonderful that it's him because he's such a brilliant coach. He's very understated and humble. I saw him after a game recently and asked him a couple of tactical questions. He was saying he was glad I'd noticed certain things he'd done. He's very engaging, but it's not all about him. It's about the job he's there to do.
paras.zh: 我只是觉得他真是太棒了，因为他是一位非常出色的教练。他非常低调和谦虚。我最近在一场比赛后见到了他，问了他一些战术问题。他说他很高兴我注意到他所做的某些事情。他非常有魅力，但这并不是他的全部。这是关于他在那里要做的工作。

paras.en: Player for player, this Stoke side is better than last season's team. That's what I'm saying about their recruitment and the shape Mark is playing. They're better, and the fact they can improve further makes things look really positive.
paras.zh: 就球员而言，这支斯托克城队比上赛季的球队要好。这就是我所说的关于他们的招募和马克的表现。他们变得更好了，事实上他们可以进一步提高，这让事情看起来非常积极。

paras.en: But we're only 16 games into a long season. Mark will know winter is really tough for every team, particularly when you're up near the top and everyone is looking to knock you off your position. They'll be looking at their performances and adjusting their training because that's all you can do.
paras.zh: 但我们距离漫长的赛季只有 16 场比赛了。马克会知道冬天对每支球队来说都非常艰难，尤其是当你接近顶级并且每个人都想把你从位置上击败时。他们会关注自己的表现并调整训练，因为这就是你能做的。

paras.en: Could Stoke possibly be in the mix for a top-two finish? With the way they're playing and the players they've got, who could improve further, very possibly.
paras.zh: 斯托克城有可能跻身前两名吗？就他们的比赛方式和现有球员而言，他们很有可能进一步提高。

paras.en: QPR have shown defensive improvements this season
paras.zh: QPR本赛季的防守有所进步

paras.en: Defensively for QPR there's been the big shift this season. They were 23rd last season for goals conceded and are now in the top four. That's the foundation. If you don't concede too many goals in the Championship, you've got a chance.
paras.zh: QPR 的防守本赛季发生了巨大转变。上赛季他们的失球数排名第23位，现在已跻身前四。这就是基础。如果你在锦标赛中失球不多，你就有机会。

paras.en: I don't think they're a defensive team. They're a team that defend well. It doesn't mean they're sitting everybody behind the ball and playing on the counter-attack. They can dominate possession and force opponents backwards. They defend well, but they're not defensive.
paras.zh: 我不认为他们是一支防守型球队。他们是一支防守出色的球队。这并不意味着他们让每个人都坐在球后面并进行反击。他们可以控制控球权并迫使对手后退。他们防守很好，但防守不严。

paras.en: Jimmy Dunne, Ronnie Edwards and Pierce Charles are absolutely crucial, but the team structure is there too. They've got a solid base and the nice problem now is working out how to be more creative.
paras.zh: 吉米·邓恩、罗尼·爱德华兹和皮尔斯·查尔斯绝对至关重要，但球队结构也在那里。他们已经有了坚实的基础，现在的好问题是如何变得更有创造力。

paras.en: It was important to win at Millwall and maintain their momentum in the top eight, but they won't always find themselves in such a dominant position. There's still work to do going forward to become more threatening and dangerous.
paras.zh: 在米尔沃尔获胜并保持前八的势头很重要，但他们并不总是发现自己处于如此主导地位。要想变得更具威胁性和危险性，还有很多工作要做。

paras.en: They need to find a regular goalscorer, but they also need to create more chances. Getting Ilias Chair back into the team regularly is important. He's one of those players who can affect games in the Championship.
paras.zh: 他们需要找到一名常规射手，但他们也需要创造更多机会。让伊利亚斯主席定期重返团队非常重要。他是能够影响英冠比赛的球员之一。

paras.en: This has to be a big season for Chair. He undoubtedly has the ability, but at times he's coasted along and hasn't become the dominant force Rangers need him to be.
paras.zh: 对于主席来说，这一定是一个重要的赛季。毫无疑问，他有能力，但有时他会表现得平淡无奇，并没有成为流浪者队需要他成为的主导力量。

paras.en: If they want to improve going forward and finish in the top eight, he's key. He's got the movement, intelligence and creative quality, and he can score goals. It's not just about what he can do himself, but what he can do for the players around him.
paras.zh: 如果他们想要进步并进入前八，他是关键。他有运动能力、智慧和创造力，而且他能进球。这不仅仅是他自己能做什么，而是他能为周围的球员做些什么。

paras.en: Looking at his performance against Millwall and what he could bring for the rest of the season, I think he's key to improving their attack. It's down to him to drive that improvement.
paras.zh: 看看他对阵米尔沃尔的表现以及他在本赛季剩余时间里能带来的东西，我认为他是提高球队进攻的关键。推动这一进步有赖于他。

articles.title: Smith: I want to play on the PGA Tour

paras.en: Cameron Smith plots pathway back to the PGA Tour after moving on from LIV Golf
paras.zh: 卡梅伦·史密斯 (Cameron Smith) 计划在离开 LIV Golf 后重返 PGA 巡回赛

paras.en: Cameron Smith joined LIV Golf in 2022 after clinching his first major at The Open at St Andrews; the Australian will play select events on the DP World Tour in 2027; watch Smith in action at this week's BMW Australian PGA Championship live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 卡梅伦·史密斯 (Cameron Smith) 在圣安德鲁斯公开赛上赢得个人首个大满贯赛冠军后，于 2022 年加入 LIV Golf；澳大利亚人将参加 2027 年 DP 世界巡回赛的部分赛事；天空体育直播观看史密斯在本周 BMW 澳大利亚 PGA 锦标赛上的表现

paras.en: Cameron Smith has moved on from LIV Golf, is preparing for his invitation-only appearances on the DP World Tour and is already thinking about a return to the PGA Tour.
paras.zh: 卡梅伦·史密斯 (Cameron Smith) 已经离开 LIV Golf，正在为受邀参加 DP 世界巡回赛做准备，并且已经在考虑重返 PGA 巡回赛。

paras.en: As the 2022 Open champion prepared for the BMW Australian PGA Championship starting Thursday at The Lakes in Sydney, attention inevitably turned to his career goals and his steps toward a possible return to the PGA Tour.
paras.zh: 当这位 2022 年公开赛冠军为周四在悉尼湖区开始的 BMW 澳大利亚 PGA 锦标赛做准备时，人们的注意力不可避免地转向了他的职业目标以及他为重返 PGA 巡回赛而采取的步骤。

paras.en: "I guess that's the path. That's where I want to be now for sure," Smith told the Australian Associated Press.
paras.zh: “我想这就是道路。这就是我现在想要的地方，”史密斯告诉澳大利亚美联社。

paras.en: "DP's given us a chance to kind of fulfil that. We'll see how that goes. There's plenty of good players out there and plenty of other guys that want to do the same thing, so it's going to be difficult.
paras.zh: “DP给了我们一个实现这一目标的机会。我们会看看事情进展如何。那里有很多优秀的球员，也有很多其他人想做同样的事情，所以这会很困难。”

paras.en: "But for sure that's where I want to play."
paras.zh: “但可以肯定的是，这就是我想踢球的地方。”

paras.en: Smith will not return as a full-time member on the DP World Tour, but is one of a number of former LIV players, including Dustin Johnson and Bubba Watson, to sign an agreement with the tour to receive invites to a specific number of tournaments during the 2027 season, excluding Rolex Series events.
paras.zh: 史密斯不会以全职会员的身份回归 DP 世界巡回赛，但他是包括达斯汀·约翰逊和布巴·沃森在内的众多前 LIV 球员之一，他们与巡回赛签署了一份协议，在 2027 赛季期间接受特定数量的比赛邀请，不包括劳力士系列赛事。

paras.en: He receives an exemption to play this week, having won the BMW Australian PGA Championship three times in 2017, 2018 and 2022.
paras.zh: 他在 2017 年、2018 年和 2022 年三次赢得 BMW 澳大利亚 PGA 锦标赛，本周获得了参赛资格。

paras.en: Under the DP World Tour and PGA Tour's current agreement, the top 10 players on the Race to Dubai Rankings qualify for the PGA Tour.
paras.zh: 根据DP世界巡回赛和PGA巡回赛目前的协议，迪拜赛排名前10名的选手有资格参加PGA巡回赛。

paras.en: The number of PGA Tour cards available to players finishing at the top of the Race to Dubai Rankings for the 2028 season is yet to be determined, with the PGA Tour set to launch its new two-tier championship structure the year after next.
paras.zh: 2028 赛季迪拜赛排名榜首的球员可获得的美巡赛卡数量尚未确定，美巡赛将在后年推出新的两级锦标赛结构。

paras.en: However, to even have a chance at winning one of those coveted cards, Smith will need to play more tournaments on the DP World Tour's 2027 schedule.
paras.zh: 然而，为了有机会赢得其中一张令人垂涎的卡，史密斯将需要在 DP 世界巡回赛 2027 年赛程中参加更多比赛。

paras.en: He could do that by winning the co-sanctioned BMW Australian PGA Championship or the Australian Open at Kingston Heath, which begins on December 3 and also features Rory McIlroy.
paras.zh: 他可以通过赢得宝马澳大利亚 PGA 锦标赛或金斯顿希思澳大利亚公开赛的共同认可来实现这一目标，比赛将于 12 月 3 日开始，罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 也将参加比赛。

paras.en: "I think given what they've told me, I pretty much need to win this year to get membership," Smith said.
paras.zh: “我认为，考虑到他们告诉我的情况，我今年非常需要获胜才能获得会员资格，”史密斯说。

paras.en: "It's all still very blurry to me at the moment. There are a lot of rules, but we'll have a few opportunities, and like I said, I've always managed to play pretty good down here, so why not start it off with a good one?"
paras.zh: “目前对我来说一切都还很模糊。有很多规则，但我们会有一些机会，就像我说的，我一直在这里打得很好，所以为什么不从一个好的开始呢？”

paras.en: The PGA Tour board last week said it had "thoughtful discussions" about the future of players at LIV Golf but otherwise seemed to be in no hurry to decide if there is room for them next season.
paras.zh: 美巡赛董事会上周表示，他们对 LIV Golf 球员的未来进行了“深思熟虑的讨论”，但似乎并不急于决定下赛季是否有他们的空间。

paras.en: CEO Brian Rolapp said the Returning Member Program, which allowed Brooks Koepka to return to the PGA Tour at the beginning of 2026 with financial penalties, was not on the table.
paras.zh: 首席执行官布莱恩·罗拉普 (Brian Rolapp) 表示，回归会员计划并未列入考虑范围，该计划允许布鲁克斯·科普卡 (Brooks Koepka) 在 2026 年初重返美巡赛，但会受到经济处罚。

paras.en: Smith didn't take up that one-time offer in January, which applied only to players who'd won majors or The Players Championship from 2022 through 2025, which included himself, Koepka, Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau.
paras.zh: 史密斯在一月份没有接受这一一次性报价，该报价仅适用于在 2022 年至 2025 年赢得大满贯或球员锦标赛冠军的球员，其中包括他自己、科普卡、乔恩·拉姆和布莱森·德尚博。

paras.en: Smith is in a kind of limbo. LIV Golf, which lost the financial support of Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) and filed for bankruptcy on September 8, told a bankruptcy court earlier this month it had abandoned plans for a new version of the league and had begun winding down its business.
paras.zh: 史密斯正处于一种进退两难的境地。 LIV Golf 失去了沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金 (PIF) 的财务支持，并于 9 月 8 日申请破产。本月早些时候，LIV Golf 向破产法庭表示，它已经放弃了新版联赛的计划，并开始逐步结束其业务。

paras.en: "There was a lot of uncertainty and then in a way it was good to just like get the noise over and done with," Smith, who joined LIV after winning The Open at St Andrews in 2022, said.
paras.zh: 史密斯在 2022 年赢得圣安德鲁斯公开赛后加入了 LIV，他表示：“存在很多不确定性，从某种程度上来说，把噪音平息下来是件好事。”

paras.en: "It was a big move to go LIV at the start for sure, and I think everyone that was close to me and all my friends saw why I was doing it and why I made the decision."
paras.zh: “一开始选择 LIV 肯定是一个重大举措，我想所有与我关系密切的人和我所有的朋友都明白我为什么要这样做以及我为什么做出这个决定。”

paras.en: Adam Scott said he had no doubts about Smith fitting back in.
paras.zh: 亚当·斯科特表示，他对史密斯重新融入球队毫不怀疑。

paras.en: "Cam's incredibly talented and he'll adjust to his new environment," Scott said. "He'll be just fine."
paras.zh: “卡姆非常有才华，他会适应新环境，”斯科特说。 “他会没事的。”

paras.zh: 如何观看BMW澳大利亚PGA锦标赛？
