articles.title: Deadly Russian strikes hit 3 Kyiv bridges after Putin vows revenge for Crimea attacks
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: KYIV, Ukraine — Three bridges in Kyiv were hit Friday in a massive Russian ballistic missile attack, officials in the Ukrainian capital said, hours after President Vladimir Putin vowed “painful” revenge for strikes on his prized bridge linking Crimea to Russia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰基辅——周五，乌克兰首都基辅的三座桥梁在一次大规模的俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击中被击中，几小时前，总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)发誓要对连接克里米亚和俄罗斯的珍贵桥梁遭受的袭击进行“痛苦”的报复。

paras.en: The attacks, which started in the early hours of the morning and continued well into the day, damaged the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi, Darnytskyi and Southern bridges connecting the left and right banks of the Dnipro River, which flows through the city, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said in a post on Telegram.
paras.zh: 基辅市长维塔利·克里钦科在 Telegram 上发帖称，袭击从凌晨开始，一直持续到当天，损坏了连接流经该市的第聂伯河左岸和右岸的 Podilsko-Voskresenskyi、Darnytskyi 和南部桥梁。

paras.en: At least six people were killed and 15 injured in those strikes, Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said in a separate post. Two others were killed in separate attacks across the country, which saw nine regions hit overnight, he said.
paras.zh: 总理谢尔希·科列茨基在另一篇帖子中表示，这些袭击造成至少 6 人死亡、15 人受伤。他说，全国各地的袭击事件造成另外两人死亡，一夜之间袭击了九个地区。

paras.en: The strikes on Kyiv forced authorities to restrict traffic on the bridges, impacting the movement across the capital. Klitschko asked residents not to drive private cars into the city “unless absolutely necessary” and suggested employers let staff work remotely.
paras.zh: 对基辅的袭击迫使当局限制桥梁上的交通，影响了首都的交通。克里琴科要求居民“除非绝对必要”，不要驾驶私家车进入城市，并建议雇主让员工远程工作。

paras.en: Russia has been hitting Kyiv’s Southern and Northern bridges since early October, causing multiple closures, disrupting metro services and causing traffic jams.
paras.zh: 自十月初以来，俄罗斯一直在袭击基辅的南部和北部桥梁，导致多处桥梁关闭、地铁服务中断并造成交通拥堵。

paras.en: But it is the first time that Russia hit three different bridges in a single night, and it has left most of the main road crossings over the Dnipro simultaneously damaged or restricted.
paras.zh: 但这是俄罗斯第一次在一个晚上撞上三座不同的桥梁，并且导致第聂伯河上的大部分主要公路交叉口同时受损或受到限制。

paras.en: An NBC News team in Kyiv heard air raid sirens going off every few minutes overnight, accompanied by loud explosions.
paras.zh: 基辅的 NBC 新闻团队夜间每隔几分钟就听到空袭警报，并伴随着巨大的爆炸声。

paras.en: After dawn broke on the rainy and foggy Friday morning, firefighters were seen putting out the flames from a strike on an industrial area in the capital.
paras.zh: 周五早上，多雨多雾的黎明破晓后，人们看到消防队员正在扑灭首都一个工业区的大火。

paras.en: It’s part of the daily reality for Kyiv’s residents after Russia escalated both the number of ballistic missiles it was firing at the capital and the frequency of attacks.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯增加了向首都发射的弹道导弹数量和袭击频率后，这已成为基辅居民日常生活的一部分。

paras.en: The latest strikes came hours after Putin said that Moscow would retaliate after Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge linking Russia and Crimea for a third time this week.
paras.zh: 就在最近的袭击发生几个小时前，普京表示，乌克兰本周第三次袭击连接俄罗斯和克里米亚的刻赤大桥，莫斯科将进行报复。

paras.en: Speaking in the Chinese city of Shenzhen after his much-touted trilateral meeting with President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, Putin said Moscow would hit back hard for the attacks on his flagship project. The Kerch Bridge was meant to solidify Russian dominance over Crimea, the peninsula he illegally annexed in 2014.
paras.zh: 普京在亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会上与唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平举行备受瞩目的三方会晤后，在中国深圳发表讲话称，莫斯科将对其旗舰项目的攻击进行严厉回击。刻赤大桥旨在巩固俄罗斯对克里米亚的统治地位，克里米亚是俄罗斯于 2014 年非法吞并的半岛。

paras.en: “We will respond to these strikes. I want everyone to know that,” Putin told reporters, adding that Russia’s response will be “far more painful” than what Kyiv did to the Kerch Bridge, which cost billions of dollars to build.
paras.zh: 普京对记者说：“我们将对这些袭击做出回应。我希望每个人都知道这一点。”他补充说，俄罗斯的反应将比基辅对刻赤大桥所做的“痛苦得多”，该大桥耗资数十亿美元建造。

paras.en: Putin personally opened the road and rail bridge, which is the longest in Europe, in 2018. Beyond its symbolic value, the bridge has served as a vital supply route for the Russian military and civilians in Crimea.
paras.zh: 普京于2018年亲自开通了这座欧洲最长的公路和铁路大桥。除了其象征意义之外，这座大桥还是克里米亚俄罗斯军队和平民的重要补给路线。

paras.en: Putin insisted Thursday that the bridge was “an exclusively civilian facility,” but Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called it “the main military crossing from Russian territory into our Ukrainian Crimea.”
paras.zh: 普京周四坚称这座桥是“完全民用设施”，但乌克兰总统泽连斯基称其为“从俄罗斯领土进入乌克兰克里米亚的主要军事过境点”。

paras.en: On Friday, Ukraine’s Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said that Russia’s attempts to justify its attacks as “responses” to any of his country’s own attacks should be unacceptable.
paras.zh: 周五，乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈 (Andrii Sybiha) 表示，俄罗斯试图将其袭击辩解为对乌克兰自身袭击的“回应”，这是不可接受的。

paras.en: “Putting Russia and Ukraine on an equal footing is fundamentally wrong,” he said, adding: “This week, Putin posed for photographs with world leaders. But the photograph he deserves is one of him in the dock, where he stands trial for crimes against Ukrainians and Ukraine.”
paras.zh: “将俄罗斯和乌克兰置于平等地位从根本上来说是错误的，”他说，并补充说：“本周，普京与世界领导人合影留念。但他应得的照片是他在被告席上的一张照片，他因针对乌克兰人和乌克兰的罪行而接受审判。”

paras.en: Acknowledging Friday’s strikes on Kyiv’s bridges, Russia said they were used for military purposes — the line of reasoning Moscow has used in the past to justify bridge attacks in Kyiv.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯承认周五对基辅桥梁的袭击，并表示这些袭击是用于军事目的——这是莫斯科过去用来为基辅桥梁袭击辩护的理由。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Ukraine’s air force said Friday that Russia used ballistic and cruise missiles, as well as more than 400 drones, in the massive attack against 23 locations across the country.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰空军周五表示，俄罗斯在针对该国 23 个地点的大规模袭击中使用了弹道导弹和巡航导弹以及 400 多架无人机。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said 27 of over 110 missiles launched at Ukraine overnight were ballistic. Nearly 80 cruise missiles were shot down, he said. “Ballistic missiles are, unfortunately, much more difficult to deal with, and that depends not on our capabilities but on the supply of missiles by our partners,” he added.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，夜间向乌克兰发射的 110 多枚导弹中，有 27 枚是弹道导弹。他说，近 80 枚巡航导弹被击落。他补充说：“不幸的是，弹道导弹更难对付，这不取决于我们的能力，而取决于我们合作伙伴的导弹供应。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy told NBC News in an interview on Wednesday that Ukraine was experiencing a “deficit” of American-made Patriot interceptor missiles that can stop Russian ballistic strikes, with U.S. deliveries falling this year. This was posing “a huge problem and challenge” for Kyiv, he said.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周三在接受美国全国广播公司新闻采访时表示，乌克兰正在经历美国制造的爱国者拦截导弹的“短缺”，这种导弹可以阻止俄罗斯的弹道袭击，美国今年的交付量有所下降。他说，这给基辅带来了“巨大的问题和挑战”。

paras.en: The country’s energy authorities also said Russian strikes on power plants and substations, which have been ongoing since early fall, left people in Kyiv and 10 other regions without power.
paras.zh: 该国能源当局还表示，俄罗斯自初秋以来一直对发电厂和变电站进行袭击，导致基辅和其他 10 个地区的人们断电。

paras.en: Richard Engel and Michael Fiorentino reported from Kyiv. Yuliya Talmazan reported from London.
paras.zh: 理查德·恩格尔和迈克尔·费奥伦蒂诺从基辅报道。尤利娅·塔尔马赞从伦敦报道。

articles.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to kill Ukrainian American rapper on its soil
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: COPENHAGEN, Denmark — Authorities thwarted the attempted killing of a Ukrainian American citizen on Danish soil in a plot allegedly orchestrated by Russian intelligence services, the Danish prime minister’s office said Friday.
paras.zh: 丹麦哥本哈根——丹麦首相办公室周五表示，当局挫败了在丹麦领土上企图杀害一名乌克兰裔美国公民的事件，这起事件据称是由俄罗斯情报部门策划的。

paras.en: The Russian defense attaché has been expelled from Denmark in response, Danish Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen told a news conference. Two alleged members of the outlawed Danish gang “Loyal to Familia” have been arrested in connection with the attempted killing, police said.
paras.zh: 丹麦外交部长拉斯·洛克·拉斯穆森在新闻发布会上表示，作为回应，俄罗斯国防武官已被驱逐出丹麦。警方称，丹麦非法帮派“忠诚家族”的两名涉嫌成员因涉嫌谋杀未遂而被捕。

paras.en: Danish broadcaster DR, citing a court hearing, reported the men are suspected of having been recruited to assassinate a Ukrainian rapper ahead of a planned performance.
paras.zh: 丹麦广播公司 DR 援引法庭听证会报道称，这些人涉嫌被招募在计划演出前暗杀一名乌克兰说唱歌手。

paras.en: Police thwarted the alleged plot when they arrested the two men shortly before the rapper Kyivstoner’s Sept. 25 concert, which was later canceled.
paras.zh: 警方在说唱歌手 Kyivstoner 9 月 25 日的演唱会前不久逮捕了这两人，挫败了这一阴谋，演唱会后来被取消。

paras.en: It was unclear how police identified the two men, who were stopped in a vehicle carrying several weapons, or how the investigation expanded to include two other men who are not accused of participating in the alleged assassination plot targeting Kyivstoner.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚警方如何识别这两名男子，他们被拦在一辆携带多件武器的车辆中，也不清楚调查范围如何扩大到另外两名未被指控参与针对基辅斯通纳的暗杀阴谋的男子。

paras.en: However, all four men have been held in custody since September, according to the broadcaster.
paras.zh: 然而，据该广播公司报道，自 9 月以来，所有四名男子均已被拘留。

paras.en: It was also unclear how the Russian intelligence services allegedly recruited the two Danish suspects.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚俄罗斯情报部门是如何招募这两名丹麦嫌疑人的。

paras.en: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said: “It is a clear illustration of the grave security situation Denmark and Europe find ourselves in. We are facing a Russia under pressure which is acting more aggressively and is more willing to take risks.”
paras.zh: 丹麦首相梅特·弗雷泽里克森表示：“这清楚地说明了丹麦和欧洲所处的严峻安全局势。我们面临着压力之下的俄罗斯，它的行动更加激进，更愿意承担风险。”

paras.en: The Danes’ announcement came as tensions between Europe and Russia heightened again Friday. Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down in Poland in what its prime minister said was likely a provocation timed to coincide with European military exercises in his country for a possible postwar mission in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 丹麦人宣布这一消息之际，欧洲和俄罗斯之间的紧张局势周五再次加剧。两枚俄罗斯导弹和一架疑似无人机在波兰坠落，波兰总理表示，这可能是一次挑衅，恰逢欧洲在波兰进行军事演习，以执行可能在乌克兰执行的战后任务。

paras.en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said on Saturday the E.U. stands in full solidarity with Denmark.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩周六表示，欧盟完全声援丹麦。

paras.en: “This was an attack on E.U. ‌soil. And it is unacceptable. We stand in full ‌solidarity with Denmark. ‌And with all Member States targeted by Russian hybrid attacks,” she said in an X post.
paras.zh: “这是对欧盟领土的攻击。这是不可接受的。我们完全声援丹麦。以及所有成为俄罗斯混合攻击目标的成员国，”她在 X 帖子中表示。

paras.en: European Council President António Costa said: “We will not be intimidated. Russia’s tactics and threats will not weaken the European Union’s resolve to continue supporting Ukraine.”
paras.zh: 欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔表示：“我们不会被吓倒。俄罗斯的策略和威胁不会削弱欧盟继续支持乌克兰的决心。”

paras.en: The Russian Embassy in Copenhagen said on Friday the accusations were not backed ‌with proof.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯驻哥本哈根大使馆周五表示，这些指控没有证据支持。

articles.title: Former school IT worker charged with grooming, school says
articles.author: Andi Yu

paras.en: Former high school IT support worker charged with grooming, school says
paras.zh: 学校称，前高中 IT 支持人员被控诱骗罪

paras.en: Williamstown High School has sent a letter to parents about former IT technician Mario Stocki, who worked at the school between 2012 and 2024.
paras.zh: 威廉斯敦高中 (Williamstown High School) 致家长一封关于前 IT 技术员 Mario Stocki 的信，他于 2012 年至 2024 年间在该校工作。

paras.en: The letter says Mr Stocki has been charged with grooming, trafficking and supplying a drug of dependence to a child in relation to former students of the school.
paras.zh: 信中称，斯托基先生被指控诱骗、贩运和向该校前学生的一名儿童提供依赖性药物。

paras.en: An education technology company has told the ABC that Mr Stocki worked for them from April to June this year, fixing laptops in schools across Melbourne's west.
paras.zh: 一家教育技术公司告诉澳大利亚广播公司，斯托基先生今年四月至六月为他们工作，在墨尔本西部的学校修理笔记本电脑。

articles.title: WA man guilty of raping, choking and abusing former partner
articles.author: Georgia Loney

paras.en: A West Australian man has been found guilty of raping, choking and abusing his former partner
paras.zh: 一名西澳大利亚男子被判强奸、窒息和虐待前伴侣罪名成立

paras.en: Michael Radomiljac committed the crimes against former partner Kelly North during their five-month relationship spanning late 2024 and early 2025.
paras.zh: 迈克尔·拉多米利亚克 (Michael Radomiljac) 在 2024 年底至 2025 年初的五个月关系中对前伴侣凯利·诺斯 (Kelly North) 犯下了罪行。

paras.en: Radomiljac was convicted after a six-day District Court trial.
paras.zh: 经过六天的地方法院审判后，拉多米利亚克被定罪。

paras.en: A West Australian man has been found guilty of repeatedly raping and choking his former partner over a five-month relationship that turned horrifically violent.
paras.zh: 一名西澳大利亚男子因在长达五个月的恋爱关系中多次强奸并掐死他的前伴侣而被判有罪，最后演变成了可怕的暴力行为。

paras.en: CONTENT WARNING: This story contains details of domestic violence that some readers may find distressing.
paras.zh: 内容警告：这个故事包含一些读者可能会感到痛苦的家庭暴力细节。

paras.en: Michael Robert Reynold Radomiljac, 48, has faced a week-long trial in the Busselton District Court on 11 charges, each relating to the abuse of his former partner Kelly North in late 2024 and early 2025.
paras.zh: 48 岁的迈克尔·罗伯特·雷诺德·拉多米尔雅克 (Michael Robert Reynold Radomiljac) 在巴瑟尔顿地方法院面临为期一周的审判，罪名是 11 项指控，每项指控都与 2024 年底和 2025 年初虐待他的前伴侣凯利·诺斯 (Kelly North) 相关。

paras.en: The charges included seven counts of aggravated sexual penetration without consent.
paras.zh: 这些指控包括七项未经同意的严重性侵罪。

paras.en: After several hours of deliberation today, the jury found Radomiljac guilty of five counts of rape, one count of strangulation and one count of illegally detaining Ms North.
paras.zh: 今天经过几个小时的审议，陪审团裁定拉多米利亚克犯有五项强奸罪、一项勒死罪和一项非法拘留诺斯罪。

paras.en: He was found not guilty of one count of rape, while another was discontinued during the trial.
paras.zh: 他的一项强奸罪被判无罪，而另一项强奸罪在审判期间被终止。

paras.en: Ms North has given permission to the ABC to be identified, after initially speaking out last year when Radomiljac was released on bail without an ankle tracker.
paras.zh: 去年，当拉多米利亚克在没有脚踝追踪器的情况下获得保释时，诺斯女士首次公开表示，她已允许澳大利亚广播公司透露身份。

paras.en: In his closing argument, Prosecutor Samuel Lindsay described Radomiljac as an "ogre," acknowledging the case was mainly Ms North's word against his.
paras.zh: 检察官塞缪尔·林赛在结案陈词中将拉多米雅克描述为“食人魔”，承认此案主要是诺斯女士的言论与他的观点相悖。

paras.en: Ms North had told the court she met the then-46-year-old at a music festival in November 2024 and began an intense relationship soon afterwards.
paras.zh: North 女士告诉法庭，她在 2024 年 11 月的一个音乐节上认识了当时 46 岁的男子，不久之后就开始了密切的关系。

paras.en: "He couldn't have been a nicer person," she said.
paras.zh: “他真是一个好人了，”她说。

paras.en: "He said all the right things: you're beautiful and the best thing that had ever happened to me."
paras.zh: “他说了所有正确的话：你很漂亮，是我经历过的最好的事情。”

paras.en: But she told the court the Radomiljac would become aggressive and paranoid when he took methamphetamine, accusing her of seeing other men, and calling her a "cop-loving dog" in text and in person.
paras.zh: 但她告诉法庭，当拉多米利亚克服用甲基苯丙胺时，他会变得具有攻击性和偏执，指责她与其他男人约会，并在文字和面对面中称她为“爱警察的狗”。

paras.en: The prosecution alleged the 48-year-old forced Ms North into a scalding hot shower, before sexually assaulting her.
paras.zh: 检方称，这名 48 岁的男子强迫诺斯女士洗了热水澡，然后对她进行了性侵犯。

paras.en: He also forced her to shower on two other occasions in similar circumstances.
paras.zh: 他还曾两次在类似情况下强迫她洗澡。

paras.en: On another occasion in December 2024, Radomiljac detained her at his house and in his vehicle for three hours, eventually telling her to "get out of the f***ing car".
paras.zh: 2024 年 12 月的另一次事件中，拉多米利亚克将她在他的家中和车里拘留了三个小时，最终告诉她“滚出这该死的车”。

paras.en: "I thought I was going to die," Ms North told the court.
paras.zh: “我以为我要死了，”诺斯女士告诉法庭。

paras.en: "The next day he had returned my clothes, washed and folded, and was very remorseful."
paras.zh: “第二天，他把我的衣服还给我，洗好了，叠好，非常后悔。”

paras.en: Believing Radomiljac was sorry, and he genuinely wanted to get off drugs, Ms North told the court the pair reconciled.
paras.zh: 诺斯女士在法庭上表示，相信拉多米利亚克很抱歉，而且他真的想戒毒，两人和解了。

paras.en: But in March 2025, he choked her and raped her during what was meant to be a weekend getaway at a Busselton Airbnb, after accusing her of having an affair.
paras.zh: 但在 2025 年 3 月，他在指控她有外遇后，在巴瑟尔顿 Airbnb 的一家周末度假期间掐住了她的脖子并强奸了她。

paras.en: The prosecution said Ms North waited until the next day, when Mr Radomiljac was out buying cigarettes, to leave the property, call police and attend hospital.
paras.zh: 检方称，诺斯女士等到第二天拉多米利亚克先生出去买香烟时才离开住所，报警并前往医院。

paras.en: Friends testified of Ms North's fear of Radomiljac, while medical examination found Ms North had bruises consistent with strangulation, and an uncommonly large amount of genital bruising.
paras.zh: 朋友们证实诺斯女士对拉多米利亚克的恐惧，而体检发现诺斯女士身上有与勒死相符的瘀伤，以及异常大量的生殖器瘀伤。

paras.en: Radomiljac maintained throughout the trial that he never raped, detained, or strangled Ms North, and sexual activity had either been consensual, or had not occurred.
paras.zh: 拉多米利亚克在整个审判过程中坚称，他从未强奸、拘留或勒死诺斯女士，性行为要么是双方同意的，要么根本没有发生。

paras.en: Defence counsel Tony Hager said the medical evidence did not constitute definitive proof of the state's case.
paras.zh: 辩护律师托尼·哈格表示，医学证据并不构成该州案件的决定性证据。

paras.en: The court was shown video of evidence of Radomiljac denying to police he had hurt Ms North, and that she was a "beautiful soul".
paras.zh: 法庭上播放了拉多米利亚克向警方否认他伤害过诺斯女士的证据的视频，并称她是一个“美丽的灵魂”。

paras.en: "What's she's putting on me is crazy," he told police.
paras.zh: “她给我穿的衣服太疯狂了，”他告诉警方。

paras.en: Mr Hager described the relationship as toxic, marred by drug use and Radomiljac's jealousy.
paras.zh: 海格先生形容这种关系是有毒的，因吸毒和拉多米利亚克的嫉妒而受到损害。

paras.en: He said the complainant had also used drugs, but acknowledged Radomiljac had used more.
paras.zh: 他说申诉人也吸毒，但承认拉多米利亚克吸毒的次数更多。

paras.en: "I don't say he was a role model partner," Mr Hager said.
paras.zh: “我并不是说他是一个模范合作伙伴，”海格先生说。

paras.en: "He did a lot wrong, but he is not a rapist, nor is he someone who committed acts of violence."
paras.zh: “他做错了很多事，但他不是强奸犯，也不是实施暴力的人。”

paras.en: Mr Hager said the apologetic texts Mr Radomiljac sent after the couple's arguments were not admissions of guilt, as claimed by the prosecution.
paras.zh: 海格先生表示，拉多米利亚克先生在这对夫妇争吵后发送的道歉短信并不像检方所声称的那样认罪。

paras.en: "This is not an apology for rape, detaining, or assaulting her in the shower," he said.
paras.zh: “这不是对强奸、拘留或在淋浴时袭击她的道歉，”他说。

paras.en: "He's apologising for being a dickhead."
paras.zh: “他为自己是个白痴而道歉。”

paras.en: Radomiljac has been remanded in custody and will be sentenced next month.
paras.zh: 拉多米利亚克已被还押，并将于下个月被判刑。

articles.title: Pope Francis's private diary details encounters with the devil

paras.en: Pope Francis's private diary reveals his anguish over the clergy sexual abuse scandal and what he described as encounters with the devil.
paras.zh: 教皇方济各的私人日记揭示了他对神职人员性虐待丑闻的痛苦以及他所描述的与魔鬼的遭遇。

paras.en: The late pontiff experienced a profound spiritual crisis between 2021 and 2022, linked to his exercise of power.
paras.zh: 已故教宗在 2021 年至 2022 年间经历了一场深刻的精神危机，这与他行使权力有关。

paras.en: The book is being released globally in several languages.
paras.zh: 该书正在以多种语言在全球发行。

paras.en: Pope Francis saw the "gates of hell" when he realised the depths of the clergy sexual abuse scandal and experienced mystical visions of the devil throughout his ministry, according to excerpts of his personal diary published by the Vatican.
paras.zh: 根据梵蒂冈出版的个人日记摘录，教皇方济各在意识到神职人员性虐待丑闻的严重性时看到了“地狱之门”，并在整个任期内经历了魔鬼的神秘幻象。

paras.en: The Private Diary of Pope Francis also reveals the Argentine pope suffered a profound spiritual crisis in 2021-2022, connected to his own temptations to exercise power omnipotently.
paras.zh: 教皇方济各的私人日记还透露，阿根廷教皇在 2021 年至 2022 年遭受了深刻的精神危机，这与他自己行使无所不能的权力的诱惑有关。

paras.en: He overcame the crisis by entrusting himself entirely to God's mercy.
paras.zh: 他将自己完全交托给上帝的怜悯，从而克服了危机。

paras.en: The book, being released globally in several languages, offers a deeply personal view into the mind and heart of Francis, revealing his innermost fears, insecurities, dreams and temptations.
paras.zh: 这本书以多种语言在全球发行，提供了弗朗西斯思想和内心的深刻个人视角，揭示了他内心深处的恐惧、不安全感、梦想和诱惑。

paras.en: It was curated by one of Francis's closest aides, Cardinal Víctor Manuel Fernández, the Argentine theologian who heads the Vatican's doctrine office.
paras.zh: 它是由方济各最亲密的助手之一、梵蒂冈教义办公室负责人、阿根廷神学家红衣主教维克托·曼努埃尔·费尔南德斯策划的。

paras.en: Cardinal Fernández is listed as the author, as his comments contextualise Francis's diary entries.
paras.zh: 红衣主教费尔南德斯被列为作者，因为他的评论与方济各日记的背景相符。

paras.en: Written in a leather-bound calendar used as a notebook, it starts in 1992, when Jorge Mario Bergoglio was auxiliary bishop of Buenos Aires.
paras.zh: 它写在用作笔记本的皮革装订日历上，始于 1992 年，当时豪尔赫·马里奥·贝尔戈里奥 (Jorge Mario Bergoglio) 是布宜诺斯艾利斯的辅助主教。

paras.en: Spiritual torments and encounters with the devil
paras.zh: 精神上的折磨和与魔鬼的遭遇

paras.en: Francis described three seemingly terrifying encounters with the devil — two when he was in Buenos Aires and the third after his disastrous 2018 trip to Chile.
paras.zh: 弗朗西斯描述了三次看似可怕的与魔鬼的遭遇——两次是在布宜诺斯艾利斯，第三次是在 2018 年灾难性的智利之旅之后。

paras.en: "A few days after returning to Rome, I was in a meeting. I saw him and heard his voice, triumphant possessing everything. 'Now I've gotten everything I wanted,'" Francis quoted the devil as saying in a January 24, 2021, entry.
paras.zh: “回到罗马几天后，我正在参加一个会议。我看到了他，听到了他的声音，胜利地拥有了一切。‘现在我已经得到了我想要的一切，’”弗朗西斯在 2021 年 1 月 24 日的条目中引用了魔鬼的话。

paras.en: During the January 2018 Chile trip, Francis created an uproar for discrediting victims of Chile's most notorious abuser.
paras.zh: 在 2018 年 1 月的智利之行中，方济各因诋毁智利最臭名昭著的虐待者的受害者而引起轩然大波。

paras.en: After journalists challenged him during the in-flight news conference returning home, Francis commissioned an investigation and realised the victims were right, and he had been misled by the Chilean hierarchy.
paras.zh: 在回国的机上新闻发布会上，记者们对他提出质疑后，弗朗西斯委托进行了调查，并意识到受害者是对的，他被智利高层误导了。

paras.en: "I became aware of how serious the problem was. … It was hard for me to admit what happened in Chile; I didn't think it was so serious."
paras.zh: “我开始意识到问题有多严重……我很难承认智利发生的事情；我不认为事情有那么严重。”

paras.en: Francis wrote on June 7, 2018, that he "saw the entrance to hell. Pagan seduction in full force" in the Chile scandal.
paras.zh: 弗朗西斯于 2018 年 6 月 7 日写道，他在智利丑闻中“看到了地狱的入口。异教徒的全面诱惑”。

paras.en: As he dealt with the fallout, he wrote: "What shame and evil this has brought on the church!" and "Once more the gates of hell".
paras.zh: 当他处理此事的后果时，他写道：“这给教会带来了多大的耻辱和邪恶！”和“再次地狱之门”。

paras.en: The book dates the onset of the crisis to January 24, 2021.
paras.zh: 该书将危机爆发的日期定为 2021 年 1 月 24 日。

paras.en: Francis was suffering from "insupportable" pain from an intestinal problem that would see him undergo surgery in July to remove 33 centimetres of his colon.
paras.zh: 弗朗西斯因肠道问题而遭受“难以忍受”的疼痛，这使得他在 7 月份接受了手术，切除了 33 厘米的结肠。

paras.en: The Vatican was also in upheaval over a massive financial investigation Francis had authorised, which resulted in several convictions, including that of Cardinal Angelo Becciu.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈也因方济各授权的大规模金融调查而陷入动荡，导致数人被定罪，其中包括红衣主教安杰洛·贝丘 (Angelo Becciu)。

paras.en: Cardinal Fernández reveals Francis's later musings that his spiritual crisis was "mixed with governance issues, pressure regarding decisions to make, and aridity and desolation".
paras.zh: 枢机主教费尔南德斯透露了方济各后来的沉思，他的精神危机“与治理问题、决策压力以及干旱和荒凉混合在一起”。

paras.en: Cardinal Fernández writes that the crisis was primarily related to Francis's exercise of power and the temptation toward omnipotence.
paras.zh: 枢机主教费尔南德斯写道，这场危机主要与方济各行使权力和全能的诱惑有关。

paras.en: Francis had publicly acknowledged in 2013, in his first interview as pope, a tendency to wield power in an "authoritarian" way.
paras.zh: 2013年，弗朗西斯在作为教皇的第一次采访中公开承认，他有以“独裁”方式行使权力的倾向。

paras.en: By December 30, 2022, Francis had apparently overcome the crisis by entrusting himself to God.
paras.zh: 到2022年12月30日，方济各显然已经通过将自己托付给上帝而克服了危机。

paras.en: Most confidential thoughts written in code
paras.zh: 用代码写出最机密的想法

paras.en: Cardinal Fernández says Francis wrote his most confidential thoughts in an indecipherable code, which is not reproduced.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯枢机表示，方济各用难以破译的代码写下了他最机密的想法，该代码不会被复制。

paras.en: He said he omitted entries affecting third parties, although he included Francis's description of then-cardinal Robert Prevost, now Pope Leo XIV, as "a great pastor, a generous missionary and an irreproachable man".
paras.zh: 他说，他省略了影响第三方的条目，尽管他包括了方济各对当时的红衣主教罗伯特·普雷沃斯特（现为教皇利奥十四世）的描述，称其为“一位伟大的牧师、一位慷慨的传教士和一位无可指责的人”。

paras.en: Cardinal Fernández said Francis had shown him the diary during one of their meetings, essentially entrusting the writings to him after his death on April 21, 2025.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯枢机表示，方济各在一次会面中向他展示了这本日记，实质上是在他于 2025 年 4 月 21 日去世后将这些文字委托给了他。

paras.en: Cardinal Fernández said he mentioned the writings to Leo a few weeks after his election and that the new pope showed intense interest in their publication.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯红衣主教表示，他在当选几周后向利奥提到了这些著作，新教皇对这些著作的出版​​表现出了浓厚的兴趣。

articles.title: Trump administration blacklists Megaspeed cloud company linked to Nvidia scandal

paras.en: Trump administration blacklists Megaspeed cloud company linked to Nvidia scandal
paras.zh: 特朗普政府将与 Nvidia 丑闻有关的 Megaspeed 云公司列入黑名单

paras.en: Nvidia partner has been under investigation by U.S. since 2024 over whether it diverted AI chips to China
paras.zh: 英伟达合作伙伴自2024年以来一直因是否将人工智能芯片转移到中国而受到美国调查

paras.en: The U.S. Commerce Department on Monday added Singapore-based Megaspeed, the cloud company at the centre of the Nvidia scandal, to its trade blacklist following criticism from lawmakers and administration officials.
paras.zh: 在受到立法者和政府官员的批评后，美国商务部周一将英伟达丑闻中心的新加坡云公司 Megaspeed 添加到贸易黑名单中。

paras.en: Megaspeed, an Nvidia partner which has been under investigation by U.S. authorities since 2024 over whether it diverted AI chips to China, will now need approval from the U.S. Commerce Department to obtain U.S. exports, which is likely to be denied.
paras.zh: Nvidia 的合作伙伴 Megaspeed 自 2024 年以来一直因是否将人工智能芯片转移到中国而受到美国当局的调查，现在需要获得美国商务部的批准才能获得美国出口，而这一批准很可能会被拒绝。

paras.en: "The Department of Commerce still needs to explain to Congress why this took so long," Sen. Pete Ricketts, a Nebraska Republican, said in a posting on X.
paras.zh: “商务部仍然需要向国会解释为什么花了这么长时间，”内布拉斯加州共和党参议员皮特·里基茨 (Pete Ricketts) 在 X 上发帖表示。

paras.en: Megaspeed landed in the spotlight about two weeks ago after news broke that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an ‌affair with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. authorities suspect of being a Chinese spy. China has said the spy accusations are "groundless."
paras.zh: 大约两周前，有消息称英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与 Megaspeed 前高管爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）有染，美国当局怀疑她是中国间谍，之后，Megaspeed 成为了人们关注的焦点。中国表示，间谍指控“毫无根据”。

paras.en: After the news broke, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly complained that the Commerce Department had not yet placed the company on its Entity List.
paras.zh: 消息传出后，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特公开抱怨商务部尚未将该公司列入实体名单。

paras.en: He also called out Nvidia. "The real story here should be: Did Nvidia know their client and was there a robust effort at Nvidia to make sure that there was no leakage and that they were selling to what were obviously pass-through shell companies?" Bessent told CNBC's Squawk Box ‌program.
paras.zh: 他还点名了英伟达。 “这里的真实故事应该是：英伟达是否了解他们的客户，英伟达是否做出了强有力的努力来确保不存在泄密，以及他们是否将产品出售给明显是通过空壳公司？” Bessent 告诉 CNBC 的 Squawk Box 节目。

paras.en: Nvidia has said it recently formed an export control committee to oversee trade compliance and national security risks.
paras.zh: 英伟达表示，它最近成立了一个出口管制委员会，以监督贸易合规性和国家安全风险。

paras.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang embraces Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang after delivering his keynote speech at a 2024 conference in Taipei, Taiwan. (Ann Wang/Reuters)
paras.zh: Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋在台湾台北举行的 2024 年会议上发表主题演讲后拥抱中国女商人 Alice Huang。 （王安/路透社）

paras.en: Megaspeed says it conducts 'lawful' business
paras.zh: Megaspeed称其开展“合法”业务

paras.en: Megaspeed did not immediately return a request for comment. A week ago, the company issued a statement saying it conducts legitimate and lawful business, including complying with U.S. export controls.
paras.zh: Megaspeed 没有立即回复置评请求。一周前，该公司发表声明称其开展合法合法业务，包括遵守美国出口管制。

paras.en: It also said Alice Huang officially left Megaspeed in August 2025.
paras.zh: 它还表示，Alice Huang 已于 2025 年 8 月正式离开 Megaspeed。

paras.en: The U.S. Justice Department and Commerce Department issued a joint statement last week saying they would "bring the full extent of the law against Megaspeed for any criminal conduct that may have occurred."
paras.zh: 美国司法部和商务部上周发表联合声明，称他们将“对 Megaspeed 可能发生的任何犯罪行为采取全面法律制裁”。

paras.en: Democratic lawmakers this week opened a probe into what influence Nvidia was able to wield over the Commerce Department's investigation.
paras.zh: 民主党议员本周开始调查英伟达能够对商务部的调查产生何种影响。

paras.en: Besides Megaspeed International in Singapore, the Commerce Department on Monday added six other companies from Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand to the Entity List. All had some link to Megaspeed, a Commerce official said.
paras.zh: 除了新加坡的 Megaspeed International 之外，美国商务部周一还将来自新加坡、马来西亚和泰国的另外六家公司添加到实体名单中。一位商务官员表示，所有这些都与 Megaspeed 有一定联系。

paras.en: The blacklisting coincided with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago.
paras.zh: 此次列入黑名单的时间恰逢黄仁勋在两周前辞职后重新担任英伟达首席执行官。

paras.en: The last time the Commerce Department placed any new entities on the list was in October 2025.
paras.zh: 商务部上次将任何新实体列入该名单是在 2025 年 10 月。

paras.en: As Reuters exclusively reported in June, the U.S. has held off adding China’s AI startup DeepSeek, memory chipmaker CXMT and more than 100 other companies flagged as national security risks to the trade blacklist, as the Trump administration tried to avoid escalating tensions with Beijing.
paras.zh: 正如路透社 6 月份独家报道的那样，由于特朗普政府试图避免与北京的紧张关系升级，美国推迟了将中国人工智能初创公司 DeepSeek、存储芯片制造商长鑫存储以及其他 100 多家被标记为国家安全风险的公司列入贸易黑名单。

articles.title: 'Brexit means Brexit' no more? Why the U.K. now wants closer ties with the EU
articles.author: Margaret Evans

paras.en: 'Brexit means Brexit' no more? Why the U.K. now wants closer ties with the EU
paras.zh: “脱欧就意味着脱欧”不再是吗？为什么英国现在希望与欧盟建立更紧密的关系

paras.en: U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham has opened the door to a 'Breturn'
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆打开了“布雷特恩”的大门

paras.en: Remember that old slogan, "Brexit means Brexit," in the wake of Britain’s decision to leave the European Union after the 2016 referendum pitted leavers against remainers?
paras.zh: 还记得 2016 年脱欧派与留欧派之间的公投后英国决定退出欧盟后的那句老口号吗？“脱欧就是脱欧”？

paras.en: It was relentlessly repeated by former British prime minister Theresa May — herself a remainer — as she sought to convince her own governing Conservatives that she wouldn’t allow any backsliding on the decision while negotiating the terms of Britain’s exit from the EU.
paras.zh: 英国前首相特蕾莎·梅（她本人也是留欧派）不断重复这句话，因为她试图说服自己的执政保守党，在英国脱欧条款谈判期间，她不会允许这一决定出现任何倒退。

paras.en: Well, it turns out Brexit might not have meant Brexit after all. At least, the door to a "Breturn," as they’re already calling it here, has been nudged open a crack or two by Britain’s Labour Prime Minister Andy Burnham.
paras.zh: 好吧，事实证明英国脱欧可能并不意味着英国脱欧。至少，英国工党首相安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）已经把通向“Breturn”（他们在这里已经这么称呼）的大门推开了一两道裂缝。

paras.en: "In the decade since Brexit, our standing in the world has diminished," he told a black-tie event at Guildhall in the city of London last week, just days before an EU-U.K. Summit heralded a deal to reduce some red tape on exports and improve student mobility in both directions.
paras.zh: “自英国脱欧以来的十年里，我们在世界上的地位已经下降，”他上周在伦敦市政厅举行的一场正式活动中表示，就在几天前欧盟与英国举行的峰会上。峰会宣布达成一项协议，以减少出口方面的一些繁文缛节，并改善学生的双向流动。

paras.en: "We treated both allies and institutions with insufficient care."
paras.zh: “我们对待盟友和机构都不够关心。”

paras.en: Perhaps one reason he’s becoming bolder on the issue is because opinion polls are on his side.
paras.zh: 也许他在这个问题上变得更加大胆的原因之一是民意调查站在他一边。

paras.en: Fifty-eight percent of Britons now think leaving the EU was a mistake, according to a recent YouGov poll that surveyed 2,019 people.
paras.zh: YouGov 最近对 2,019 人进行的一项民意调查显示，58% 的英国人现在认为离开欧盟是一个错误。

paras.en: "The majority of Brits realized that they were lied to by various politicians … and they have actually woken up to the fact that they’re not better off," said Chris Riddell, a political cartoonist for the Observer newspaper who would like to see the U.K. rejoin the EU.
paras.zh: 《观察家报》的政治漫画家克里斯·里德尔希望看到英国重新加入欧盟，他说：“大多数英国人意识到他们被各种政客欺骗了……而且他们实际上已经意识到自己的处境并没有变得更好。”

paras.en: "I’ve been drawing a Brexit ogre for the last decade. I’m looking forward to drawing maybe a tombstone and he’s been laid to rest, finally."
paras.zh: “过去十年来，我一直在画一个脱欧怪物。我期待着画一块墓碑，而他终于安息了。”

paras.en: One of political cartoonist Chris Riddell's depictions of the Brexit ogre. (Chris Riddell)
paras.zh: 政治漫画家克里斯·里德尔对脱欧怪物的描绘之一。 （克里斯·里德尔饰演）

paras.en: Among the most toxic debates in recent U.K. history
paras.zh: 英国近代历史上最具毒性的辩论之一

paras.en: Still, Burnham is treading carefully, talking about resetting relations before any moves toward rejoining, insisting he’ll never move ahead of British public opinion.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，伯纳姆还是谨慎行事，在采取任何重新加入的行动之前谈论重置关系，并坚称他永远不会领先于英国公众舆论。

paras.en: The Brexit debate was perhaps one of the most toxic in recent British history, with 51.9 per cent voting to leave and 48.1 per cent voting to stay. Many of those in favour of leaving argued that Brussels had too much influence over U.K. decision-making, especially on the control of its borders.
paras.zh: 英国脱欧辩论可能是英国近代历史上最具毒性的辩论之一，51.9%的人投票支持脱欧，48.1%的人投票支持留欧。许多支持脱欧的人认为，布鲁塞尔对英国的决策影响太大，尤其是在边境控制方面。

paras.en: Since leaving the EU, the U.K.'s GDP per capita is now six to eight per cent lower than it would have been had the country remained, by one estimate.
paras.zh: 据一项估计，自从离开欧盟以来，英国的人均国内生产总值现在比英国留在欧盟的情况下低了六到八个百分点。

paras.en: In the wake of the EU-U.K. summit, all five of the Conservative prime ministers from the 2016 referendum on have risen like ghosts of Christmases past to warn Burnham against reopening the debate.
paras.zh: 在欧盟-英国之后在峰会上，自 2016 年公投以来的所有五位保守党首相都像过去圣诞节的幽灵一样站起来，警告伯纳姆不要重新开启辩论。

paras.en: David Cameron, who campaigned to remain after calling the referendum and then resigned after the result, told Bloomburg that Britain’s poor economic growth was not, as Burnham argued, because of Brexit.
paras.zh: 戴维·卡梅伦(David Cameron)在举行公投后竞选留欧，并在公投结果公布后辞职。他告诉彭博社，英国经济增长不佳并不是像伯纳姆所说的那样，是因为脱欧。

paras.en: And Theresa May, of "Brexit means Brexit" fame, told the BBC that she was "aghast" at the talk of rejoining, saying Burnham needed to "move on."
paras.zh: 因“脱欧就是脱欧”而闻名的特蕾莎·梅告诉英国广播公司，她对重新加入的谈论感到“震惊”，并表示伯纳姆需要“继续前进”。

paras.en: May was eventually felled by divisions within her Conservative Party over how "hard" Britain’s exit from the EU should be and replaced by Boris Johnson, who recently told the Daily Telegraph that Britain would still back Brexit today.
paras.zh: 梅最终因保守党内部关于英国脱欧应该有多“艰难”的分歧而下台，并被鲍里斯·约翰逊取代，鲍里斯·约翰逊最近告诉《每日电讯报》，英国今天仍将支持脱欧。

paras.en: Liz Truss, who became the shortest-serving prime minister in U.K. history after replacing Johnson, said the idea of Britain "reshackling" itself to the EU was "sheer lunacy."
paras.zh: 取代约翰逊后成为英国历史上任期最短的首相的利兹·特拉斯表示，英国“重新束缚”欧盟的想法“纯粹是疯狂”。

paras.en: - Canada's new relationship with EU will be 'closer to membership' than ever, senior officials say
paras.zh: - 高级官员表示，加拿大与欧盟的新关系将比以往任何时候都“更接近成为欧盟成员”

paras.en: - Analysis Brexit, 10 years later: What a regret-fuelled British town can teach Canada about referendums
paras.zh: - 十年后英国脱欧分析：一个充满遗憾的英国小镇可以教会加拿大关于公投的知识

paras.en: Her successor, Rishi Sunak, said it would be a "huge distraction."
paras.zh: 她的继任者里希·苏纳克(Rishi Sunak)表示，这将是“巨大的干扰”。

paras.en: It could well be a cautionary tale for Burnham, given the role that Brexit played in much of the Conservative Party’s infighting. But he said on Monday that he wouldn't be listening to them.
paras.zh: 考虑到英国脱欧在保守党内讧中扮演的角色，这对伯纳姆来说很可能是一个警示。但他周一表示，他不会听他们的。

paras.en: "They left Britain with a bad Brexit deal that has hit growth over the past decade," he told British media. "They’re stuck in the past because they can’t face up to the bad deal that they did."
paras.zh: 他对英国媒体表示：“他们给英国留下了一份糟糕的脱欧协议，该协议打击了过去十年的经济增长。” “他们陷入了过去，因为他们无法面对自己所做的糟糕交易。”

paras.en: Pro-Brexit supporters attend the Brexit Day Celebration Party hosted by Leave Means Leave at Parliament Square in January 2020 in London. (Jeff J. Mitchell/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 支持脱欧的支持者参加 2020 年 1 月在伦敦议会广场由“Leave Means Leave”主办的脱欧日庆祝派对。 （杰夫·J·米切尔/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Economist Patrick Minford, who campaigned for Brexit, argues Britain’s sluggish economy isn’t suffering from leaving the EU, but from bad management.
paras.zh: 支持脱欧的经济学家帕特里克·明福德认为，英国经济低迷并不是因为脱欧，而是因为管理不善。

paras.en: "The EU would have enormous power over us, through its ability to regulate all aspects of our lives," he told CBC News. "And that was the central non-economic issue in the debate."
paras.zh: “欧盟将通过其监管我们生活各个方面的能力，对我们拥有巨大的权力，”他告诉加拿大广播公司新闻。 “这是辩论中的核心非经济问题。”

paras.en: But Burnham and other supporters of rejoining the EU argue that the world has changed over the past 10 years — and with it, attitudes toward the European Union.
paras.zh: 但伯纳姆和其他重新加入欧盟的支持者认为，过去十年世界发生了变化，人们对欧盟的态度也随之改变。

paras.en: Labour MP and former U.K. foreign secretary David Lammy puts part of that shift down to the Trump factor.
paras.zh: 工党议员、前英国外交大臣大卫·拉米将这一转变部分归因于特朗普因素。

paras.en: "Just like Canada is reeling from a different relationship with the United States, so Europe is reeling from a different relationship to the United States," he said.
paras.zh: “就像加拿大因与美国的不同关系而陷入困境一样，欧洲也因与美国的不同关系而陷入困境，”他说。

paras.en: "Sovereignty disappears very quickly in the current geopolitical environment, unless you are in concert with other shared friends."
paras.zh: “在当前的地缘政治环境中，主权很快就会消失，除非你与其他共同的朋友保持一致。”

paras.en: He’s not surprised that Canada has been exploring closer ties with the European Union.
paras.zh: 对于加拿大一直在探索与欧盟建立更密切的关系，他并不感到惊讶。

paras.en: "The space between us is so slim we’re better huddled together in the best formation," he said.
paras.zh: “我们之间的距离太小了，我们最好挤在一起，形成最好的队形，”他说。

paras.en: "That does not, of course, mean that we do not have the closest of relationships with our friends in the United States."
paras.zh: “当然，这并不意味着我们与美国的朋友没有最密切的关系。”

paras.en: Even some Britons who voted to remain in the EU worry about the possibility of reopening old wounds.
paras.zh: 甚至一些投票决定留在欧盟的英国人也担心旧伤复发的可能性。

paras.en: "So there’s an aspect where you just say, 'Well, hold on a minute. If people have voted, you do have to respect it,'" said Bleue Granada, a retired woman.
paras.zh: “因此，在某个方面，你只需说，‘好吧，等一下。如果人们投票了，你就必须尊重它，’”退休女性布鲁·格拉纳达 (Bleue Granada) 说。

paras.en: "But at the same time, I think we need a much more intelligent debate, more informed debate. And I think that was lacking and I think people are a lot wiser now."
paras.zh: “但与此同时，我认为我们需要一场更明智的辩论，更有见识的辩论。我认为这是缺乏的，而且我认为人们现在更加明智了。”

paras.en: Bleue Granada, a retired woman in the U.K., says the country needs a more informed debate on the issue of Brexit. (Katie Pedersen/CBC)
paras.zh: 英国退休女性布鲁·格拉纳达 (Bleue Granada) 表示，英国需要就英国脱欧问题进行更明智的辩论。 （凯蒂·佩德森/CBC）

paras.en: David Arvidsson, a dual Swedish and British citizen, was studying in England when the U.K. voted to leave the EU.
paras.zh: 大卫·阿维德森 (David Arvidsson) 拥有瑞典和英国双重国籍，英国公投脱欧时他正在英国读书。

paras.en: "[As a] student in Cambridge, you had basically not met a single person in favour of Brexit, so it came as a shock," he said.
paras.zh: “作为一名剑桥大学的学生，你基本上没有遇到过任何支持英国脱欧的人，所以这让人感到震惊，”他说。

paras.en: "[Pushing to rejoin] will lead to a lot of arguments," he said. "I do think that a majority would be in favour of it. I do feel that we lost something in the U.K. when we left the EU."
paras.zh: “（推动重新加入）会引发很多争论，”他说。 “我确实认为大多数人都会赞成。我确实觉得，当我们离开欧盟时，我们在英国失去了一些东西。”

paras.en: Kenneth Robbie, another resident, says he decided how to vote on his way to the polls during the last referendum, eventually casting his ballot to remain.
paras.zh: 另一位居民肯尼思·罗比 (Kenneth Robbie) 表示，他在上次公投期间决定如何投票，最终投了留欧票。

paras.en: "I just hope that if it’s going to become a live, red-hot issue again, that we can discuss it calmly and avoid another referendum, because the referendum 10 years ago, I think, was very divisive."
paras.zh: “我只是希望，如果它再次成为一个热点问题，我们可以冷静地讨论它，避免再次举行公投，因为我认为10年前的公投是非常分裂的。”

paras.en: 'Unthinkable' to rejoin without referendum
paras.zh: 不经公投重新加入“不可想象”

paras.en: But when pressed on the questions of a referendum in Parliament on Monday, Burnham replied that it would be "unthinkable" for any British prime minister to rejoin the EU without one.
paras.zh: 但在周一被问及议会公投问题时，伯纳姆回答说，任何一位英国首相在没有首相的情况下重新加入欧盟都是“不可想象的”。

paras.en: David Lammy, the Labour MP, agrees. He wants his party to fight the next election with a commitment to rejoin the EU.
paras.zh: 工党议员戴维·拉米 (David Lammy) 对此表示同意。他希望他的政党在下次选举中承诺重新加入欧盟。

paras.en: Brexit continues to be controversial, with this protest in September 2023 showing a man holding an anti-Brexit sign, in central London. (Justin Tallis/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 英国脱欧仍然存在争议，2023 年 9 月的这次抗议活动中，一名男子在伦敦市中心举着反脱欧标语。 （贾斯汀·塔利斯/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: "We will then have a negotiation. We will have a referendum. And the deal will be done by the election after the next one."
paras.zh: “然后我们将进行谈判。我们将进行全民公投。协议将在下一次选举后完成。”

paras.en: The Brexit genie has never really stayed in the bottle, managing to bedevil British politics before, during and after the referendum.
paras.zh: 英国脱欧精灵从未真正待在瓶子里，在公投之前、期间和之后都困扰着英国政坛。

articles.title: Trump says Jensen Huang 'did nothing wrong.' The investigations aren't over
articles.author: Mike Crawley

paras.en: Trump says Jensen Huang 'did nothing wrong.' The investigations aren't over
paras.zh: 特朗普称黄仁勋“没有做错任何事”。调查尚未结束

paras.en: U.S. president takes credit for convincing Nvidia to reinstate CEO, despite intelligence concerns
paras.zh: 尽管存在情报担忧，美国总统仍然说服英伟达恢复首席执行官职位

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump's extraordinary intervention to get Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO does little to shut down many pressing questions about a scandal that has rocked both Washington and the stock markets.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普为让黄仁勋重新担任英伟达首席执行官而进行的非同寻常的干预，并没有消除有关震惊华盛顿和股市的丑闻的许多紧迫问题。

paras.en: Nvidia's about-face comes just 11 days after Huang stepped down, following allegations he'd had multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a woman reportedly suspected of spying for China.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋被指控有多次婚外情，其中包括与一名涉嫌为中国从事间谍活动的女性发生婚外情，而就在黄仁勋辞职 11 天后，英伟达的态度发生了转变。

paras.en: Trump is taking full credit for persuading the board of one of the world's most valuable companies to bring Huang back by assuring them he poses no national security risk.
paras.zh: 特朗普向世界上最有价值的公司之一的董事会保证黄先生不会构成国家安全风险，从而说服他们将黄先生带回来，这完全归功于特朗普。

paras.en: "I convinced them," Trump told CNBC in a phone interview on Monday. "I made the deal."
paras.zh: “我说服了他们，”特朗普周一在接受 CNBC 电话采访时表示。 “我达成协议了。”

paras.en: - North American stocks soar, recovering half of last week's plunge after Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia's CEO
paras.zh: - 黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 重新担任 Nvidia 首席执行官后，北美股市飙升，收复了上周跌幅的一半

paras.en: That "deal" triggered a one-day jump of 30 per cent in Nvidia's share price, effectively erasing the $1 trillion US loss in market value the company had seen since Huang's Nov. 12 resignation.
paras.zh: 这项“交易”引发英伟达股价单日上涨 30%，有效消除了自黄仁勋 11 月 12 日辞职以来该公司市值损失的 1 万亿美元。

paras.en: What the deal did not erase are the doubts on Capitol Hill about whether Huang's actions — or the Trump administration's inactions — may have harmed U.S. national security interests by allowing China to access Nvidia's most advanced microchips.
paras.zh: 该交易并没有消除国会山的疑虑，即黄仁勋的行为——或者特朗普政府的不作为——是否可能因允许中国获得英伟达最先进的微芯片而损害美国的国家安全利益。

paras.en: "No national security risk? Based on what?" asked Sen. John Cornyn, the Texas Republican, in a post on X.
paras.zh: “没有国家安全风险？基于什么？”德克萨斯州共和党参议员约翰·科宁 (John Cornyn) 在 X 上的一篇帖子中问道。

paras.en: Since the New York Times first broke the story in late October, Trump has repeatedly tried to cast doubt on U.S. intelligence reports suggesting Huang's paramour, Alice Huang (no relation), had been recruited by Beijing's spy services.
paras.zh: 自《纽约时报》于 10 月底首次披露此事以来，特朗普多次试图对美国情报报告提出质疑，称黄的情人爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）（无亲属关系）已被北京间谍部门招募。

paras.en: Trump intervening has costs, editorial warns
paras.zh: 社论警告称，特朗普的干预是有代价的

paras.en: Investigations were soon launched by Nvidia's board, the FBI, the Securities and Exchange Commission and Congressional committees.
paras.zh: 英伟达董事会、联邦调查局、证券交易委员会和国会委员会很快启动了调查。

paras.en: But Trump told CNBC on Monday that the Department of Justice had done its own "very thorough investigation" into Huang and concluded "he did nothing wrong."
paras.zh: 但特朗普周一对 CNBC 表示，司法部已经对黄进行了“非常彻底的调查”，并得出结论“他没有做错任何事”。

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal was unimpressed.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》不为所动。

paras.en: "That must be the quickest very thorough investigation in history," a Journal editorial said Monday, noting that Trump's intervention "will have major national security and political costs."
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》周一发表社论称，“这一定是历史上最快、最彻底的调查”，并指出特朗普的干预“将带来重大的国家安全和政治成本”。

paras.en: Nvidia's most advanced chips are considered crucial to U.S. national security because of their role in powering the frontiers of artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 英伟达最先进的芯片被认为对美国国家安全至关重要，因为它们在推动人工智能前沿方面发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: Keeping them out of China's hands was U.S. policy under Joe Biden. But amid lobbying from the AI sector, particularly Huang, the Trump administration loosened restrictions in 2025.
paras.zh: 让它们远离中国手中是乔·拜登领导下的美国政策。但在人工智能行业（尤其是黄仁勋）的游说下，特朗普政府在 2025 年放松了限制。

paras.en: On Monday, Nvidia, headquartered in Santa Clara, Calif., announced it had reinstated Huang as CEO. (Carlos Barria/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周一，总部位于加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉的英伟达宣布恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官。 （卡洛斯·巴里亚/路透社）

paras.en: Meanwhile, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick reportedly ignored evidence that China was getting back-door access through companies in southeast Asia, including Megaspeed, the company run by Alice Huang.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据报道，商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克忽视了中国通过东南亚公司获得后门准入的证据，其中包括由爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）经营的Megaspeed公司。

paras.en: The Department of Justice is investigating whether Megaspeed smuggled Nvidia's advanced chips to China in violation of U.S. export controls.
paras.zh: 美国司法部正在调查 Megaspeed 是否违反美国出口管制，将 Nvidia 的先进芯片走私到中国。

paras.en: - Trump administration blacklists Megaspeed cloud company linked to Nvidia scandal
paras.zh: - 特朗普政府将与 Nvidia 丑闻有关的 Megaspeed 云公司列入黑名单

paras.en: - How China gets around the U.S. ban on Nvidia chips
paras.zh: - 中国如何绕过美国对英伟达芯片的禁令

paras.en: Republican senators, including staunch Trump loyalists, expressed concern Monday about Huang's return as CEO and said they'll be looking for answers when he appears before Congressional hearings next week.
paras.zh: 包括特朗普的坚定支持者在内的共和党参议员周一对黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官表示担忧，并表示他们将在黄仁勋下周出席国会听证会时寻找答案。

paras.en: "Congress has much to investigate," said Sen. Tom Cotton, chairman of the Senate Intelligence Committee.
paras.zh: “国会有很多事情需要调查，”参议院情报委员会主席、参议员汤姆·科顿说。

paras.en: "The controversy with Nvidia and Megaspeed is just the tip of the iceberg, and it's not resolved because Jensen Huang has his job back," Cotton posted on X.
paras.zh: Cotton 在 X 上发帖称：“与 Nvidia 和 Megaspeed 的争议只是冰山一角，而且还没有解决，因为黄仁勋已经恢复了工作。”

paras.en: Sen. Pete Ricketts of Nebraska said Huang's behaviour doesn't support reinstating him.
paras.zh: 内布拉斯加州参议员皮特·里基茨表示，黄的行为不支持让他复职。

paras.en: "Jensen Huang had multiple affairs including with subordinates and an alleged Chinese spy," Ricketts wrote on X.
paras.zh: Ricketts 在 X 上写道：“黄仁勋有多处外遇，包括与下属和一名所谓的中国间谍。”

paras.en: Ricketts said the company's decision to bring Huang back "doesn’t absolve Nvidia of answering for national security concerns and unaccounted-for chips."
paras.zh: 里基茨表示，该公司决定让黄回归“并不能免除英伟达对国家安全问题和下落不明的芯片的责任。”

paras.en: Sen. John Curtis of Utah, a Republican who sits on the Senate Committee on Foreign Relations, said he wants to know what changed after the Nvidia board's earlier insistence that Huang was not coming back as CEO.
paras.zh: 参议院外交关系委员会成员、犹他州共和党参议员约翰·柯蒂斯 (John Curtis) 表示，他想知道英伟达董事会早些时候坚称黄仁勋不会重新担任首席执行官后发生了什么变化。

paras.en: "Who in our government weighed in? What did they tell the board? And on what basis did the board conclude there was no risk?"
paras.zh: “我们政府中的谁参与了权衡？他们告诉了董事会什么？董事会是根据什么得出不存在风险的结论的？”

paras.en: One common theme in all the Republicans' posts: they stopped short of calling out Trump for intervening.
paras.zh: 所有共和党人的帖子都有一个共同主题：他们没有呼吁特朗普进行干预。

paras.en: Jensen Huang, centre, was one of several top tech executives who met U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House on Sept. 29, 2026, to try to quell public concerns about the potential risks of artifical intelligence. (Alex Brandon/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 黄仁勋（中）是 2026 年 9 月 29 日在白宫会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、试图平息公众对人工智能潜在风险的担忧的几位科技高管之一。 （亚历克斯·布兰登/美联社）

paras.en: "Trump is putting his own financial interests and the needs of his billionaire buddies before our national security," Sen. Chuck Schumer wrote on X.
paras.zh: “特朗普将自己的经济利益和亿万富翁伙伴的需求置于我们的国家安全之上，”参议员查克·舒默在 X 上写道。

paras.en: Come January, Democrats will control Congress and the subpoena power of its committees. if those Congressional investigations dig up evidence that the Huang saga compromised national security, Trump's insistence to the contrary would backfire spectacularly.
paras.zh: 一月份，民主党将控制国会及其委员会的传票权。如果国会的调查发现了黄氏事件损害国家安全的证据，特朗普坚持相反的做法将会适得其反。

paras.en: - Analysis What the Jensen Huang scandal means for Trump and his administration
paras.zh: - 分析黄仁勋丑闻对特朗普及其政府意味着什么

paras.en: - U.S. Treasury Secretary frustrated by Commerce Department's inaction on Nvidia chips
paras.zh: - 美国财政部长对商务部对 Nvidia 芯片不采取行动感到沮丧

paras.en: "That the president won't recognize the intelligence that he is receiving from our own agents, from his own State Department, is outrageous," Congressman Robert Garcia, the top Democrat on the House Oversight Committee told CNN on Monday evening.
paras.zh: “总统不承认他从我们自己的特工、他自己的国务院那里收到的情报，这是令人愤慨的，”众议院监督委员会民主党领袖、众议员罗伯特·加西亚周一晚间告诉美国有线电视新闻网。

paras.en: "Every single American should be concerned that the president seems to not care, has no interest in finding out the truth," Garcia said.
paras.zh: 加西亚说：“每个美国人都应该担心总统似乎并不关心，也没有兴趣找出真相。”

paras.en: For now at least, Trump appears unbothered by the potential for Congressional probes.
paras.zh: 至少目前，特朗普似乎并不担心国会调查的可能性。

paras.en: He spent significant portions of his 50-minute phone interview with CNBC pointing to the rise in Nvidia shares and the bounce-back in the stock market after last week's sharp downturn. He blamed the midterms for wiping trillions off the U.S. stock market.
paras.zh: 在接受 CNBC 的 50 分钟电话采访中，他用很大一部分时间指出了英伟达股价的上涨以及股市在上周急剧下滑后的反弹。他指责中期选举让美国股市蒸发了数万亿美元。

paras.en: Trump also suggested that had he not intervened to get Huang back on Nvidia's board, China would try to recruit him to work for one of its major tech companies.
paras.zh: 特朗普还表示，如果他不进行干预，让黄回到英伟达董事会，中国将试图招募他为中国一家主要科技公司工作。

paras.en: "People say, 'Is it a [national security] threat to have him?' No, it's a threat to lose him," Trump said.
paras.zh: “人们说，‘拥有他会构成[国家安全]威胁吗？’不，这是失去他的威胁，”特朗普说。

paras.en: "Jensen could take the next plane to China, and I guarantee you they would give him whatever he wanted," he said.
paras.zh: “詹森可以乘坐下一班飞机前往中国，我向你保证，他们会给他任何他想要的东西，”他说。

paras.en: That statement raises yet another concern: if Trump truly believes there was a risk Huang would go work for China, perhaps the national security concerns of the whole affair weren't fully put to rest.
paras.zh: 这一声明引发了另一个担忧：如果特朗普真的相信黄有可能去中国工作，那么整个事件对国家安全的担忧也许还没有完全消除。

articles.title: German police respond to multiple school bomb threats

paras.en: Police in several locations across Germany reported large numbers of bomb threats targeting schools.
paras.zh: 德国多个地点的警方报告称，学校收到大量炸弹威胁。

paras.en: They said that while they were investigating the claims, they did not initially have reason to treat them as credible threats.
paras.zh: 他们表示，虽然他们正在调查这些指控，但他们最初没有理由将其视为可信的威胁。

paras.en: More than 400 schools in the southwestern state of Baden Württemberg received threats, and more than 250 in Saxony-Anhalt received the emails, with several other regions also targeted on Monday morning.
paras.zh: 周一早上，西南巴登符腾堡州的 400 多所学校收到了威胁，萨克森-安哈尔特州的 250 多所学校收到了电子邮件，其他几个地区也受到了威胁。

paras.en: What did police say about the bomb threats?
paras.zh: 警方对炸弹威胁有何评论？

paras.en: Police in Erfurt in Thuringia were among the first to issue a statement on the threats, saying they were responding to threats at "multiple schools" after morning warnings, including in Jena, Erfurt, Mühlhausen, Zella-Mehlis, Nordhausen, Gotha, Rudolstadt and Greiz.
paras.zh: 图林根州埃尔福特的警方是最先就这些威胁发表声明的警察之一，称他们正在对早上发出警告后对“多所学校”的威胁做出回应，其中包括耶拿、埃尔福特、米尔豪森、泽拉-梅利斯、诺德豪森、哥达、鲁多尔施塔特和格赖茨。

paras.en: "The same word-for-word threats were received this morning at the various eductional institutes," police wrote in a press release. "Based on preliminary findings other federal states are also affected by the threatening messages."
paras.zh: 警方在一份新闻稿中写道：“今天早上，各个教育机构都收到了同样的逐字威胁。” “根据初步调查结果，其他联邦州也受到威胁信息的影响。”

paras.en: Police said they had no information yet on the potential author or sender of the emails. They were investigating breach of the peace-based crimes via the threat of criminal activity.
paras.zh: 警方表示，他们还没有关于电子邮件潜在作者或发件人的信息。他们正在调查通过犯罪活动威胁来破坏基于和平的犯罪行为。

paras.en: "At present the police is not working on the assumption of the bomb threats being serious and recommends that schools do not implement evacuation measures and continue their normal operations," they said.
paras.zh: 他们说：“目前警方并未考虑炸弹威胁是否严重的假设，并建议学校不要实施疏散措施并继续正常运作。”

paras.en: Police in Freiburg in the southwest and authorities to the north in Hanover also said they were responding to emailed bomb threats directed against schools.
paras.zh: 西南部弗莱堡警方和北部汉诺威当局也表示，他们正在回应针对学校的炸弹威胁电子邮件。

paras.en: Similar reports are emerging to the north of Germany in Denmark.
paras.zh: 德国北部的丹麦也出现了类似的报道。

paras.en: As in Germany, Danish police said they did not believe the threats were credible, "but they understandably create insecurity locally at the schools."
paras.zh: 与德国一样，丹麦警方表示，他们认为这些威胁并不可信，“但它们在学校当地造成了不安全感，这是可以理解的。”

paras.en: Various disruptive incidents targeting Europe in recent weeks
paras.zh: 最近几周针对欧洲的各种破坏性事件

paras.en: This follows other recent cases of coordinated bomb threats against multiple schools that turned out to be hoaxes in Italy earlier in the month.
paras.zh: 在此之前，意大利最近发生了针对多所学校的协调炸弹威胁案件，这些案件在本月早些时候被证明是恶作剧。

paras.en: It also comes amid various apparent bids to create disruption within Europe in recent weeks, such as multiple bomb threats targeting commercial airlines, or hacking into supermarket refrigeration systems to spoil produce en masse.
paras.zh: 最近几周，各种明显的企图在欧洲制造混乱，例如针对商业航空公司的多起炸弹威胁，或侵入超市制冷系统以破坏大量农产品。

articles.title: Uganda minister at COP31: 'We need a just transition'

paras.en: Ugandan Environment Minister Beatrice Atim Anywar has come to the UN climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, seeking to secure more funding for her country as it grapples with climate change.
paras.zh: 乌干达环境部长比阿特丽斯·阿蒂姆·安瓦尔 (Beatrice Atim Anywar) 出席了在土耳其安塔利亚举行的联合国气候谈判，寻求为该国应对气候变化争取更多资金。

paras.en: "This is a thing we are living with," she told DW on the sidelines of the COP31 summit, where she's leading the Ugandan delegation. "People are displaced, people are dying of harm, hunger. It has implications on food security and livelihoods."
paras.zh: 她率领乌干达代表团在 COP31 峰会间隙告诉德国之声：“这是我们必须面对的现实。” “人们流离失所，人们因伤害和饥饿而死亡。这对粮食安全和生计产生了影响。”

paras.en: In recent years, the East African nation has been hit by a series of climate-related disasters, from deadly landslides and floods washing away villages, to droughts damaging harvests and hydroelectricity production.
paras.zh: 近年来，这个东非国家遭受了一系列与气候有关的灾难，从致命的山体滑坡和洪水冲毁村庄，到干旱破坏收成和水力发电。

paras.en: "When we come to COP and we talk of what the reality is on the ground, we Ugandans have suffered it," Anywar said, referring to the effects of climate change.
paras.zh: “当我们来到缔约方会议并谈论当地的现实情况时，我们乌干达人已经遭受了苦难，”安瓦尔在谈到气候变化的影响时说。

paras.en: "It has an implication for the health of our people, on national budgets," she added.
paras.zh: “这对我们人民的健康和国家预算都有影响，”她补充道。

paras.en: Climate financing for developing countries to deal with the impacts of a warming planet has become a major sticking point at this year's climate talks. The gathering of some 200 states is seeking to close gaps on how to scale up financing from developed states and whether support should be provided through grants or loans.
paras.zh: 为发展中国家应对地球变暖影响而提供的气候融资已成为今年气候谈判的一个主要症结所在。大约 200 个国家聚集在一起，寻求缩小在如何扩大发达国家融资规模以及是否应通过赠款或贷款提供支持等问题上的分歧。

paras.en: Africa contributes less than 4% of the global greenhouse emissions that drive rising temperatures globally, but the continent is among the most vulnerable to climate impacts.
paras.zh: 非洲的温室气体排放量仅占全球温室气体排放量的不到 4%，导致全球气温上升，但非洲大陆却是最容易受到气候影响的地区之一。

paras.en: As it deals with the effects of climate change, including extreme weather, Uganda is also rapidly expanding investment in electricity production from renewables such as hydropower and solar.
paras.zh: 在应对包括极端天气在内的气候变化影响的同时，乌干达还迅速扩大对水力发电和太阳能等可再生能源发电的投资。

paras.en: In the country of some 53 million people, more than 90% of Ugandan households still rely on wood and charcoal as the most affordable fuel for things like cooking. Biomass accounts for 90% of the country's final energy consumption.
paras.zh: 在这个拥有约 5300 万人口的国家，超过 90% 的乌干达家庭仍然依赖木材和木炭作为烹饪等最实惠的燃料。生物质能占全国最终能源消费的90%。

paras.en: While using wood and charcoal leads to deforestation, Ugandans have little choice. Only around 2% of the country's energy comes from electricity — which is largely derived from hydropower — and less than half of the population has access to electricity.
paras.zh: 虽然使用木材和木炭会导致森林砍伐，但乌干达人别无选择。该国只有约 2% 的能源来自电力（主要来自水力发电），只有不到一半的人口用上电力。

paras.en: "Now we are deliberately going into scaling up the production of electricity — hydropower electricity — and making it cheaper for cooking," Anywar said. "We have other alternative energy sources... to mitigate this charcoal use. But the use needs to be phased out in a systematic manner by giving them alternatives."
paras.zh: “现在我们正在刻意扩大电力生产——水力发电——并降低烹饪成本，”安瓦尔说。 “我们有其他替代能源......来减少木炭的使用。但需要通过为他们提供替代品来系统地逐步淘汰这种使用。”

paras.en: At the same time, the country is seeking to boost economic development by becoming an oil producer. Due to open in 2027, a controversial 1,443-kilometer (897-mile) pipeline is nearly complete. It connects two oil sites in eastern Uganda with a port on the Tanzanian coast.
paras.zh: 与此同时，该国正在寻求通过成为石油生产国来促进经济发展。一条全长 1,443 公里（897 英里）、备受争议的管道即将完工，预计将于 2027 年开通。它将乌干达东部的两个石油基地与坦桑尼亚海岸的一个港口连接起来。

paras.en: Environmentalists have criticized the East African Crude Oil Pipeline project, which can transport up to 246,000 barrels per day. Environmentalists say it runs counter to the goal of limiting global temperature rise and could damage fragile ecosystems.
paras.zh: 环保人士批评了东非原油管道项目，该项目每天可输送多达 246,000 桶石油。环保人士表示，这与限制全球气温上升的目标背道而驰，并可能损害脆弱的生态系统。

paras.en: The Climate Accountability Institute said it would release 379 million tons of climate-heating pollution over its 20-year lifetime.
paras.zh: 气候责任研究所表示，在其 20 年的生命周期内，将释放 3.79 亿吨气候变暖污染物。

paras.en: Oil wells for the project, operated by French energy giant TotalEnergies, are also located in Uganda's largest and oldest national park, Murchison Falls.
paras.zh: 该项目的油井由法国能源巨头 TotalEnergies 运营，也位于乌干达最大、最古老的国家公园默奇森瀑布。

paras.en: "That has been also a sticky issue. And actually, that is one of the challenges we are facing at COPs," Anywar said. She stressed that measures have been taken to limit emissions, and that the project was progressing in a "very deliberate way."
paras.zh: “这也是一个棘手的问题。实际上，这是我们在缔约方大会上面临的挑战之一，”安瓦尔说。她强调，已经采取措施限制排放，并且该项目正在以“非常审慎的方式”取得进展。

paras.en: The minister also urged developed countries to cut less wealthy nations some slack for using the resources they have to drive much-needed development, saying oil revenues could help fund the transition to cleaner energy.
paras.zh: 这位部长还敦促发达国家对不太富裕的国家放松一些，让它们利用现有资源来推动急需的发展，并表示石油收入可以帮助为向清洁能源的过渡提供资金。

paras.en: "You cannot tell us to cut off the umbilical cord that feeds us, as much as it has to be cut off," Anywar said, criticizing the lack of financing from developed countries to deal with climate change. "We are here begging for funds that are not forthcoming."
paras.zh: 安瓦尔说：“你不能告诉我们切断养活我们的脐带，但它必须被切断。”他批评发达国家缺乏应对气候变化的资金。 “我们在这里乞求资金，但尚未到位。”

paras.en: Anywar added that developing countries "need a just transition," referring to an equitable shift away from fossil fuels that focuses on protecting workers and communities.
paras.zh: Anywar补充说，发展中国家“需要公正的转型”，指的是以保护工人和社区为重点，公平地摆脱化石燃料。

paras.en: Another way Uganda is looking to finance climate change adaptation is through carbon credits, Anywar said, describing them as a potential "breakthrough."
paras.zh: 安瓦尔表示，乌干达寻求为适应气候变化提供资金的另一种方式是通过碳信用额，并将其描述为潜在的“突破”。

paras.en: Carbon credits are tradeable permits representing one ton of carbon dioxide that has been reduced or removed from the atmosphere through initiatives such as forest protection, renewable energy projects or tree planting schemes. Companies or governments can buy them to offset emissions they have not cut themselves.
paras.zh: 碳信用额是可交易的许可证，代表通过森林保护、可再生能源项目或植树计划等举措从大气中减少或消除的一吨二氧化碳。公司或政府可以购买它们来抵消他们自己没有削减的排放量。

paras.en: "Our country is rich with biodiversity. And that is what we are looking forward to — attracting investors into our natural setup so that we earn some finances," Anywar said.
paras.zh: “我们的国家拥有丰富的生物多样性。这就是我们所期待的——吸引投资者进入我们的自然环境，以便我们赚取一些资金，”安瓦尔说。

paras.en: Carbon credits have been promoted as an important source of income for developing countries. But they have also faced criticism, for a lack of transparency and allowing polluting activities to continue.
paras.zh: 碳信用额已被宣传为发展中国家的重要收入来源。但他们也面临批评，因为缺乏透明度并允许污染活动继续进行。

paras.en: "We need to have a bankable approach to all interventions. Otherwise… it's not going to work for us," Anywar said, adding that her country also wants to attract investment and build partnerships in smart agriculture and the energy transition.
paras.zh: 安瓦尔说：“我们需要对所有干预措施采取可行的方法。否则……这对我们不起作用。”她补充说，她的国家还希望在智能农业和能源转型领域吸引投资并建立合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: "If we rely on begging for funds which are not forthcoming, we shall go back empty handed."
paras.zh: “如果我们靠乞讨资金而得不到资金，我们就会空手而归。”

paras.en: This interview also appeared as a video.
paras.zh: 这次采访还以视频形式出现。

articles.title: What happens if a nuclear weapon explodes in space?

paras.en: A nuclear explosion in space would be unlikely to cause widespread injuries on Earth. But it could disable satellites that provide services we depend on every day, including some that save lives.
paras.zh: 太空中的核爆炸不太可能在地球上造成广泛的伤害。但它可能会导致卫星瘫痪，这些卫星为我们提供日常所依赖的服务，包括一些拯救生命的服务。

paras.en: In the United States, satellite failures could make it harder for emergency crews to communicate in remote areas. If GPS were also disrupted, drivers and pilots could lose navigation guidance, and financial networks could lose a source of precise time.
paras.zh: 在美国，卫星故障可能会使紧急救援人员在偏远地区进行通信变得更加困难。如果 GPS 也受到干扰，驾驶员和飞行员可能会失去导航指导，金融网络可能会失去精确时间的来源。

paras.en: We have some idea of what would happen because it's already been done.
paras.zh: 我们对会发生什么有所了解，因为它已经完成了。

paras.en: On the evening of July 8, 1962, people in Hawaii held "watch-the-bomb parties" and followed the countdown on shortwave radio. Then the night sky lit up. The United States had detonated a nuclear weapon about 400 kilometers (250 miles) above the Pacific. The test was called Starfish Prime.
paras.zh: 1962年7月8日晚，夏威夷人民举行“观弹派对”，并通过短波广播收听倒计时。然后夜空亮了起来。美国在太平洋上空约 400 公里（250 英里）处引爆了一枚核武器。该测试被称为 Starfish Prime。

paras.en: An electromagnetic pulse knocked out some streetlights in Hawaii, and some Pacific radio links briefly went down. The glow faded within minutes, but some satellites failed months later.
paras.zh: 电磁脉冲摧毁了夏威夷的一些路灯，一些太平洋无线电链路短暂中断。光芒在几分钟内就消失了，但一些卫星在几个月后就失效了。

paras.en: The air was too thin for a conventional fireball to form or for a destructive shock wave to reach the ground. Charged particles made denser air below glow, creating an artificial aurora. The atmosphere also absorbed much of the initial radiation.
paras.zh: 空气太稀薄，无法形成传统的火球，也无法让破坏性的冲击波到达地面。带电粒子使辉光下的空气变得更稠密，形成人造极光。大气层也吸收了大部分初始辐射。

paras.en: Satellites are especially vulnerable because they orbit above most of the atmosphere that shields people on the ground from the initial radiation.
paras.zh: 卫星特别容易受到攻击，因为它们在大部分大气层上方运行，从而保护地面上的人们免受最初的辐射。

paras.en: In orbit, the initial burst of X-rays can damage spacecraft right away. But Earth's magnetic field can also trap electrons released after the blast, as it did after Starfish Prime. Satellites receive another dose each time they cross the resulting radiation belt. Over time, that exposure can damage electronics and solar panels.
paras.zh: 在轨道上，最初的 X 射线爆发可能会立即损坏航天器。但地球磁场也可以捕获爆炸后释放的电子，就像海星主星之后那样。卫星每次穿过由此产生的辐射带时都会收到另一个剂量。随着时间的推移，这种暴露会损坏电子设备和太阳能电池板。

paras.en: That would depend on where the explosion happened and which satellites crossed the radiation belt. GPS satellites send signals that help phones, planes and ships work out where they are. They orbit about 20,200 kilometers above Earth and could keep working even if satellites closer to Earth failed.
paras.zh: 这将取决于爆炸发生的地点以及哪些卫星穿过辐射带。 GPS 卫星发送的信号可帮助手机、飞机和船舶确定其所在位置。它们的轨道距地球约 20,200 公里，即使距离地球较近的卫星发生故障，它们也能继续工作。

paras.en: But satellites do different jobs. A ship's emergency beacon can use GPS to work out its location, then send it to rescuers through a separate satellite network. If part of that network failed, the alert could take longer to get through.
paras.zh: 但卫星的工作不同。船舶的紧急信标可以使用 GPS 确定其位置，然后通过单独的卫星网络将其发送给救援人员。如果该网络的一部分出现故障，警报可能需要更长的时间才能发出。

paras.en: The 1967 Outer Space Treaty bars its parties from placing nuclear weapons in orbit. The 1963 Limited Test Ban Treaty prohibits its parties from carrying out nuclear explosions in space.
paras.zh: 1967 年的《外层空间条约》禁止其缔约方将核武器送入轨道。 1963 年《有限禁试条约》禁止其缔约方在太空进行核爆炸。

paras.en: The Outer Space Treaty has no dedicated system for checking what spacecraft carry. A detonation is easier to detect because US satellite sensors are designed to pick up the signals it gives off.
paras.zh: 《外层空间条约》没有专门的系统来检查航天器携带的物品。爆炸更容易被检测到，因为美国卫星传感器的设计可以接收爆炸发出的信号。

paras.en: Shielding could help protect satellite electronics, and backups could keep some services running. During a GPS outage, pilots over the contiguous US can use ground-based navigation aids. Operators could launch replacements, but those satellites could still face lingering radiation or debris.
paras.zh: 屏蔽可以帮助保护卫星电子设备，备份可以保持某些服务的运行。在 GPS 中断期间，美国本土的飞行员可以使用地面导航设备。运营商可以发射替代卫星，但这些卫星仍可能面临挥之不去的辐射或碎片。

paras.en: Radiation could leave many satellites intact but unable to steer. If two objects collided, fragments from the crash could hit other satellites, creating more debris and triggering further collisions. If enough debris built up for the chain reaction to keep going on its own, it could continue even if no new satellites were launched. This is known as Kessler syndrome.
paras.zh: 辐射可能会使许多卫星完好无损，但无法导航。如果两个物体相撞，碰撞产生的碎片可能会击中其他卫星，产生更多碎片并引发进一步的碰撞。如果积累的碎片足够多，足以让连锁反应继续自行进行，那么即使没有发射新卫星，连锁反应也可能继续下去。这被称为凯斯勒综合症。

paras.en: Whether an explosion would trigger such a cascade is uncertain. If it did, the debris could endanger replacement satellites for years.
paras.zh: 爆炸是否会引发这样的级联尚不确定。如果确实如此，碎片可能会在数年内危及替换卫星。

paras.en: Could radioactive fallout reach the ground?
paras.zh: 放射性尘埃能到达地面吗？

paras.en: Some radioactive particles could enter the atmosphere and eventually settle on the ground. But a blast in space is too far away to sweep up the soil and water that carry fallout from a surface explosion.
paras.zh: 一些放射性粒子可能会进入大气层并最终沉积在地面上。但太空中的爆炸距离太远，无法扫除表面爆炸产生的尘埃的土壤和水。

paras.en: As the particles disperse, their radioactivity decreases over time. The concentrated local fallout that can expose people near a ground-level blast to high doses would be unlikely.
paras.zh: 随着粒子的分散，它们的放射性随着时间的推移而降低。集中的局部放射性尘埃不太可能使地面爆炸附近的人们暴露在高剂量的环境中。

articles.title: Pakistan’s Zeeshan Ali set for historic flight to China’s space station

paras.en: Islamabad, Pakistan – Pakistan is poised to send an astronaut into space for the first time on Wednesday, when an air force pilot joins China’s Shenzhou-24 mission to the country’s Tiangong space station.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦伊斯兰堡——周三，巴基斯坦准备首次将一名宇航员送入太空，届时一名空军飞行员将加入中国前往该国天宫空间站的神舟二十四号任务。

paras.en: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, 40, will fly as a payload specialist alongside commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi. The spacecraft is scheduled to launch from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center in northwest China at 8:18am Beijing time (00:18 GMT), or 5:18am in Pakistan.
paras.zh: 40 岁的穆罕默德·泽山·阿里 (Muhammad Zeeshan Ali) 将作为有效载荷专家，与指挥官唐洪波和飞行工程师吴仪一起飞行。该航天器计划于北京时间上午 8:18（格林威治标准时间 00:18）或巴基斯坦凌晨 5:18 从中国西北部的酒泉卫星发射中心发射升空。

paras.en: Speaking at a news conference in Jiuquan on Tuesday, China Manned Space Agency (CMSA) spokesperson Zhang Jingbo said the mission would mark the first joint flight by Chinese and foreign astronauts in the country’s crewed space programme.
paras.zh: 中国载人航天工程局（CMSA）发言人张静波周二在酒泉举行的新闻发布会上表示，此次任务将标志着中外宇航员在中国载人航天计划中的首次联合飞行。

paras.en: After reaching orbit, the spacecraft will carry out a rapid, autonomous rendezvous lasting about three and a half hours before docking with the forward port of the station’s Tianhe core module, Zhang said.
paras.zh: 张说，到达轨道后，航天器将进行约三个半小时的快速自主交会，然后与空间站天河核心舱的前端口对接。

paras.en: Ali’s stay will be brief. He will return to Earth on board the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft after a short joint flight, while Zhu Yangzhu, a member of that crew, remains in orbit for a year, Zhang said.
paras.zh: 阿里的逗留时间很短。张说，在短暂的联合飞行后，他将乘坐神舟二十三号飞船返回地球，而该机组成员朱杨柱将在轨道上停留一年。

paras.en: Pakistan’s Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO) has said Ali will spend about a week on the station.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦太空和高层大气研究委员会（SUPARCO）表示，阿里将在空间站停留大约一周的时间。

paras.en: “I want to assure you that I am not flying for myself. I carry the name of Pakistan on my shoulder, the hopes of 250 million Pakistanis,” Ali told reporters during the crew’s conversation with the media.
paras.zh: “我想向你们保证，我不是为了自己而飞行。我肩负着巴基斯坦的名字，2.5亿巴基斯坦人的希望，”阿里在机组人员与媒体交谈时告诉记者。

paras.en: Ali and Khurram Daud, a second Pakistani selected for astronaut training, are Pakistan Air Force pilots.
paras.zh: 阿里和库拉姆·达乌德是第二位被选拔参加宇航员训练的巴基斯坦人，他们都是巴基斯坦空军飞行员。

paras.en: They were selected through a three-stage process that began with screening in Pakistan and included medical, psychological and technical assessments.
paras.zh: 他们是通过三个阶段的过程选出的，首先在巴基斯坦进行筛选，包括医学、心理和技术评估。

paras.en: CMSA named them reserve astronauts on April 22 earlier this year. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif met them in Islamabad the following day, and on April 24, China’s Space Day, they joined the Astronaut Center of China in Beijing for training.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，CMSA 于 4 月 22 日任命他们为预备宇航员。第二天，谢赫巴兹·谢里夫总理在伊斯兰堡会见了他们，4月24日中国航天日，他们来到北京中国航天员中心接受训练。

paras.en: Before leaving, Daud asked Pakistanis to pray for him in a video released by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
paras.zh: 离开之前，达乌德在信息和广播部发布的一段视频中请求巴基斯坦人为他祈祷。

paras.en: “My message to you all is to pray for me, so that I can complete this training and this mission well, and make my nation and my country proud,” he said in Urdu.
paras.zh: 他用乌尔都语说：“我要向大家传达的信息是为我祈祷，以便我能够很好地完成这次训练和这项使命，让我的民族和国家感到自豪。”

paras.en: Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal, who is in China for the launch, paid tribute to both men on X on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 正在中国参加发布会的规划部长阿赫桑·伊克巴尔 (Ahsan Iqbal) 于周二向两人表示敬意。

paras.en: “They trained in centrifuges and simulators, in emergency drills and in a new language. Both performed exceptionally well in training. Though Zeeshan Ali will fly tomorrow both have already made Pakistan proud,” he wrote.
paras.zh: “他们接受了离心机和模拟器、应急演习和新语言的培训。两人在训练中表现都非常出色。尽管泽山·阿里明天将飞行，但两人已经让巴基斯坦感到自豪，”他写道。

paras.en: Thanking his instructors, SUPARCO and CMSA, at Tuesday’s news conference, Ali said: “No matter who flies, we have already made the history together.”
paras.zh: 阿里在周二的新闻发布会上感谢他的教练 ​​SUPARCO 和 CMSA 说：“无论谁飞，我们都已经共同创造了历史。”

paras.en: Daud was not named in the crew, and it is not yet clear whether he will fly on a later mission.
paras.zh: 机组人员中没有提到达乌德的名字，目前还不清楚他是否会执行以后的任务。

paras.en: In written responses to Al Jazeera, SUPARCO said the backup astronauts would serve as experts to help carry the programme forward.
paras.zh: SUPARCO 在给半岛电视台的书面回复中表示，后备宇航员将作为专家帮助推进该计划。

paras.en: Zhang said Ali would take part in the crew’s daily work but would mainly oversee China-Pakistan experiments, install samples and equipment and conduct tests in orbit.
paras.zh: 张说，阿里将参与机组人员的日常工作，但主要负责监督中巴实验、安装样品和设备以及在轨进行测试。

paras.en: The mission will include four joint science projects in biotechnology and materials, Zhang said. Ali will also conduct an experiment involving cyanobacteria, photosynthetic microorganisms.
paras.zh: 张说，该任务将包括生物技术和材料领域的四个联合科学项目。阿里还将进行一项涉及蓝藻、光合微生物的实验。

paras.en: Pakistan’s Information Ministry said in April that the experiments would cover materials science, fluid physics, life sciences and biotechnology, with potential applications in climate resilience, food security and industrial innovation.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦信息部四月份表示，这些实验将涵盖材料科学、流体物理学、生命科学和生物技术，在气候适应能力、粮食安全和工业创新方面具有潜在应用。

paras.en: Qamarul Islam, a space scientist and former senior official in the state-affiliated Institute of Space Technology (IST) in Islamabad, said the experiments had been shortlisted after SUPARCO invited research institutes in Pakistan to submit proposals.
paras.zh: 太空科学家、伊斯兰堡国家附属空间技术研究所（IST）前高级官员卡马鲁·伊斯兰（Qamarul Islam）表示，在 SUPARCO 邀请巴基斯坦研究机构提交提案后，这些实验已被列入候选名单。

paras.en: “Primarily these experiments are the experiments of the research institutes, universities and others, from Pakistan,” he told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “这些实验主要是来自巴基斯坦的研究机构、大学和其他机构的实验，”他告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: SUPARCO said the station was a fully equipped laboratory. It added in its response that Ali’s week in orbit was meant to start and install the experiments, and to record data confirming that the equipment had survived launch loads and vibrations and was safely installed in microgravity.
paras.zh: SUPARCO 表示，该站是一个设备齐全的实验室。它在回应中补充说，阿里在轨道上的一周旨在开始和安装实验，并记录数据，确认设备经受住了发射载荷和振动的考验，并在微重力下安全安装。

paras.en: “Completing the four experiments takes between six and 12 months,” it said.
paras.zh: “完成这四项实验需要 6 到 12 个月的时间，”它说。

paras.en: According to Zhang, preparations focused on professional skills, crew coordination and language.
paras.zh: 张说，准备工作主要集中在专业技能、船员协调和语言方面。

paras.en: “We focus on Chinese commands and technical terms to ensure accurate execution,” he said, in the English interpretation of his remarks.
paras.zh: “我们专注于中文命令和技术术语，以确保准确执行，”他在英文解释中说道。

paras.en: In a promotional video by the Chinese space agency, Ali, who described himself as a fighter pilot, said centrifuge, rescue and survival, and emergency procedures training were part of his preparation.
paras.zh: 在中国航天局的宣传视频中，自称为战斗机飞行员的阿里表示，离心机、救援和生存以及应急程序训练是他准备工作的一部分。

paras.en: “But the real challenge, honestly speaking, was mastering the Chinese language, because all the switches, all the software, all the programmes, all the voice announcements, everything is in Chinese. So we had to learn that and master that technical Chinese,” he said.
paras.zh: “但说实话，真正的挑战是掌握中文，因为所有的开关、所有的软件、所有的程序、所有的语音通知，一切都是中文的。所以我们必须学习并掌握技术性的中文，”他说。

paras.en: SUPARCO and CMSA signed their astronaut agreement in Islamabad in February 2025. Ali said the two countries had since moved quickly.
paras.zh: SUPARCO 和 CMSA 于 2025 年 2 月在伊斯兰堡签署了宇航员协议。阿里表示，两国此后行动迅速。

paras.en: “The two great nations of China and Pakistan have turned a pilot into an astronaut in a remarkably short span of time,” he said.
paras.zh: “中国和巴基斯坦这两个伟大的国家在极短的时间内将一名飞行员变成了一名宇航员，”他说。

paras.en: This year marks 75 years of diplomatic ties between the two neighbours. Zhang described the flight as another milestone in their cooperation.
paras.zh: 今年是两个邻国建交75周年。张将此次飞行描述为双方合作的又一个里程碑。

paras.en: “Pakistan is China’s all-weather strategic cooperative partner,” Zhang said, according to the English interpretation of his remarks.
paras.zh: “巴基斯坦是中国的全天候战略合作伙伴，”张说，根据他的讲话的英文解释。

paras.en: Pakistan’s Information Ministry said in April that the programme placed the country among a select group of nations involved in human spaceflight.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦新闻部四月份表示，该计划使该国跻身参与载人航天的精选国家之列。

paras.en: China built its own space station after being excluded from the International Space Station (ISS), in part because a 2011 US law bars NASA from bilateral cooperation with Beijing.
paras.zh: 中国在被排除在国际空间站（ISS）之外后建造了自己的空间站，部分原因是美国2011年的一项法律禁止美国宇航局与北京进行双边合作。

paras.en: “Chinese were left out. And obviously China developed their own space station. Pakistan is also out of the International Space Station as far as the astronauts are concerned,” Qamar said.
paras.zh: “中国人被排除在外。显然，中国开发了自己的空间站。就宇航员而言，巴基斯坦也被排除在国际空间站之外，”卡马尔说。

paras.en: He said China’s decision to choose Pakistan for its first foreign visitor reflected the two countries’ closeness.
paras.zh: 他说，中国决定选择巴基斯坦作为其首位外国访问者，反映了两国的亲密关系。

paras.en: Asked by a reporter on Tuesday whether China would expand cooperation, including joint flights with Russia, Zhang pointed to the station’s transport and astronaut-training systems. He said China hoped to explore space with more countries and regions.
paras.zh: 周二，当记者问及中国是否会扩大合作，包括与俄罗斯的联合飞行时，张提到了空间站的运输和宇航员培训系统。他表示，中国希望与更多国家和地区共同探索太空。

paras.en: SUPARCO said Pakistan was opening a path for international collaboration on the Chinese station and could now offer its expertise to other countries.
paras.zh: SUPARCO表示，巴基斯坦正在为中国站的国际合作开辟一条道路，现在可以向其他国家提供其专业知识。

paras.en: Asked by China’s state-run CGTN about the future of the partnership, Ali looked beyond the current mission.
paras.zh: 当中国官方媒体 CGTN 问及双方合作的未来时，阿里的目光超越了当前的使命。

paras.en: “I believe what comes after this flight matters more than the flight itself. This mission is not a finish line; it is a launchpad. And I hope the next chapter of China-Pakistan space cooperation to grow from one astronaut, one flight, to multiple joint flights, to Moon, Mars, and beyond.”
paras.zh: “我相信这次飞行之后发生的事情比飞行本身更重要。这次任务不是终点线，而是一个发射台。我希望中巴太空合作的下一个篇章能够从一名宇航员、一次飞行，发展到多次联合飞行，前往月球、火星，甚至更远的地方。”

paras.en: Pakistan’s government has also set a lunar target.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦政府也设定了登月目标。

paras.en: Asked about lunar plans, SUPARCO said Pakistan was already working with China on a lunar mission tentatively planned for 2028. It said it could not yet disclose details.
paras.zh: 当被问及登月计划时，SUPARCO 表示，巴基斯坦已经在与中国合作，暂定于 2028 年进行登月任务。该组织表示，目前尚无法透露细节。

paras.en: Pakistan’s lunar programme has so far focused on robotic missions. The iCube-Qamar satellite, developed at IST, reached the lunar orbit on board China’s Chang’e-6 mission in 2024. A SUPARCO-developed rover is due to fly on the Chang’e-8 about 2028.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，巴基斯坦的登月计划主要集中在机器人任务上。 IST 开发的 iCube-Qamar 卫星于 2024 年搭乘中国嫦娥六号任务进入月球轨道。SUPARCO 开发的月球车预计将于 2028 年左右搭载嫦娥八号飞行。

paras.en: Qamar, who was the project director for iCube-Qamar, said lunar missions ranged from flybys and orbiters, such as the satellite, to landings and eventually permanent bases.
paras.zh: iCube-Qamar 项目总监卡马尔表示，月球任务包括飞越和轨道飞行器（例如卫星）、着陆以及最终的永久基地。

paras.en: “In the long term you will see stations on the Moon, a utilisation of the Moon,” he said.
paras.zh: “从长远来看，你会看到月球上的车站，这是对月球的利用，”他说。

paras.en: China is also advancing its lunar programme. Zhang said preparations were under way for tests of the Long March-10 rocket and Mengzhou crewed spacecraft. The first flight of the Lanyue lunar lander was on track, he said. Beijing aims to put astronauts on the Moon by 2030.
paras.zh: 中国也在推进其探月计划。张说，长征十号火箭和孟州载人飞船的试验准备工作正在进行中。他说，揽月月球着陆器的首次飞行已步入正轨。北京的目标是到2030年将宇航员送上月球。

paras.en: For Pakistan, Qamar said, sending a person into space would introduce scientific challenges beyond the technology of getting there, including coping with isolation and supplying oxygen and food.
paras.zh: 卡马尔说，对于巴基斯坦来说，将人送入太空将带来超出到达那里的技术之外的科学挑战，包括应对隔离以及供应氧气和食物。

paras.en: “I think it will be really good learning for Pakistan to be involved in such thing because then it has many other applications on ground, applications in the medical field and other aspects,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我认为，巴基斯坦参与此类事情将是一次很好的学习，因为这样它还有许多其他地面应用、医疗领域和其他方面的应用。”

articles.title: Malaysia set to return thousands of Rohingya refugees to Myanmar

paras.en: Malaysia will send more than 6,500 Rohingya refugees back to Myanmar in a new round of repatriations, said Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim.
paras.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣表示，马来西亚将在新一轮遣返行动中将超过6500名罗兴亚难民送回缅甸。

paras.en: The announcement on Tuesday comes five days after the International Court of Justice in The Hague ruled that Myanmar’s security forces committed genocide against the Rohingya minority.
paras.zh: 周二宣布这一消息的五天前，海牙国际法院裁定缅甸安全部队对罗辛亚少数民族实施种族灭绝。
