paras.en: Malaysia has historically offered safe haven to exiles from Myanmar but has grown increasingly frustrated by large numbers of refugees, saying that hosting them has become a financial burden and security risk.
paras.zh: 马来西亚历来为缅甸流亡者提供避风港，但对大量难民越来越感到沮丧，称收容他们已成为经济负担和安全风险。

paras.en: In late September, around 1,500 migrants were sent back to war-torn Myanmar in an opaque scheme that concerns rights groups.
paras.zh: 9 月下旬，大约 1,500 名移民通过一项涉及人权组织的不透明计划被遣返回饱受战争蹂躏的缅甸。

paras.en: Addressing the Malaysian parliament, Anwar said 1,500 Myanmar nationals will be returned on three navy vessels from December 6 to 7. “For the month of December, 5,303 will be brought back by aircraft at the expense of the Myanmar government,” he said.
paras.zh: 安瓦尔在马来西亚议会发表讲话时表示，12月6日至7日，1500名缅甸国民将乘坐三艘海军舰艇返回。“12月份，将有5303人乘坐飞机返回，费用由缅甸政府承担”，他说。

paras.en: As of August, there were 225,740 refugees and asylum seekers registered with the UNHCR in Malaysia, around 90 percent of them from Myanmar, according to the agency’s data.
paras.zh: 根据该机构的数据，截至8月，马来西亚有225,740名难民和寻求庇护者在联合国难民署登记，其中约90%来自缅甸。

paras.en: The UN’s highest court ruled last week that Myanmar authorities must “allow and facilitate the safe, voluntary and dignified return” of refugees displaced either within Myanmar or abroad.
paras.zh: 联合国最高法院上周裁定，缅甸当局必须“允许并促进在缅甸境内或国外流离失所的难民安全、自愿和有尊严地返回”。

paras.en: Malaysia hosted Myanmar’s former junta chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing last month, despite criticisms from rights groups that the move risked legitimising Myanmar’s government and posed dangers for those being returned.
paras.zh: 马来西亚上个月接待了缅甸前军政府主席、现任总统敏昂莱，尽管人权组织批评此举有可能使缅甸政府合法化，并对被遣返的人构成危险。

paras.en: Anwar said his engagements with Myanmar’s former leader were part of efforts to safeguard Malaysia’s interests and in line with the ruling by the International Court of Justice, which was “to guarantee a safe and dignified return” for those fleeing persecution.
paras.zh: 安瓦尔表示，他与缅甸前领导人的接触是维护马来西亚利益的努力的一部分，并符合国际法院的裁决，即“保证那些逃离迫害的人安全和有尊严地返回”。

paras.en: The PM acknowledged that many asylum seekers in Malaysia were “victims of atrocities carried out by the Myanmar regime”, but said Malaysia could no longer afford to ‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌host refugees and that hoping for them to be resettled in third countries had not worked.
paras.zh: 总理承认，马来西亚的许多寻求庇护者是“缅甸政权暴行的受害者”，但他表示，马来西亚再也无力收容难民，希望他们在第三国重新定居的希望也行不通。

paras.en: Late last month, Malaysia said it would seek clarification from Myanmar about reports that hundreds of migrants recently returned to the country were being held in military detention.
paras.zh: 上个月末，马来西亚表示将寻求缅甸澄清有关最近返回该国的数百名移民被军事拘留的报道。

paras.en: Anwar did not mention the request for clarification, but said Malaysia reiterated its stance over concerns about the Rohingya and other ethnic groups, which was also underscored by the ICJ’s ruling.
paras.zh: 安瓦尔没有提及澄清要求，但表示马来西亚重申了对罗兴亚人和其他族裔群体的担忧的立场，国际法院的裁决也强调了这一点。

paras.en: The mainly Muslim Rohingya – described as the ‘world’s most persecuted minority’ – make up two-thirds of the 190,000 Myanmar refugees and asylum seekers in Malaysia, according to the United Nations.
paras.zh: 据联合国称，以穆斯林为主的罗辛亚人被称​​为“世界上受迫害最严重的少数民族”，占马来西亚 19 万缅甸难民和寻求庇护者的三分之二。

articles.title: US army says detonation of lead explosives in Iowa will proceed

paras.en: The United States military will proceed with its plan to blow up a deteriorating stockpile of toxic lead explosives in rural Iowa, according to the army’s top civilian official, after a federal appeals court gave clearance to the waste disposal operation.
paras.zh: 据陆军高级文职官员称，在联邦上诉法院批准废物处理行动后，美国军方将继续执行其炸毁爱荷华州农村地区日益恶化的有毒铅炸药库存的计划。

paras.en: In an announcement late Monday on X, Acting Army Secretary Adam Telle called the choice to move forward a “consensus decision” among all the federal agencies involved, as well as the courts and state officials.
paras.zh: 代理陆军部长亚当·特尔 (Adam Telle) 在周一晚间发布的声明中称，这一选择是所有相关联邦机构以及法院和州官员之间的“共识决定”。

paras.en: “Every expert agency agrees, and both Iowa’s current and incoming governors say the call belongs to the experts,” Telle said.
paras.zh: 特勒说：“每个专家机构都同意，爱荷华州现任和即将上任的州长都表示，这一呼吁属于专家们。”

paras.en: “We are proceeding with the controlled removal in full coordination with all state, local and federal authorities.”
paras.zh: “我们正在与所有州、地方和联邦当局充分协调，进行有控制的拆除工作。”

paras.en: The Army prompted a public outcry last week when details surfaced of its plan to conduct two controlled detonations of 68 drums containing almost 4,500kg (10,000lb) of degraded lead azide, a chemical used in munitions, at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa.
paras.zh: 上周，陆军计划在爱荷华州米德尔敦的爱荷华陆军弹药厂对 68 个装有近 4,500 公斤（10,000 磅）降解叠氮化铅（一种用于弹药的化学品）进行两次受控爆炸的计划细节浮出水面，引起了公众的强烈抗议。

paras.en: Environmental groups immediately filed suit to block the plan, raising public safety concerns over the likelihood that the explosions would release a plume of toxic lead dust over homes, crops and livestock far beyond the detonation site, about 240km (150 miles) southeast of Des Moines.
paras.zh: 环保组织立即提起诉讼阻止该计划，引发公众安全担忧，因为爆炸可能会在距离得梅因东南约 240 公里（150 英里）的爆炸地点以外的房屋、农作物和牲畜上释放大量有毒铅尘。

paras.en: The lawsuit challenged a special permit granted for the operation by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA).
paras.zh: 该诉讼对环境保护局（EPA）授予的特别许可证提出质疑。

paras.en: The EPA countered that a managed detonation would be far less risky than an uncontrolled, spontaneous explosion of the highly volatile material, a scenario the agency said was growing more likely as the weather turns colder in Iowa.
paras.zh: 美国环保署反驳说，可控爆炸的风险远低于高挥发性物质不受控制的自发爆炸，该机构表示，随着爱荷华州天气变冷，这种情况的可能性越来越大。

paras.en: According to the EPA, any attempt to chemically neutralise or relocate the storage drums would also risk an uncontrolled blast.
paras.zh: 根据美国环保署的说法，任何化学中和或重新安置储存桶的尝试也将面临失控爆炸的风险。

paras.en: A three-judge panel of the 8th US Circuit Court of Appeals last Thursday issued a temporary stay blocking the EPA’s permit while the court more thoroughly reviewed the case.
paras.zh: 上周四，美国第八巡回上诉法院的三名法官组成的陪审团发布了一项临时中止令，阻止美国环保局的许可，同时法院更彻底地审查此案。

paras.en: But Trump administration lawyers filed a legal notice two days later asserting that the Army intended to carry out the controlled detonation with or without court approval, citing an emergency exemption to federal environmental laws.
paras.zh: 但特朗普政府律师两天后提交了一份法律通知，声称陆军打算在有或没有法院批准的情况下进行受控爆炸，理由是联邦环境法的紧急豁免。

paras.en: Then, in another twist on Monday, US President Donald Trump weighed in on the controversy, ordering the Army to hold off on its disposal plan until the appeals court had ruled in its favour.
paras.zh: 然后，周一的另一个转折是，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对这场争议发表了意见，命令陆军推迟其处置计划，直到上诉法院作出对其有利的裁决。

paras.en: Hours after Trump’s edict on Monday pausing the army’s demolition plan, the 8th Circuit sided with the EPA and lifted the court’s earlier stay, removing the final legal obstacle. But the status of the detonation plan remained unclear until Telle’s announcement on Monday night.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一下令暂停军队的拆除计划几小时后，第八巡回法院站在美国环保局一边，取消了法院早先的中止令，消除了最后的法律障碍。但在特勒周一晚上宣布之前，爆炸计划的状态仍不清楚。

articles.title: Meet Colombia's fuzzy 'water guardians'
articles.author: John Otis

paras.en: MONGUÍ, Colombia — Moisés Moreno greets visitors at his greenhouse 10,000 feet high in the Andes Mountains. Underneath the plastic roof, he nurtures tiny seedlings that can grow to be 30-feet tall.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚蒙古伊——莫伊塞斯·莫雷诺在安第斯山脉一万英尺高的温室里迎接游客。在塑料屋顶下，他培育可长到 30 英尺高的小树苗。

paras.en: "Do you know anything about frailejons?" Moreno asks his visitors, who are mostly clueless.
paras.zh: “你知道关于frailejons的事情吗？”莫雷诺问他的访客，他们大多一无所知。

paras.en: Related to the sunflower, frailejons are the iconic flora of Colombia's high mountain wetlands, which are known as páramos, and are vital for the country's water supply.
paras.zh: frailejons 与向日葵有关，是哥伦比亚高山湿地的标志性植物，被称为“帕拉莫斯”，对该国的供水至关重要。

paras.en: The wooly fuzz on their leaves protect frailejons from the cold and absorb water from the cloud cover. This helps maintain moisture in the páramos, which are the source of major rivers, and much of Colombia's water.
paras.zh: 叶子上的毛茸茸的绒毛可以保护脆弱的植物免受寒冷，并吸收云层中的水分。这有助于保持帕拉莫斯河的水分，帕拉莫斯河是主要河流和哥伦比亚大部分水源的源头。

paras.en: But frailejons and the páramos where they grow face a growing array of threats, including farmers, cattle ranchers and coal miners who are gradually pushing higher into the Andes. In addition, climate change is warming the mountains, allowing invasive species to survive at higher altitudes and disrupt their fragile ecosystems.
paras.zh: 但脆弱的乔木和它们生长的帕拉莫斯面临着越来越多的威胁，其中包括逐渐向安第斯山脉推进的农民、牧场主和煤矿工人。此外，气候变化正在使山脉变暖，使入侵物种能够在更高的海拔地区生存并破坏其脆弱的生态系统。

paras.en: Of the nearly 150 species of frailejons, two-thirds are at risk and 17 are endangered, says Mauricio Diazgranados, a Colombian expert on the plant who is chief science officer at the New York Botanical Garden.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚植物专家、纽约植物园首席科学官毛里西奥·迪亚兹格拉纳多斯 (Mauricio Diazgranados) 表示，在近 150 种脆弱植物中，三分之二面临危险，其中 17 种濒临灭绝。

paras.en: "They are a keystone species for maintaining the páramos and play a key role in water production," he says. "But most frailejons are in trouble,"
paras.zh: “它们是维持帕拉莫斯的关键物种，并在水生产中发挥着关键作用，”他说。 “但大多数脆弱的人都遇到了麻烦，”

paras.en: When explorers first spotted the shrubs mysteriously protruding from the mountain fog centuries ago, they reminded them of hooded monks. Hence the name frailejon, which is Spanish for "big friar."
paras.zh: 几个世纪前，当探险家第一次发现这些神秘地从山雾中伸出的灌木时，他们让他们想起了戴着兜帽的僧侣。因此得名 frailejon，在西班牙语中是“大修道士”的意思。

paras.en: The long, thin leaves of some species bend toward the sky and resemble palm fronds. Many are stout in the middle because, rather than falling to the ground, their dying leaves slump down to form a brownish outer shell to their trunks.
paras.zh: 有些物种的叶子又长又薄，向天空弯曲，类似于棕榈叶。许多植物的中部粗壮，因为它们垂死的叶子不会掉落在地上，而是会掉落下来，在树干上形成棕色的外壳。

paras.en: The Muisca Indians, who once populated the area, considered frailejons to be sacred guardians of the water. When he first came across the plants as a teenager in Colombia, Diazgranados says: "I became completely captivated."
paras.zh: 曾经居住在该地区的穆伊斯卡印第安人认为脆弱的水神是水的神圣守护者。当迪亚兹格拉纳多斯十几岁的时候在哥伦比亚第一次看到这些植物时，他说：“我完全被迷住了。”

paras.en: By contrast, Moreno, 53, who runs the frailejon greenhouse, used to be one of the plant's predators. Growing up on a mountainside farm near the central Colombian town of Monguí, Moreno and neighboring farmers knew little about them and chopped them down to make way for potato fields and cow pastures.
paras.zh: 相比之下，53 岁的莫雷诺经营着 frailejon 温室，他曾经是这种植物的捕食者之一。莫雷诺在哥伦比亚中部小镇蒙吉附近的一个山腰农场长大，他和邻近的农民对它们知之甚少，他们把它们砍倒，为马铃薯田和奶牛牧场让路。

paras.en: "We viewed them as a nuisance," Moreno says.
paras.zh: “我们认为它们很麻烦，”莫雷诺说。

paras.en: Later, while employed by a coal mine, he was injured during a cave-in and vowed to work above ground in the fresh mountain air.
paras.zh: 后来，他在一家煤矿工作时，在一次塌方中受伤，他发誓要在山上空气清新的地面上工作。

paras.en: On his own he began studying páramo ecosystem that he'd grown up in, started his greenhouse and began leading tourists and volunteers on expeditions to replace the frailejons that had been wiped out.
paras.zh: 他开始独自研究他长大的帕拉莫生态系统，建立了自己的温室，并开始带领游客和志愿者进行探险，以取代已被消灭的脆弱地区。

paras.en: "I felt inspired to do something to protect the páramos," he says.
paras.zh: “我受到启发，想做一些事情来保护帕拉莫斯，”他说。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Colombia's National Parks agency and even its armed forces have gotten involved in reforestation campaigns after wildfires scorched thousands of acres of frailejons.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，野火烧毁了数千英亩的脆弱森林后，哥伦比亚国家公园机构甚至其武装部队也参与了重新造林活动。

paras.en: Yet many average Colombians have learned about the plant's importance through an enormously popular cartoon character called Ernesto Pérez. Shaped like a frailejon, he exhorts people to conserve the flora and fauna of the Andes, similar to the way Smokey Bear promotes forest fire prevention in the U.S.
paras.zh: 然而，许多普通哥伦比亚人通过一个非常受欢迎的卡通人物埃内斯托·佩雷斯（Ernesto Pérez）了解了这种植物的重要性。他的形状像一个frailejon，劝告人们保护安第斯山脉的动植物群，类似于烟熊在美国促进森林防火的方式。

paras.en: In fact, several of the volunteers Moreno is guiding up the mountain say the cartoon and its earworm theme song introduced them to the frailejon.
paras.zh: 事实上，莫雷诺带领上山的几位志愿者表示，这部动画片及其耳虫主题曲让他们认识了 frailejon。

paras.en: "The song is very contagious," says Nicolás Coronado, 25, who works for a Bogotá-based plastics company, and is carrying a 6-inch frailejon that he will plant in the páramo.
paras.zh: “这首歌很有感染力，”25 岁的尼古拉斯·科罗纳多 (Nicolás Coronado) 说，他在波哥大一家塑料公司工作，他手里拿着一棵 6 英寸的 frailejon，他将把它种植在帕拉莫。

paras.en: The hike takes the group up to an altitude of 11,000 feet, past streams, waterfalls and lagoons. Underfoot, the ground is damp and spongy. The area is a state park and frailejons dot the landscape. But there are also barbed-wire fences erected by farmers and a half dozen cows grazing on the mountainside.
paras.zh: 徒步旅行团将到达海拔 11,000 英尺，途经溪流、瀑布和泻湖。脚下的地面又湿又软。该地区是一个州立公园，景观中点缀着脆弱的树木。但也有农民竖起的铁丝网和在山坡上吃草的六头牛。

paras.en: Moreno and his assistants show the volunteers how to dig shallow holes, then add a bit of shredded tobacco as fertilizer, before nestling the tiny frailejons into the soil.
paras.zh: 莫雷诺和他的助手向志愿者展示了如何挖浅洞，然后添加一些切碎的烟草作为肥料，然后将微小的脆弱植物埋入土壤中。

paras.en: Their survival is no sure thing. Many die in the cold, harsh climate and those that take hold grow just a few inches per year.
paras.zh: 他们的生存并不确定。许多人死于寒冷、恶劣的气候，而那些扎根的每年只长几英寸。

paras.en: To help them along, the volunteers hold an impromptu ceremony, with one member reciting a prayer to connect with the mountain spirits and another blowing on a conch shell.
paras.zh: 为了帮助他们前进，志愿者们举行了一个即兴仪式，其中一名成员背诵祈祷文以与山神联系，另一名成员吹响海螺壳。

paras.en: By now, some volunteers have grown attached to the frailejons that they've carried up the mountain and have bestowed names on them. Among them is biologist Julieta Barba has baptized hers "Gerry," in honor of her mother.
paras.zh: 现在，一些志愿者已经对他们抬上山的脆弱的东西产生了依恋，并给它们起了名字。其中生物学家朱丽叶塔·巴尔巴（Julieta Barba）为她的儿子命名为“格里”，以纪念她的母亲。

paras.en: After patting some dirt around the plant's roots, she says: "I'm very excited for her future here in the páramo."
paras.zh: 在拍掉植物根部周围的一些泥土后，她说：“我对她在帕拉莫的未来感到非常兴奋。”

articles.title: Bleeding, birth defects: Congo residents sue over alleged mining pollution
articles.author: Emmet Livingstone

paras.en: Bleeding, birth defects: Congo residents sue over alleged mining pollution
paras.zh: 出血、出生缺陷：刚果居民因涉嫌采矿污染提起诉讼

paras.en: KOLWEZI, Democratic Republic of Congo — In a small cinderblock home in the scrub beside a Chinese-owned copper and cobalt mine in Kolwezi, a mother shares a story of devastating loss.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国科卢韦齐——在科卢韦齐一座中资铜钴矿旁灌木丛中的一栋煤渣砌成的小房子里，一位母亲讲述了她遭受毁灭性损失的故事。

paras.en: She believes pollution from the neighboring mine is responsible for her family's suffering.
paras.zh: 她认为附近矿井的污染造成了她家人的痛苦。

paras.en: She has lost three children. Two died at birth. A third suffered repeated nosebleeds before dying. One of her two surviving children has stunted growth.
paras.zh: 她已经失去了三个孩子。其中两人在出生时就夭折了。三分之一的人在死前反复流鼻血。她幸存的两个孩子中的一个发育迟缓。

paras.en: Now she and 26 other residents are taking the company to court in a rare attempt to hold alleged polluters accountable in the Democratic Republic of Congo. They are also suing the government, accusing it of failing to enforce environmental regulations.
paras.zh: 现在，她和其他 26 名居民正在将该公司告上法庭，以罕见地试图追究刚果民主共和国涉嫌污染者的责任。他们还起诉政府，指责其未能执行环境法规。

paras.en: Like other plaintiffs, she asked NPR not to identify her, fearing retribution from the company or government. Although the claimants' names are public in court documents, they want to avoid further exposure. Their lawyers also fear the plaintiffs could face intimidation from other locals.
paras.zh: 和其他原告一样，她要求 NPR 不要透露她的身份，因为担心遭到公司或政府的报复。尽管原告的名字在法庭文件中公开，但他们希望避免进一步曝光。他们的律师还担心原告可能会面临其他当地人的恐吓。

paras.en: "Our children are the first victims," she said, as the sun set over a nearby mound of mine tailings. "What we're hoping for is to see justice done."
paras.zh: “我们的孩子是第一批受害者，”当太阳落在附近的尾矿堆上时，她说道。 “我们希望看到正义得到伸张。”

paras.en: The plaintiffs, whose case began Nov. 3, describe similar problems: contaminated water, nosebleeds, skin rashes, miscarriages and birth defects, which they blame on mining pollution.
paras.zh: 原告于 11 月 3 日开始审理此案，他们描述了类似的问题：水污染、流鼻血、皮疹、流产和出生缺陷，他们将这些问题归咎于采矿污染。

paras.en: The mine, known as COMMUS, is owned by Chinese multinational Zijin and lies in Kolwezi, a city of more than 500,000 people in the heart of Congo's copper belt, a southern region with vast mineral reserves.
paras.zh: 该矿名为 COMMUS，由中国跨国公司紫金矿业拥有，位于科卢韦齐，这座拥有超过 50 万人口的城市位于刚果铜矿带的中心地带，是一个矿产储量丰富的南部地区。

paras.en: Congo is the world's second-largest producer of copper, and also the source of over 70% of the world's cobalt, a metal that is critical to the electric-vehicle revolution because of its use in rechargeable batteries.
paras.zh: 刚果是世界第二大铜生产国，也是全球 70% 以上钴的产地，钴因用于可充电电池而对电动汽车革命至关重要。

paras.en: Last year, the U.S. signed a sweeping economic partnership with Congo aimed at attracting American investment and challenging the dominance of Chinese companies in the country's mining industry
paras.zh: 去年，美国与刚果签署了全面的经济伙伴关系，旨在吸引美国投资并挑战中国公司在该国采矿业的主导地位

paras.en: Despite the global importance of Congo's copper and cobalt mines, however, environmental pollution from the industry has received comparatively little scrutiny.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管刚果的铜矿和钴矿在全球具有重要意义，但该行业的环境污染却受到相对较少的关注。

paras.en: In Kolwezi, pollution is severe. Neighborhoods near mines are often filled with an acrid smell that residents attribute to the sulfuric acid used to process minerals. A study published in June by environmental research organization Source International — carried out with the advocacy groups RAID and Afrewatch, and scientists from Congo's University of Lubumbashi — also highlighted the scale of the contamination.
paras.zh: 科卢韦齐污染严重。矿井附近的社区经常充满刺鼻的气味，居民将其归因于用于加工矿物的硫酸。环境研究组织 Source International 与倡导组织 RAID 和 Afrewatch 以及刚果卢本巴希大学的科学家共同开展的一项研究 6 月发表的研究也强调了污染的规模。

paras.en: Researchers found that levels of fine particulate matter, known as PM2.5, in Kolwezi were three to six times the World Health Organization's air quality guideline. The highest concentrations were recorded near the COMMUS mine.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，科卢韦齐的细颗粒物（即 PM2.5）含量是世界卫生组织空气质量指南的三到六倍。 COMMUS 矿附近记录到的浓度最高。

paras.en: These tiny particles can penetrate deep into the lungs and enter the bloodstream. Exposure poses health risks generally, but is particularly dangerous for pregnant women and young children.
paras.zh: 这些微小颗粒可以深入肺部并进入血液。接触通常会造成健康风险，但对孕妇和幼儿尤其危险。

paras.en: The researchers also tested dust samples and found residue of copper, cobalt and manganese, which they said pointed to mining waste as the main source. When the study was released, Source International's executive director, Flaviano Bianchini, said that "these are among the most concerning air quality results we have documented in years of monitoring pollution at industrial mining sites around the world."
paras.zh: 研究人员还测试了灰尘样本，发现了铜、钴和锰的残留物，他们说这表明采矿废物是主要来源。当这项研究发布时，Source International 的执行董事弗拉维亚诺·比安基尼 (Flaviano Bianchini) 表示，“这些是我们多年来监测世界各地工业采矿场污染所记录的最令人担忧的空气质量结果之一。”

paras.en: The study did not examine health impacts directly, and the authors recommended formal epidemiological research. Residents and health workers in Kolwezi nonetheless point to a string of ailments that they blame on a polluted environment.
paras.zh: 该研究没有直接检查健康影响，作者建议进行正式的流行病学研究。尽管如此，科卢韦齐的居民和卫生工作者仍将一系列疾病归咎于环境污染。

paras.en: In a dilapidated health clinic in the shadow of a mountain of waste from the COMMUS mine, nurse Héritier Bukassa said that people routinely break out in itchy hives. "Some sick people scratch themselves with knives to relieve itching," he explained.
paras.zh: 在 COMMUS 矿山堆积如山的废物阴影下的一家破旧诊所里，护士赫里蒂埃·布卡萨 (Héritier Bukassa) 说，人们经常会长出发痒的荨麻疹。 “有些病人用刀子抓自己以止痒，”他解释道。

paras.en: Bukassa added that women in the area also suffer from high rates of miscarriage, and that he had referred four babies born with congenital malformations — mostly cleft palates — to hospitals this year alone.
paras.zh: 布卡萨补充说，该地区的妇女流产率也很高，仅今年他就将四名患有先天畸形（大部分是腭裂）的婴儿转诊到医院。

paras.en: Respiratory illnesses are common too, Bukassa said, especially in otherwise healthy babies who develop breathing problems a few weeks after birth. "No one from the [mining] company has ever come to talk to us about this," the nurse said.
paras.zh: 布卡萨说，呼吸道疾病也很常见，特别是对于出生后几周出现呼吸问题的其他健康婴儿来说。 “[采矿]公司没有人来和我们谈论这件事，”护士说。

paras.en: Zijin, the owner of COMMUS, did not respond to emailed requests for comment. Neither did Congo's mining and environment ministries.
paras.zh: COMMUS 的所有者紫金没有回复通过电子邮件发送的置评请求。刚果矿业和环境部也没有这样做。

paras.en: The Cobalt Institute, an industry lobby, said that understanding environmental pollution requires "an evidence-based approach that considers all potential sources and contributors." It added that companies perform environmental monitoring and carry out mitigation measures.
paras.zh: 行业游说团体钴研究所表示，了解环境污染需要“采用基于证据的方法，考虑所有潜在的来源和贡献者”。它补充说，公司进行环境监测并采取缓解措施。

paras.en: RAID, which is supporting the plaintiffs alongside Afrewatch, described the case this month as one of "the most ambitious legal challenges yet brought by Congolese residents over industrial mining pollution."
paras.zh: 与 Afrewatch 一起支持原告的 RAID 本月将该案描述为“刚果居民迄今为止就工业采矿污染提出的最雄心勃勃的法律挑战之一”。

paras.en: The suit is an important test case that could lead to communities challenging other mines in the future, it added.
paras.zh: 它补充说，该诉讼是一个重要的测试案例，可能会导致社区在未来挑战其他矿山。

paras.en: The plaintiffs are seeking $1.3 million in compensation for health problems and medical expenses, as well as $5 million to restore the environment. Their lawyers say they worry their clients might come under pressure or intimidation to withdraw their testimony.
paras.zh: 原告寻求 130 万美元的健康问题和医疗费用赔偿，以及 500 万美元的环境恢复赔偿。他们的律师表示，他们担心客户可能会受到压力或恐吓而撤回证词。

paras.en: The mother, however, said she had no such fears. "We have a right to a clean environment," she said, "and to health."
paras.zh: 然而，母亲说她没有这样的恐惧。 “我们有权享受清洁的环境，”她说，“还有健康的权利。”

articles.title: California man accused of making online threats against ICE agents: DOJ

paras.en: A California man was arrested after allegedly making social media threats against Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents, the Department of Justice announced on Monday.
paras.zh: 美国司法部周一宣布，一名加州男子因涉嫌在社交媒体上对移民和海关执法人员发出威胁而被捕。

paras.en: Leonard Michael Fierro, 37, of Hacienda Heights, is facing one count of interstate threats.
paras.zh: 37 岁的伦纳德·迈克尔·菲耶罗 (Leonard Michael Fierro) 来自哈仙达高地 (Hacienda Heights)，他面临一项州际威胁指控。

paras.en: Fierro used social media to threaten violence against ICE agents, advocate armed attacks on government facilities and encourage others to participate in a violent revolution against the U.S. government, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Central District of California.
paras.zh: 据加州中区美国检察官办公室称，菲耶罗利用社交媒体威胁对 ICE 特工实施暴力，主张对政府设施进行武装袭击，并鼓励其他人参与反对美国政府的暴力革命。

paras.en: "Threats of violence against federal law enforcement officers is not protected speech. They are serious criminal acts that endanger public safety and undermine the rule of law," U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli said in a statement.
paras.zh: “针对联邦执法人员的暴力威胁不属于受保护的言论。它们是危害公共安全和破坏法治的严重犯罪行为，”美国检察官比尔·埃萨利在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: "We will aggressively prosecute those who seek to intimidate, harm, or incite violence against the men and women who enforce our nation's laws," he continued.
paras.zh: 他继续说道：“我们将积极起诉那些试图恐吓、伤害或煽动对执行我们国家法律的男女实施暴力的人。”

paras.en: Last month, the FBI became aware of threatening posts allegedly made by Fierro on Instagram. In multiple posts and stories, Fierro allegedly called for an armed uprising against the U.S. government, advocated for violence against federal agents and encouraged others to join him in conducting attacks against ICE facilities.
paras.zh: 上个月，FBI 发现 Fierro 据称在 Instagram 上发布了威胁帖子。据称，菲耶罗在多个帖子和故事中呼吁武装起义反对美国政府，主张对联邦特工使用暴力，并鼓励其他人与他一起对 ICE 设施进行袭击。

paras.en: In one post, he allegedly asked followers to meet outside ICE facilities, the White House and other government buildings to "take up arms" and "overthrow" the government.
paras.zh: 据称，他在一篇帖子中要求追随者在 ICE 设施、白宫和其他政府大楼外会面，“拿起武器”并“推翻”政府。

paras.en: Fierro also allegedly called for an armed mob to storm the Adelanto ICE Processing Center, break migrant detainees free and violently overthrow the government.
paras.zh: 据称，菲耶罗还号召武装暴徒袭击阿德兰托 ICE 处理中心、释放被拘留的移民并暴力推翻政府。

paras.en: Investigators also discovered that Fierro owned a firearm and had purchased approximately 700 rounds of 9mm ammunition in October and early November.
paras.zh: 调查人员还发现，Fierro 拥有一把枪支，并在 10 月和 11 月初购买了大约 700 发 9 毫米弹药。

paras.en: He also made extensive online searches about tactical equipment, ballistic protection, surveillance countermeasures, bolt cutters, GPS tracking devices, government facilities and the Adelanto ICE detention facility, according to investigators.
paras.zh: 据调查人员称，他还在网上广泛搜索了有关战术装备、弹道防护、监视对策、断线钳、GPS 跟踪设备、政府设施和阿德兰托 ICE 拘留设施的信息。

paras.en: Fierro allegedly researched specific ICE officers and searched for information regarding a leaked database of Department of Homeland Security employees. Investigators also said he had what appeared to be a planning checklist with references to tactical gear, ammunition, GPS trackers, a rental vehicle, communication equipment and other items allegedly associated with his plot.
paras.zh: 据称，菲耶罗研究了特定的 ICE 官员，并搜索了有关国土安全部员工泄露数据库的信息。调查人员还表示，他似乎有一份计划清单，其中涉及战术装备、弹药、GPS 跟踪器、租赁车辆、通讯设备和其他据称与他的阴谋有关的物品。

paras.en: On Nov. 5, FBI agents searched Fierro, his vehicle and his residence under judicially authorized search warrants, recovering a gun, 19 loaded magazines, more than 400 additional rounds of ammunition, tactical body armor, ballistic plates, GPS tracking devices, bolt cutters, digital devices and other equipment.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日，FBI 特工根据司法授权的搜查令搜查了 Fierro、他的车辆和住所，找到了一把枪、19 个装弹匣、400 多发弹药、战术防弹衣、防弹板、GPS 跟踪设备、断线钳、数字设备和其他设备。

paras.en: Authorities later reviewed data stored on Fierro’s devices and found several videos allegedly recorded by him in late October and early November in which he discussed initiating a violent revolution, targeting ICE agents and encouraged others to conduct armed attacks against government facilities and officials.
paras.zh: 当局后来审查了 Fierro 设备上存储的数据，发现了据称由他在 10 月底和 11 月初录制的几段视频，其中他讨论了发起一场暴力革命、针对 ICE 特工并鼓励其他人对政府设施和官员进行武装袭击。

paras.en: Investigators also recovered what appeared to be a farewell video that included Fierro talking about his anticipated death, leaving instructions for family members and saying that he expected to be found "riddled with bullet holes."
paras.zh: 调查人员还找到了一段看似告别的视频，视频中菲耶罗谈到了他预期的死亡，给家人留下了指示，并表示他预计被发现时“布满弹孔”。

paras.en: Notes with Spanish-language phrases that appeared to have been made to communicate with migrant detainees during a planned attempt to free people held at an ICE detention facility were also found by investigators.
paras.zh: 调查人员还发现了带有西班牙语短语的笔记，这些笔记似乎是在计划释放被拘留在 ICE 拘留设施中的人时与移民被拘留者进行交流的。

paras.en: If convicted, Fierro would face a statutory maximum sentence of five years behind bars.
paras.zh: 如果罪名成立，菲耶罗将面临法定最高五年监禁。

articles.title: Bringing hostages home: How Trump revived Rome's citizen-first ethos

paras.en: "Today America is the Roman Empire and New York is Rome itself." — John Lennon
paras.zh: “今天的美国是罗马帝国，纽约是罗马本身。” — 约翰·列侬

paras.en: When Rome lost a citizen to a foreign power, it did not negotiate from a position of weakness or wait for the right diplomatic moment to engage. It sent legions. Its actions were swift and total because Rome understood what no one else did: that a citizen is not a statistic, but the living proof that the state exists to protect its own.
paras.zh: 当罗马因外国势力而失去公民时，它并没有处于弱势地位进行谈判，也没有等待合适的外交时机进行接触。它派遣了军团。它的行动迅速而彻底，因为罗马明白其他人没有做到的事情：公民不是一项统计数字，而是国家存在是为了保护自己公民的活生生的证据。

paras.en: To be a Roman citizen was to carry the full weight of the Republic on your back. That protection wasn’t a privilege you earned or a favor you begged for; it was your right, simply for being Roman. And when that right was violated, the Republic didn’t file a complaint or turn a blind eye; it came to get you.
paras.zh: 成为罗马公民就意味着要背负共和国的全部重担。这种保护不是你赢得的特权，也不是你乞求的帮助；而是你获得的。这是你的权利，仅仅因为你是罗马人。当这项权利受到侵犯时，共和国并没有提出申诉，也没有视而不见。它是来抓你的。

paras.en: The young Julius Caesar learned this early. Captured by Cilician pirates in 75 B.C., he spent 38 days in their hands, joking that they had no idea who they had taken. When his ransom arrived and he was freed, he raised a fleet, hunted them down, and crucified every last one of them. That was Rome. You do not take a Roman and live to tell about it. That is the standard and the ethos that President Donald Trump has restored to America.
paras.zh: 年轻的尤利乌斯·凯撒很早就明白了这一点。公元前 75 年，他被西里西亚海盗抓获，在他们手中度过了 38 天，他开玩笑说他们不知道自己抓走了谁。当他的赎金到达并被释放时，他召集了一支舰队，追捕他们，并将他们全部钉死在十字架上。那是罗马。你不能带着一个罗马人活着去讲述它。这就是唐纳德·特朗普总统为美国恢复的标准和精神。

paras.en: Under President Trump’s steadfast leadership, this administration has brought home a record-breaking more than 100 unjustly detained Americans, including securing the release of every last hostage in Gaza — living and deceased. But the numbers are not the story. The story is the principle underneath them. And that principle is what sets this administration apart from all the others and why it is so successful at bringing Americans home. It’s simple: This administration does not treat the rescue of Americans as a burden to be managed or a category to be triaged. It treats it as a sacred mission, rooted in an ancient Western ideal: the state exists to protect its people, and no one is left behind.
paras.zh: 在特朗普总统的坚定领导下，本届政府破纪录地接回了 100 多名被不公正拘留的美国人，其中包括释放加沙的最后每一名人质——包括活着的和已故的人质。但数字并不代表故事。故事是它们背后的原则。这一原则使本届政府区别于其他政府，也是它如此成功地让美国人回家的原因。很简单：本届政府并不将美国人的救援视为需要管理的负担或需要分类的类别。它将其视为一项神圣使命，植根于一种古老的西方理想：国家的存在是为了保护其人民，不让任何人掉队。

paras.en: As in the Roman Republic, American citizens are the core of this nation — and abandoning one is a stain on the whole. This instinct is clearly visible in the personal promises President Trump has made and kept, like the one made to Marc Fogel’s 95-year-old mother, and in his willingness to use hard leverage against Venezuela, Russia, the Taliban and Hamas. Moreover, under President Trump, that ethos is backed by an executive order that lets the State Department designate countries as state sponsors of wrongful detention and hit them with meaningful sanctions.
paras.zh: 就像在罗马共和国一样，美国公民是这个国家的核心——放弃一个公民就是整个国家的一个污点。这种本能在特朗普总统做出和兑现的个人承诺中清晰可见，就像对马克·福格尔 95 岁母亲做出的承诺，以及他愿意对委内瑞拉、俄罗斯、塔利班和哈马斯使用强硬影响力。此外，在特朗普总统的领导下，这种精神得到了一项行政命令的支持，该命令允许国务院指定一些国家为错误拘留的支持者，并对它们实施有意义的制裁。

paras.en: The sheer credibility of President Trump’s policy of "peace through strength," which makes adversaries calculate that holding an American costs more than releasing one, combined with the personal dealmaking style that builds direct relationships with strongmen instead of relying on slow multilateral channels, is another reason this administration succeeds where others have failed. Moreover, the president’s explicit elevation of the issue to a top priority means that every embassy and envoy knows this is what the president measures himself by — and expects from them.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统“通过实力实现和平”政策的绝对可信度让对手认为，抓捕一个美国人比释放一个美国人的成本更高，再加上与强人建立直接关系而不是依赖缓慢的多边渠道的个人交易风格，是本届政府在其他政府失败的情况下取得成功的另一个原因。此外，总统明确将这一问题提升为首要任务，意味着每个大使馆和特使都知道这是总统衡量自己的标准，也是对他们的期望。

paras.en: That bias for action is the operational engine behind the historic numbers. Hostage negotiations usually die in process — committees, risk assessments, endless interagency reviews — while the clock runs on the person in the cell. This administration treats speed as a moral duty, not a risk. The contrast is sharp. The Biden administration let cases drag on for years — like the slow, bureaucratic approach that left people like Brittney Griner and Paul Whelan in limbo while lawyers and diplomats traded notes and held endless meetings.
paras.zh: 这种对行动的偏向是历史数字背后的运营引擎。人质谈判通常会在过程中终止——委员会、风险评估、无休止的机构间审查——而时间却在牢房里的人身上运行。本届政府将速度视为一种道德义务，而不是一种风险。对比很鲜明。拜登政府让案件拖延了多年——比如缓慢的官僚作风，让布里特尼·格林纳和保罗·惠兰等人陷入困境，而律师和外交官则交换纸条并举行无休止的会议。

paras.en: As in the Roman Republic, American citizens are the core of this nation — and abandoning one is a stain on the whole.
paras.zh: 就像在罗马共和国一样，美国公民是这个国家的核心——放弃一个公民就是整个国家的一个污点。

paras.en: President Trump’s team moves with purpose and alacrity in days or weeks, not years, because they see delay as a form of abandonment. And that includes all elements of the president’s team, from across the U.S. government, including the Office of the Special Presidential Envoy for Hostage Affairs, the FBI’s Hostage Recovery Fusion Cell, the National Security Council’s counterterrorism directorate and Special Presidential Envoy for Peace Steve Witkoff.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统的团队在几天或几周内而不是几年内有目的地和敏捷地采取行动，因为他们认为拖延是一种放弃的形式。这包括来自美国政府各个部门的总统团队的所有成员，包括人质事务总统特使办公室、联邦调查局人质解救融合小组、国家安全委员会反恐理事会和总统和平特使史蒂夫·威特科夫。

paras.en: Previous administrations waited for the other side to offer a deal, then spent months studying it. The Trump administration seizes openings the moment they appear or, better yet, creates them. When a window cracks open — a diplomatic thaw, a backchannel, a shift in a foreign leader’s incentives — they move through it before it closes, and if a case stalls, pressure is increased to create opportunity. That opportunism and decisiveness are what turned a stalled Gaza process into a completed deal, and brought former U.S. Marine Robert Gilman home from Russia, as well as Joseph St. Clair and 23 other Americans home from Venezuela.
paras.zh: 前几届政府等待对方提出协议，然后花费数月时间进行研究。特朗普政府在机会出现时就抓住机会，或者更好的是创造机会。当一扇窗户打开时——外交解冻、秘密渠道、外国领导人动机的转变——他们会在窗户关闭之前穿过它，如果案件陷入停滞，创造机会的压力就会增加。正是这种机会主义和果断将陷入僵局的加沙进程变成了一项完整的协议，并让前美国海军陆战队队员罗伯特·吉尔曼从俄罗斯回国，以及约瑟夫·圣克莱尔和其他 23 名美国人从委内瑞拉回国。

paras.en: Driven by an unwavering moral compass, this administration views every unjustly detained American abroad as a priority mission. Whereas Biden’s team treated these cases as liabilities — something to manage, contain and quietly resolve without drawing attention — the Trump administration inverts that entirely. There’s no triage here. No ranking cases by profile or political cost. No telling families to go away or be quiet. President Trump’s team tackles every case head-on, offering full transparency and accountability, because every American is a citizen of the republic, and the republic owes them all — just ask the families who have unfettered access to the entire hostage enterprise, including White House officials, from day one. Our refusal to categorize is what makes the mission sacred and righteous, rather than bureaucratic.
paras.zh: 在坚定不移的道德准则的推动下，本届政府将每一个在海外被不公正拘留的美国人视为首要任务。拜登团队将这些案件视为责任——需要在不引起注意的情况下管理、遏制和悄悄解决——而特朗普政府则完全颠倒了这一点。这里没有分类。没有按概况或政治成本对案件进行排名。不告诉家人离开或保持安静。特朗普总统的团队正面处理每一个案件，提供完全的透明度和问责制，因为每个美国人都是共和国的公民，共和国欠他们所有人——只要问问那些从第一天起就能不受限制地接触整个人质事件的家庭，包括白宫官员就知道了。我们拒绝分类，这使得我们的使命变得神圣而正义，而不是官僚主义。

paras.en: And the mission doesn’t end when the plane lands back on U.S. soil. Rescue is only the beginning, not the end. Our team stays with the person — rehab, counseling, rebuilding a life that captivity tried to erase. And when justice demands it, we go after the perpetrators themselves. The message is unmistakable: Take an American, and you will pay. Not someday, not maybe. You will regret it. That’s the Roman part in full. Rome didn’t just retrieve its citizens; it made the cost of taking one so high that few dared try again. The republic protected its own, and it punished those who harmed them.
paras.zh: 当飞机返回美国领土时，任务并没有结束。救援只是开始，而非结束。我们的团队会陪伴在这个人身边——康复、咨询、重建被囚禁试图抹去的生活。当正义需要时，我们就会追究肇事者本人。这个信息是明确无误的：选择一个美国人，你就会付出代价。不会有一天，也许不会。你会后悔的。这是完整的罗马部分。罗马不仅夺回了它的公民，而且还夺回了它的公民。这使得接受一项治疗的成本如此之高，以至于很少有人敢再尝试一次。共和国保护自己的人民，并惩罚那些伤害他们的人。

paras.en: The Trump administration carries that same standard and is united under that same coda because to be an American is something unique and special, envied by the world over and worth preserving: Every American home, every American family whole, and every enemy who thought they could profit from Americans’ suffering left to count the price, and the bodies.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府遵循同样的标准，并在同样的尾声下团结起来，因为作为一个美国人是独一无二的，是全世界羡慕的，值得保护的：每个美国家庭，每个美国家庭，以及每一个认为可以从美国人留下的痛苦和尸体中获利的敌人。

articles.title: Trump flirts with leftist Democrats on credit cards and could be flirting with disaster

paras.en: President Donald Trump is hinting that he might find common ground with incoming Democrats who are promising "affordability." In particular, he has signaled a willingness to work with Massachusetts Democrat Sen. Elizabeth Warren on capping credit card interest rates, and perhaps even with Michigan Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed on promoting universal healthcare.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统暗示，他可能会与承诺“负担得起”的即将上任的民主党人找到共同点。特别是，他表示愿意与马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦(Elizabeth Warren)合作限制信用卡利率，甚至可能与密歇根州当选参议员阿卜杜勒·赛义德(Abdul El-Sayed)合作促进全民医疗保健。

paras.en: These are terrible ideas. The president will not rebuild his popularity or dampen Democrats’ impeachment zeal by climbing aboard failed notions that will hurt the economy. Indeed, just the opposite is true.
paras.zh: 这些都是糟糕的想法。总统不会通过采取损害经济的失败想法来重建自己的声望或挫伤民主党的弹劾热情。事实上，事实恰恰相反。

paras.en: Trump should accept that the zealots eager to impeach him and punish his associates will not give up. Democrats know they were not elected because American voters have suddenly lost their enthusiasm for free enterprise. Instead, surveys have shown that Trump was indeed on the midterm ballot and was rejected by MAGA and Democrats alike.
paras.zh: 特朗普应该承认，那些渴望弹劾他并惩罚他的同伙的狂热分子不会放弃。民主党人知道他们没有当选是因为美国选民突然失去了对自由企业的热情。相反，调查显示特朗普确实参加了中期选举，但遭到了 MAGA 和民主党的拒绝。

paras.en: Moderate Democrats and even some on the left are warning that endless impeachments and investigations could hurt Democrats. Former Democrat New York City Mayor Bill de Blasio cautioned exactly that recently on a "Cats Roundtable" on 770 WABC. While acknowledging "there will be some investigations of one thing or another," he urged his party to not "get lost in that stuff. People don’t want bickering and endless negativity."
paras.zh: 温和派民主党人，甚至一些左翼人士警告称，无休止的弹劾和调查可能会伤害民主党人。纽约市前民主党市长比尔·白思豪 (Bill de Blasio) 最近在 770 WABC 的“猫圆桌会议”上发出了这样的警告。他承认“将对这一或另一件事进行一些调查”，但敦促他的政党不要“迷失在这些事情中。人们不想要争吵和无尽的消极情绪。”

paras.en: He’s right, but the tail wagging the dog of the Democratic Party may not care. The furious left threatens to primary established Democrats across the country as we approach 2028. While the liberal media keeps reassuring us that it is "moderate Democrats" who are now taking over Washington, it is clear that even supposed centrists like incoming House Speaker Hakeem Jeffries cannot resist the siren call of survival.
paras.zh: 他是对的，但民主党的尾巴可能不在乎。随着 2028 年的临近，愤怒的左派对全国范围内的民主党初选构成了威胁。虽然自由派媒体不断向我们保证，现在接管华盛顿的是“温和派民主党”，但很明显，即使是像即将上任的众议院议长哈基姆·杰弗里斯这样所谓的中间派也无法抗拒生存的诱惑。

paras.en: As to teaming up with Warren to cap interest rates, specifically holding rates at 10%, Trump is playing with fire. Speaking with Kayleigh McEnany on Fox News over the weekend, Trump suggested he was open to a one-year cap on interest rates and fees charged by lenders. He told the former White House press secretary, "I would do it," adding, "These credit card companies have made a lot and the credit card fees that they charge, I'm all into it."
paras.zh: 至于与沃伦联手限制利率，特别是将利率维持在10%，特朗普这是在玩火。周末，特朗普在接受福克斯新闻的凯莉·麦肯尼采访时表示，他对贷款机构收取的利率和费用设定一年上限持开放态度。他对这位前白宫新闻秘书说，“我会这么做，”并补充道，“这些信用卡公司赚了很多钱，他们收取的信用卡费用，我很喜欢。”

paras.en: The president acknowledged, "I know that some people would say it's not free enterprise, but what's free enterprise when you're sitting home and you get a bill that some guy set up in an office on Park Avenue and they said, 'Let's charge a fee that's too high,'" he continued. "So, I'm all for that."
paras.zh: 总统承认，“我知道有些人会说这不是自由企业，但是当你坐在家里，收到某人在公园大道办公室设立的账单时，他们说，‘让我们收取太高的费用吧，’”他继续说道。 “所以，我完全赞成。”

paras.en: This is not a new idea for Trump, who first suggested capping credit card rates during the 2024 presidential campaign.
paras.zh: 对于特朗普来说，这并不是什么新想法，他在 2024 年总统竞选期间首次建议限制信用卡利率。

paras.en: The problem with putting an artificial lid on interest rates, even if it’s for a limited time, is that credit card companies will respond by restricting credit. The reason rates are as high as they are, with some companies charging more than 20% interest, is that those lenders are facing high costs, and for some, have to charge more to compensate for losses.
paras.zh: 人为限制利率的问题在于，即使是在有限的时间内，信用卡公司也会通过限制信贷来应对。利率之所以如此之高，有些公司收取的利息超过 20%，是因为这些贷款机构面临着高昂的成本，对于一些公司来说，必须收取更高的费用来弥补损失。

paras.en: If you mandate lower rates, it will be the high-risk or subprime borrower who immediately loses access to credit. An analysis from the Committee to Unleash Prosperity, drawing on a survey of credit markets published by the American Bankers Association (an interested party, to be sure) concluded that 74% to 85% of existing credit card accounts could be closed or have credit lines reduced, affecting between 137 million and 159 million cardholders. This is pretty fundamental, and quite drastic.
paras.zh: 如果你要求降低利率，那么高风险或次级借款人将立即失去获得信贷的机会。释放繁荣委员会根据美国银行家协会（当然是相关方）发布的信贷市场调查进行的分析得出的结论是，74% 至 85% 的现有信用卡账户可能会被关闭或信用额度减少，影响 1.37 亿至 1.59 亿持卡人。这是非常基本的，也是非常激烈的。

paras.en: Opposition to a cap is also backed by research from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York examining usury limits, which are legal caps on the interest rates that lenders can charge. The study finds that these caps, imposed by various states, lead to reduced lending to riskier borrowers.
paras.zh: 纽约联邦储备银行对高利贷限额的研究也支持了对上限的反对，高利贷限额是贷款人可以收取的利率的法定上限。研究发现，各个州施加的这些上限导致向风险较高的借款人提供的贷款减少。

paras.en: Consumer debt has increased. The Federal Reserve Bank of New York reports that nationwide credit card balances have risen 67% since the beginning of 2021, helping to drive consumer spending. Pull the rug out from borrowers, and the economy will sink like a stone.
paras.zh: 消费者债务有所增加。纽约联邦储备银行报告称，自 2021 年初以来，全国信用卡余额增长了 67%，有助于推动消费者支出。把借款人的地毯撤走，经济就会像石头一样下沉。

paras.en: As to teaming up with Warren to cap interest rates, specifically holding rates at 10%, Trump is playing with fire.
paras.zh: 至于与沃伦联手限制利率，特别是将利率维持在10%，特朗普这是在玩火。

paras.en: As to possibly joining newly elected El-Sayed’s push for Medicare for All, Trump is going where no sane president should venture. El-Sayed is cleverly courting the president, flattering him by calling his proposal "Trumpcare," and posting a photo of a gold credit card, which the president reposted. Trump must resist.
paras.zh: 至于可能加入新当选的埃尔-赛义德推动全民医疗保险的行列，特朗普正在走向任何理智的总统都不会冒险的地方。埃尔-赛义德巧妙地讨好总统，称他的提案为“特朗普医改”，并张贴了一张金信用卡的照片，总统转发了这张照片，以此来讨好他。特朗普必须抵制。

paras.en: The horrors of government-run healthcare in the U.K. and in Canada are well known. Lengthy wait times and rationed healthcare are pervasive in those countries, as is unhappiness with their systems.
paras.zh: 英国和加拿大政府运营的医疗保健的可怕之处是众所周知的。在这些国家，漫长的等待时间和配给的医疗保健普遍存在，人们对这些国家的系统也普遍不满。

paras.en: In 2025, only "26% of British adults were satisfied with how the NHS runs," according to a British Social Attitudes survey which has been conducted yearly since 1983 by the National Centre for Social Research. The 2025 tally was considered a victory as it was up from an all-time low of 21% in 2024.
paras.zh: 根据国家社会研究中心自 1983 年以来每年进行的英国社会态度调查，到 2025 年，只有“26% 的英国成年人对 NHS 的运行方式感到满意”。 2025 年的数据被认为是一次胜利，因为它比 2024 年 21% 的历史低点有所上升。

paras.en: Compare that to an NBC survey last year which found a resounding 82% of Americans satisfied with their health insurance coverage, including most older Americans and those on Medicare and Medicaid. Only 18% were unhappy with their coverage.
paras.zh: 相比之下，NBC 去年的一项调查发现，82% 的美国人对他们的健康保险覆盖范围感到满意，其中包括大多数老年人以及享受医疗保险和医疗补助的美国人。只有 18% 的人对他们的报道不满意。

paras.en: About two-thirds of Americans have private health insurance, the majority provided by their employer. Under earlier proposals embraced by El-Sayed and Vermont Independent Sen. Bernie Sanders, private insurance would no longer be available. Progressives have tempered those suggestions of late, aware that the majority of the country will not stand to have their reliable program snatched away.
paras.zh: 大约三分之二的美国人拥有私人健康保险，其中大部分由雇主提供。根据埃尔-赛义德和佛蒙特州独立参议员伯尼·桑德斯早期提出的提议，私人保险将不再提供。进步人士最近缓和了这些建议，因为他们意识到该国大多数人不会忍受他们可靠的计划被剥夺。

paras.en: This is especially true for union households, which enjoy the luxury of Cadillac health benefits negotiated on their behalf. With Democrats struggling to hold onto blue-collar voters, undermining union wins would not be welcome.
paras.zh: 对于工会家庭来说尤其如此，他们享受代表他们协商的凯迪拉克医疗福利的奢侈待遇。由于民主党正在努力留住蓝领选民，破坏工会的胜利将是不受欢迎的。

paras.en: Our healthcare system is broken in many ways, but undertaking an overhaul that is projected to cost $25 trillion to $47 trillion, and that might make the average consumer less well-off, is not the way to go.
paras.zh: 我们的医疗保健系统在很多方面都存在问题，但进行预计耗资 25 万亿至 47 万亿美元的彻底改革并不是正确的选择，而且这可能会导致普通消费者的富裕程度降低。

paras.en: Republicans need – finally – to offer some common-sense answers on these topics and more. President Trump should lead that effort and abandon his flirtation with the feckless left.
paras.zh: 最后，共和党人需要就这些话题及其他话题提供一些常识性答案。特朗普总统应该领导这一努力，并放弃与不负责任的左派的调情。

articles.title: DR Congo says aircraft missing as rebels claim to shoot down plane

paras.en: The Democratic Republic of Congo says it is searching for one of its aircraft, after rebels said they had shot down a warplane in the east.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国表示正在寻找一架飞机，此前叛军称他们在东部击落了一架战机。

paras.en: The military said it had lost contact with a small Cessna 208 cargo plane on Sunday following "poor weather conditions". The fate of the plane and its crew remained uncertain, it added.
paras.zh: 军方表示，由于“天气条件恶劣”，周日与一架小型塞斯纳 208 货机失去了联系。声明补充说，这架飞机及其机组人员的命运仍不确定。

paras.en: On the same day, the rebel Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN) said it had shot down a warplane that was on a mission to bomb Minembwe in South Kivu province.
paras.zh: 同一天，叛军国家重建阵线（FRN）表示，他们击落了一架执行轰炸南基伍省米内布韦任务的战机。

paras.en: Four people were reportedly on board, including a Ugandan and a South African pilot, who is said to have been captured alive.
paras.zh: 据报道，机上有四人，其中包括一名乌干达飞行员和一名南非飞行员，据称后者已被活捉。

paras.en: The BBC has not independently verified the rebels' claim.
paras.zh: BBC 尚未独立证实叛军的说法。

paras.en: It is also unclear whether the aircraft reported missing by the DR Congo military is the same one rebels say they shot down.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚刚果民主共和国军方报告失踪的飞机是否就是叛军声称被击落的那架飞机。

paras.en: Uganda's military on Monday denied any involvement.
paras.zh: 乌干达军方周一否认与此事有任何关系。

paras.en: A statement attributed to army chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba posted on X said: "UPDF had nothing to do with the aircraft that was shot down in Minembwe. We have penalized that company."
paras.zh: X 上发布的陆军参谋长穆胡齐·凯内鲁加巴 (Muhoozi Kainerugaba) 发表的一份声明称：“乌干达人民国防军与在米内布韦被击落的飞机无关。我们已对该公司进行了处罚。”

paras.en: The statement did not identify the company or explain what penalty had been imposed.
paras.zh: 该声明没有透露该公司的身份，也没有解释所受到的处罚。

paras.en: Gen Kainerugaba later posted that "no Ugandan is allowed to work for mercenary companies in [DR Congo]".
paras.zh: 凯内鲁加巴将军后来发帖称，“乌干达人不得为[刚果民主共和国]的雇佣军公司工作”。

paras.en: Uganda's denial followed the circulation of a video apparently showing a man being questioned beside the plane's wreckage.
paras.zh: 乌干达的否认是在一段视频流传后发生的，该视频显然显示一名男子在飞机残骸旁接受讯问。

paras.en: In the footage, the man identifies himself as Ugandan and claims he had been sent by the government. The BBC has not independently verified the video or established the man's identity.
paras.zh: 在视频中，该男子自称是乌干达人，并声称他是政府派来的。 BBC 尚未独立核实该视频或确定该男子的身份。

paras.en: He and the alleged South African pilot are said to be the only other survivors.
paras.zh: 据说他和所谓的南非飞行员是唯一的幸存者。

paras.en: South African media outlet Mail & Guardian quoted an FRN spokesperson identifying the pilot as a South African and a "mercenary [who] has no link to the place that he was hired to destroy".
paras.zh: 南非媒体《Mail & Guardian》援引 FRN 发言人的话说，这名飞行员是南非人，是一名“雇佣兵，与他受雇摧毁的地方没有任何联系”。

paras.en: "Unfortunately, we have a multi-country conflict in the eastern DRC," deputy FRN spokesperson Oscar Balinda told the outlet.
paras.zh: “不幸的是，刚果民主共和国东部发生了多国冲突，”FRN 副发言人奥斯卡·巴林达 (Oscar Balinda) 告诉媒体。

paras.en: The Congolese government has in the past used foreign mercenaries to fight the rebels.
paras.zh: 刚果政府过去曾使用外国雇佣军来打击叛乱分子。

paras.en: In recent days, fighting between the FRN and the government has intensified with the rebel group accusing the government of targeting heavily populated areas.
paras.zh: 最近几天，革命阵线与政府之间的战斗愈演愈烈，叛乱组织指责政府针对人口稠密地区。

paras.en: The rebels control large areas of eastern DR Congo, including the major city of Goma, after major territorial advances last year.
paras.zh: 去年取得重大领土进展后，叛军控制了刚果民主共和国东部的大片地区，包括主要城市戈马。

paras.en: Aid agencies say the violence is increasingly disrupting healthcare services.
paras.zh: 援助机构表示，暴力事件日益扰乱医疗服务。

paras.en: Over the weekend, medical charity MÃ©decins Sans FrontiÃ¨res said fighting in North Kivu had forced some of its teams to temporarily suspend outreach activities.
paras.zh: 周末，医疗慈善机构无国界医生组织表示，北基伍省的战斗迫使其一些团队暂时中止了外展活动。

paras.en: The fighting has also affected the response to the Ebola outbreak, with many health workers trapped, according to the World Health Organization (WHO).
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织（WHO）称，战斗还影响了埃博拉疫情的应对工作，许多卫生工作者被困。

paras.en: The epicentre of the outbreak is in eastern DR Congo, which has been wracked by conflict for many decades, with some affected areas under rebel control.
paras.zh: 此次疫情的震中位于刚果民主共和国东部，该地区数十年来一直饱受冲突蹂躏，部分受影响地区处于叛军控制之下。

articles.title: Watch: Moment troops raid home and capture Mexican drug lord

paras.en: Watch: Moment troops raid home and capture Mexican drug lord
paras.zh: 观看：部队突袭家园并抓获墨西哥毒枭的瞬间

paras.en: Newly-released bodycam footage shows the moment troops entered a house and detained a Mexican drug lord who had managed to evade capture for years.
paras.zh: 新发布的随身摄像机镜头显示，部队进入一所房屋并拘留了一名多年来一直设法逃脱抓捕的墨西哥毒枭。

paras.en: The video shows armed personnel entering via a garage and finding Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, also known as 'El Chapo Isidro', who was on the FBI's most wanted list.
paras.zh: 视频显示，武装人员通过车库进入，发现福斯托·伊西德罗·梅萨·弗洛雷斯（Fausto Isidro Meza Flores），也被称为“矮子伊西德罗”，他是联邦调查局的头号通缉犯。

paras.en: Seven suspects were killed in last Friday's operation, as were four members of the Mexican army who were travelling to reinforce security in Guasave, Mexico's defence secretariat said.
paras.zh: 墨西哥国防部秘书处称，七名嫌疑人在上周五的行动中被打死，四名前往瓜萨韦加强安全的墨西哥军队成员也被打死。

paras.en: The arrest of Meza Flores in the northern Sinaloa state sparked a wave of unrest, which led to eight alleged drug cartel members being detained for their involvement in the retaliatory violence.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯在锡那罗亚州北部被捕引发了一波骚乱，导致八名涉嫌贩毒集团成员因参与报复性暴力而被拘留。

articles.title: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang

paras.en: Jensen Huang has been reinstated as the boss of Nvidia less than two weeks after he was forced to resign following the revelations of extra marital affairs, one of which was with a suspected Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋因婚外情被曝光而被迫辞职，不到两周后他又恢复了英伟达老板的职位，其中一次婚外情与一名疑似中国间谍有关。

paras.en: The AI chipmaker handed its co-founder his job back, despite rejecting his initial offer to return, after pressure from US President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 尽管迫于美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的压力，这家人工智能芯片制造商拒绝了联合创始人最初的回归提议，但还是将其职位交还给了联合创始人。

paras.en: Trump said he "made the deal" with the tech giant's board to get Huang his job back, but both the president and Nvidia are facing backlash from lawmakers.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他与这家科技巨头董事会“达成协议”，让黄重返工作岗位，但总统和英伟达都面临立法者的强烈反对。

paras.en: But his comeback added almost $1 trillion to Nvidia's market value as its share price jumped 31%, ending ended a streak of losses on the US stock market.
paras.zh: 但他的复出使英伟达的市值增加了近 1 万亿美元，其股价上涨了 31%，结束了美国股市的连跌。

paras.en: Nvidia's gains helped boost shares in other tech companies and financial markets in Asia while European markets were flat.
paras.zh: 英伟达的上涨帮助提振了亚洲其他科技公司和金融市场的股价，而欧洲市场则表现平平。

paras.en: However, despite the surge, Nvidia's closing price was still down from its Friday morning price amid investor concerns about the wider AI industry and future development.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管价格飙升，但由于投资者对更广泛的人工智能行业和未来发展感到担忧，英伟达的收盘价仍低于周五上午的价格。

paras.en: But it is a dramatic return for the man dubbed the "Taylor Swift of tech" to the company at the centre of the AI spending boom.
paras.zh: 但对于这位被称为“科技界泰勒·斯威夫特”的人来说，这对处于人工智能支出热潮中心的公司来说是一次戏剧性的回报。

paras.en: Attention will soon turn to Huang's appearance before Congress next week, where the Nvidia boss will be questioned over his relationship with Alice Huang, alleged to be a spy for China, due to national security concerns.
paras.zh: 人们的注意力很快就会转向黄下周在国会的露面，届时英伟达老板将因国家安全问题而就他与被指控为中国间谍的爱丽丝黄的关系接受质询。

paras.en: On Monday, the US Commerce Department announced it was preparing to blacklist Megaspeed, the Singapore-based Nvidia customer where Alice Huang (no relation) was chief executive. China has denied the spying allegations.
paras.zh: 周一，美国商务部宣布准备将总部位于新加坡的 Nvidia 客户 Megaspeed 列入黑名单，Alice Huang（无亲属关系）担任该公司首席执行官。中国否认了间谍指控。

paras.en: Harvey Jones, chairman of Nvidia's board, said Huang's reinstatement after originally resigning on 12 November was in the "best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers".
paras.zh: Nvidia 董事会主席哈维·琼斯 (Harvey Jones) 表示，黄仁勋在 11 月 12 日辞职后复职符合“我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益”。

paras.en: The board said it had received input from senior levels of the US government and was confident that Huang's reinstatement posed no national security risk.
paras.zh: 该委员会表示，已收到美国政府高层的意见，并相信黄的复职不会构成国家安全风险。

paras.en: Last Tuesday, the board explicitly said it did not intend to reinstate him following calls to do so and Huang himself stating he would be open to returning.
paras.zh: 上周二，董事会明确表示不打算让他复职，黄本人也表示愿意回归。

paras.en: The U-turn suggests Nvidia's board believe Huang is irreplaceable.
paras.zh: 这一转变表明英伟达董事会相信黄仁勋是不可替代的。

paras.en: The 63-year-old, who co-founded the company in 1993, transformed it from a chipmaker for video and computer games to the semiconductor powerhouse it is today, making the chips used in AI systems.
paras.zh: 这位 63 岁的人于 1993 年共同创立了该公司，将其从一家视频和电脑游戏芯片制造商转变为如今的半导体巨头，生产用于人工智能系统的芯片。

paras.en: It is now one the most valuable firms in the world. Some believed Huang's departure risked not only the future of Nvidia, but the wider AI industry given the position the company, under Huang, has in the financing of other tech firms.
paras.zh: 它现在是世界上最有价值的公司之一。一些人认为，考虑到黄仁勋领导下的英伟达公司在其他科技公司融资中的地位，黄仁勋的离开不仅会危及英伟达的未来，还会危及更广泛的人工智能行业。

paras.en: In a interview with CNBC on Monday, Trump said he had spoken to Nvidia's board of directors and convinced them to bring back Huang.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一在接受 CNBC 采访时表示，他已经与英伟达董事会进行了交谈，并说服他们召回黄仁勋。

paras.en: "They did ask for assurance on the national security threat," Trump said. "And we gave them assurances at least with everything we know. And we know a lot."
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“他们确实要求就国家安全威胁做出保证。” “我们至少用我们所知道的一切向他们保证。而且我们知道很多。”

paras.en: "People say, is it a threat to have him? No, it's a threat to lose him," the president added.
paras.zh: “人们说，拥有他是一种威胁吗？不，这是失去他的威胁，”总统补充道。

paras.en: The president was asked whether Nvidia stock losses after Huang resigned last week had influenced his decision to personally intervene.
paras.zh: 总统被问及黄上周辞职后英伟达股票下跌是否影响了他亲自干预的决定。

paras.en: Since returning last year to the White House, the president has amassed a significant level of investment in Nvidia.
paras.zh: 自去年重返白宫以来，总统已在英伟达积累了大量投资。

paras.en: Recent financial disclosures show he purchased $265,000 in its stock and sold as much as $15,000 worth of shares in September.
paras.zh: 最近的财务披露显示，他在 9 月份购买了 265,000 美元的股票，并出售了价值 15,000 美元的股票。

paras.en: A BBC review of his government financial disclosures for the last two years shows he purchased shares of Nvidia shares worth between $23m and $86m (Â£18m and Â£66m). And he has bought Nvidia stock 85 separate times through a number of investment accounts.
paras.zh: BBC 对过去两年政府财务披露的审查显示，他购买了价值 2300 万美元至 8600 万美元（1800 万英镑至 6600 万英镑）的 Nvidia 股票。他还通过多个投资账户分别购买了 85 次 Nvidia 股票。

paras.en: The value of those holdings would have been affected by the recent fall in Nvidia's stock price amid Huang's exit.
paras.zh: 这些持股的价值可能会受到黄仁勋退出后英伟达股价近期下跌的影响。

paras.en: Trump has also sold some of his stake in Nvidia since returning to the presidency. Over 19 sales, Trump gained between $3.5m and $10.2m, according to his government disclosures.
paras.zh: 自重返总统职位以来，特朗普还出售了英伟达的部分股份。根据政府披露的信息，特朗普在 19 笔销售中获得了 350 万至 1020 万美元的收益。

paras.en: Both Trump and White House have repeatedly rejected assertions that he has profited from the presidency. The president has said "everybody" was making money from rising stocks and he does not make decisions related to his investment accounts.
paras.zh: 特朗普和白宫都一再否认他从总统职位中获利的说法。总统曾表示，“每个人”都从股市上涨中赚钱，他不做出与投资账户相关的决定。

paras.en: The White House has emphasised that Trump has placed his businesses in a trust managed by his sons.
paras.zh: 白宫强调，特朗普已将其企业交给儿子管理的信托基金。

paras.en: Congress vows to investigate Nvidia and the Trump administration's role
paras.zh: 国会誓言调查英伟达和特朗普政府的角色

paras.en: The head of the International Association for Safe and Ethical AI, Prof Stuart Russell, told the BBC that the Nvidia board must have been under "enormous pressure" from the White House to reinstate Huang.
paras.zh: 国际安全与道德人工智能协会主席斯图尔特·拉塞尔教授告诉英国广播公司，英伟达董事会肯定受到了来自白宫的“巨大压力”，要求黄仁勋复职。

paras.en: Concerns remain among US lawmakers, including some Republicans, over Huang's actions and Nvidia's compliance with US export controls.
paras.zh: 包括一些共和党人在内的美国立法者仍然对黄仁勋的行为以及英伟达遵守美国出口管制的情况感到担忧。

paras.en: Hakeem Jeffries, who is expected to lead the House of Representatives as Speaker when Democrats take control in January, called the decision to reinstate Huang "indefensible, irresponsible and incomprehensible".
paras.zh: 民主党一月份掌权后，预计将担任众议院议长的哈基姆·杰弗里斯 (Hakeem Jeffries) 称，让黄复职的决定“站不住脚、不负责任、难以理解”。

paras.en: "We will not allow America's national security to be sold out by the Trump Administration for personal financial gain," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们不会允许特朗普政府为了个人经济利益而出卖美国的国家安全。”

paras.en: Huang is scheduled to appear before Congress for a closed-door interview with three House committees on 1 December. Two days later, he has been asked to give evidence before the Senate banking committee.
paras.zh: 黄计划于 12 月 1 日出席国会，接受众议院三个委员会的闭门采访。两天后，他被要求向参议院银行委员会提供证据。

paras.en: Senator Elizabeth Warren, who is set to be chairwoman of the Senate Banking Committee in January, said the reinstatement was "reckless".
paras.zh: 即将于一月份担任参议院银行委员会主席的参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦表示，恢复职务是“鲁莽的”。

paras.en: And the chair of the Senate's select committee on intelligence, Republican Tom Cotton said: "The controversy with Nvidia and Megaspeed is just the tip of the iceberg, and it's not resolved because Jensen Huang has his job back."
paras.zh: 参议院情报特别委员会主席、共和党人汤姆·科顿 (Tom Cotton) 表示：“与 Nvidia 和 Megaspeed 的争议只是冰山一角，问题还没有解决，因为黄仁勋已经恢复了工作。”

paras.en: With additional reporting from Brandon Drenon and Rachel Clun
paras.zh: 布兰登·德雷农 (Brandon Drenon) 和雷切尔·克伦 (Rachel Clun) 的补充报道

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life
paras.zh: Carlisle 推出 EL121 盘式制动器，以提高性能和磨损寿命

paras.en: (MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.
paras.zh: （俄亥俄州梅迪纳，2023 年 9 月 12 日）——Carlisle Brake & Friction 很高兴地宣布推出适用于矿用卡车应用的 EL121 盘式制动片。新产品系列将被命名为Extend Life，即EL系列，EL121将是该系列中首款推出的摩擦配方。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的 EL121 系列摩擦材料使前轴、矿用运输卡车刹车片的使用寿命几乎延长了一倍。使用 OEM 卡钳和转子时，可以增加设备的正常运行时间并降低维护成本。

paras.en: Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).
paras.zh: 自动运输卡车的刹车片温度较高，当使用缓速器和行车制动器时，制动周期的增加会导致刹车片磨损加剧。 EL121 采用高度耐磨的摩擦材料混合物，可延长刹车片的使用寿命，并具有一致且防褪色的制动性能。 EL121 是当今自动矿用运输卡车的理想解决方案（也可用于载人矿用运输卡车，以提高性能和使用寿命）。

paras.en: “We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司摩擦产品产品线总监 Ron Ratell 表示：“我们了解矿山运营商需要让运输卡车继续工作，而不是在车间进行制动维修。我们的最新创新技术可将前轴矿用运输卡车制动片的使用寿命延长一倍，并且是现有 OEM 制动片的理想替代品。这些制动片经过了彻底的实验室测试以及小松 830E-1 卡车的现场测试。”

paras.en: EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱苏州获得卡特彼勒 SER 认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: （梅迪纳，2024 年 1 月 25 日）——卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司宣布其苏州工厂获得卡特彼勒公司颁发的供应商卓越认可 (SER) 认证。卡特彼勒 SER 是一种新的供应商管理体系，具有“认证”和“优秀”级别。卡特彼勒于 2022 年正式启动该计划。卡莱尔苏州制造工厂获得了“认证”级别的认可，并与卡特彼勒团队在卡莱尔苏州工厂举行了仪式，庆祝这一成就。

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在 27,000 家供应商中，有 250 家入选卡特彼勒授予的奖项。 Carlisle 是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速箱摩擦产品供应商，也是全球唯一一家获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: “我们很荣幸被 Caterpillar 认可为认证级供应商，”Carlisle 制动与摩擦部全球销售副总裁 Doug Wagner 说道。 “该奖项是对支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的卓越努力和奉献精神的认可。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle 获得了 SER 认证，以表彰该公司对支持 Caterpillar 全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。

articles.title: Milwaukee Tool Introduces New M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 Battery Pack
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Milwaukee Tool has introduced the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 Battery Pack, delivering increased power and runtime for demanding applications across the M18 system.
paras.zh: Milwaukee Tool 推出了 M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 电池组，为 M18 系统中要求苛刻的应用提供更高的功率和运行时间。

paras.en: This new battery delivers 50% more power than the M18 REDLITHIUM HIGH OUTPUT HD12.0 Battery Pack and 25% more runtime than the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD12.0 Battery Pack, giving users the ability to get more work done than ever before. The new HD15 is also the same size as the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD12.0, giving the user more capability without sacrificing size and weight.
paras.zh: 这款新型电池的电量比 M18 REDLITHIUM HIGH OUTPUT HD12.0 电池组多 50%，运行时间比 M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD12.0 电池组多 25%，让用户能够比以往完成更多工作。新款 HD15 的尺寸也与 M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD12.0 相同，在不牺牲尺寸和重量的情况下为用户提供更多功能。

paras.en: “Our users continue to push cordless equipment into increasingly demanding applications, creating a need for greater power and runtime without sacrificing size,” said Zafir Farooque, director of product marketing at Milwaukee Tool. “With the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 Battery Pack, we’re expanding the capability of the M18 system by delivering our highest-capacity M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE battery with the power, runtime and durability professionals need for demanding work.”
paras.zh: Milwaukee Tool 产品营销总监 Zafir Farooque 表示：“我们的用户不断将无绳设备推向要求越来越高的应用，从而需要在不牺牲尺寸的情况下提高功率和运行时间。” “借助 M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 电池组，我们提供最高容量的 M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE 电池，为专业人士提供高要求工作所需的功率、运行时间和耐用性，从而扩展了 M18 系统的功能。”

paras.en: Built for high-demand applications, the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 provides 15 amp hours of runtime and reaches PWR Level 5 on the REDLITHIUM Power Scale. The combination of increased power and capacity gives users the performance and runtime needed to take on long-duration and demanding applications, and continue conversion from AC, gas and pneumatic solutions.
paras.zh: M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 专为高要求应用而打造，可提供 15 安培小时的运行时间，并达到 REDLITHIUM 功率等级上的 PWR 5 级。增加的功率和容量相结合，为用户提供了执行长期和要求苛刻的应用所需的性能和运行时间，并继续从交流、气体和气动解决方案转换。

paras.en: The M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 is engineered to minimize downtime in high-demand applications. When paired with the M18 and M12 Four Bay Simultaneous Super Charger, the battery can supercharge in 25 minutes to 80%, making it our fastest charging M18 battery. The battery is also COOL-CYCLE capable, providing high-speed cooling with COOL-CYCLE capable chargers to charge hot batteries 3x faster, helping users achieve less downtime in demanding applications and hot environments. Designed for demanding jobsite conditions, the battery features a patented ingress coating and upgraded venting design for increased protection while maximizing active cooling. A resistant housing further enhances durability by providing increased protection against exposure to common oils, greases and solvents.
paras.zh: M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 旨在最大限度地减少高要求应用中的停机时间。与 M18 和 M12 四槽同时超级充电器配合使用时，电池可在 25 分钟内超级充电至 80%，使其成为我们充电速度最快的 M18 电池。该电池还支持 COOL-CYCLE，通过支持 COOL-CYCLE 的充电器提供高速冷却，使热电池充电速度提高 3 倍，帮助用户在要求苛刻的应用和炎热环境中减少停机时间。该电池专为苛刻的工作现场条件而设计，具有专利入口涂层和升级的通风设计，可在最大限度地提高主动冷却的同时增强保护。耐用的外壳可提供更好的保护，防止接触常见的油、油脂和溶剂，从而进一步增强耐用性。

paras.en: For more information, visit milwaukeetool.com.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 milwaukeetool.com。

articles.title: NABC, Partners Donate Recycled Ride to Navy Veteran
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: On Tuesday, Nov. 17, a U.S. Navy veteran and single mother from the Twin Cities received a refurbished vehicle to help her maintain employment, continue building a sustainable future and create greater opportunities for herself and her family. The donation was made possible by the NABC Recycled Rides program, vehicle donor Farmers and repair partner Heppner’s Auto Body & Glass.
paras.zh: 11 月 17 日星期二，一位来自双城的美国海军退伍军人和单身母亲收到了一辆翻新车辆，以帮助她维持就业、继续建设可持续的未来并为自己和家人创造更多机会。此次捐赠是由 NABC Recycled Rides 计划、车辆捐赠者 Farmers 和维修合作伙伴 Heppner’s Auto Body & Glass 共同促成的。

paras.en: The recipient was nominated by the Minnesota Assistance Council for Veterans, whose mission is to end veteran homelessness in Minnesota.
paras.zh: 获奖者是由明尼苏达州退伍军人援助委员会提名的，该委员会的使命是结束明尼苏达州退伍军人无家可归的现象。

paras.en: Stacya May is a U.S. Navy veteran who proudly served from 2012 to 2017, conducting mine countermeasures. During her military service, she deployed to Bahrain in June 2014 and earned her Air Warfare pin. She was honorably discharged after five years of service.
paras.zh: 斯塔西娅·梅 (Stacya May) 是一名美国海军退伍军人，曾在 2012 年至 2017 年期间服役，从事反水雷工作。在服兵役期间，她于 2014 年 6 月被部署到巴林并获得了空战徽章。服役五年后，她光荣退役。

paras.en: Today, May is focused on building a stable and successful future for her and her family. She is currently attending college, pursuing a degree in supply chain logistics. Her goal is to complete her two-year degree and transfer to the University of Minnesota to continue her education.
paras.zh: 如今，梅专注于为她和她的家人打造稳定和成功的未来。她目前正在上大学，攻读供应链物流学位。她的目标是完成两年制学位并转学到明尼苏达大学继续学业。

paras.en: This vehicle will allow her to transport her disabled cousin to medical appointments, provide safer and more dependable transportation for her child, help maintain her educational commitments and support the stability that she has worked hard to achieve.
paras.zh: 这辆车将使她能够运送她残疾的表弟去就医，为她的孩子提供更安全、更可靠的交通，帮助维持她的教育承诺，并支持她努力实现的稳定。

paras.en: Additional partners in this presentation included: Enterprise; O’Reilly; Finishing Touch Car Care; Roseville Midway Ford; Auto Images; Southeast Towing; Showroom Auto Care; PPG; Inver Grove Honda; Advanced Vehicle Solutions; Advanced Remarketing Services; Cars for Charity; and Copart.
paras.zh: 本次演示中的其他合作伙伴包括：Enterprise；奥莱利；画龙点睛的汽车护理；罗斯维尔中途福特；汽车图像；东南拖车；展厅汽车护理； PPG；因弗格罗夫本田；先进的车辆解决方案；高级再营销服务；慈善汽车；和科帕特。

paras.en: Individuals in the community can support this program in two ways — donate to the program directly or donate their unwanted or non-running vehicle through the Changing and Saving Lives Keys for Change program. They will receive a tax donation for their contribution, and proceeds will help provide reliable transportation for those in need across the country — and in their community.
paras.zh: 社区中的个人可以通过两种方式支持该计划——直接向该计划捐款，或者通过“改变和拯救生命钥匙促进改变”计划捐赠他们不需要或未运行的车辆。他们的贡献将获得税收捐赠，收益将有助于为全国各地及其社区有需要的人提供可靠的交通。

paras.en: Farmers, a level one partner of the NABC, has donated nearly 100 vehicles to people and organizations through the Recycled Rides program.
paras.zh: Farmers 是 NABC 的一级合作伙伴，已通过“回收乘车”计划向个人和组织捐赠了近 100 辆车辆。

paras.en: Heppner’s Auto Body & Glass is an I-CAR Gold Class repair facility. With six locations, they have been serving the Twin Cities for more than 65 years, and have presented multiple Recycled Rides to people in need in their local community.
paras.zh: Heppner 的汽车车身和玻璃是一家 I-CAR 黄金级维修厂。他们拥有六个地点，为双子城提供服务已超过 65 年，并向当地社区有需要的人们提供了多个回收游乐设施。

paras.en: For more information on Recycled Rides, click here.
paras.zh: 有关回收游乐设施的更多信息，请单击此处。

articles.title: MANN+HUMMEL’s Hasmeet Kaur and Cedric Dackam on Anticipating What’s Next
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Hasmeet Kaur, president, Transportation Division, MANN+HUMMEL, and Cedric Dackam, president & GM, Automotive Aftermarket, MANN+HUMMEL.
paras.zh: 本期《DriveTime》由曼胡默尔运输部门总裁 Hasmeet Kaur 和曼胡默尔汽车售后市场总裁兼总经理 Cedric Dackam 担任嘉宾。

paras.en: As the automotive industry undergoes significant transformation, MANN+HUMMEL is leveraging its presence in both the original equipment and aftermarket sectors to deliver solutions throughout a vehicle’s lifecycle. Kaur explained how the company’s integrated business model enables it to anticipate customer needs, beginning with vehicle design and continuing through aftermarket service and repair. Rather than treating OE and aftermarket operations as separate businesses, Kaur emphasized how the two segments complement each other, allowing MANN+HUMMEL to address evolving customer requirements while positioning both for long-term growth.
paras.zh: 随着汽车行业经历重大转型，曼胡默尔正在利用其在原始设备和售后市场领域的影响力，在车辆的整个生命周期中提供解决方案。考尔解释了该公司的综合业务模式如何使其能够预测客户需求，从车辆设计开始，一直到售后服务和维修。考尔没有将原配设备和售后市场业务视为独立的业务，而是强调这两个部门如何相互补充，使曼胡默尔能够满足不断变化的客户需求，同时为两者的长期增长做好准备。

paras.en: Dackam highlighted the growing complexity facing aftermarket suppliers and customers. An aging vehicle fleet, electrification, advanced vehicle technologies and increasing parts proliferation are reshaping the industry’s challenges and opportunities. He said customers increasingly expect more than quality products, placing greater importance on predictive analytics, accurate coverage and access to vehicle data. He also emphasized how MANN+HUMMEL’s OE engineering expertise helps the company prepare aftermarket solutions for emerging technologies, including filtration applications in battery safety, thermal management and battery venting. Its established WIX, Purolator and MANN-FILTER brands further support the company’s ability to serve different market segments and distribution channels.
paras.zh: 达卡姆强调了售后市场供应商和客户面临的日益复杂的情况。车队老化、电气化、先进的车辆技术和零部件的激增正在重塑该行业的挑战和机遇。他表示，客户对优质产品的期望越来越高，他们更加重视预测分析、准确的覆盖范围和车辆数据的访问。他还强调了曼胡默尔的原厂工程专业知识如何帮助公司为新兴技术准备售后解决方案，包括电池安全、热管理和电池通风方面的过滤应用。其成熟的 WIX、Purolator 和 MANN-FILTER 品牌进一步支持了公司服务不同细分市场和分销渠道的能力。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Kaur emphasized MANN+HUMMEL’s commitment to innovation, sustainability and its core mission of separating the useful from the harmful. She pointed to investments in filtration media development and vertical integration that enable the company to accelerate innovation and tailor solutions to customer needs. Kaur also discussed her leadership philosophy, emphasizing trust, empowerment and creating an environment where teams can perform at their best. Dackam reinforced the importance of anticipating industry change and translating emerging technologies into aftermarket opportunities, noting that the company’s engineering capabilities, established brands and customer relationships provide a foundation for navigating the industry’s evolving landscape.
paras.zh: 展望未来，考尔强调了曼胡默尔对创新、可持续发展的承诺以及将有用与有害分开的核心使命。她指出，在过滤介质开发和垂直整合方面的投资使公司能够加速创新并根据客户需求定制解决方案。考尔还讨论了她的领导理念，强调信任、授权以及创造一个让团队能够发挥最佳水平的环境。达卡姆强调了预测行业变化并将新兴技术转化为售后市场机会的重要性，并指出公司的工程能力、知名品牌和客户关系为驾驭行业不断发展的格局奠定了基础。

paras.en: To hear more of Kaur’s and Dackam’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解更多考尔和达卡姆的见解，请务必观看上面的视频。
